'Ard As Nails.brief: Friendly WARBOSS model destroyed, its unit not yet selected to fight this phase: roll D6 (+1 if riled up); on 3+ the WARBOSS stays until its unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever first.

'Ardboyz Upgrade.brief: BOYZ unit only. This unit has 4+ Sv.

'Eadbanger.brief: ORKS PSYKER only. This model has the listed weapon.

'Ere We Go.brief: Your Movement phase, friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit selected to move: +2 to Advance rolls.

A CEASELESS CAUSE.brief: End of Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit eligible to fight this phase: if unengaged, Normal move of up to 6"; cannot embark if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

A CHALLENGE MET.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move, unengaged WYCH CULT unit within 6" of it: declare a charge, targeting only enemy units that Fell Back this phase within range.

A Challenge Worthy of Skill.brief: Attacks targeting a CHARACTER, MONSTER or WALKER unit: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

A Chink in Their Armour.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS only: each time bearer is set up as Reinforcements: bearer's unit ranged weapons gain [Lethal Hits] until end of your next Fight phase.

A DARK NETWORK.brief: Reinforcements step of opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit set up from Reserves, ASTRA MILITARUM or GENESTEALER CULTS unit (not MONSTERS/VEHICLES) within 12" of it: makes a Normal move of up to 6".

A DEADLY SNARE.brief: Opponent's Charge phase, enemy unit declares a charge, GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit targeted by it: roll one D6: 2-4 that enemy unit suffers D3 MW; 5+ it suffers 3 MW.

A Foot in the Future.brief: TROUPE MASTER only: bearer's unit re-rolls Charge rolls.

A Giant Amongst Giants.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY only. This model has +2 W; its melee attacks have +1 S.

A Gory Path.brief: This model's unit Consolidates up to 6" instead of 3".

A GRIM WARNING.brief: Any phase, BLOOD ANGELS unit just destroyed within range of an objective you controlled at the end of the previous phase: you keep control of 1 such objective until your opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

A LONG LEASH.brief: Your Command phase, 1 ABHORRENT unit and up to 2 friendly WAR DOG units: until your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units count as within range of the ABHORRENT unit's Aura abilities.

A Noble Death in Combat.brief: DEATH COMPANY model's melee attacks: re-roll Wound rolls of 1 if its unit is below Starting Strength ; re-roll the Wound roll if Below Half-strength.

A Perfect Ambush.brief: Each time a GENESTEALER CULTS unit is set up as Reinforcements: until end of your next Fight phase, its weapons have [Sustained Hits 1] and [Ignores Cover].

A Plan Generations in the Making.brief: End of your Command phase, if within range of an objective you control: it stays yours even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at start or end of a turn.

A TEMPTING TRAP.brief: Your Shooting phase (not rounds 1-2), T'AU EMPIRE unit not yet shot: first use picks an objective outside enemy deployment zone as your Trap marker for the battle; ranged attacks on enemy units within range of it get +1 to Wound this phase.

A Threat Ended.brief: Fight phase, PALADIN SQUAD unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Precision].

A TRAP WELL LAID.brief: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, KROOT unit not yet shot/fought: after its attacks, pick an enemy unit it hit; attacks of KROOT models (not Battle-shocked) on it get AP improved by 1 this phase.

A Trophy for the Throne.brief: Fight, TERMINATOR SQUAD unit selected to fight: +1 to wound against MONSTER/VEHICLE.

A Worthy Death.brief: Fight phase, enemy unit targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to fight: each model destroyed, roll a D6; on 4+ it stays until the unit has fought or end of phase.

A Worthy Skull.brief: Melee attacks vs a CHARACTER unit: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls; each time this model's unit destroys a CHARACTER model: gain 1CP.

A WORTHY SKULL.brief: Fight, BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit that just destroyed a CHARACTER or MONSTER: gain D3 BTP and you may spend BTP at once on a Blood Tithe ability.

A'rgath, the King of Blades.brief: KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA only. Bearer's melee weapons: +1 A and +1 S; +2 A and +2 S instead while within your Shadow of Chaos.

Abbess Sanctorum.brief: While leading a unit: attacks by that unit re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

Abhuman Detail.brief: COMMISSAR only. Can issue Orders to OGRYN units; in Declare Battle Formations, can be attached to an OGRYN SQUAD or BULLGRYN SQUAD.

ABLATIVE CARAPACE.brief: enemy Shooting or Fight, HARVESTER unit just targeted: Feel No Pain 5+ until end of phase; 4+ if within range of an objective you control.

ABLATIVE PLATING.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets are chosen, ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit targeted: until end of phase, -1 Damage on each attack allocated to it.

Ablative Plating#bebec22820.brief: Once per battle, when an attack is allocated to this model: change its Damage to 0.

ABOMINUS-CLASS TARGETS.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, GREY KNIGHTS unit not yet shot/fought: +1 to Wound against MONSTER or VEHICLE units.

Absolute Sensory Overload.brief: Your Shooting phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit selected to shoot: those ranged attacks do not prevent it from being hidden.

Absolutist Principles.brief: BULLGRYN SQUAD, OGRYN SQUAD and RATLINGS units have ABHUMAN; COMMISSAR models can issue the Take Aim! Order and 1 Order to an ABHUMAN unit. ABHUMAN tag: cannot be taken with another ABHUMAN detachment.

Abyssal Void.brief: Models in this unit have Lone Operative.

Accelerator Mandible.brief: Start of the Fight phase, 1 friendly CANOPTEK unit within 3" of the bearer's unit: WS of its weapons improved by 1 until end of phase.

ACCEPTABLE LOSSES.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM unit: pick an enemy unit within Engagement Range of GENESTEALER CULTS units; your unit can shoot it this phase; afterwards roll one D6 per such GENESTEALER CULTS unit: on 5+ it suffers D3+1 MW.

Accomplished Tactician.brief: Once per turn, opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shot: 1 friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit within 9" that was hit can embark in a friendly TRANSPORT it is wholly within 6" of.

Accuracy Under Pressure.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, re-roll Hit rolls for its attacks.

Acheron’s Duty (Bondsman).brief: Affected model, start of Fight phase: each enemy unit within Engagement Range of units with this ability takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Achillan Eye.brief: Radium jezzail attacks vs INFANTRY: re-roll Wound roll; Skatros transuranic arquebus attacks vs MONSTER/VEHICLE: re-roll Wound roll.

Acquisition at any cost.brief: Start of your Command phase: pick 1 objective as Acquisition objective until your next Command phase; ADEPTUS MECHANICUS models within range of it, or attacking a target within range of it, re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Acquisitor-at-Arms.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Bearer on your defensive line with no enemy unit on it: each model affected by its Bondsman ability adds the bearer's OC to its own.

Acrobatic.brief: Can charge in a turn it Advanced or Fell Back.

Acrobatic Display.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit targets a WYCH CULT unit: your unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

ACROBATIC DISPLAY.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, WYCH CULT unit just targeted: 5+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Acrobatic Escape.brief: End of Fight phase, if engaged: fall-back move of up to D6"; end of opponent's turn, if more than 3" from all enemies: place in Strategic Reserves, must ingress in your next Movement phase.

Acrobatic Gladiators (Pain).brief: Start of your Charge phase, spend 1 Pain token to Empower: this unit can charge in a turn it Advanced or Fell Back.

Acrobatic Grace.brief: Stealth; melee attacks against this unit: -1 to Hit.

Acrobatic Onslaught#106b8ea3f5.brief: HARLEQUINS units can move through enemy models while making a Charge move. Acrobatic tag: cannot be taken with another Acrobatic detachment.

Acrobatic Onslaught#56a02db60a.brief: HARLEQUINS models can move through enemy models when making a Charge move.

Acts of Faith.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS army: 1 Miracle dice (D6, fixed value) at start of each turn and per friendly unit destroyed; each unit, once per phase, before an Advance, Battle-shock, Charge, Damage, Hit, Save or Wound roll: swap 1 dice for a Miracle dice.

Adamantine Avalanche.brief: start of Fight, a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD is engaged: Blessings of Khorne roll, 1 extra Blessing active for TERMINATOR SQUAD units until end of phase.

Adamantine Behemoth.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit not yet selected to move or charge: until end of phase, its Normal, Advance and Charge moves can pass horizontally through terrain features.

Adamantine Mantle.brief: Attack allocated to the bearer: -1 D; if made with a [Melta] or [Torrent] weapon: D changed to 1 instead.

Adamantine Terror.brief: Start of the Fight phase, DREADNOUGHT unit: each enemy unit engaged with it makes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Adamantine Will.brief: While leading: models in the unit have [Feel No Pain 4+] against Psychic Attacks.

ADAPTABLE AVARICE.brief: Start of any phase while your army has Fortify Takeover, LEAGUES OF VOTANN CHARACTER unit: spend any YP ; if you then have 6 or fewer YP, your units have Hostile Acquisition instead until your next turn.

Adaptable Executioner#f6c48f2be0.brief: EXECRATOR only. When selected to fight: this model's melee attacks have [Cleave 1]; or [Precision].

Adaptable Predators.brief: can shoot and charge in a turn it Fell Back.

Adaptive Biology.brief: TYRANIDS only. Bearer: [Feel No Pain 5+]; at start of any turn, if below starting wounds: [Feel No Pain 4+] instead until end of battle.

Adaptive Defence.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within a terrain area: re-roll Wound rolls of 1. Entrenched = in a terrain area, not set up this turn, no model moved more than 3" this turn. DARNATH LYSANDER/TOR GARADON always entrenched. Only IMPERIAL FISTS, no other Chapter.

Adaptive Instincts.brief: once per turn, Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight or targeted: melee attacks +1 S; or +1 T.

Adaptive Optimisation.brief: Command, MAWLOC or TRYGON unit: it has SYNAPSE until your next Command.

Adaptive Reprisal.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY only. Heroic Intervention on this unit: -1 CP.

Adaptive Strategy#6613e7fe57.brief: Your Command phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: pick one combat doctrine, active for it until your next Command phase.

Adaptive Strategy#af703a5854.brief: This model's unit is eligible to shoot and charge in a turn it Fell Back.

Adaptive Tactics.brief: your Command phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: select 1 combat doctrine, active for it until the start of your next Command phase.

ADAPTIVE TACTICS.brief: Your Command phase, DEATHWATCH unit: choose Furor, Malleus or Purgatus Tactics; until your next Command phase it is active for this unit instead of the army's, even if already used this battle.

Additional Armour.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets are chosen, ASTRA MILITARUM unit targeted: until end of phase, attacks targeting it have -1 AP.

Adept of the Codex.brief: CAPTAIN only. Tactical Doctrine active for this unit in addition to any other Combat Doctrine.

Adept of the Omnissiah.brief: TECHMARINE only. Once per battle round, per army, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6" of this unit: that VEHICLE has Feel No Pain 5+ until that enemy unit has attacked.

Admired Leader.brief: T'AU EMPIRE (not KROOT) only. Your Command phase: 1 KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit within 12" has +1 Ld and +1 OC until your next Command phase.

Adrenal Infusions.brief: ANHRATHE INFANTRY only: can perform the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre without a Battle Focus token, even if other units did it this phase, and without preventing others from doing it.

ADRENAL SURGE.brief: Fight, up to 2 TYRANIDS units in Synapse Range (or 1 other): unmodified hit rolls of 5+ are Critical Hits until end of phase.

Adrenaline Junkies.brief: Friendly WARBIKERS units have BATTLELINE. When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit Advances/Falls Back: its ranged attacks have [Assault] until end of the turn, and that move does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge.

Adrenalised Onslaught.brief: TYRANIDS only. Bearer's unit's Pile In and Consolidation moves: +3".

ADVANCE AND CLAIM.brief: Your Command phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TRANSPORT carrying a TORMENTORS unit (not Battle-shocked): 1 objective you control in its range stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Advanced Armour.brief: Models in this unit have Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

Advanced Firepower.brief: Ranged attacks vs a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit: re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.

Advanced Guardian Drone.brief: Ranged attacks targeting the bearer: -1 to the Wound roll.

Advanced Quantum Shielding.brief: Each attack targeting this model with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound roll.

Advanced Scouting.brief: Each time this model's ranged attack hits an enemy unit: until end of turn, other KROOT models from your army re-roll Hit rolls against that unit.

ADVANCED STABILISERS.brief: Shooting phase, GRAV-ASSAULT unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Assault].

AEGIS ETERNAL.brief: opponent's Shooting phase, GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit selected as a target: its models wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ Inv until end of phase.

Aegis of the Emperor.brief: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability: [Feel No Pain 5+] against mortal wounds.

Aerial Assault#5fdda56d82.brief: A Deep Strike unit disembarking from this model after it made a Normal move: still eligible to charge this turn.

Aerial Deployment.brief: Your first Movement phase: this unit can make an ingress move.

Aerial Manoover.brief: End of your opponent's Fight phase, if unengaged: you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

Aerial Seeding.brief: Must start in Reserves (not counted in Reserves limits, nor its passengers); arrives in Reinforcements step of Movement phase 1-3; passengers disembark at once, >8" from enemies; no embarking afterwards.

Aerialists.brief: End of Fight phase, if this TRANSPORT is empty: one friendly DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit (≤6 models, no FLY) wholly within 6" and not in Engagement Range can embark, even if it disembarked this turn.

Aethersails#36e4cc5e07.brief: While DRUKHARI units are embarked: re-roll Advance and Charge rolls.

Aethersails#aca0ec0b05.brief: Advancing: no Advance roll; +6" to Move until end of phase instead.

Aethersense (Psychic).brief: Enemy units arriving from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

Aetherstride (Psychic).brief: Your Movement phase, set up via Deep Strike: can be placed more than 6" from all enemy units; until end of turn, Dark Blessing has [Sustained Hits D3] and it cannot declare a charge.

Against the Horde.brief: Attacks vs a visible enemy unit: can ignore any modifiers to the Hit roll; weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Agent of Discord.brief: Once per turn, opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem: +1 CP to its cost.

Aggravus Spasms.brief: Start of your Shooting phase, DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit: 1 visible enemy unit within Contagion Range gets +6" detection range.

Aggressive Advance.brief: While leading a unit: models in that unit have Move 10" and can move horizontally through terrain on Normal, Advance, Fall Back and Charge moves.

AGGRESSIVE ANTICIPATION.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit not yet shot/fought: its attacks re-roll Hit rolls.

Aggressive Assault.brief: Ranged attacks vs the closest eligible target: +1 to Hit.

Aggressive Deployment#11f2b3184a.brief: Declare Battle Formations, bearer starts embarked in a DEDICATED TRANSPORT: that transport has Scouts 9".

Aggressive Deployment#18a042749b.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit; until end of phase, attacks against it by friendly models that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn re-roll the Wound roll.

Aggressive Disembarkation.brief: Any phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked in a TRANSPORT selected to move: each model can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT (instead of wholly within).

AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION.brief: your Movement, WORLD EATERS RHINO not yet moved: 1 WORLD EATERS unit inside disembarks wholly within 6" of it, even into Engagement Range.

Aggressive Impulse.brief: Your Movement phase, SKORPIUS DUNERIDER not yet moved: until end of turn, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units disembarking from it after its Normal move can still charge this turn.

Aggressive Leader‑beast.brief: opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots, if models of this unit were destroyed: Surge move of D6" towards the closest enemy unit (not AIRCRAFT), may engage it; 1/phase, not if Battle-shocked or engaged.

AGGRESSIVE MOBILITY.brief: Your Movement phase, T'AU EMPIRE unit not yet moved: if it Advances, no Advance roll; instead +6" Move this phase.

AGGRESSIVE ONSLAUGHT.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that just Advanced: can shoot or charge this turn ; or give in to the Red Thirst: Battle-shocked but can shoot and charge.

Aggressive Reconnaissance.brief: Your Shooting phase: ranged attacks targeting an enemy unit not within 6" of other enemy units have +1 to wound.

AGGRESSOR IMPERATIVE.brief: Your Movement phase, 1 SKITARII unit not yet moved (+1 non-BATTLELINE SKITARII unit within 6" if it is BATTLELINE): when advancing, no advance roll, +6" M instead.

Agile Combatant.brief: Can shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Agile Reach.brief: When selected to fight: unengaged models within 3" of an enemy unit engaged with this unit can target it with melee weapons.

Agonised Cacophony.brief: Start of your Shooting phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" gets +6" detection range.

Agonising Suppression (Pain).brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; after shooting, 1 enemy unit hit is suppressed until your next turn (-1 to Hit).

Air Caste Colossus.brief: Stratagems targeting this model cost three times their stated CP cost.

Airborne Agility.brief: End of opponent's turn, if not within Engagement Range of enemy units: can be removed and placed into Strategic Reserves.

Airborne Evasion.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if not in Engagement Range: Normal move up to 6", then cannot charge this turn.

Airborne Insertion.brief: End of your opponent's Movement phase: units embarked within this TRANSPORT can disembark.

Airborne Predator#9424f9afd6.brief: Attack targeting a unit that can FLY: +1 to Hit roll.

Airborne Predator#cf4e484454.brief: Attacks vs a unit that can FLY: +1 to Hit.

Airborne Predator#e363fa2aab.brief: ranged attacks of this model against a unit that can FLY: +1 to Hit roll.

Airborne Predator#f6c3a2513d.brief: End of Normal move: 1 enemy unit moved over, roll 2D6 (+1 each if it can FLY): each 4+ = D3 MW.

Akshur's Binding Runes.brief: Bearer's unit can Deep Strike in the Reinforcements step of your 1st, 2nd or 3rd Movement phase, regardless of mission rules.

Alacritous Assault.brief: ANHRATHE only: melee weapons of the unit have [Lance].

Alchemicus Familiar.brief: Once per battle, when bearer's unit is selected to fight: until end of phase, attacks by the unit targeting INFANTRY get +1 to Wound roll.

Alchemyk Counteragents.brief: Bearer's unit has Feel No Pain 6+ against MW.

Alien Cunning.brief: TYRANIDS only. After deployment: redeploy up to 3 TYRANIDS units; they can be set up in Strategic Reserves regardless of limits.

Alien Expertise.brief: Your Movement phase, KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit selected to Advance: that move does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

Alien Majesty.brief: ABOMINANT, BIOPHAGUS or PATRIARCH only. Enemy units within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit: -1 OC (min 1).

Alien Physiology.brief: enemy Shooting or Fight, TYRANID WARRIORS unit targeted: attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

All is Dust.brief: Attack with unmodified Damage 1 allocated to a RUBRICAE model: +1 to the armour save against it.

ALL IS ROT.brief: Your Shooting phase, engaged PLAGUE LEGIONS unit: enemies in Engagement Range do not block its ranged targeting; each wound lost by an enemy model in Engagement Range, on a 5+ your unit suffers 1 MW after the attacks.

All-Seeing Mutant Hordes.brief: Friendly TZAANGORS units have BATTLELINE; your Shooting phase, while a friendly MUTANT unit shoots, enemy units have +6" detection range; MUTANT tag: cannot be taken with another MUTANT detachment.

Alliance of Agony.brief: Start of battle: +2 Pain tokens per combination in your army (cumulative): ARCHON + KABALITE WARRIORS unit; SUCCUBUS + WYCHES unit; HAEMONCULUS + WRACKS unit (need not be attached together).

ALONG SHADOWED TRAILS.brief: Any phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of your Cult Ambush markers, one of those markers: set it up anywhere more than 8" from all enemy units.

Alpha Invader.brief: Weapons of this unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

Alpha Leader.brief: while leading a unit: re-roll Hit rolls for that unit's attacks.

ALPHA STRIKE.brief: Your Charge phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit: until end of phase, can charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Alpha Warrior#03022150d3.brief: weapons of this model's unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

Alpha Warrior#8ac8333f35.brief: While leading a unit: weapons of that unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

Altered Reality (Psychic).brief: Once per battle round, after a Hit, Wound or save roll for this model: change the result to a 6.

Ambushing Hunters.brief: End of opponent's turn, if more than 6" from all enemy units: can be removed and placed into Strategic Reserves.

Ammo Runts.brief: Once per battle, your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

Amulet of Auto-chastisement.brief: Start of enemy Shooting phase: 1 enemy VEHICLE (not TITANIC) within 12" and visible takes a Leadership test; passed = -1 to its Hit rolls this phase; failed = cannot shoot this phase.

Amulet of Tainted Vigour.brief: Your Command phase: return up to D3 destroyed DAMNED models (not CHARACTER) to bearer's unit.

An Honourable Death in Combat.brief: Attacks have [Sustained Hits 1] if below Starting Strength; [Sustained Hits 2] instead if Below Half-strength.

Analytic Reprisals.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit shot, SKITARII INFANTRY unit that lost models to it: shoots as in your Shooting phase, targeting only that enemy unit (if eligible).

Analytical Divination.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit (not KATAPHRON) within 8" of it and not engaged: Normal move of up to D6", or 6" if HALO OVERRIDE.

ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY.brief: Fight phase, VIGILATOR SQUAD unit selected to fight: its attacks have [Sustained Hits 1] or [Lethal Hits].

Ancestral Crest.brief: Once per turn, Command Re-roll on the bearer's unit: spend 1YP, -1CP on that Stratagem.

Ancestral Fortune.brief: Once per turn: spend 1YP to change one Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw of this model to an unmodified 6.

Ancestral Overbleed Upgrade.brief: ARMIGER unit only: Fire Overwatch or Heroic Intervention Stratagem on this unit costs 1 CP less.

ANCESTRAL SENTENCE.brief: Your Shooting phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit not yet selected to shoot (optionally spend 3YP): until end of phase its ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1], or [Sustained Hits 2] if YP spent.

Ancient Collector.brief: While leading, end of your Command phase, unit within range of an objective you control: it stays yours even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at start or end of a turn.

Ancient Cover.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a model not fully visible to every attacking model because of this FORTIFICATION: Benefit of Cover.

Ancient Fury.brief: Your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit: until your next Command phase, +1" M, +1 T, +1 Ld, +1 OC and +1 to Hit.

Ancient Tactician.brief: Once per turn, per army: when you target this unit with a stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

Ancient Weapons.brief: This model's melee attacks: +2 S, +1 AP.

Ancient's Banner#4433c2a120.brief: +1 OC for models in bearer's unit.

Ancient's Banner#a0a9c468d7.brief: Models in the bearer's unit: +1 OC.

Angel's Fang.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Bearer's melee attacks targeting a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit: [Sustained Hits 2].

ANGEL’S SACRIFICE.brief: Start of the Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit: until end of phase, enemy models within Engagement Range of it must target it with all their attacks.

Angel’s Wrath.brief: This unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

Angelic Ascent.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if not in Engagement Range: Normal move up to 6"; then cannot charge this turn.

ANGELIC DESCENT.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, one unengaged ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit: remove it from the battlefield and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Angelic Executioner.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK only. When selected to fight: this unit's melee attacks have [Lethal Hits]; or [Sustained Hits 1].

ANGELIC GRACE.brief: Any phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit just allocated a MW: Feel No Pain 5+ against MW until end of phase.

Angelic Judgement.brief: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY units have Condemnatory Psalms: your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12"; it is condemned = +3" detection range.

Angelic Visage.brief: Melee attacks targeting this unit: -1 to Hit rolls.

Angels Defiant.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, enemy unit targets a CRUSADER SQUAD unit: attacks on it with S greater than its T get -1 to Wound rolls.

Anguish of the Unredeemed.brief: Model destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: roll D6; on 2+ it stays, fights after the attacking unit has finished, then is removed.

ANIMALISTIC RAGE.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after a WAR DOG unit that hasn't attacked this phase is destroyed, that unit: before Deadly Demise, it shoots or fights, targeting only the unit that destroyed it (if eligible); then resolve Deadly Demise.

Animus Curse.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit shot or fought, CRYPTEK model it destroyed: until end of battle, friendly NECRONS attacks against that enemy unit re-roll Hit rolls.

Animus Damper.brief: C'TAN SHARD OF THE VOID DRAGON only. Once per turn, start of opponent's Shooting phase, 1 enemy VEHICLE visible: Leadership test; -1 to its Hit rolls, and -1 to Wound rolls if failed, until end of phase.

Annihilate the Unworthy.brief: Friendly KNIGHT TYRANT attacks against a Battle-shocked unit: +1 to Hit roll.

Annihilating Force.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, GRAVIS unit selected to attack: its attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Annihilation Protocol.brief: DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit declares a charge: re-roll the Charge roll, +1 if a target is Below Half-strength; DESTROYER CULT ranged attacks at the closest eligible target: +1 AP.

Annihilator.brief: Ranged attack of this model allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model: re-roll the Damage roll.

Anointed Champion.brief: EMPEROR'S CHAMPION unit selected to fight: its melee attacks can re-roll one Hit roll and one Wound roll ; enhancements from this detachment do not count towards the army's enhancement total. Army: BLACK TEMPLARS only, no other Chapter.

Anti-Gravitic Mobility.brief: GRAV-ASSAULT unit only: a Fall Back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

Brôkhyr Guild Support.brief: Within 3" of a friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN VEHICLE or IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit, if not attached: Lone Operative.

Brood Brothers.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM units allowed: up to 500 pts (Incursion), 1000 (Strike Force), 1500 (Onslaught); Warlord must be GENESTEALER CULTS; they lose Voice of Command; no AIRCRAFT, COMMISSAR, EPIC HERO, MILITARUM TEMPESTUS, OGRYN, RATLING, TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER, MINISTORUM PRIEST.

Brood Progenitor (Aura, Psychic).brief: friendly TERMAGANTS units within 6": ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Brood Surge.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots, if a model of this unit was destroyed: surge move of up to D6".

BROODGUARD IMPULSE.brief: any phase, HARVESTER unit just destroyed: friendly TYRANIDS attacks against the enemy unit that destroyed it have +1 to wound for the rest of the battle.

BRUTAL ATTRITION.brief: Fight phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (except DAMNED): for each melee attack allocated to it, after the attacker finishes, roll a D6 (max 6 per attacker): each 4+ = 1 MW to the attacker.

Brutal Disciplinarian#1ef5136a47.brief: Once per turn, start of any phase: select a Battle-shocked friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit (2+ models) within 12"; 1 model destroyed, unit no longer Battle-shocked.

Brutal Disciplinarian#2b39c5cdd4.brief: Once per turn, start of any phase: select a Battle-shocked friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit (2+ models) within 24" and visible; 1 model destroyed, unit no longer Battle-shocked.

Brutal Example.brief: Once per turn, leading a unit with a TRAITOR ENFORCER: Fire Overwatch on that unit for 0 CP, even if already used on another unit this phase; 1 Bodyguard model of the unit is destroyed.

Brutal Impact.brief: If this unit made a charge move this turn: attacks have +1 D.

Brutal Raider.brief: After this model's unit ends a Charge move: until end of turn, this model's melee weapons +1 S and AP improved by 1.

Brutalis Charge (Once per phase, per uni.brief: Once per phase. Can be targeted by Crushing Impact regardless of other uses this phase: that use is -1 CP and does not block uses on other units.

Built to Last.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SAGITAUR unit, that unit: ranged attacks against it with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound rolls.

BULWARK IMPERATIVE.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets chosen, 1 targeted SKITARII unit (+1 non-BATTLELINE SKITARII unit within 6" if it is BATTLELINE): 4+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Burna Bomb.brief: End of your opponent's Fight phase: 1 visible enemy unit (not Lone Operative, MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 36", D6: on 2+, D3 MW, cannot be hidden and ranged attacks on it have [Ignores Cover] until your next turn ends.

Burning Lance.brief: Leading a unit: +6" Range to Melta weapons in that unit.

Burning Spray.brief: your Shooting phase, after this unit shoots: 1 enemy unit hit loses the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Burning Vengeance.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit it targeted: 1 embarked unit can disembark as in your Movement phase, then shoot as in your Shooting phase at that enemy unit only (if eligible).

Burrowing Claws.brief: M becomes 10", gains VANGUARD INVADER keyword and Deep Strike; if INFANTRY: can only be attached to RAVENERS.

Burst of Speed.brief: End of your Movement phase, ASTRA MILITARUM unit that did not Remain Stationary or arrive from Reserves this phase: it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Bust 'Em.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit is busted until the end of the turn: friendly SPEED FREEKS attacks targeting it have [Lethal Hits].

Butcher Lord.brief: WORLD EATERS INFANTRY only: bearer has Infiltrators.

By Thought Alone.brief: Your Shooting phase, INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit starts an action: that action does not stop it from shooting.

Cabal of Sorcerers.brief: THOUSAND SONS army, start of your Shooting phase: each model with this ability can attempt 1 unattempted Ritual: Psychic test 2D6 (+1 optional D6; double/triple = D3 MW to its unit); total >= Warp Charge = manifested.

CACHED ACQUISITION.brief: Any phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit just destroyed within range of an objective you control: you keep control of it, even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

Cacophonic Accompaniment.brief: LORD KAKOPHONIST model only. Bearer has Deep Strike; unit's ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Cadia Stands!.brief: While this unit contains an OFFICER and is within range of an objective: re-roll Battle-shock tests.

Calculated Tenacity.brief: While leading a unit: +1 OC to models in that unit.

Calgar’s Champion.brief: Attacks targeting a CHARACTER unit: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Call to Murder.brief: Fight phase, LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE CHARACTER unit (unless MONSTER) that charged this turn selected to fight: its melee attacks have +1 A.

Called Shots.brief: Each time this model is selected to shoot: re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.

Callous Competition.brief: DRUKHARI start winning the wager; each enemy unit destroyed by DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS makes that side winning, the other losing. DRUKHARI/HARLEQUINS attacks: winning side re-rolls Hit rolls of 1; losing side re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

CALLOUS SACRIFICE.brief: Your Shooting phase, engaged PLATOON unit: until end of phase, enemies are not counted as engaged with it for ranged targeting; each time an enemy model engaged with it loses a wound, roll 1 D6, on 4+ one of your models is destroyed after the attacker finishes.

Calm Under Fire.brief: VEHICLE OFFICER only. Once per turn, after issuing an Order to a SQUADRON unit: issue the same Order to another SQUADRON unit.

Cameleoline Cloak.brief: INFANTRY only: gains [Infiltrators] and [Stealth]; can only be attached to Rangers.

Camouflaged Snipers Upgrade.brief: RANGERS only: the unit's ranged attacks do not prevent it from being hidden.

Cankerblight (Aura).brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE only. Enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 6" fails a Battle-shock test: 1 model in it destroyed (opponent's choice); no MW from Daemonic Terror that use.

Canoptek Retinue.brief: Start of Declare Battle Formations: can join a unit led by a CRYPTEK (max 1 TOMB CRAWLERS unit, not with CRYPTOTHRALLS); models count as part of that Bodyguard unit, Starting Strength increased.

Canoptek Swarm.brief: Your Command phase: 1 friendly CANOPTEK SCARAB SWARM unit within 6" gets 1 destroyed model back per SPYDER in this unit.

Cantic Thrallnet.brief: Start of battle round: 1 friendly SKITARII unit within 12" of bearer; until next battle round, Protector and Conqueror Imperatives both active for it.

Canticles of the Omnissiah.brief: Start of your Command phase: pick one Canticle of the Omnissiah; this model has it until the start of your next Command phase.

CAPRICIOUS REACTIONS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit: until end of phase, attacks targeting it have -1 to Hit rolls.

Captain of the Honour Guard.brief: If the army includes MARNEUS CALGAR: Leader replaced by Support (same attachable units).

Captain-General (Aura).brief: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES non-MONSTER/VEHICLE units within 6": re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Captivating Performance.brief: End of your Movement phase, TROUPE unit: 1 objective it controls is secured.

Carmine Reliquary.brief: CHAPLAIN only. Models in the bearer's unit have Scouts 6"; re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of the bearer.

Carnival of Excess.brief: Fight phase, enemy unit has fought, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER SLAANESH unit (unless MONSTER) not yet fought: it has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

CARRY FORTH THE FAITHFUL.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT about to Advance: until end of turn, re-roll its Advance rolls and units can disembark after it Advanced (count as Normal move, cannot charge this turn).

Cartographic Data-leech.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS only: while bearer is embarked, each time that TRANSPORT shoots: BS of its Firing Deck ranged weapons improved by 1 for the phase.

Castellan's Mark.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only; after both armies deployed: redeploy up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

Castellum Omnivox.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. An Advance/Fall Back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

Castigate the Demagogues.brief: Fight phase, CHAPLAIN unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Precision].

Castigator’s Duty (Bondsman).brief: Affected model: ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1] and AP improved by 1.

Casting Back the Veil.brief: Your Shooting phase, RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit that has shot: 1 enemy unit hit has +6" detection range.

CAT Unit.brief: Once per battle, when selected to shoot: until end of phase, ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover].

Catalytic Biofortification.brief: any phase, NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffering a mortal wound: Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds until end of phase.

Catalytic Stimulus.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit that lost wounds: surge move of up to D6".

Catch Dat Red Bit.brief: Once per battle per unit, when using Crude Surgery: +D3 wounds healed.

Catechism of Divine Penitence.brief: CANONESS, PALATINE or MINISTORUM PRIEST only. Bearer gains the PENITENT keyword.

Catechism of Fire.brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: pick 1 visible enemy unit; this unit's ranged attacks targeting it have [Devastating Wounds].

CAVALCADE OF BLADES.brief: Your Charge phase, LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit ends a Charge move: pick 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range; roll 1 D6 per model in Engagement Range of it (6 D6 if MONSTER): each 4+ = 1 MW.

Ceaseless Cannonade.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC or SQUADRON units selected to shoot can target enemy units engaged with them (Blast included) if no other friendly unit is engaged with that enemy, with no Hit penalty for being engaged (except Indirect Fire attacks).

CEASELESS ONSLAUGHT.brief: Your Charge phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn: eligible to declare a charge until end of phase.

Cegorach's Coil.brief: TROUPE MASTER only: bearer's unit ends a Charge move: one enemy unit in Engagement Range; 1 D6 per model of the bearer's unit in Engagement Range of it: each 4+ = 1 MW (max 6).

Cegorach’s Favour:.brief: Melee attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and +1 to Wound.

Celeritous Sentries#b1c3e35108.brief: TRUSTED SENTINEL unit only; once per phase per unit: Heroic Intervention stratagem on this unit for -1 CP, even if already used this phase; does not block other uses on other units.

CELERITY.brief: Your Charge phase, GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit: it can charge this turn even though it Advanced.

Cerebrex Logic Engine.brief: Declare Battle Formations step: 1 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has Scouts 6".

Chainbreaker.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly IMPERIUM unit within 12" that is Battle-shocked is no longer Battle-shocked.

Chameleonic.brief: VANGUARD INVADER only. This unit has [Stealth].

Champion of the Deathwing.brief: This unit's attacks targeting an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have [Sustained Hits 1].

Champion of the First Company.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR only. This unit's melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Champion of the Kingsguard.brief: This model's attacks targeting a CHARACTER unit: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1.

Champion of the Order of Purifiers (Psyc.brief: While leading a unit: +1 A on Purifying Flame weapons of that unit.

Champion Slayer.brief: Melee attacks against a CHARACTER or MONSTER unit: re-roll the Wound roll; each enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER destroyed: regain up to D6 wounds.

Champion's Guidance.brief: Fight phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit selected to fight: its melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

CHAMPION’S GUIDANCE.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, its attacks can re-roll the Hit roll.

Chance for Glory.brief: Once per battle, start of Fight phase: until end of phase, this model's melee weapons +1 S, +1 A, +1 AP, +1 D.

Changecaster.brief: While leading: the unit's ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Channeler stones.brief: Once per turn, the first failed saving throw for the bearer's unit: that attack's D becomes 0.

Channelled Force.brief: GREY KNIGHTS unit selected to fight: Leadership test; if passed, until end of phase its Psychic melee weapons gain 1 choice: [Sustained Hits 1] ; or [Lethal Hits].

CHANNELLED WRATH.brief: Fight phase, 1 SHADOW LEGION unit not yet fought: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Lance]; if KHORNE, their AP is improved by 1 as well.

Chant of Deathless Devotion.brief: Friendly CHAPLAIN units have a 5+ Inv against ranged attacks. Army: BLACK TEMPLARS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter.

Chant of Electrotraction.brief: Your Movement phase, ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit selected to Advance: that move does not prevent it from charging.

CHANT OF THE REMORSELESS FIST.brief: Fight phase, 1 CULT MECHANICUS unit not yet fought: its CULT MECHANICUS models' melee attacks have +1 to wound until end of phase.

CHAOS BANE.brief: Your Shooting phase, GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit not yet shot: its ranged weapons have [Anti-Chaos 4+].

Chaos Familiar.brief: Once per battle, when an attack is allocated to the bearer: change its D to 0.

Chaos icon.brief: Bearer's unit takes a Leadership test for Dark Pacts: re-roll it.

Chaplet of Sacrifice.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. End of your Command phase, bearer on the battlefield: re-roll 1 Miracle dice in your pool (keep new result); up to 3 if the bearer's unit is below Starting Strength.

Chariots of the Storm.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. After both armies are deployed: redeploy up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units; they can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

Cherub#5d8e716d50.brief: Once per battle, after this unit performs an Act of Faith: gain 1 Miracle dice.

Cherub#94d10d275e.brief: Once per battle, after this model's unit performs an Act of Faith: gain 1 Miracle dice.

Cherub#e308989d8b.brief: Once per battle: Command Re-roll Stratagem on this unit for 0CP, even if another unit was already targeted by it this phase.

Cherubs.brief: Twice per battle, after this unit performs an Act of Faith: gain 1 Miracle dice.

Chief Librarian (psyker level 3)#ce28d9c.brief: Has the psychic abilities listed on the datasheet.

Chief Librarian (psyker level 3)#ed6e8af.brief: Has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.

Chilling Howl.brief: Opponent's Command phase, friendly WOLF GUARD TERMINATORS unit: 1 enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test, at -1 if it is at or below half-strength.

Chirurgeon.brief: First time FABIUS BILE is destroyed, end of phase: D6, on 2+ set him back up close to where destroyed, outside Engagement Range, full wounds.

Chitinous Horrors (Aura).brief: Enemy units within Engagement Range of this unit: OC halved.

Chittering Swarm.brief: Enemy units in Engagement Range of this unit: -1 OC (min 1); while within 6" of friendly CRYPTEK models: this unit's OC is 1.

Chogorian Huntmaster.brief: Bearer's unit in Strategic Reserves: to set it up, treat the battle round as 1 higher.

Choice Samples.brief: While Garreon is on the battlefield, your Command phase: return 1 destroyed non-CHARACTER model; or if a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit below Starting Strength is within 3": gain 1CP.

Choreographer of War.brief: Leading a unit: Pile In and Consolidate moves up to 6" instead of 3"; need not end closer to the closest enemy model if as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

CHOSEN FOR GLORY.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, DAMNED unit not yet shot/fought: can make a Desperate Pact; if so, re-roll Hit rolls; if the Leadership test was passed, re-roll Wound rolls too.

Chosen Marauders.brief: Eligible to shoot and charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

CHOSEN PREY.brief: Your Movement phase, after a SPACE WOLVES unit Falls Back: until end of turn, it can shoot and charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Chrono-impedance Fields.brief: Your Command phase, 1 friendly NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (not TITANIC) within 6": attacks allocated to it -1 D until your next Command phase.

Chronodistortion.brief: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, NECRONS unit targeted: until end of phase, each model destroyed that has not fought: D6 (+1 if the attacker is unravelling), on 4+ it fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

Chronometron.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model's unit shot, if not in Engagement Range: Normal move up to 5"; then cannot declare a charge this turn.

Chronoshard.brief: SUCCUBUS; once per battle, start of Fight phase: bearer's unit has [Fights First] until end of phase.

Chronoshift.brief: Movement phase, NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (not TITANIC) not yet moved: until end of phase, if it Advances, no Advance roll: +6" to Move instead.

CHRONOSORCEROUS BLEED.brief: Start of enemy Charge phase, unengaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" has -1 to charge rolls when it declares a charge.

CIRCLE OF SANCTUARY.brief: Start of opponent's Movement phase, GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model: enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of it this phase.

Claimed for the Cult.brief: Start of your Command phase: roll D6 per objective you control with a unit with this ability in range; any 4+ = gain 1CP.

CLAIMED FOR THE DARK GODS.brief: Start of your Command phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit within range of an objective you control: that objective stays yours with Level of Control 5 (if not higher) until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

CLAIMSTAKER REFLEX.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit (unless ARTILLERY/VEHICLE) within 8" of it: Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if 2YP spent ; cannot embark.

Clandestine Infiltrator.brief: Bearer and led unit have [Infiltrators] and [Scouts 6"].

Clandestine Operation.brief: Start of Declare Battle Formations: up to 3 AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY units (not GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD) gain Infiltrators.

Clandestine Reposition.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged INFILTRATORS/PTERAXII unit: placed in Strategic Reserves.

Clarion of Haste (Psychic).brief: While leading a unit: that unit can charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Clarion of Urgency.brief: CANONESS WITH JUMP PACK only. End of your opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged: you can place it in Strategic Reserves.

CLEANSING FLAMES.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its Torrent weapons have [Devastating Wounds].

CLEAR AND SECURE.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, re-roll Hit and Wound rolls against units within range of an objective marker.

Clever Know-wotz.brief: Your Movement phase, start or end of this unit's move: 1 friendly ORKS VEHICLE (not AIRCRAFT/TITANIC) within 3" heals D3 W and has +1 to Hit rolls until your next Movement phase.

Cloak and Shadow.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, AELDARI INFANTRY unit within range of an objective you control, just targeted: until end of phase, Stealth and can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18".

Cloaked Assassin.brief: If equipped with a Sanctus bio-dagger: cannot be targeted by snap shooting attacks.

CLOSE-QUARTERS BARRAGE.brief: Your Shooting phase, VOIDFARERS unit: until end of phase, its ranged attacks on units within 12" get +1 S and AP improved by 1.

Close-quarters Excruciation.brief: Your Shooting phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its EMPEROR'S CHILDREN models' attacks against units within 12" have +1 S and AP improved by 1.

Close-quarters Firestorm.brief: Attacks targeting an enemy unit within 9": +1 S.

Close-quarters Warfare.brief: No Hit roll penalty for shooting while enemy units are within Engagement Range.

Close-Range Dakka.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly ORKS unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Rapid Fire 1], or +1 to their [Rapid Fire] value if they already have it.

Close-Range Detection.brief: Start of your Shooting phase, SCOUT SENTINEL or ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit: while a visible enemy unit is within 6" of it, that enemy has +3" detection range.

Close-range Killers (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG model within 9": its attacks vs the closest enemy unit have AP improved by 1.

CLOSE-RANGE SHOOT-OUT.brief: Your Shooting phase, GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit not yet shot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits] against enemy units within 18".

Close-range Titan Killer.brief: Magma cannon targeting a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit: always counts as within half range.

Cloudstrider.brief: While leading: end of opponent's turn, if unit not engaged, place it in Strategic Reserves; when set up via Deep Strike in your Movement phase, can land >6" from enemies, but cannot charge this turn.

Cluster Caltrops.brief: Eviscerating Fly-by wound rolls: re-roll one D6 per model equipped with cluster caltrops.

CLUTCHING CORRUPTION.brief: Fight phase, DEATH GUARD unit not yet fought: its attacks against an enemy unit in Engagement Range of a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit can re-roll the Hit roll until end of phase.

Co-ordinated Strike.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN unit within 9" of a battlefield edge: placed into Strategic Reserves.

Code Chivalric.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS army, after Read Mission Objectives: choose or roll 1 Deed and 1 Quality; the Quality applies all battle to models with this ability; Deed first completed: army Honoured, gain 2 CP (3 CP if rolled).

Codex Adept.brief: Assault, devastator and tactical doctrines are all active for this unit.

Codex Discipline.brief: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

Codex Fire-patterns.brief: Friendly TACTICUS units' [Rapid Fire] attacks get the [Rapid Fire] bonus against targets up to the attack's maximum range.

Cogbound Alliance.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models: Assisted Targeting (Aura), ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit within 6" has +1 BS and [Heavy] on ranged attacks. TECH-PRIEST models: Sacristan Pledge, your Command phase, 1 IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model within 3" heals D3 wounds (1 use per model per phase).

COGITATED NEED.brief: End of opponent's Movement phase, IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit: Normal move, ending as close as possible to the closest objective marker.

Cogitative Instincts.brief: Enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of this model.

Cognitive Reinforcement#80512e4252.brief: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only (not CYBERNETICA DATASMITH). Conqueror and Protector Imperatives both active for the bearer's unit.

Cognitive Reinforcement#efaf1abc34.brief: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only (not CYBERNETICA DATASMITH). Conqueror and Protector Imperatives both active for the bearer's unit.

COILS OF DECEPTION.brief: Your Movement phase, after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit Falls Back, that unit: until end of turn, can shoot despite Falling Back.

Cold and Calculating.brief: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when selected to attack: [Lethal Hits: MONSTER/VEHICLE]; or [Sustained Hits 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]; or both if the tactical doctrine is active.

Cold Fervour.brief: DESTROYER CULT weapons: +2 S; first time each turn a DESTROYER CULT unit destroys a unit or takes it Below Half-strength: until end of turn, +2 S to weapons of friendly NECRONS (not DESTROYER CULT, MONSTER, TITANIC).

Coldstar Commander.brief: While leading: unit's models have M 12" and their ranged weapons have [Assault].

Collar of Khorne#c3e54bf8ea.brief: Bearer: Feel No Pain 3+ against Psychic Attacks.

COMBAT DEBARKATION.brief: Your Shooting phase, T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: attacks on the closest enemy unit re-roll Wound rolls this phase.

Combat Deployment.brief: GRAV-ASSAULT TRANSPORT model only; friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit disembarks from it, until end of turn: that unit re-rolls Charge rolls; enemy cannot snap shoot it.

Combat Doctrines.brief: Start of your Command phase: 1 doctrine (each once per battle) for ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until your next Command phase: Assault = charge after Advancing; Devastator = ranged [Assault]; Tactical = shoot and charge after Falling Back.

Combat Drugs.brief: Start of your Command phase, until your next: choose 1 drug (each once per battle) or roll 2 D6 at random for WYCH CULT models. 1 Adrenalight: +1 A melee; 2 Hypex: +2" M; 3 Serpentin: WS +1; 4 Painbringer: +1 T; 5 Grave Lotus: +1 S melee; 6 Splintermind: Ld +1 and BS +1.

Combat Embarkation.brief: Opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy picks charge targets: 1 unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES target wholly within 3" of this TRANSPORT can embark; the enemy then picks new charge targets.

COMBAT EMBARKATION.brief: Enemy Charge phase, after a charge is declared, T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit targeted and a friendly TRANSPORT (all models within 3", enough capacity): the unit can embark; if so, the enemy may pick new charge targets.

Combat Landers.brief: Start of Declare Battle Formations: up to 3 VOIDFARERS units gain Deep Strike.

COMBAT MANIFESTATION.brief: Your Movement phase, GREY KNIGHTS unit arriving by Deep Strike: set it up anywhere more than 6" from enemy units; it cannot charge this turn.

COMBAT STIMMS.brief: Fight phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit: until end of phase, attacks targeting it have -1 to Wound rolls.

Combined Deployment.brief: Your Shooting phase, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot: 1 enemy unit hit is assailed until end of turn ; ADEPTUS ASTARTES units that disembarked this turn targeting it have [Sustained Hits 1].

Combined Fire.brief: Your Shooting phase, after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit has shot, that unit: pick 1 enemy unit it hit; until end of phase, it cannot have Benefit of Cover and ARMOURED SKIRMISHER attacks against it get +2 Strength.

Command Protocols.brief: While a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading this unit: +1 to Hit rolls.

Command Rod.brief: While the bearer is leading a unit: that unit can be affected by up to 2 different Orders at the same time.

Command Squad.brief: Attacks targeting this unit have -1 to wound rolls.

Command Uplink.brief: Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem: roll D6; 5+ = gain 1 CP.

Command-link Drone (Aura).brief: Friendly T'AU EMPIRE unit within 6" targeted by a Stratagem: roll D6, on 5+ gain 1CP.

Comms array.brief: Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem: D6, on 5+ gain 1CP.

Compact.brief: Can embark in an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT as if INFANTRY; takes up the space of 7 models.

Companion's Watch#9389e0d5b1.brief: TRUSTED SENTINEL unit within range of an objective: its attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Competitive Streak.brief: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

Computational Mastermind.brief: End of your Command phase, before Hostile Acquisition/Fortify Takeover: for each objective you control with a model with this ability in range, spend 1YP or gain 1YP.

Concussive Wave.brief: Your Shooting phase, after choosing a target for the Stormsword siege cannon: roll D6 for it and every unit within 3" of it; on 5+ that unit suffers D3 MW after this model's attacks on the target.

Condemnatory Annihilation#32f6c7b2e1.brief: After this unit fights, if it destroyed an enemy model this phase: each enemy unit engaged with it makes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

Condemnatory Annihilation#6bd04de8ec.brief: After this model's unit has fought, if ≥1 enemy unit was destroyed: each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test.

CONDEMNATORY INFO-SCREED.brief: Your Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to fight, disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: until end of phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1; full Wound re-roll if it was a LAND RAIDER.

Conductor of Torment.brief: DRUKHARI; your Command phase: if DRUKHARI are losing the wager, may gain 1 Pain token and DRUKHARI now win the wager; if winning, may discard 1 Pain token and HARLEQUINS now win the wager.

Conduit of Chaos.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON model only (not KHORNE): melee attacks have [Lance].

Conduit of Cruelty.brief: This unit is always Empowered (no Pain tokens needed for its Pain abilities).

CONNOISSEURS OF PAIN.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, DRUKHARI unit just targeted: spend 1 Pain token; attacks targeting it have AP worsened by 1 until the attacker finishes; if HAEMONCULUS COVENS and still alive at end of phase, gain 1 Pain token.

CONQUERORS WITHOUT MERCY.brief: Fight phase, 1 CHAOS KNIGHTS model that charged this turn, not yet fought: until end of phase, its melee weapons' AP improved by 1; if it destroys a unit this phase, each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test.

Consecrating Aura#6d0aebdbfe.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have a 5+ Inv.

Consumed with Hunger (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG models within 6": attacks vs TITANIC or TOWERING units re-roll the Hit roll.

Contempt for Rivals.brief: ARCHON only: the bearer's unit's attacks have [Precision].

Contemptuous Disregard.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit: until end of phase, attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound rolls.

CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not DAMNED) targeted: until the attacker finishes, attacks against it have AP worsened by 1.

Contemptuous Volleys.brief: Your Movement phase, after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit Falls Back, that unit: until end of turn, can shoot and charge despite Falling Back.

Contraband Munitions.brief: KELERMORPH/REDUCTUS SABOTEUR only. Bearer's unit's ranged attacks: +2 S.

Contracted Harvest.brief: BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL units' ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1] against targets that are not MONSTER or VEHICLE. KABAL tag: cannot be taken with another KABAL detachment.

Control Edict.brief: While leading: re-roll Hit rolls for the unit's attacks.

Convoy Escort Vehicle.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: Normal move of up to D6"; not eligible to charge this turn.

COORDINATE TO ENGAGE.brief: Your Shooting phase, T'AU EMPIRE unit just chosen as Observer: attacks on its Spotted unit get BS improved by 1 this phase, plus [Ignores Cover] if the unit has MARKERLIGHT.

COORDINATED ACTION.brief: Start of any phase, 1 REGIMENT unit and 1 SQUADRON unit within 6" of and visible to it: until end of phase, Orders affecting one also affect the other.

Coordinated Crossfire.brief: Start of Shooting phase, up to 2 friendly SAGITAUR units: select 1 enemy unit; their ranged attacks against it re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Coordinated Exploitation.brief: T'AU EMPIRE (not KROOT SHAPER) only. While leading a unit, each time it is an Observer unit: until end of phase, the Guided unit's ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1] against the Spotted unit.

Coordinated Leadership.brief: Your Command phase: roll D6, on 4+ gain 1CP.

Coordinated Strike.brief: While a Guided unit: attacks targeting its Spotted unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

COORDINATED TRAP.brief: Start of your Shooting or the Fight phase, two GENESTEALER CULTS units not yet shot/fought: pick one enemy unit (in Fight, within Engagement Range of both); until end of phase both units only target it, +1 to Wound rolls.

Corner the Quarry.brief: Non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit engaged with this unit making a Fall Back move: must use Desperate Escape; if Battle-shocked, -1 to those hazard rolls.

Cornered Prey.brief: Enemy unit engaged with this unit Falls Back: must use Desperate Escape; if battle-shocked, -1 to those hazard rolls.

Cornucophagus.brief: Declare Battle Formations: select one Plague; all battle, enemy units within the bearer's Contagion Range also have that Plague's effect.

Coronal Susurrant.brief: Bearer gains Lord of Deceit (Aura): each time your opponent targets a unit of theirs within 12" with a Stratagem, its cost +1 CP.

Corporeum Reliquary.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR only. Your first Movement phase: this unit can make an ingress move.

CORROSIVE VISCERA.brief: enemy Shooting or Fight, TYRANIDS MONSTER with Deadly Demise (cannot FLY) just destroyed: its Deadly Demise mortal wounds are inflicted automatically, no D6.

Corrupt Machine Spirits.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: visible enemy VEHICLE within 12", D6: 2-3 = D3 MW; 4-5 = 3 MW; 6 = D3+3 MW.

CORRUPT REALSPACE.brief: Start of any Command phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit in range of an objective you control: that objective is Corrupted, stays yours until the opponent controls it at the start/end of a turn; within 6" of it is your Shadow of Chaos.

Corrupted Munitions.brief: Your Shooting phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit just selected to shoot: its ranged attacks get +1 AP.

CORRUPTING TAINT.brief: Your Command phase, after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit makes a Malefic Surge, that unit: 1 objective you control in range stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Corsair Raider.brief: INFANTRY only: gains [Scouts 7"] and the ANHRATHE keyword; can only be attached to Corsair Voidreavers or Corsair Voidscarred.

Cosmic Distortion.brief: NECRONS MONSTER units: Distortion Fields (Aura): attacks against enemies within 6" +1 AP; start of each phase, can suffer 3 MW for a 9" aura until end of phase; mustering: Necrodermal Binding ability and extra points (MFM).

Cosmic Horror (Psychic).brief: Start of Fight phase: each enemy unit within 6" must take a Battle-shock test.

COSMIC PRECISION.brief: Movement phase, NECRONS unit (not MONSTER) arriving by ingress move: set up anywhere more than 6" from all enemy models; cannot charge this turn.

Cosmic Storm.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly OBELISK/TESSERACT VAULT unit selected to shoot: its Tesla Sphere weapons have +1 AP.

COST OF VICTORY.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, GUARDIANS unit not in Engagement Range: remove it and place it in Strategic Reserves, returning every destroyed GUARDIANS model to it.

COUNTERCHARGE.brief: End of opponent's Charge phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit within 6" of enemy units it could charge: it declares and resolves a charge vs only those units as if your Charge phase; no Charge bonus this turn.

COUNTERFIRE DEFENCE SYSTEMS.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets chosen, T'AU EMPIRE unit targeted: attacks allocated to it get -1 Damage this phase.

Counterpredation.brief: Fight, DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit selected to fight: its attacks against a hidden unit have +1 S and +1 AP.

COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, CANOPTEK unit targeted: until end of phase, only targetable by ranged attacks from models within 18".

Courage and Honour!.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: until end of phase its melee weapons have [Lance] ; if under the Assault Doctrine, also +1 AP.

COURAGEOUS DIVERSION.brief: Start of enemy Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit: until end of phase, it has Feel No Pain 6+, and enemy attacks get -1 to Hit when it is the closest eligible target.

COURAGEOUS STAND.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy unit picks targets, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit targeted: until end of phase, [Feel No Pain 6+].

Coursing Thralls.brief: Start of your Shooting phase, friendly DAMNED unit: pick a visible enemy unit within 12"; it is hunted: +6" detection range.

Cover.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a model not fully visible to every attacking model because of this Fortification: Benefit of Cover.

Covering Fire.brief: When targeted by Fire Overwatch: hits on unmodified 5+; 4+ instead if within 6" of a friendly PLATOON unit.

Covert Stealth Team.brief: End of your opponent's turn, if unengaged: place this unit in Strategic Reserves; it has Deep Strike until your next Shooting phase; it must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (even turn 1).

Crack Shot.brief: Ranged attacks: on a Critical Wound, that attack has AP -3.

CRACK SHOTS.brief: Your Shooting phase, PLATOON unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Precision].

CRASH THROUGH.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit not yet selected to move or charge: until end of phase, its Normal, Advance and Charge moves can pass horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

Crawling Horror.brief: Start of opponent's Movement phase, one PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit: -6" detection range until end of turn.

CRAZED FOCUS.brief: Your Shooting phase, DAMNED unit not yet shot: can make a Desperate Pact; if so, attacks get +1 AP; if the Leadership test was passed, +1 S too.

Crazed Rampage.brief: Fight phase, enemy unit targets friendly ORKS WALKER unit (not TITANIC): each model destroyed before the unit has fought, roll D6 (+3 if DEFF DREAD); on 4+ it stays until the unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever first.

Creations of Bile.brief: Start of battle, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY models (except DAMNED): pick 1 augmentation or roll 2D6 for two (Fabius Bile WARLORD: re-roll dice; duplicates no effect). 1 melee +1 A; 2 +2" Move; 3 melee WS +1; 4 T +1; 5 melee +1 S; 6 ranged BS +1.

CREEPING BLIGHT.brief: Your Shooting phase, DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit not yet shot: its ranged attacks against an Afflicted unit can re-roll Hit and Wound rolls until end of phase.

Creeping Shadow.brief: If equipped with a cult sniper rifle, enemy Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, Normal move of up to 6".

Crewed Platform#385979b560.brief: Last STORM GUARDIAN destroyed: remaining SERPENT'S SCALE PLATFORM models also destroyed.

Crewed Platform#3cd459b076.brief: Last GUARDIAN DEFENDER destroyed: remaining HEAVY WEAPON PLATFORM models also destroyed.

Crimson Harvest.brief: Each time this model ends a Charge move: 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll D6: 2-5 = D3 MW; 6 = D3+3 MW.

Crossfire.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: pick 1 enemy unit hit; until end of turn, friendly GENESTEALER CULTS attacks targeting it get +1 AP (once per turn per enemy unit).

Crown of Worms.brief: +3" range to bearer's Warpsmith, Master of Mechanisms and Enrage Machine Spirits abilities.

Crucible of Battle.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, attacks vs the closest eligible target within 6" get +1 to Wound.

Crucible of Malediction.brief: HAEMONCULUS; once per battle, your Shooting phase: may spend 1 Pain token; each enemy unit within 12" takes a Battle-shock test (-1 if token spent); each PSYKER unit that fails suffers 3 MW.

Crude Surgery.brief: Your Command phase: this unit heals 3 W.

Cruel Amusement.brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: Shrieker Cannon gains [Ignores Cover]; [Precision]; or [Sustained Hits 3] until end of phase.

CRUEL BLADESMAN.brief: Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit that charged this turn, not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons' AP improved by 1.

Cruel Enforcers.brief: End of your Command phase, within range of an objective you control: it stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Cruel Hunter.brief: While leading: that unit's Pile In and Consolidate moves are up to 6" instead of 3".

Cruel Lashmaster.brief: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Friendly DAMNED unit within 6" selected for a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move: +2" M until end of phase.

CRUEL RAIDERS.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and not within 3" of enemies: placed into Strategic Reserves.

Crusade of Wrath.brief: Melee attacks of this unit: +1 A and +1 S.

Crusader's Duty (Bondsman).brief: Affected model: ranged attacks +1 to Hit.

Crush All Who Stand Before Us.brief: When selected to fight, optional: models within 3" of enemy models are eligible to fight and can target an enemy unit within 3" of them and in Engagement Range of their unit.

CRUSHED LIKE VERMIN.brief: Your Movement phase, after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit ends a Normal move, that unit: pick an enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) it moved over, roll 6D6: each 4+ = 1 MW; if any model is destroyed, that enemy takes a Battle-shock test.

Crushing Charge.brief: Re-roll Charge rolls; after a Charge move: pick 1 enemy unit, roll 1 D6 per model in Engagement Range of it, each 4+ = D3 MW.

Crushing Condemnation.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Once, after the bearer fights and destroys 1+ enemy units: 1 enemy unit not in Engagement Range, within 12" and visible: roll 6 D6, 1 MW per 4+.

CRUSHING STRIDES.brief: Your Charge phase, WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit that just ended a Charge move: pick an enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll 1 D6 per WRAITHBLADES model (4 D6 for WRAITHLORD, 6 D6 for WRAITHKNIGHT): each 3+ = 1 MW.

Cry of the Wind.brief: Each time this model is set up on the battlefield, until end of turn: its ranged attacks score a Critical Hit on any successful unmodified Hit roll.

Cryptek Retinue.brief: Start of Declare Battle Formations: join 1 unit led by a CRYPTEK (max 1 CRYPTOTHRALLS unit per unit); models count as part of that Bodyguard unit, Starting Strength increased.

Cryptophotaic Camouflage Upgrade.brief: VON RYAN'S LEAPERS only. Bearer's unit: -3" detection range.

Crystal Matrix.brief: Each time selected to shoot: re-roll 1 Hit roll and 1 Wound roll.

Crystalline Targeting.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this unit shot: pick one enemy unit hit; until end of phase, friendly AELDARI attacks vs it have AP improved by 1; each unit selected once per turn.

Cult Ambush.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS army: 6/10/14 Resurgence points by battle size; destroyed unit with this ability: spend points (by unit/size) to return it in Cult Ambush with a marker >8" from enemies; ingress on it after opponent's next Movement phase.

Cult Demagogue.brief: While leading: attacks by the unit get +1 to Hit roll.

Cult Icon#527e659592.brief: Your Command phase: return up to 3 destroyed models to bearer's unit; D3+3 if within range of an objective you control (no attached CHARACTERS; used [One Shot] weapons stay used).

Cult Icon#bc5ec70c16.brief: Your Command phase: return up to D3 destroyed models to bearer's unit; 3 if within range of an objective you control (no attached CHARACTERS; used [One Shot] weapons stay used).

Cult Infiltration.brief: Start of each player's Command phase, if on the battlefield: move 1 of your Cult Ambush markers not yet moved this turn up to 6".

Cultist's Brand.brief: If every other model in bearer's unit (except Dark Disciples) is DAMNED: re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for that unit.

Cunning Ambush.brief: After both armies deployed: redeploy this unit and 1 other friendly T'AU EMPIRE unit; either can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of the limit.

CUNNING HUNTER.brief: Your Movement phase, after a WAR DOG unit Falls Back, that unit: until end of turn, can shoot and charge despite Falling Back.

Cunning Hunters#4368e1c3f4.brief: Fight phase, if this unit is within range of an objective: melee attacks have +1 S and +1 AP.

Curse of Life.brief: INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER only; when healed by Sorcerous Invigoration: +3 wounds healed.

CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit shot or fought, CRYPTEK model it destroyed: until end of battle, friendly CANOPTEK attacks against that enemy unit +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

Curse of the Walking Pox.brief: Each time a POXWALKER attack destroys an enemy model (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE): after resolving attacks, return one destroyed POXWALKER; kills by TYPHUS' Eater Plague count too.

Curse of the Wulfen#b84bac4ae2.brief: While within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER (excluding WULFEN) or within 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST, if not Battle-shocked: +1 OC for INFANTRY models, +3 OC for VEHICLE models in this unit.

Curse of the Wulfen#f2c8f84341.brief: CHAMPION OF THE CHAPTER only. M 9", T 6, Sv 4+; loses TACTICUS, gains WULFEN; attaches only to WULFEN, WULFEN WITH STORM SHIELDS.

Cursed Circlet.brief: After an enemy unit shoots and destroys models of the bearer's unit: Surge move of D6" towards the closest enemy (not AIRCRAFT), may enter Engagement Range; not while Battle-shocked.

Cursed Fang.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: AP improved by 1 and [Precision].

Cursed Flames.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shot: 1 enemy INFANTRY unit hit takes a Battle-shock test.

CUT DOWN THE WEAK.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit (VEHICLE only if WALKER) within 6" eligible to charge it: declares a charge against that unit, no Charge bonus this turn.

Cut Off Their Escape.brief: Enemy unit engaged with this unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) falling back must use Desperate Escape; if battle-shocked, -1 to those Hazard rolls.

Cutting Down the Foe.brief: Melee attacks of this unit in a turn it made a Charge move: +1 S and +1 D.

Cyber Psalm-Programming.brief: LEGIO CYBERNETICA units: +2" M; unless Battle-shocked, +1 OC.

Cyber-familiar.brief: TACTICUS only. After both armies are deployed: redeploy up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units; they can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

Cyber-Static Canticles.brief: CORPUSCARII units' ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits]; a FULGURITE unit that has fought heals D3 wounds. DATA-PSALM tag: not with another DATA-PSALM detachment.

CYBERSPIRIT MACHINATIONS.brief: Your Movement phase, after a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit Falls Back, that unit and a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit within 6": until end of turn, the VEHICLE can shoot and charge even though it Fell Back.

CYBERSTIMM INFUSION.brief: Fight phase, CTHONIAN BESERKS unit not yet selected to fight (optionally spend 2YP): until end of phase its attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1, or any Wound roll if YP spent.

Cyberstimms.brief: Model destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: D6 (+1 with Fortify Takeover), 4+ it fights after the attacker then is removed.

Cybinfernal Font.brief: Models in bearer's unit have the SOUL FORGE keyword.

Cybork Boosta.brief: BIG MEK/MEK only. This model has +2" M.

CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION.brief: Start of Shooting phase or Fight phase, CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit wholly within your Power Matrix: until end of phase, weapons of its CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models have [Devastating Wounds].

Da Bigger Dey Iz....brief: Melee attacks of this unit targeting a MONSTER/VEHICLE: re-roll Wound rolls.

Da Boss.brief: Start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD: gain 1 CP.

Da Boss Is Watchin'.brief: ORKS only. Once per battle per army, your Movement phase: this unit is riled up until your next turn.

Da Gobshot Thunderbuss.brief: WARBOSS only. This model has the listed weapon.

Da Grand Warlord’s Ladz.brief: While within 3" of another friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit: this unit has Lone Operative.

Da Hunt Is On.brief: Friendly BEAST SNAGGA units' attacks targeting a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 AP.

Da Jump (psychic level 1, once per army,.brief: Your Movement phase, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6, 1 = battle-shocked; place this unit in strategic reserves; it has Deep Strike.

Da Krunch.brief: ORKS PSYKER only. This model has the listed weapon.

Daemon Lord of Khorne (Aura)#63673ba009.brief: Friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6": melee attacks +1 to Hit.

Daemon Lord of Khorne (Aura)#7f95248248.brief: Friendly KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6": +1 to melee Hit rolls.

Daemon Lord of Nurgle (Aura)#57ecda7f50.brief: Friendly NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6": +1 T.

Daemon Lord of Nurgle (Aura)#b61c6a9189.brief: Friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS units within 6": +1 T.

Daemon Lord of Slaanesh (Aura)#d3bb4e4ce.brief: Friendly SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6": melee weapons AP improved by 1.

Daemon Lord of Slaanesh (Aura)#e25217757.brief: Friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6": melee weapons' AP improved by 1.

Daemon Lord of Tzeentch (Aura)#6bce91818.brief: Friendly TZEENTCH LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6": +1 S on ranged attacks.

Daemon Lord of Tzeentch (Aura)#751dc8332.brief: Friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units within 6": ranged attacks +1 S.

Daemon Prince of Slaanesh.brief: Start of opponent's Command phase: pick 1 ability from the Daemon Prince of Slaanesh section; has it until start of opponent's next Command phase.

Daemon Weapon of Nurgle.brief: Bearer's melee attacks: Critical Hit on unmodified 5+.

Daemonforge.brief: After this unit makes a Dark Pact: until end of phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

Daemonic Destruction#688f0bd24a.brief: Ends a Charge move: 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll 1 D6 per remaining wound of this model; each 4+ = 1 MW (max 6).

Daemonic Destruction#8353bb71a0.brief: End of Charge move: 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll 1 D6 per remaining wound: each 4+ = 1 MW (max 6).

Daemonic Empowerment.brief: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit within 6" of a friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit, and vice versa: Empowered. Empowered unit's weapons have [Sustained Hits 1]; if already so, Critical Hit on unmodified 5+.

DAEMONIC FURY.brief: start of your Fight, BLOOD LEGIONS unit: 1 friendly WORLD EATERS unit within 6" gets melee [Lance] until end of turn; also [Twin-linked] if Daemonic Rage is active.

Daemonic Icon#7c477ed3a0.brief: Models in the bearer's unit: Ld 6+.

Daemonic Icon#b523e5c1e8.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have Ld 6+.

Daemonic Illusions (Aura).brief: While a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is within 6" and visible: models in this unit have a 4+ Inv against ranged attacks.

Daemonic Infestation.brief: Your Command phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit (unless PINK HORRORS): heals 3 wounds.

DAEMONIC INVULNERABILITY.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets are selected, 1 targeted LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit: until end of phase, re-roll invulnerable saving throws of 1.

Daemonic Lord.brief: While within 3" of ≥1 friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA INFANTRY unit: this model has [Lone Operative].

Daemonic Ordnance.brief: When selected to shoot, optional: until end of phase its ranged weapons gain [Devastating Wounds] and [Hazardous].

Daemonic Patrons.brief: When selected to fight, can call patrons: unmodified Wound roll 3+ = Critical Wound this phase; end of Fight phase, if no enemy model destroyed by this unit: 1 model destroyed.

Daemonic Poisons.brief: Your Shooting phase and Fight phase, after attacking: 1 enemy unit hit is poisoned for the battle; start of each Command phase, per poisoned unit roll D6: 4+ = D3 MW.

DAEMONIC POSSESSION.brief: Your Command phase, HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (not Daemon): gains the DAEMON keyword until end of battle.
