DAEMONIC RESISTANCE.brief: enemy Shooting or Fight, WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit just targeted: attacks against it have -1 to wound until end of phase.

DAEMONIC STRENGTH.brief: Fight, WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit not yet fought: +1 D against non-MONSTER/VEHICLE if EIGHTBOUND, or against MONSTER/VEHICLE if EXALTED EIGHTBOUND.

Daemonkin (Psychic)#adc26f6386.brief: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls for this unit.

Daemonkin (Psychic)#d4cecb8bad.brief: Leading a unit: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

DAEMONTIDE.brief: your Command, WORLD EATERS unit: 1 BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6" regains 1 MOUNTED, up to D3 BEAST or up to D6 INFANTRY destroyed models (not attached Characters).

Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!.brief: Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units' ranged attacks have [Assault] and, while the unit is riled up, +3" Range.

Dakkastorm.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly SPEED FREEKS unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Damocles-class Uplink.brief: CAPTAIN only. Your Movement phase, if embarked in a TRANSPORT: 1 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit within 6" of that TRANSPORT gets a Combat Doctrine of your choice active.

Dance Macabre.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, DRUKHARI INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit within 8" of it: Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if losing the wager.

Dance of Death.brief: Start of Fight phase, 1 choice until end of phase: Hero's Prowess re-roll Hit rolls of 1; Villain's Doom +1 to Wound; Trickster's Grace attacks against this unit -1 to Hit.

Dance of Distortion.brief: HARLEQUINS units have Stealth. Acrobatic tag: cannot be taken with another Acrobatic detachment.

Daring Recon.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: select an enemy unit within 18" and visible; until end of phase, friendly ASTRA MILITARUM attacks on it re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

DARING RIDERS.brief: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit in Reserves: set it up anywhere more than 6" from enemy units; if within 8" of an enemy, it cannot charge this turn.

Dark Angels Bodyguard.brief: While within 3" of a friendly DARK ANGELS INFANTRY unit: this unit has Lone Operative.

DARK APPARITIONS.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged DAEMONETTES unit: placed into Strategic Reserves; if it Deep Strikes next Movement phase, more than 6" from enemies (not 8") if wholly within 8" of an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit.

Dark Ascension (Aura).brief: Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 6" making a Dark Pact: until end of phase its weapons gain both abilities of that pact (instead of one).

Dark Blessing (Aura).brief: Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit within 6": Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

Dark Blessings.brief: Once per battle, just after an enemy unit selects targets: until end of phase, bearer has a 3+ Inv.

Dark Destiny.brief: Each time this model's unit makes a Dark Pact and passes the Leadership roll with a 7+: +1 CP.

Dark Fervour (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG models within 6": ranged weapons have [Assault].

DARK HARVEST.brief: Start of Fight phase, up to 2 WRACKS units or 1 other DRUKHARI unit: until end of phase, their melee weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Dark Pacts.brief: Army Faction HERETIC ASTARTES, when selected to shoot or fight: can make a Dark Pact: Leadership test first, failed = D3 MW; then weapons gain [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1] until end of phase.

Dark Ritual.brief: Once per battle, your Command phase, with a CULT DEMAGOGUE: until end of turn, can charge after Advancing; attacks +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

Dark Sacrifice#744deea3fb.brief: CHAOS KNIGHTS unit selected to shoot/fight: friendly DAMNED unit within 6" takes a Ld test, passed = destroy D3 models, failed = D3+3; then weapons get [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1] until end of phase.

Dark Sacrifice#b0094e57d3.brief: Your Command phase, friendly DAMNED unit (not ACCURSED CULTISTS) within 9" of a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS model: pick a CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9", roll D3+3: your DAMNED unit suffers that many MW, that model heals that many wounds.

DARK VIGOUR.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit (not BEASTS/VEHICLE) within 8" of it: Normal move of up to 6".

Dark Vitality.brief: DRUKHARI: bearer's unit is always Empowered (no Pain tokens needed for its Pain abilities).

Dark Zealotry#1a6f5ee98b.brief: Leading a unit with a DARK APOSTLE: melee attacks of that unit +1 to Wound.

Dark Zealotry#9c3a821056.brief: Melee attacks of this unit: +1 to Wound roll.

Darkest Artifice.brief: Attacks targeting CRONOS/TALOS units with S greater than the target's T: -1 to the Wound roll. COVENS tag: cannot be taken with another COVENS detachment.

Darkglass Prism.brief: Disembarks from a TRANSPORT: until end of turn, enemy units cannot Fire Overwatch at this unit.

Darting Attacks.brief: Your Shooting or Charge phase, one TYRANIDS unit: until end of phase, eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Dat'll Learn Ya.brief: Once per battle round per unit, when battle-shocked with 4+ Gretchin: you can roll a D3; that many Gretchin are destroyed and the unit is no longer battle-shocked.

Data-blessed Autosermon.brief: Once per battle, start of your Command phase: the Benediction of the Omnissiah not chosen is also active for the bearer's unit until your next Command phase.

Data-severed.brief: If no KASTELAN ROBOT models in the unit: unit loses VEHICLE and has INFANTRY.

Data-spike.brief: Start of Fight phase: 1 enemy VEHICLE in Engagement Range of this model's unit, roll a D6: on 4+ it suffers D6 MW and its melee weapons get -1 WS until end of phase.

Daughters of the Abyss.brief: Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability: [Feel No Pain 3+] against Psychic Attacks; Psychic Null (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" have [Feel No Pain 5+] against Psychic Attacks.

Dauntless Champions.brief: PALADIN SQUAD unit selected to fight: if the attacks' S is lower than the target's T, +1 to Wound rolls.

Dauntless Defenders.brief: Start of round 1: 2 objectives become your foundations (40mm markers); a unit crossing the line between them is on your defensive line. IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit on it: Against the Horde, attacks on visible enemies can ignore Hit modifiers and its weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Dauntless Veteran.brief: Re-roll Battle-shock tests for this unit.

Dazzling Acrobatics.brief: Can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Dead Reckoning.brief: End of turn, bearer on the battlefield and no YP spent this turn: gain 1YP.

Dead-shot.brief: When selected to shoot, until this unit has shot: enemy units lose Lone Operative; Hidden enemy units have +15" detection range.

Dead‐shot.brief: When selected to shoot, until this unit has shot: enemy units lose Lone Operative; Hidden enemy units have +15" detection range.

DEADLY DEBUT.brief: Fight phase, DRUKHARI unit that charged this turn, not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, melee weapons have [Lethal Hits]; if WYCHES, also +1 AP.

DEADLY DECEIVERS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit just targeted: until end of phase, it can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18".

Deadly Stalkers.brief: Attacks targeting an enemy unit more than 6" from any other enemy unit: +1 to wound rolls.

Deadly Vectors.brief: Opponent's Command phase, roll 2D6 for each Afflicted enemy unit (-1 if Below Half-strength): on 6 or less, it suffers D3 MW.

DEATH ANSWERS DEATH.brief: End of opponent's Shooting phase, YNNARI unit (not WRAITH CONSTRUCT) that lost models this phase: it shoots as if it were your Shooting phase.

Death Approaches.brief: Your Movement phase, when set up by Deep Strike: can be more than 6" from Afflicted enemy units and more than 8" from all other enemy units.

Death Befitting An Officer.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, when destroyed, before Deadly Demise, roll D6: on 2+, stay on the table; after the attacker has shot, shoot back at that unit only, then resolve Deadly Demise and remove.

Death Begets Vengeance.brief: any phase, enemy unit that destroyed a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit: it is hated until the end of the battle; friendly DEATH COMPANY attacks targeting it have +1 to Wound rolls.

Death Blow#143a001635.brief: If this unit charged this turn: melee attacks +1 AP.

Death Blow#2564bec1e7.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to Charge rolls.

Death Blow#d64f578f79.brief: Destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: D6, on 4+ it fights after the attacking unit has finished, then is removed.

Death Companion.brief: INFANTRY only. Feel No Pain 6+; unless within 12" of a friendly CHAPLAIN: cannot Fall Back and OC 0; gains DEATH COMPANY; attaches only to DEATH COMPANY MARINES (incl. with Bolt Rifles).

Death Companion with Jump Pack.brief: INFANTRY only. M 12", Deep Strike, Feel No Pain 6+; unless within 12" of a friendly CHAPLAIN: cannot Fall Back and OC 0; gains DEATH COMPANY, FLY, JUMP PACK; attaches only to DEATH COMPANY MARINES WITH JUMP PACKS.

DEATH DENIED.brief: Your Command phase, 1 SHADOW LEGION unit: 1 model regains up to 3 wounds; if TZEENTCH, also return up to 1 destroyed non-CHARACTER model with full wounds.

DEATH ECSTASY.brief: Fight phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit: until end of phase, each model destroyed before fighting stays in play, fights after the attacker, then is removed.

DEATH FRENZY.brief: Fight, TYRANIDS unit just targeted: each model destroyed before fighting, D6; on 4+ it still fights after the attacker, then is removed.

Death From Below.brief: End of opponent's turn, if not within Engagement Range: remove from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

DEATH FROM ON HIGH.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit arrived from Reserves this turn, not yet selected to shoot/fight: re-roll Wound rolls until end of phase.

DEATH FROM THE SKIES.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit that just Advanced or Fell Back: can shoot and charge this turn.

Death Guard Defenders.brief: While within 3" of friendly DEATH GUARD INFANTRY: this model has Lone Operative.

Death Hex (Psychic).brief: Start of your Shooting phase, 1 PSYKER: enemy unit within 12" and visible, D6: 1 = PSYKER's unit suffers D3 MW; 2+ = attacks on that unit +1 AP until start of your next Movement phase.

Death is Not Enough.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) takes a Battle-shock test; -1 to the test if those attacks destroyed a model.

Death Korps of Krieg Medi-pack.brief: Start of your Command phase, if the unit is below Starting Strength: return up to D3 destroyed Death Korps Troopers (D3+1 if 2 medi-packs in the unit).

Death Mask of Ollanius.brief: OFFICER only. While the bearer's unit is Battle-shocked: -1 OC to its models instead of OC 0.

Death Mask of Sanguinius.brief: Start of Fight phase: each enemy unit within 6" makes a Battle-shock roll with -1.

DEATH ON THE WIND.brief: your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that ended an Advance move: that Advance does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

Death Scream.brief: your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: 1 unit hit must take a Battle-shock test at -1.

Death to the Alien.brief: Attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if the target does not have IMPERIUM/CHAOS, re-roll Hit rolls.

Death Totem.brief: Melee attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Death Visions of Sanguinius.brief: Fight phase, enemy unit has fought and destroyed this model: roll D6, +2 if engaged with enemy WARLORD; 2-3 = D3 MW, 4-5 = 3 MW, 6+ = D3+3 MW to that unit.

Death’s Heads.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, one enemy unit hit: until end of turn, friendly NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA attacks on it re-roll Wound rolls.

DEATH’S HEADS.brief: Your Shooting phase, unengaged BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit not yet shot: 1 enemy unit (not VEHICLE) within 8" and visible has the effect of all Plagues (Nurgle's Gift) until your next turn.

DEATHLESS DUTY.brief: Fight phase, DEATH COMPANY unit just targeted: until end of phase, each model destroyed that has not fought stays in play, fights after the attacker has finished, then is removed.

Deathstrike Missile.brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot, if the Deathstrike missile has not fired this battle: also place a Deathstrike Target marker anywhere; or move the existing marker anywhere.

Deathwatch Mission Tactics.brief: Start of your Command phase: 1 Mission Tactic active for DEATHWATCH units until your next Command phase, each once per battle; Furor: weapons have [Sustained Hits 1]; Malleus: weapons have [Lethal Hits]; Purgatus: on a Critical Wound, attack has [Precision].

Deathwing.brief: Attacks of this unit can ignore modifiers to BS, WS and Hit rolls.

Deathwing Assault.brief: Your first Movement phase: this unit can make an ingress move.

Debt to the Soulforge.brief: Each HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE model making a Dark Pact can invoke its contract: -1 to the resulting Leadership test; until end of phase, ranged attacks +1 to Wound rolls and melee weapons +2 A.

Decapitating Strikes (Pain).brief: Fight phase, when selected: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; while Empowered, melee attacks against INFANTRY have [Devastating Wounds].

Deceptive Feint.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8", unengaged HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit: Normal move of up to D3+3".

DECEPTIVE GLAMOUR.brief: Start of Fight phase, THOUSAND SONS unit: until end of phase, enemy models in Engagement Range can target it only if no SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit is an eligible target.

Decisive Command.brief: Next Order issued by this model: to 1 eligible friendly unit within 12"; if it is your army's first Order this Command phase, it also affects every other eligible friendly unit within 6" of that unit.

Decisive Destruction.brief: Ranged attacks of this unit against the closest eligible target: re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Decoy Targets.brief: CALLIDUS ASSASSIN only, twice per battle (max once per round), your Movement phase: destroy 1 friendly INFANTRY model not in Engagement Range; set this model up as close as possible to it, out of Engagement Range.

Decoys and Misdirection.brief: After both armies are deployed: redeploy up to 3 GENESTEALER CULTS units; they may go into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

Dedication to Duty.brief: Model destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: on a 4+, it fights after the attacking unit has finished, then is removed.

Deeds of Legend.brief: While within range of an objective: melee attacks +1 A.

Deeds That Speak to the Masses.brief: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD only: start the battle with 2 additional Resurgence points.

Deepening Madness Upgrade.brief: DESTROYER CULT MOUNTED only: ranged attacks have [Assault].

Defect Scrutiny.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit selected to shoot: pick 1 visible enemy unit within 12" of a RECON AUGURY unit; your unit's ranged attacks on it have [Ignores Cover].

Defence Line#c724bdc20c.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY model with the Benefit of Cover from this terrain feature: 4+ Inv.

Defend at All Costs.brief: DIRE AVENGER, GUARDIAN, SUPPORT WEAPON and WAR WALKER models: +1 to Hit if their unit and/or the target is within range of an objective marker.

Defend the Divine Work.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: all models in this model's unit have a 4+ Inv until end of phase.

Defenders of the Faith#9da08d9114.brief: End of your Command phase, within range of an objective you control: it stays yours even with no models in range, until the opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

Defenders of the Faith#c3607032f4.brief: End of your Command phase, if within range of an objective marker you control: it stays yours until your opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Defensive Mastery.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. After both armies are deployed: redeploy up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units; they can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

Defensive Stance.brief: Fire Overwatch on this unit: hits on unmodified 5+; 4+ instead if within range of an objective marker you control.

Deff from Above.brief: Your Shooting phase, if this unit made an ingress move this turn: ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

Deff from the Shadows (First battle roun.brief: End of opponent's Movement phase, if in strategic reserves: this unit can make an ingress move.

DEFT MANOEUVRING.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy targets chosen, targeted ACHILLES RIDGERUNNERS or ATALAN JACKALS unit: 4+ Inv until end of phase.

Deft Parry.brief: Melee attacks targeting this unit: -1 to Hit rolls.

DEFT PARRY.brief: Fight phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit: until end of phase, attacks targeting it have -1 to Hit rolls.

Delayed Mutations.brief: Your Command phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (except DAMNED): suffers D3 MW, then gains one chosen augmentation in addition to its others until your next Command phase.

DELAYED-FIRE ROUNDS.brief: Your Shooting phase, after a BRÔKHYR, IRONKIN STEELJACKS or ARKANYST EVALUATOR unit shot, that unit: 1 enemy unit it hit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE), until your next Shooting phase each time it makes a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, roll 1D6 per model: each 1 = 1 MW (max 6).

Delicious Eating Squigs.brief: Your Movement phase, friendly RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit: any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" each heal 3 wounds.

Delight in Agony.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit: attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound rolls.

Delightful Agonies.brief: First time destroyed, end of phase: D6, on 2+ set back up as close as possible to where it was destroyed, outside Engagement Range, full wounds.

DELIRIUM UNMADE.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, 1 unengaged LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit (or up to 2, even engaged, for 1 Flux token): removed from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

Deluge of Nurgle (Aura).brief: Enemy units within 6": -2 M and -1 OC.

Dêlvewerke Navigator.brief: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase: 1 friendly CTHONIAN BESERKS unit visible to bearer, spend any YP: return 1 destroyed non-CHARACTER model, +1 more per 2YP spent.

Demagogue.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 12" of the DARK APOSTLE is no longer Battle-shocked.

Demanding Leader.brief: Your Command phase, 1 friendly NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (not TITANIC) within 6": eligible to shoot in a turn it Fell Back, until your next Command phase.

Demi-company Commander (Once per turn, p.brief: Once per turn. When a friendly CAPTAIN uses Strategic Acumen: the selected combat doctrine is active for this unit until your next Command phase.

Demolition Charges.brief: Each time this model or an enemy unit ends a move, if within 3" of an enemy unit: this model is destroyed; instead of Deadly Demise, roll D6: 2-5 that unit suffers D3 MW; 6 D6 MW.

Demolition Gear.brief: Bearer's unit has the GRENADES keyword.

Demolition Run.brief: Once per round, your Movement phase, after a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move: pick 1 enemy unit within 6" and visible, roll 1D6 per ATALAN JACKALS model; each 4+ = 1 MW (max 6).

DENIZENS OF THE WARP.brief: Your Movement phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit arriving by Deep Strike: can be set up anywhere more than 6" from all enemy models.

Denuncia Oratory.brief: Each time the bearer's unit's quarry is destroyed: pick a new enemy unit as quarry.

Denunciator of Tyrants.brief: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD only: bearer's unit attacks targeting a CHARACTER unit: +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

Deployment Complete.brief: Once set up and all embarked units have disembarked: units cannot embark within this unit.

Deployment#14bd2d0395.brief: Set up as 1 platform, up to 5 shield, up to 2 broken shield and up to 2 end sections, all connected (broken sections at the end or mid-line within ½" of each other); all count as a single model.

Deployment#2adbd7edcb.brief: First set up: no Unit Coherency needed, each model wholly within 12" of another model of the unit; then each model is a separate unit.

Deployment#e3c8b5644e.brief: Both parts of this FORTIFICATION deploy within 1" of each other; then treated as a single model.

DEPTHLESS CRUELTY.brief: Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit not yet fought: attacks against Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength units get +1 AP.

DERANGED FEROCITY.brief: Fight phase, TZEENTCH MUTANT unit selected to fight: until end of phase, Pile-in and Consolidation moves up to 6" instead of 3"; models within 3" of enemy models can fight and target those units in Engagement Range of the unit.

DESCENT OF ANGELS.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit arriving by Deep Strike: set up anywhere more than 6" from all enemy units ; cannot declare a charge this turn.

DESECRATION OF WORLDS.brief: Your Command phase, THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit in range of an objective you control: that objective stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Designated Targets.brief: SCOUT SENTINEL and ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE units get Signal Flares: in your Shooting phase, pick 1 visible enemy unit within 12", it is designated and has +3" detection range. RECON tag: cannot be taken with another RECON detachment.

Desperate Devotion.brief: DAMNED unit with Dark Pacts selected to make a Normal/Advance move or charge (not arrived from Reserves this turn) can make a Desperate Pact: Leadership test first, failed = D3 MW; then +2" Move and +2 to Charge rolls until end of phase. TRAITOR GUARDSMEN SQUAD gain BATTLELINE.

Desperate for Redemption.brief: Start of your Command phase: 1 Vow until your next Command phase, each once per battle; Path of the Penitent: PENITENT +3" Move; Absolution in Battle: unit that charged, PENITENT melee +1 A and +1 S; Death Before Disgrace: PENITENT slain in melee before fighting, on 2+ it fights before removal.

DESPERATE PLEDGE.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit not yet shot/fought: if it invokes its contract, its attacks get +1 AP.

Despoilers.brief: Each time this unit makes a Dark Pact: until end of phase, re-roll Hit rolls.

Despot's Claim.brief: Start of your Command phase, if on the battlefield: roll 1 D6, +1 if wholly within 12" of enemy deployment zone; on 5+ gain 1CP.

Dessication Conduit (Aura).brief: End of turn, each enemy unit within this model's Contagion Range: roll one D6; on 4+, D3 MW.

Destabilising Predation Upgrade.brief: NORN EMISSARY only. Bearer's unit's ranged attacks have [Anti-Character 2+].

Destabilising Quakes.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: one enemy unit hit by tremor shells takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

DESTINED BY FATE.brief: Any phase, after a failed save, that THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model: that attack's Damage becomes 0 (fast dice: pick 1 of the failed attacks).

Destroy the Daemonic.brief: INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS and ORDO MALLEUS models' attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; against a DAEMON unit, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 as well.

Destroyer Ankh.brief: Bearer gains DESTROYER CULT keyword; models in the bearer's unit +2" M; bearer's melee weapons +2 A.

Destroyer Cult.brief: While leading: ranged attacks of the unit score a Critical Hit on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

Destroyer of Futures.brief: Once per phase, per unit: Counter-offensive can target this unit regardless of other uses this phase; -1 CP and does not block other uses.

Destructor.brief: Ranged attack of this model targeting an enemy INFANTRY unit: AP improved by 1.

Destructor Optics.brief: Ranged attacks vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE units: +1 AP.

DETONATOR.brief: Any phase, after an enemy model with Deadly Demise (not TITANIC) is destroyed, HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit within 18" of it: its Deadly Demise MW are inflicted automatically, no roll (random amounts still rolled).

Devastating Assault.brief: After a Charge move, until end of turn: its hellforged weapons have [Devastating Wounds].

Devastating Charge.brief: Each time this model's unit ends a Charge move: every enemy unit within Engagement Range takes a Battle-shock test.

Devastating Refrain.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, Indirect Fire hit on an enemy unit: it takes a Battle-shock test; models with Deadly Demise destroyed by such attacks explode on 5+ instead of 6.

Devastating Reprise.brief: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly EXORCIST unit has shot, one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY unit: select one enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by those attacks; your ranged attacks on it have [Devastating Wounds].

DEVASTATING SORCERY.brief: Your Shooting phase, THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit not yet shot: until end of phase, +9" Range on its Psychic weapons and re-roll Hit and Wound rolls with Psychic weapons.

Devastator Mastery.brief: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

Devious Disguises Upgrade.brief: NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS only. Bearer's unit: -3" detection range.

Devious Mastermind.brief: Once per battle round, when this model's unit is targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

DEVOTED CREW.brief: Enemy targets chosen (Shooting/Fight), targeted GOLIATH ROCKGRINDER or GOLIATH TRUCK unit: until end of phase, attacks against it have -1 D.

DEVOTED DUELLISTS.brief: Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units not yet selected to fight: pick 1 enemy unit; their melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1] against it until end of phase.

Devoted to Destruction#13b38eb5f6.brief: If equipped with 2 melee weapons besides its close combat weapon: +2 A on those two weapons.

Devoted to Destruction#6b6e3c1649.brief: If equipped with 2 melee weapons besides its close combat weapon: +2 A on those 2 weapons.

Devoted to Pain.brief: Model equipped with 2 macro-scalpels: those weapons have [Twin-Linked].

DEVOUT FANATICISM.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, PENITENT unit it targeted: can make a surge move of up to D6".

Devout Push.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit selected to pile-in/consolidate: that move can be up to D3+3".

DEVOUT PUSH.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, Pile-in and Consolidation moves of up to 6" instead of 3". Not with Hearts Hardened to Duty same phase unless CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR.

DIABOLIC BULWARK.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit targeted: until end of phase, 4+ invulnerable save.

DIABOLIC MAJESTY.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit becomes Favoured Champions: each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test at -1. Once per battle round.

Diabolic Regeneration.brief: Your Command phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (except DAMNED): 1 destroyed model (not CHARACTER) returns; D3 if BATTLELINE.

Diabolic Savant.brief: Bearer within 6" of 1+ friendly SCINTILLATING LEGION units: +1 to Psychic test results when Channelling the Warp.

Diamond of Distortion.brief: While leading: attacks targeting the unit -1 to Hit.

Digital Weapons.brief: Bearer selected to fight: roll 3D6, each 4+ = 1 MW to 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, allocated as [Precision].

DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR.brief: Charge phase, NECRONS unit set up this turn via the Eternity Gate of a MONOLITH that started the turn on the battlefield: eligible to charge this phase.

Dimensional Overseer.brief: NECRONS only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves: +1 unit selectable for Hyperphasing.

Dimensional Sanctum.brief: CRYPTEK only. Models in the bearer's unit have Infiltrators.

Dimensional Tunnel.brief: Movement phase, NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (not TITANIC): until end of phase, its models can move horizontally through models and terrain features.

Direct the Slaughter.brief: Once per round, friendly WORLD EATERS unit within 12" targeted by a Stratagem: its cost -1CP.

Dirtcycle.brief: M 12", T 4, MOUNTED instead of INFANTRY; loses Deep Strike and Infiltrators, gains Scouts 9" and Stealth; can only be attached to ATALAN JACKALS.

Disciple of Khorne.brief: LORD ON JUGGERNAUT only: bearer has Deep Strike and the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of WORLD EATERS.

Disciples of Be'lakor.brief: Unit has Dark Pacts (as in Codex: Chaos Space Marines); Be'lakor auto-passes its Leadership test; SHADOW LEGION HERETIC ASTARTES models have [Deep Strike].

Discordant Disruption (Aura)#314389c3d7.brief: Enemy PSYKER units within 12": their Psychic weapons have [Hazardous].

Discordant Disruption (Aura)#b4c5bbe20f.brief: Enemy PSYKER units within 12": their Psychic weapons have [Hazardous].

DISDAIN FOR THE WEAK.brief: Fight phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit targeted: until end of phase, Feel No Pain 6+, and Feel No Pain 5+ against attacks from Battle-shocked models.

Disease of Mirth (Aura).brief: Start of Fight phase: each enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 6" takes a Battle-shock test.

Diseased Cover#17b38c25ab.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a model not fully visible to every attacking model because of this FORTIFICATION: Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Diseased Cover#3dc5956e33.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a model not fully visible to every attacking model because of this FORTIFICATION: Benefit of Cover.

Diseased Influence.brief: Enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of a friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 6" of this model: that DEATH GUARD unit, if unengaged, can make a Normal move of up to 5".

Diseased Malice.brief: Attacks of this model targeting an Afflicted unit: +1 to Wound.

DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after targets chosen, targeted DEATH GUARD unit: attacks allocated to it have -1 D until end of phase.

Disharmonisation Cascade.brief: Any phase, just after a NECRONS MONSTER model is destroyed, before its Deadly Demise roll, that model: until end of phase, its Deadly Demise inflicts MW on a D6 of 3+ instead of 6.

Disparate Paths.brief: Mustering: HARLEQUINS units can be included even without the ASURYANI Faction keyword; Harlequins or Ynnari cannot be your Army Faction.

DISPENSE JUSTICE.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, its weapons have [Lethal Hits].

DISPERSED FORMATION.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets are chosen, targeted LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit: until end of phase, Stealth and Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

DISPLACER FIELD.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit selects targets, targeted AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit (not OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM): until end of phase, 4+ Inv; after the attacker resolves its attacks, if not engaged, Normal move of up to 6" as if FLY.

Displays of Savagery.brief: Friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ units' melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Disruption Bombardment.brief: your Shooting phase, after this unit shoots: 1 enemy INFANTRY unit hit is disrupted until end of opponent's next turn: -2" M, -2 to Advance and Charge rolls.

DISTILLERS OF FEAR.brief: Fight phase, HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its attacks against Battle-shocked units have [Devastating Wounds].

Distortion.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: +1 A and +1 D.

Distortion Fields (Aura).brief: Enemy unit within 6": attacks targeting it have AP improved by 1; start of each phase, each NECRONS MONSTER can suffer 3 MW to extend this aura to 9" until end of phase.

Dividends of Agony.brief: Fight phase, HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit destroys an enemy unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Divinator-class Auspexes (Once per phase.brief: Once per phase. Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot: pick 1 visible enemy unit within 18"; it is scanned: ranged attacks targeting it re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Divine Aspect.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. Your Movement phase: 1 enemy unit within 12" takes a Battle-shock test; if failed, gain 1 Miracle dice.

Divine Authority.brief: Each attack by a model in this unit: re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

Divine Deliverance.brief: Once per battle, start of the Fight phase: until end of phase, melee weapons of this model get +3 A and [Devastating Wounds].

DIVINE GUIDANCE.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit not yet selected to shoot or fight: until end of phase, its attacks have AP improved by 1; if they destroy 1+ enemy models, gain 1 Miracle dice.

Divine Imperative.brief: Your Charge phase, GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of an engaged friendly TYRANIDS unit declaring a charge: +1 to Charge rolls; optionally re-roll the Charge roll but must end engaged with an enemy unit engaged with that TYRANIDS unit.

DIVINE INTERVENTION.brief: Any phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER just destroyed (not SAINT CELESTINE, once per CHARACTER per battle): discard 1-3 Miracle dice; end of phase, set it up unengaged near where it died, alone, with D3+1 per discarded die wounds (max starting W).

Diviner of the Futures.brief: Start of your Command phase, if on the battlefield: +1 CP.

Doctrina Imperatives.brief: Start of battle round: 1 Imperative for units with this ability until end of round: Protector = ranged [Heavy], +1 BS, -1 to hit it in melee if BATTLELINE or within 6" of one; Conqueror = ranged [Assault], +1 WS, +1 AP same condition.

Doctrinal Flexibility.brief: Your Command phase, CRUSADER SQUAD unit: pick one combat doctrine, active for it until your next Command phase.

Dodge Dis!.brief: This unit's attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

Dominance Protocols.brief: Command phase, friendly IMMORTALS unit: +1 OC until end of the turn.

Domination Fire.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot: one enemy unit hit is suppressed until the start of your next turn; its attacks get -1 to Hit rolls.

Domination of the Hive Mind (Aura).brief: friendly TYRANIDS units within 9" of this model are within Synapse Range.

Doom (Psychic).brief: End of your Movement phase: 1 enemy unit within 18" and visible; until your next Command phase, friendly AELDARI attacks against it get +1 to Wound.

DOOM INESCAPABLE.brief: Your Shooting phase, AVATAR OF KHAINE model not yet selected to shoot: its Wailing Doom ranged weapon has Range 18" and Damage 8 until end of phase.

Doom Siren#454d432e94.brief: Your Shooting phase, after the unit shoots: 1 enemy INFANTRY unit hit, roll 3D6; each 4+ = 1 MW; if any MW suffered, Battle-shock test.

Doom Siren#fba4fd33ec.brief: Your Shooting phase, after unit has shot: 1 enemy INFANTRY unit hit, roll 3D6: each 4+ = 1 MW; if any MW, that unit takes a Battle-shock test.

Doomseer.brief: PSYKER only: this unit's attacks +1 to Hit roll.

Doomseer's Amulet.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; bearer's unit set up in your Reinforcements step: 1 enemy unit within 12" and visible takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

DOUBLE-CROSS.brief: Fight phase, KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit just targeted + 1 friendly DRUKHARI unit (not VEHICLE): until end of phase, while the DRUKHARI unit is engaged with the attacker, attacks allocated to the KABAL/BLADES FOR HIRE unit get no save; the DRUKHARI unit suffers MW equal to the attack's D instead.

Downtrodden.brief: Transport capacity: each 2 Gretchin (rounding up) count as 1 model.

Dragonfire Rounds.brief: Your Shooting phase, KILL TEAM unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and have [Ignores Cover].

DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS.brief: Your Shooting phase, DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot (not already targeted by Kraken/Hellfire Rounds): until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Assault] and [Ignores Cover].

Drain Life.brief: End of Fight phase, each enemy unit within 6": D6, on 4+ it suffers D3 MW.

Drakolithe (Once per battle, per token).brief: Enemy unit ends a move within 8", if this unit is unengaged or that enemy ended engaged with it: roll D6, on 3+ it suffers 1 MW; once per Drakolithe equipped.

DRAUGHT OF TERROR.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit not yet shot/fought: until end of phase, its weapons' AP improved by 1 and re-roll Wound rolls against Battle-shocked units.

DRAW THEM OUT.brief: Enemy Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, PLATOON unit within 8" of it and not engaged: it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

DRAWN TO DESPAIR.brief: Your Shooting phase, DEATH GUARD unit not yet shot: its attacks against a visible enemy unit (not AIRCRAFT) in the enemy deployment zone can re-roll the Hit roll until end of phase.

DRAWN TO THE SLAUGHTER.brief: any phase, JAKHALS unit just destroyed: an identical new unit goes into Strategic Reserves at full strength; once per battle, attached Characters not returned.

Dread Catechism.brief: Fight phase, friendly CHAPLAIN unit destroys an enemy unit: enemy units within 6" of it make a Battle-shock roll; friendly CHAPLAIN units have Sower of Dread (Aura): enemy units within 6" have -1 Ld. Army: DARK ANGELS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES from another Chapter.

Dread Crusaders.brief: Opponent's Charge phase, enemy unit selects charge targets, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit among them: that enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

DREAD CRUSADERS.brief: Opponent's Charge phase, enemy unit declares a charge, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit among its targets: that enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Dread Dominion (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG models within 9": Ld and OC improved by 1.

Dread Foe.brief: Melee attacks vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE units: +1 AP.

Dread Majesty (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS units (not MONSTER, TITANIC) within 6": re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Dread Power.brief: Your Movement phase, friendly ORKS WALKER unit: riled up until start of your next turn.

Dread Reaver.brief: Bearer's melee attacks while wholly within 12" of enemy deployment zone: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

Dread Reputation.brief: When bearer's unit is set up on the battlefield: each enemy unit within 6" (12" if set up by Deep Strike) takes a Battle-shock test.

Dread Snipers.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: 1 enemy unit hit by those attacks takes a Battle-shock test.

Dread Tyrants (Aura).brief: Friendly DAMNED unit within 9": its attacks re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1.

Dreadherder.brief: BIG MEK only. Within 3" of a friendly ORKS WALKER (not BIG MEK): Lone Operative; your Shooting phase, 1 friendly ORKS WALKER within 3" re-rolls Hit rolls of 1 this turn.

Dreaming Crown (Aura).brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH only. Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units (not MONSTERS) within 6": melee attacks +1 to Hit roll.

Drill Commander.brief: OFFICER only. While leading a unit, its ranged attacks, if the unit Remained Stationary: Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

DRIVE THEM OUT!.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit not yet shot/fought: attacks on enemy units on your defensive line score Critical Hits on unmodified 5+.

Drive-By Bustin'.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit selected to shoot: ranged attacks with weapons chosen for Firing Deck have +1 to Hit rolls.

Drive-by Skorchin'.brief: Your Movement phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 6" (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) cannot be targeted with Fire Overwatch until the end of the turn.

Driven by Duty.brief: GREY KNIGHTS WALKER only: when the bearer's unit Piles In or Consolidates, the bearer moves up to 6" instead of 3".

Driven by Fury.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots and hits this unit: surge move of up to D6+1".

Driven by Hatred.brief: Attacks vs an enemy unit Below Half-strength: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

DRIVEN BY THE PAST.brief: Your Charge phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit: until end of turn, can charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Driven by Ultimate Rage (Aura).brief: Friendly WORLD EATERS unit within 6": melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Driven from Cover.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: pick 1 enemy unit hit; friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES ranged attacks targeting it have [Ignores Cover].

Driven from their Lairs.brief: While a friendly ARMIGER unit is affected by a Bondsman ability, its ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover]. ARMIGERS tag: cannot be taken with another ARMIGERS detachment.

Driven to Butchery.brief: Shooting phase or Charge phase, DESTROYER CULT unit: until end of turn, eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite Advancing; once per turn.

Droneport.brief: When this FORTIFICATION is selected to shoot: its drone defenders weapon attacks every enemy unit that is an eligible target.

Droning Horror.brief: Your Shooting phase, PLAGUE MARINES unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks re-roll hit rolls of 1; against a unit within half range, also re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Droning Shroud (Aura).brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE MONSTER only. Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE units within 6": only targetable by ranged attacks from within 18".

Drop Pod Assault.brief: Must start in strategic reserves; can make an ingress move in your first Movement phase; when set up, embarked units must disembark/assault disembark more than 8" from enemy units.

DS8 Support Turret.brief: Your Movement phase, if the unit Remains Stationary: until start of your next turn, the Shas'ui is equipped with the support turret weapon.

Dubious Restraint.brief: Start/end of your Movement phase, friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit: one objective it controls is secured.

Duellist’s Hubris.brief: Start of Fight phase, if not leading a unit: Fights First until end of phase.

Duplicitous Malediction.brief: After deployment: redeploy up to 3 THOUSAND SONS units, into Strategic Reserves if wished regardless of the limit.

Dutiful Tenacity.brief: attacks targeting friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED units with S greater than the unit's T have -1 to Wound rolls. Army: DARK ANGELS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES from another Chapter.

Duty Before All.brief: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR units are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

Duty Eternal.brief: Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to wound.

Duty in Death.brief: Fight phase, enemy unit targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to fight: each model destroyed, roll a D6 (+1 if assault doctrine active); on 4+ it stays until the unit has fought or end of phase.

Duty is Never Done.brief: End of the Fight phase, unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit eligible to fight, wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark in: it embarks within that TRANSPORT.

DUTY UNENDING.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy in Engagement Range Falls Back, GREY KNIGHTS unit now unengaged: if it has Deep Strike, place it into Strategic Reserves.

Duty Unto Death.brief: Fight phase, DEATHWING unit targeted before fighting: each model destroyed rolls 1 D6 (+1 if engaged with an enemy within range of your vowed objective); on 4+ it stays until your unit has fought or the phase ends.

DUTY UNTO DEATH.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit targeted that has not fought yet: each model destroyed, roll D6 (+1 if CHARACTER): on 3+ it stays until the unit has fought or end of phase.

DYNAMIC BREAKTHROUGH.brief: Your Movement phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit not yet moved: until end of phase, moves through enemy models (not MONSTER/VEHICLE), may pass within their Engagement Range but not end there; Desperate Escape tests auto-passed.

Dynamic Efficiency.brief: Can charge in a turn it Advanced or Fell Back; re-roll Desperate Escape tests for its models.

Eager Advance.brief: INFANTRY OFFICER only. While leading a REGIMENT unit: that unit has Scouts 6".

EAGER FOR THE KILL.brief: Start of your Movement phase, up to 2 WYCHES units or 1 other DRUKHARI unit not yet moved: until end of phase, when Advancing, no Advance roll: +6" M instead (not cumulative with Reavers' Matchless Swiftness).

Eager for Vengeance.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES (not DAMNED) only. Unit can shoot and charge after Falling Back; if it Fell Back, attacks vs your focus of hatred +1 to Hit and +1 to Charge rolls vs it.

Eager to Kill.brief: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit when set up: +1 to Charge rolls until end of turn.

Eager to Prove.brief: Bearer's unit: re-roll Charge rolls; while your army's Favoured Champions: +2" M.

Eagle's Eye.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only: +1 W; once per battle per army, when attacks are allocated to this model: 3+ Inv.

Earthshaker Rounds.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if the earthshaker cannon hit an enemy INFANTRY unit: until your next Shooting phase that unit is shaken (-2" M, -2 to Charge rolls).

Eater of Dread.brief: Start of your Command phase, if on the battlefield: roll 1 D6, +1 per Battle-shocked enemy unit on the battlefield; on 5+ gain 1CP.

Eater Plague (Psychic).brief: Your Shooting phase, one enemy unit within 18" and visible: roll D6; 1 = this unit suffers D3 MW; 2-5 = target suffers D6 MW; 6 = target suffers D3+3 MW.

Echo of the Ravenspire.brief: End of your opponent's Fight phase, if unengaged: you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

Echoes of the Conduit Wars.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit selected to attack: its attacks on a unit within range of an objective re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Echoes of Ulthanesh.brief: ASURYANI MOUNTED; your Command phase: roll one D6, +1 if bearer outside your deployment zone, +1 more if in the enemy's: on a 5+, gain 1CP.

Echojump.brief: Your Shooting phase, after an INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit has shot: it cannot use Personal Teleporters, and makes a surge move of up to D6+1".

Economy of Motion.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PIONEERS unit, that unit: Normal move of up to D3+3".

Ecstatic Death.brief: Destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: D6, 2+ = not removed; fights after the attacking unit, then removed.

ECSTATIC SLAUGHTER.brief: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit destroys an enemy unit, friendly unengaged EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it: can declare a charge; if it already fought this phase, it cannot fight again.

Ectoplasmic Extrusion.brief: Your Shooting phase, SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit starting an action: that action does not stop it shooting.

Edge of the Blade.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only; if this unit charged this turn: this model's attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

EGOTISTICAL POWER.brief: Your Command phase, THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit: pick Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium; until your next Command phase it applies to this unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if already used this battle.

Eldritch Flames.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit cannot have the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Eldritch Flames (Psychic).brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shot: 1 enemy unit hit loses the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Eldritch Nightmare.brief: DESTROYER CULT only. Start of Fight phase: each enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test.

Eldritch Suppression.brief: Your Shooting phase, RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit that has shot: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test, at -1 if it lost a model to those attacks.

Eldritch Vortex of E'taph.brief: Bearer's Psychic weapons: +1 S and +1 D.

Electro-Infusion.brief: While a CHARACTER is leading this unit: attacks targeting it get -1 to Wound roll.

Electro-shock.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) is shocked until the end of your opponent's next turn: -2" Move, -2 to Advance and Charge rolls.

Elemental Ensnarement.brief: End of your Fight phase, if not battle-shocked: roll D6, on 1 this unit is battle-shocked; one visible enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE (not TITANIC) within 18" is ensnared until your next turn: -2" M, cannot be pinned.

Elevated Might.brief: WINGED TYRANID PRIME/TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP only. Melee attacks: re-roll Wound rolls; +1 AP.

Elevated Strider.brief: Can shoot in a turn it Fell Back or Advanced; re-roll Desperate Escape tests for its models.

Elixir of the Corpse Courts Upgrade.brief: CRONOS/TALOS only: the unit has a 5+ Inv.

Elusive.brief: Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9": if not in Engagement Range, Normal move of up to 6".

Emanatus Forcefield (Aura).brief: Friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE models wholly within 6": 4+ Inv against ranged attacks.

Embarking#3bbc26838d.brief: Embarked: each Heavy Weapons Gunner takes up the space of 2 models; its weapons count as 2 models' weapons for Firing Deck.

Embarking#ff5b341334.brief: Embarked: each model takes up the space of 2 models; its weapons count as 2 models' weapons for Firing Deck.

Embodied Prophecy.brief: When selected to fight: melee weapons get [Sustained Hits 1] or [Lethal Hits] until end of phase; both if the unit made a Charge move this turn.

EMBRACE THE PAIN.brief: Start of Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit: until end of phase, enemy models within its Engagement Range must target it.

EMISSARIES OF YNNEAD.brief: Fight phase, YNNARI INFANTRY unit that just chose its targets: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if below Starting Strength, re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Emnity for the Unworthy.brief: Attacks of this unit targeting a CHARACTER unit: +1 to Hit rolls.

Emotionless Clarity.brief: Once per turn, friendly LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE model with [Deadly Demise] destroyed within 12": no roll, mortal wounds automatically inflicted.

EMP GRENADES.brief: Enemy Shooting phase or Fight phase, after an enemy VEHICLE is selected to shoot/fight, KROOT GRENADES unit within 8" of it: that VEHICLE's weapons get WS and BS worsened by 1 this phase.

EMPEROR'S DOMAIN.brief: Fight phase, TRUSTED SENTINEL unit selected to consolidate: it can use the objective consolidation mode regardless of Before Moving restrictions, even leaving engagement range.

Emperor's Light.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only: this model has the Emperor's Light weapon.

EMPEROR’S WILL.brief: Your Movement phase, AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit: until end of phase, eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Emplacement Platform.brief: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY models can be set up or end any move on top of this FORTIFICATION's platform section.

Empowered by Death.brief: Start of Fight phase, if this model's unit is below Starting Strength: models in the unit have Fights First.

Empowered Engines.brief: Friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY units have +6" M. HYPERCRYPT tag: not with another HYPERCRYPT detachment.

Empowered Manifestation.brief: Bearer's unit wholly within your Flow of Magic: +6" range to the bearer's ranged Psychic abilities (incl. Rituals); re-roll Hazardous tests for Psychic weapons in the unit.

Empyric Ambush.brief: While leading: the unit can declare a charge in a turn it used Flickerjump.

Empyric Dislocation.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not DAMNED): attacks targeting it get -1 AP until the attacker finishes; not with Armour of Corruption on the same unit that phase.

Empyric Guidance (Psychic)#1fda7cb206.brief: Weapons of models in this unit have [Lethal Hits].

Empyric Guidance (Psychic)#3c962c1a4b.brief: While leading a unit: weapons of models in that unit have [Lethal Hits].

Empyric Onslaught.brief: Bearer's unit wholly within your Flow of Magic: bearer's ranged Psychic weapons +3 A.

Empyric Suffusion.brief: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Heroic Intervention stratagem on this unit: -1 CP.

Empyric Symbiote.brief: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls for bearer's unit.

Empyric Wellspring.brief: Your Shooting phase, HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit (not DAEMON) selected to shoot making a Dark Pact: ranged attacks +1 S. Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE / DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS (not KHORNE) selected to fight making a Dark Pact: melee attacks +2 S and +1 AP.

Enaegic Dermal Bond.brief: NECRONS only. Bearer has Feel No Pain 4+.

Encephalic Diffusion (Aura, Psychic).brief: enemy units within 6" of this model: -1 to Hit rolls; -1 to Wound rolls too if Below Half-strength.

Encircling Horrors Upgrade.brief: NEUROLICTOR/LICTOR/VON RYAN'S LEAPERS only. Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of bearer's unit: it makes a Normal move up to D3+3".

ENCIRCLING PACK.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, WAR DOG unit wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge and not in Engagement Range: removed and placed into Strategic Reserves.

Encircling Surge.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in Engagement Range: removed from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

ENCIRCLING THE PREY.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge: remove it and place it into Strategic Reserves.

ENCROACHING DARKNESS.brief: Your Shooting phase, up to 1 SHADOW LEGION HERETIC ASTARTES and up to 1 SHADOW LEGION LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit arrived from Reserves this turn: until end of phase, their weapons have [Ignores Cover].

ENDLESS IRE.brief: Any phase, after your focus of hatred is destroyed, HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit (not DAMNED): 1 visible enemy unit within 12" becomes your focus of hatred until your next Command phase.

ENDLESS PURSUIT OF VIOLENCE.brief: end of Fight, WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark in: it embarks.

Endless Servitude.brief: End of Fight phase, NECRONS unit (not MONSTER/TITANIC) within range of an objective marker you control: its Reanimation Protocols activate.

Endless Suffering.brief: Can charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

ENDLESS SWARM.brief: your Command, up to 2 ENDLESS MULTITUDE units in Synapse Range (or 1 other): each returns up to D3+3 destroyed models.

Enduring Vengeance.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

ENEMIES WITHOUT NUMBER.brief: Your Command phase, just after completing a Contract, ARCHON WARLORD: pick a new Contract (even one already completed) and a matching enemy unit on the battlefield as the new Contract unit.

Enemy Within.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase: friendly unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units can be placed in Strategic Reserves. PURESTRAIN tag: cannot be taken with another PURESTRAIN detachment.

Enfeebling Miasma (Aura).brief: Enemy units (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 6" that Fall Back: must take Desperate Escape tests, at -1 if Battle-shocked.

Enfilading Emergence.brief: end of your Movement, TYRANIDS unit set up as Reinforcements this turn: weapons [Sustained Hits 1] and [Ignores Cover] until end of your next Fight phase.

ENFOLDING NIGHTMARE.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shot, HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit it targeted: surge move of up to D6".

Enforcer Commander.brief: While leading: ranged attacks targeting the unit have their AP worsened by 1.

Engine of Wrath.brief: Fight phase, ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit not yet selected to fight: pick 1 enemy unit engaged with it; until end of phase, its melee weapons get +6 Attacks and +2 AP, and it can only target that enemy.

Engine Speaker.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER only. Each use of Omnissiah's Blessing: selected VEHICLE gets +3" M until start of your next Command phase.

Enginseer#1f666dc050.brief: While within 3" of friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE units and not leading a unit: this model has Lone Operative.

Enginseer#be5357f46c.brief: While within 3" of a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit: this model has [Lone Operative].

Engrammatic Logic#b831910e79.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly NECRONS unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Engrammatic Logic#c706d3a94a.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase, 1 friendly Battle-shocked NECRONS unit within 12": no longer Battle-shocked.

Engulfing Fear (psychic level 1).brief: Your Shooting phase, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6, 1 = this unit battle-shocked; 1 enemy unit within 12" makes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

Enhanced data-tether.brief: Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem: roll a D6, on 5+ gain 1 CP.

Enhanced Runt-Maw Upgrade.brief: BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN only. After shooting: 1 enemy unit hit is infested with Snotlings until the start of your next turn: -1 to Leadership rolls.

Enhanced Warriors.brief: Attached to a unit at start of battle: Bodyguard models of that unit have +1 S on melee weapons and +1 T all battle.

Enrage Machine Spirits.brief: End of your Movement phase: 1 enemy VEHICLE within 12" must take a Battle-shock test.

Enraged Behemoths.brief: TYRANIDS MONSTER models: +1 to hit while below Starting Strength, +1 to wound as well while Below Half-strength; +2 OC while at Starting Strength (not battle-shocked).

Enraged Reserves.brief: TYRANIDS MONSTER only. Bearer destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: D6, on 3+ it fights after the attacking unit has finished, then is removed.

Enraptured Damnation.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS only: enemy units cannot Fire Overwatch at the bearer's unit.

ENSLAVED ARTIFICE.brief: Shooting phase or Fight phase, NECRONS unit (not TITANIC) not yet selected to shoot or fight: until end of phase, unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ are Critical Hits.

Ensnaring Trap.brief: End of enemy Charge phase, AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit within 6" of enemies and eligible to charge them: it can declare a charge against them, no Charge bonus this turn; CALLIDUS ASSASSIN that charges this way: +1 to Wound in melee until end of turn.

Ensorcelled Animus.brief: Friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS units' attacks have [Psychic]; friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units: Infusion (Aura), friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" has +1 WS on melee attacks.

Ensorcelled Annihilation.brief: Ranged attack of this model targeting a MONSTER or VEHICLE hit by a Psychic attack of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER this turn: re-roll Hit roll and Damage roll.

Ensorcelled Destruction.brief: Ranged attack of this model targeting a unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by a Psychic attack of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER this turn: +1 S and AP improved by 1.

ENSORCELLED INFUSION.brief: Your Shooting phase, THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit not yet shot, within 6" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit: until end of phase, its VEHICLE models' ranged weapons have [Psychic] and +1 to Wound.

Enthralling Hypnosis (Aura).brief: Enemy unit within 6" selected to Fall Back: Leadership test; failed = must Remain Stationary instead.

Entreaty of Perpetual Ardour Upgrade.brief: HELLBLASTER SQUAD only: this unit's snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified 5+.

Entrophasic Aura Targeting.brief: Shooting phase or Fight phase, NECRONS unit (not MONSTER) not yet selected to shoot or fight: until end of phase, its attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1; against an unravelling target, also re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

ENTROPIC DAMPING.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, TITANIC model targeted and within 18" of the attacker: until end of phase, the attacking unit's weapons have [Hazardous].

Entropic Knell.brief: Battle-shock step of opponent's Command phase: each enemy unit within 6" below Starting Strength takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Ephemeral Tome.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; start of your Shooting phase, if not in Engagement Range: bearer's unit makes a Normal Move up to D6"; then cannot charge this turn.

Eradicate the Foe.brief: Attacks against an enemy unit at Starting Strength: re-roll Hit rolls.

Eradication Protocols.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1; if HALO OVERRIDE, re-roll Hit rolls of 1 too.

Errant's Duty (Bondsman).brief: Affected model: re-roll its Advance rolls; its ranged weapons have [Assault].

Eruption of Vitality.brief: INFANTRY/MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER only; once per battle per army, when destroyed, end of phase: D6, 2+ = set up unengaged as close as possible, alone (Starting Strength 1), with 3 wounds.

Esoteric Explosives.brief: CULEXUS ASSASSIN only: when targeted by the Grenades Stratagem, 1 MW per D6 roll of 3+ instead of 4+.

Establish Supremacy.brief: Fight phase, entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit consolidating: you can pick the objective consolidation mode regardless of its Before Moving restrictions (can leave Engagement Range).

Etacarn SB9 Targeting Implant.brief: Bearer's unit attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; unit selected to shoot or fight: spend 3YP for [Sustained Hits 1] on its attacks until end of phase.

Eternal Conqueror.brief: OVERLORD only. Attacks by the bearer's unit against an enemy unit within range of an objective: re-roll Hit rolls.

ETERNAL HATE.brief: Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit targeted: until end of phase, each model destroyed before fighting rolls a D6 (+1 if KHORNE): on 4+ it stays, fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

Eternal Madness.brief: Fight phase, each model in the bearer's unit destroyed before fighting: on 4+, it stays and fights after the attacking unit, then is removed.

Eternity Gate.brief: Your Movement phase (not round 1): 1 friendly NECRONS INFANTRY unit (Strategic Reserves or battlefield) makes an ingress move wholly within 6" of this unit, unengaged, even in enemy deployment zone; no charge this turn.

Ethereal Form.brief: Each time this model destroys an enemy unit: regains up to D3 W.

Ethereal Pathway.brief: ASURYANI only: Deploy Armies step, select up to two GUARDIANS units: their models have Infiltrators.

ETHEREAL PHANTASM.brief: Enemy Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, unengaged SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit within 8" of it: Normal move up to D6", or up to 6" if wholly within 6" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS unit.

Etheric Emergence.brief: Your Movement phase, when set up via Deep Strike: can be set up anywhere more than 6" from all enemy units, but cannot declare a charge this turn.

Euphoric Crown.brief: LORD EXULTANT model only. Bearer's melee attacks: +1 S.

Euphoric Inspiration.brief: Your Charge phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN DAEMON unit: until end of phase, re-roll Charge rolls for friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units within 6" of it.

Euphoric Strikes.brief: Once per battle, start of Fight phase: until end of phase, this model's melee weapons +3 A and AP improved by 1.

Evade and Survive (Once per phase, per u.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if unengaged: this unit makes a normal move of up to D3+3".

Evasion Engrams.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this unit shot: Normal Move up to 6"; then cannot declare a charge this turn.

Evasive Manoeuvres#e59175e992.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets are chosen, targeted ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or FLY VEHICLE unit: until end of phase, attacks against it have -1 to Wound.

Evasive Protocols.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit targets friendly NECRONS MOUNTED unit: ranged attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound rolls.

Evasive Repositioning.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy has shot, unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound: Normal move of up to D6"; or, if entrenched, up to D3+3"; cannot embark in a TRANSPORT this turn.

EVASIVE VANGUARD.brief: Any phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing them, one of those markers: set it up anywhere more than 8" from all enemy units.

Even More Dakka.brief: If riled up: ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Eviscerating Fly-by#35732d2e59.brief: End of a Normal or Advance move: 1 enemy unit moved over (not MONSTER/VEHICLE), D6 per model in this unit, each 4+ = 1 MW.

Eviscerating Fly-by#b160f4940e.brief: End of a Normal move: one enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) moved over; roll 1 D6 per model in this unit: each 4+ = 1 MW.

EXACT PUNISHMENT.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit is destroyed, ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit within 6" of it: after the attacker shot, shoots as in your Shooting phase at that enemy unit only (if eligible).

Exacting Cruelty.brief: WYCH CULT units' melee attacks have [Lethal Hits] against units that are not MONSTER or VEHICLE. Wych Cult tag: cannot be taken with another Wych Cult detachment.

Exacting Punishment.brief: your Shooting or Fight phase, CHAPLAIN unit selected to attack: its attacks have [Precision].

Exalted Patron.brief: LORD EXULTANT model only. +1" M for the bearer.

Excessive Assault.brief: Melee attacks: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; target within range of an objective marker: re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Excessive Vigour (Aura).brief: Friendly SLAANESH unit within 6" that made a Charge move this turn: its melee weapons' AP improved by 1.

Execute and Redeploy.brief: PHOBOS only. Your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if unengaged: Normal move up to 6"; it then cannot declare a charge until end of turn.

EXECUTION ORDER.brief: Your Command phase, ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit: pick 1 enemy CHARACTER unit; until your next Command phase, its weapons have [Precision] against that CHARACTER.

Executioner#0ad769fd66.brief: Attacks vs a unit Below Half-strength: +1 to Hit; enemy unit destroyed by this model: each other enemy unit within 3" takes a Battle-shock test.

Executioner#c7525e5c18.brief: Ranged attacks targeting a unit not below half-strength: +1 to hit.

Exemplar of Duty Upgrade.brief: COMMISSAR only. Feel No Pain 4+; in Declare Battle Formations, can be attached to an OGRYN SQUAD or BULLGRYN SQUAD unit.

Exemplar of Hate.brief: Melee attacks of this unit: re-roll Hit rolls.

Exemplar of the Code.brief: Start of battle: pick 1 enemy unit as quarry; attacks vs the quarry: re-roll Wound rolls; quarry destroyed: pick a new one.

Exemplar of the Einhyr.brief: While leading a unit: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls of that unit.

Exemplar of the Kauyon.brief: T'AU EMPIRE (not KROOT SHAPER) only. While leading a unit: Patient Hunter Detachment rule applies to it from battle round 2 instead of 3.

Exemplar of the Mont'ka.brief: T'AU EMPIRE (not KROOT SHAPER) only. While leading a unit: Killing Blow Detachment rule applies to it during battle round 4 as well.

EXEMPLAR’S WISDOM.brief: Your Shooting phase, after an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model shoots, it plus friendly ARMIGER models affected by its Bondsman ability: pick 1 enemy unit hit by those attacks; until end of phase, your ARMIGER attacks vs that unit have AP improved by 1.

Exemplars of Mont’ka.brief: Ranged attacks targeting the closest eligible target: [Sustained Hits 1] and [Ignores Cover].

Exemplary Officer.brief: INFANTRY OFFICER only. Bearer issues an Order to its own unit: up to 2 other PLATOON units within 3" also receive it.

Exemplary Vigilance.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase its ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover] ; if under the Devastator Doctrine, also +1 AP.

Exhortation of Rage.brief: While at or below half-strength: this unit's melee attacks re-roll wound rolls.

Exit the Stage.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged HARLEQUINS unit: place it in Strategic Reserves.

EXIT THE STAGE.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, HARLEQUINS unit not in Engagement Range: remove it and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Exotic Munitions.brief: ANHRATHE only: ranged weapons of the unit have [Anti-Monster 5+] and [Anti-Vehicle 5+].

EXPEDITED PURGE PROTOCOL.brief: Your Charge phase, 1 SKITARII unit: eligible to declare a charge this turn even though it Advanced.

EXPEDITIOUS EXIT.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit: if every model has Deep Strike, remove it into Strategic Reserves (even if engaged, in addition to Gate of Infinity).

Experimental Ammunition.brief: Your Shooting phase, BATTLESUIT CHARACTER unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks get +1 S; or +1 S, +1 AP and [Hazardous].

Experimental Enhancements (Pain).brief: Fight phase, when selected to fight, spend 1 Pain token to Empower: until end of phase, melee weapons of non-CHARACTER models have A 3; or A 4 and [Hazardous].

Experimental Modifications.brief: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS unit selected to attack: its attacks have +1 AP.

Expert Fieldcraft.brief: Your Shooting phase, when a PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit shoots: those ranged attacks do not prevent it from being hidden.

Exploding Horrors#427f4ad2d0.brief: Selected to fight: pick 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range and 1+ BRIMSTONE HORRORS, roll 1 D6 each; 4+ = that model destroyed, enemy unit 1 MW.

Exploding Horrors#7902c13a62.brief: Each time selected to fight: one enemy unit within Engagement Range, then any BRIMSTONE HORROR models; each one, roll D6: on 4+ it is destroyed and that enemy suffers 1 MW.

Exploit Their Cowardice.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with this unit ends a fall-back move: if this unit is unengaged, normal move of up to 6".

Explosive Blight.brief: Your Shooting phase, each time this model's attack destroys an enemy unit: before removing the last model, roll D6 (+1 if Afflicted); on 5+ enemy units within 6" of it are Afflicted until your next turn.

EXPOSED FLAWS.brief: Your Shooting phase, HERNKYN unit not yet selected to shoot (optionally spend 2YP): until end of phase, re-roll Wound rolls if YP spent and/or against assailed units.

Exquisite Swordsmanship.brief: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit selected to fight that made a Charge move this turn: its melee weapons have 1 chosen ability: [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1].

EXTINCTION ORDER.brief: Your Command phase, 1 TECH-PRIEST model and 1 objective within 24": each enemy unit in range of it, D6 4+ = 1 MW and Battle-shock test.

Extra Armour.brief: SENTINEL COMMANDER only. M 8", T 8, Sv 2+; loses Scouts 9".

Extra Sneaky Upgrade.brief: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

Extraction of Fresh Disease.brief: First time this model's unit destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack: +6 OC for this model until end of battle.

Extreme Mobility.brief: Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge moves: ignore vertical distance.

Extremis Sanction.brief: OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units use Overkill, Soulless Horror and Shieldbreaker twice per battle instead of once (max once per battle round); when mustering, each OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM unit has its Extremis ability and its points cost is increased by the amount shown.

Extremis Trigger Word.brief: When selected to fight, optional: until end of phase, arco-flails have A 6 and [Hazardous].

Eye For Weakness.brief: Attacks of the bearer's unit against an assailed unit: +1 to Wound rolls.

Eye of Abaddon.brief: While bearer is on the battlefield, each time your focus of hatred is destroyed: roll 1 D6, on 4+ gain 1CP.

Eye of Affliction.brief: Ranged weapons of the bearer's unit have [Ignores Cover] against an Afflicted enemy unit.

Eye of Judgement (Psychic).brief: Each attack by this model: can re-roll the Wound roll.

Eye of Oblivion.brief: WARPSMITH only; when selected to shoot: 1 enemy unit within 24" has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

Eye of Spite.brief: SUCCUBUS: bearer's melee weapons +1 A and AP improved by 1; when its unit is selected to fight, may spend 1 Pain token: +2 A and AP improved by 2 instead until end of phase.

Eye of the Augurium.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only: can use Heroic Intervention on this unit for -1 CP, regardless of and not preventing other uses this phase.

EYE OF THE GODS.brief: Fight phase, after a HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit (not DAMNED/DAEMON/EPIC HERO) destroys an enemy unit, 1 CHARACTER model in it: until end of battle, +1 M, T, W and +1 A, S, D on its melee weapons.

Eye of the Hunt.brief: Friendly HERNKYN units' ranged attacks against a unit within 12" have +1 to Hit rolls.

Eye of the Hunter.brief: WOLF GUARD BATTLE LEADER only. This unit's ranged attacks have [Assault], [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.

Eye of the Pack.brief: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit selected to attack: its attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and 2.

Eye of the Swarm.brief: Your Shooting phase, PLAGUE MARINES unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Close-Quarters].

Eye of the Warp.brief: When bearer's unit is set up on the battlefield: until end of turn, re-roll Charge rolls for it.

Eye of Tzeentch#a78b33f264.brief: Bearer's unit makes a Dark Pact and passes the Leadership test with a result of 8+: gain 1 CP.

Eyes of the Cult.brief: Start of your Shooting phase, one NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a terrain area: enemy units within that terrain area have +6" detection range.

Eyes of the Hunter.brief: Ranged weapons of bearer's unit have [Ignores Cover].

Eyes of the Oracle.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. Bearer's weapons have [Precision]; each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER model: gain 1 CP.

EYESTINGER STORM.brief: Opponent's Command phase, DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit: 1 objective visible to it; each Afflicted enemy unit within range of it takes a Battle-shock test (no other Battle-shock test this phase).

Fables of Nightmare.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. While 2+ ARMIGER models are under the bearer's Bondsman ability: their melee weapons have [Precision].

Fabricator Claw Array (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS VEHICLE units within 6" of bearer: [Feel No Pain 6+].

Face of Death#cbfa5e2e42.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Face of Death#fa31d7c08d.brief: Start of Fight phase: each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit takes a Battle-shock test.

Fade Away (Pain).brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, if not in Engagement Range: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; remove this unit and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Fade Back.brief: Trigger: opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit shot: one eligible unit (not TITANIC) hit by those attacks makes a Normal move of up to D6+1".

Fade to Darkness.brief: End of Fight phase, if bearer's unit destroyed ≥1 enemy unit this phase and is not in Engagement Range: remove it and place it into Strategic Reserves.

FAIL NOT THE BLOOD GOD.brief: Fight, JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit: re-roll hit rolls of 1; full hit re-rolls if within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a TITANIC.

FAIL-SAFE DETONATOR.brief: Any phase, after a T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model is destroyed, its unit: if it has Deadly Demise, choose the roll result as 1 or 6; otherwise roll a D6 per unit within 6": on 4+, D3 MW.

Failure Is Not an Option.brief: While leading: unit's models have Feel No Pain 5+.

FAITH AND FURY.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Lance]; if its attacks destroy 1+ enemy models this phase, gain 1 Miracle dice.

Faith-fuelled Resolve.brief: Fight phase, SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit within range of an objective: its melee attacks have +1 A. Army: BLACK TEMPLARS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter.

Faithful Cenobytes.brief: Chaplain Grimaldus destroyed: remaining CENOBYTE SERVITOR models also destroyed; each CENOBYTE SERVITOR takes up 0 transport capacity.

Faithful Flock.brief: Leading a unit with a CULT DEMAGOGUE: models in that unit have 5+ Inv.

Faithful Fortitude.brief: Any phase, CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit that suffers a MW: Feel No Pain 5+ vs MW until end of phase.

False Majesty (Aura).brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH only. Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units (not MONSTERS) within 6": melee attacks +1 to Wound roll.

Falsehood.brief: Can start in Reserves; in a Movement phase: destroy 1 model of a friendly LEGIONARIES or CHOSEN unit (2+ models, not Attached), bearer set up in its place and attaches as Leader.

Fanatical Hail.brief: Your Shooting phase, NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit selected to shoot: select one enemy unit; ranged attacks against it re-roll Hit rolls.

Fanged Leer.brief: DEATH JESTER: Cruel Amusement grants two abilities to the shrieker cannon instead of one.

Fangrune Pendant.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR only. Bearer's unit can shoot and charge in a turn it Fell Back.

Fangs of the Brood.brief: Start of Fight phase, TROUPE unit: its Dance of Death grants 3 abilities instead of 1 until end of phase.

Fangs of the Pack#1cf0d95ef3.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Precision].

Fangs of the Pack#e129469e30.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Precision].

Faolchú.brief: Ranged weapons of bearer's unit: [Ignores Cover].

Far-reaching Doom.brief: When a RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit is selected to shoot, enemy units have +6" detection range until it has shot.

Fârstrydr Node.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have Deep Strike.

FATE INESCAPABLE.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASURYANI INFANTRY unit (not WRAITH CONSTRUCT) not yet selected to shoot, within 9" of an ASURYANI PSYKER: ranged weapons get [Ignores Cover] and each Critical Wound improves AP by 1 until end of phase.

FATEBORNE NIGHTMARES.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit: until end of phase, its models can move through terrain features.

Fated Hero.brief: Start of battle, choose INFANTRY, MONSTER, MOUNTED or VEHICLE: attacks against that keyword re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Fateful Role.brief: Fight phase, DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit just targeted: until end of phase, each model destroyed before fighting, D6 (+1 if losing the wager): on 4+ it stays, fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

Fates in Flux.brief: Start with 3 Flux tokens; spend 1 to re-roll an Advance/Hit/Wound/Damage roll, save or Hazardous test of a LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit (some Stratagems too); each spent token goes to the opponent, who may spend it likewise and give it back. Your Command phase: +1 token if the opponent has any.

Fateskimmer.brief: While leading: the unit's melee weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Faultless Opportunist.brief: Can be targeted by Heroic Intervention regardless of other uses this phase: that use is -1 CP ; does not prevent other uses on other units this phase.

Favoured Ka'tah: Calistus.brief: Readied unit using the Calistus Ka'tah also: +2" M.

Favoured Ka'tah: Conservai.brief: Readied unit using the Conservai Ka'tah also: until end of turn, an advance/fall-back move does not prevent it from starting an action.

Favoured Ka'tah: Dacatarai.brief: When a friendly readied unit uses the Dacatarai Ka'tah [Martial Ka'tah], additional effect: enemy units engaged with it have -2" to their Pile-in and Consolidation moves.
