Favoured Ka'tah: Kaptaris.brief: Readied unit using the Kaptaris Ka'tah also: 1 enemy unit engaged with it makes a battle-shock roll at -1; same enemy unit once per phase.

Favoured Ka'tah: Rendax.brief: Readied unit using the Rendax Ka'tah also: pick 1 enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE engaged with it, roll D6: 1-2 = 1 MW; 3-5 = D3 MW; 6 = 3 MW.

Favoured Ka'tah: Salvus.brief: When a friendly readied unit uses the Salvus Ka'tah [Martial Ka'tah], additional effect: its ranged attacks have +6" range.

Favoured of Khorne.brief: Each Blessings of Khorne roll, if the bearer is on the battlefield: re-roll up to 2 of the D6.

Fear Incarnate (Aura)#2e4c9a5c09.brief: Enemy units within 6": Ld worsened by 1; in the opponent's Battle-shock step, such a unit below Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test.

Fear Incarnate (Aura)#941385454f.brief: Enemy units within 6": Ld worsened by 1; Battle-shock step of opponent's Command phase, such a unit below Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test.

Fear of the Unseen (Aura)#2e4c9a5c09.brief: Enemy units within 6": -1 Ld; Battle-shock step of opponent's Command phase, if such a unit is below Starting Strength: it must take a Battle-shock test.

Fear of the Unseen (Aura)#941385454f.brief: Enemy units within 6": -1 Ld; in the Battle-shock step of opponent's Command phase, such a unit below Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test.

Feared Interrogator.brief: Start of the Fight phase: each enemy CHARACTER unit within 6" makes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

Fearsome (Aura).brief: Enemy unit within 6": -1 to Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

Fearsome Assault.brief: Start of the Fight phase: each enemy unit engaged with this unit takes a battle-shock roll at -1.

Feculent Despair (Aura, Psychic).brief: Enemy units within 6": -1 to Battle-shock tests.

Feed the Swarm.brief: your Command: each HARVESTER unit Regenerates 1 friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" (once per unit per phase): 1 model regains up to D3+1 wounds, or 1 destroyed INFANTRY model (not CHARACTER) returns; ENDLESS MULTITUDE: up to 3 models return.

Feeder Tendrils#77b3ece897.brief: This model destroys an enemy CHARACTER model: gain 1CP.

Feeder Tendrils#80c06b1544.brief: Melee attack of this unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER model: gain 1CP.

Feeder Tendrils#d23ff73e99.brief: Each time this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER model: +1 CP.

Feeding Frenzy.brief: melee attacks of this model against a unit below Starting Strength: +1 to Hit roll; +1 to Wound roll too if Below Half-strength.

FEEDING FRENZY.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) Falls Back, HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or Vashtorr unit in Engagement Range of it: enemy units (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) Falling Back from your units take Desperate Escape tests for every model; -1 if Battle-shocked.

FEIGNED RETREAT.brief: Your Movement phase, ASURYANI unit that just Fell Back: it can still shoot and charge this turn.

FEIGNED WEAKNESS.brief: Your Movement phase, DRUKHARI unit that just Fell Back: it can shoot and declare a charge this turn.

Feint and Thrust.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: until end of turn, can shoot and charge in a turn in which it Fell Back; if a PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit, also after Advancing.

Fenrisian Ferocity.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or WALKER unit selected to move or declaring a charge: it has MOBILE.

Fenrisian Terminator Armor.brief: INFANTRY only. M 5", T 5, Sv 2+, W 5, Inv 4+; loses TACTICUS, gains TERMINATOR and Deep Strike; can only be attached to WOLF GUARD TERMINATORS.

Feral Arrogance.brief: Any phase, after a MW is allocated to a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit, that unit: until end of phase, Feel No Pain 5+ against MW.

Feral Rage.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: +1 A; each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until end of turn: +1 A more.

Ferocious Show-Off.brief: ORKS INFANTRY only. This model's melee attacks: +1 A; +2 A if the unit has 11+ models.

Fervent Exemplars Upgrade.brief: SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD only. This unit has +1 to Charge rolls.

Fervent Purgation.brief: Ranged weapons of ADEPTA SORORITAS models have [Assault]; each attack with such a weapon targeting a unit within 6" has +1 S.

Fervour of the Ancients (Aura).brief: Friendly SPACE WOLVES units within 6": +1 to Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

FESTERING MIASMA.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit targeted: until end of phase, Stealth; if a NURGLE unit, can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18".

FEVER VISIONS.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE unit not yet shot/fought: until end of phase, +1 to Hit; afterwards 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test.

Fevered Strategist.brief: Once per battle round, when a friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 12" is targeted by a Stratagem: its CP cost is reduced by 1.

FICKLEFIRE.brief: Your Shooting phase, 1 engaged LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit: until end of phase, it shoots as if not engaged; each enemy model destroyed while its unit is engaged with yours: on a 5+, your unit suffers 1 MW after the attacks.

Heavy Jump Pack and Mk X Gravis Armour.brief: INFANTRY only. M 10", T 6, W 5; loses TACTICUS, gains JUMP PACK, FLY, GRAVIS and Deep Strike; can only be attached to INCEPTOR SQUAD.

Heavy Walker.brief: Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves: can move over models (not TITANIC) and terrain 4" or less in height as if not there.

HEIGHTENED JEALOUSY.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, just after a unit becomes Favoured Champions or Favoured Champions destroy a unit: until end of phase, other EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units' attacks have +1 S.

Heirs of Azkaellon.brief: Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound rolls.

Helix Gauntlet.brief: Your Command phase: this unit heals D3 wounds.

HELLFIRE ROUNDS.brief: Your Shooting phase, DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot (not already targeted by Kraken/Dragonfire Rounds): until end of phase, its ranged weapons (except [Devastating Wounds]) have [Anti-Infantry 2+] and [Anti-Monster 5+].

Hellfire Rounds#afba73b889.brief: Your Shooting phase, KILL TEAM unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks (except [Devastating Wounds]) have [Anti-non-VEHICLE 4+].

Hellfire Rounds#e4381e017a.brief: your Shooting phase, KILL TEAM unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks (except [Devastating Wounds] attacks) have [Anti-non-VEHICLE 4+].

HELLFORGED CONSTRUCTION.brief: Fight phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit targeted: until the attacker finishes, attacks against it have AP worsened by 1.

Helm Conditioning.brief: Your Command phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit using a Bondsman ability: can select an ARMIGER model within 18" (excluding models already affected by a Bondsman ability).

Helm of All-Seeing.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (not DAMNED) only. Enemy units arriving from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of bearer.

Helm of Brazen Ire.brief: Each attack allocated to the bearer: -1 D.

Helm of the Fly King.brief: While leading a unit: models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacker is within 18".

Herald of Sacred Slaughter.brief: Declare Battle Formations step, bearer starts embarked in a DEDICATED TRANSPORT: that transport has [Scouts 9"].

Herald of the Apocalypse (Aura).brief: Enemy unit within 6" below Starting Strength: must take a Battle-shock test in opponent's Command phase (never 2 tests in a phase).

Herald of Triumph.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Once, when the bearer ends a Charge move: each enemy unit within its Engagement Range takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Herald of Ynnead.brief: Start of Fight phase: 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range; until end of phase, friendly AELDARI attacks against it re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

Heralds of the Throne.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES units have Fights First.

Herd banner.brief: While the bearer's unit is within range of an objective you control: +1 Ld.

Heresy Begets Retribution.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of an ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit, that unit: surge move of up to D6".

HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR unit within 8" of it and unengaged: surge move of up to D6".

Heretek Adept.brief: Once per battle round, failed save for a friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN VEHICLE within 6": change that attack's D to 0.

Hero of Hades Hive.brief: Your Command phase: select one ability from the Hero of Hades Hive section; this model has it until your next Command phase.

Hero of the Empire (Aura).brief: Friendly T'AU EMPIRE units within 6": ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Hero of the Golden Host.brief: CHAPTER OF THE CHAMPION only. M 12", Deep Strike; gains FLY and JUMP PACK; can only be attached to SANGUINARY GUARD.

HERO’S TREAD.brief: End of your Command phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model within range of an objective you control: your Level of Control there is 5 (unless higher) until the opponent's exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Heroes All.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit shoots/fights: Saga done, re-roll 1 Hit, 1 Wound, 1 Damage roll; else SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit re-rolls 1 of them. Saga of the Bold: 3 different Boasts by SPACE WOLVES CHARACTERS (kill Oath target; 2nd by same unit; in enemy zone; objective held outside your zone, round 2+).

Heroes of Legend.brief: Start of your turn, if your Oath is fulfilled: determine an additional Oath (never a Deed or Quality already chosen). Qualities of fulfilled Oaths keep applying to all Code Chivalric models; completing an additional Oath's Deed gives 1 CP instead.

Heroes' Fall.brief: Fight phase, HARLEQUINS unit targeted by an enemy unit: each model destroyed before the unit has fought, D6: on 4+ it stays until the unit has fought or the phase ends.

HEROES’ FALL.brief: Fight phase, after targets chosen, targeted HARLEQUINS unit: each model destroyed before fighting this phase, roll D6: on 4+ it fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

Heroic Fusillade.brief: Once per turn, after a model with this ability shoots: 1 INFANTRY unit hit must take a Battle-shock test.

Heroic Last Stand.brief: Fight phase, this model destroyed before its unit has fought: on a 2+, it stays until the unit has fought or the end of the phase.

Heroic Resolve.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, enemy unit targeting a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit: attacks targeting your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

HEROIC RESOLVE.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit picks targets, SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit targeted: until end of phase, each attack allocated to a model in your unit has -1 D.

HEX-MARKED ARMOUR.brief: Enemy Shooting or Fight phase, targeted THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit: until the attacker finishes its attacks, those attacks have AP worsened by 1.

HEXAGRAMMIC WARDS.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets, targeted ORDO MALLEUS unit: until end of phase, all [Psychic] weapons of the attacking unit have [Hazardous].

HEXWROUGHT REPRISAL.brief: End of any phase, GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit on the battlefield that suffered mortal wounds this phase: pick 1 enemy unit that inflicted them, roll 1 die per MW suffered; each 2+ = 1 MW to it (max 6), as Psychic Attacks.

HIDDEN ACCESSWAYS.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged CTHONIAN BESERKS, HEARTHKYN WARRIORS or HERNKYN YAEGIRS unit: removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

HIDDEN AMONGST THE DEAD.brief: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, POXWALKERS unit in Strategic Reserves (not Attached): it has Deep Strike until end of phase.

HIDDEN HUNTERS.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets chosen, KROOT unit targeted: this phase it can only be targeted by ranged attacks from models within 18".

High Kâhl#32e957012a.brief: Model of the bearer's unit destroyed by a melee attack before fighting: D6, on 4+ it fights after the attacker then is removed.

High Kâhl#b466ace3ac.brief: KÂHL only. Fight phase, model destroyed before this unit fought: D6, on 4+ it stays until the unit has fought or end of phase.

High King of Fenris#0714b116b5.brief: Once per battle round, your Movement phase: 1 friendly SPACE WOLVES unit in strategic reserves makes its ingress move as if the battle round number were 1 higher.

High Marshal.brief: Start of Fight phase, pick up to 1 enemy unit engaged with this unit, roll 1 D6: 2-3 = D3 MW ; 4-5 = 3 MW ; 6+ = D3+3 MW.

High Rune Priest (psyker level 3).brief: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Runic Abilities section.

High-speed Carnage.brief: If this unit made a charge move this turn: melee attacks have +1 S and D.

HIGH-SPEED FOCUS.brief: opponent's Shooting phase, RAVENWING unit selected as a target: attacks targeting it have -1 to Hit rolls until end of phase.

Higher Duty.brief: SPIRITSEER; opponent's Movement phase, an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit: if not in Engagement Range, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Higher Imperatives.brief: NORN EMISSARY and NORN ASSIMILATOR units: once per battle, in your Command, re-select their Singular Purpose.

Hit 'Em Harder.brief: Fight phase, friendly ORKS unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Hive Commander.brief: start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield: +1 CP.

Hive Defences.brief: Fire Overwatch on this model costs 0 CP, even if already used on another unit this turn; max once per turn on this model.

Holy Avarice.brief: Your Shooting phase, TECH-PRIEST unit starting an action: that action does not prevent it from shooting.

Holy Hatred#60b1e3e001.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Holy Judgement.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: 1 enemy unit within 12" and visible to Ephrael Stern takes a Battle-shock test (-2 if CHAOS); if failed, 3 MW.

Holy Mission.brief: Attached at Declare Battle Formations to a DOMINION SQUAD: gains [Scouts 6"]; to a SISTERS NOVITIATE SQUAD: gains [Infiltrators].

Holy Piety.brief: Each melee attack by this model, unless its unit is Battle-shocked: re-roll the Hit roll.

Holy Quest.brief: Friendly CELESTIAN units' attacks have +1 BS and WS. REVEREND tag: cannot be taken with another REVEREND detachment.

Holy Vanguard.brief: If a Leader is attached at Declare Battle Formations and this unit starts embarked in a TRANSPORT: that Leader gains [Scouts 6"].

Homing Beacon.brief: Once per battle: Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP; target set up within 3" of bearer's unit and more than 8" from all enemy units.

Honour Guard of Macragge.brief: Attacks targeting this unit: -1 to Wound roll.

Honour Indefatigable.brief: GRAVIS only. Once per battle, per army, end of a phase in which this model is destroyed: roll D6; on 2+, set it back up as close as possible to where it died, unengaged, with 3 W.

Honour is for Fools.brief: Fight phase, FLAWLESS BLADES unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Precision].

HONOUR OF THE HOLD.brief: Fight phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit not yet selected to fight (optionally spend 3YP): until end of phase its melee attacks against 1 chosen enemy unit within Engagement Range have +1 AP, or +2 AP if YP spent.

Honour of Ultramar.brief: Fight phase, this model destroyed before its unit fought: on 2+ it stays until the unit has fought or end of phase, then is removed.

Honour of Vigilance.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. This unit's ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits]; if the Devastator Doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll Advance rolls.

Honour or Death#3969cd0d88.brief: Heroic Intervention stratagem used on this unit: -1 CP.

Honour or Death#f5bf203e1a.brief: While this unit contains a RAVENWING CHAMPION: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls; Heroic Intervention stratagem on this unit costs -1 CP.

HONOUR THE PRINCE.brief: Your Movement phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit not yet moved: if it Advances, no Advance roll, +6" to M instead until end of phase.

Honourable Combatant.brief: OVERLORD only. Bearer's unit destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit: opponent loses 1CP if they have any.

HONOURED INTERRED.brief: Shooting or Fight phase, 1 ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit: Aura, ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Honoured to Serve.brief: Your Shooting phase, ARMIGER unit that has shot: those attacks do not prevent it from starting an action.

Hood of Hellfire (Psychic).brief: [Feel No Pain 4+] against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

Hordes of the Faithful.brief: Your Command phase: each friendly NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit within a terrain area heals 3 wounds. HOSTS tag: cannot be taken with another HOSTS detachment.

Hordeslayer.brief: Start of Fight phase, more enemy than friendly models wholly within 6" of the bearer: until end of phase, bearer's melee weapons +2 A; +3 A instead if its unit achieved 1+ Boasts.

Horrible Fascination (Psychic).brief: Start of opponent's Shooting phase, 1 PSYKER with this ability: 1 enemy unit within 12" and visible, D6: 1 = PSYKER suffers D3 MW; 2-5 = that unit -1 to Hit this phase; 6 = it cannot shoot this phase.

Horrific Incursion.brief: Your Movement phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit arrived from Reserves this turn: one enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 12" and visible takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Horrifying Beauty#61d4f905f8.brief: Start of Fight phase: enemy units in Engagement Range of units with this ability take a Battle-shock test, -1 if Below Half-strength.

Horrifying Beauty#9325c75e46.brief: Start of Fight phase: each enemy unit within Engagement Range of units with this ability takes a Battle-shock test, -1 if Below Half-strength.

HORRIFYING VIOLENCE.brief: enemy Command, WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit: each enemy unit in Engagement Range takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Horrifying Visage.brief: Each time this model ends a Charge move: one enemy unit within Engagement Range takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Horrors are Pink. Horrors are Blue. Wher.brief: No PINK HORRORS left: use the Blue Horrors datasheet; while 1+ PINK HORRORS remain, Sullen Malevolence and Exploding Horrors do not apply.
If the unit contains no PINK HORRORS: use the Blue Horrors datasheet; while it has PINK HORRORS, Cackling Horrors and Exploding Horrors do not apply.

Horsemasters.brief: Eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Host of Plagues.brief: End of your Movement phase, each enemy unit within 6": roll D6 (+1 if Afflicted); on 3+ it suffers D3 MW.

Host of the Hybridised Pox.brief: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY only. Once per battle per army, your Command phase: select one Plague from Nurgle's Gift; enemy units within this unit's Contagion Range also have its effect until end of battle.

Hover Drone.brief: Bearer can FLY and has M 10".

Hovering Death.brief: Eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Howling Horde.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit shoots and destroys a model of this unit: surge move up to D6".

Howling Plate.brief: LORD EXULTANT model only. Unit's ranged attacks: +1 AP.

Howlmaw.brief: WOLF PRIEST only. Once per turn, start of the Fight phase: 1 enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test with -1 to the roll.

Hulking Bodyguards.brief: While led by a CHARACTER, each attack targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound roll.

Hulking Brutes.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit targets friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit: ranged attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound rolls; or, for 1 additional CP, all ranged attacks targeting it have -1 to Wound rolls.

HUNGRY FOR COMBAT.brief: Start of Fight phase, 2+ WAR DOG units in Engagement Range of the same enemy: pick that enemy unit; until end of phase they can only target it, but their unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ are Critical Hits.

Hunter of Souls.brief: Attacks vs CHARACTER: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1 (vs PSYKER CHARACTER: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls); destroys a CHARACTER unit: regains up to D3 wounds (PSYKER: 3).

Hunter's Eye#2a575be3db.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Bearer's ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover].

Hunter's Eye#412cc94c6d.brief: Ranged weapons of models in the bearer's unit have [Sustained Hits 1] and [Ignores Cover].

Hunter's Guile.brief: After both armies are deployed: redeploy up to 3 friendly BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

Hunter's Helm.brief: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for bearer's unit.

Hunter’s Instincts.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit within 8" of it: Normal move of up to 6".

Hunter's Instincts#1d747569fe.brief: Your Movement phase, bearer's unit in Strategic Reserves: to set it up, treat the battle round as 1 higher.

Hunter's Instincts#5884a5c30f.brief: Attacks of KROOT models: +1 to Hit if the target is below its Starting Strength; +1 to Wound as well if the target is Below Half-strength.

Hunters from the Warp.brief: End of opponent's turn, if not in Engagement Range: remove unit and place it in Strategic Reserves.

HUNTERS’ TRAIL#44c3cba244.brief: Command phase, RAVENWING MOUNTED unit within range of an objective you control: that objective stays yours even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

HUNTERS’ TRAIL#8947606bec.brief: Fight phase, SPACE WOLVES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its Pile-in and Consolidation moves are up to 6" instead of 3", and need not end closer to the closest enemy model if they end as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

Hunting Grounds.brief: TYRANIDS only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each enemy Reserves unit set up: D6, on 2+ it must take a Battle-shock test.

Hunting Hounds#58bbfa1b9e.brief: Within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN), if not battle-shocked: this unit has +1 OC.

Hunting Hounds#e05056428c.brief: While within 12" of friendly KROOT CHARACTER models: models in this unit have OC 1.

Hunting Hounds#ea891afda8.brief: Within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN), if not battle-shocked: HUNTING WOLF models have +1 OC.

Huntmaster (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG within 6": its ranged weapons have [Assault].

HUNTR’S MARK.brief: Your Shooting phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase its attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Huntress' Eye.brief: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only; your Movement phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" takes a Battle-shock test with -1 to the roll.

Huntsman.brief: Attacks vs MONSTER or VEHICLE units: re-roll the Wound roll.

Hurtling Targets.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit targeted: ranged attacks targeting it have -1 to hit rolls.

Hymns of Battle.brief: Enhancements from this detachment do not count towards the army's enhancement total; friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER units have +1 Ld.

Hyper Adaptions.brief: start of round 1: 1 Hyper-adaptation for TYRANIDS units all battle; Swarming Instincts: [Sustained Hits 1] vs INFANTRY/SWARM; Hyper-aggression: [Lethal Hits] vs MONSTER/VEHICLE; Hive Predators: Critical Hits vs CHARACTER have [Precision].

HYPER-METABOLIC VIGOUR.brief: Fight phase, ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit not yet fought: until end of phase, Pile-in and Consolidation moves of up to 6" instead of 3", ending as close as possible to the closest enemy unit rather than model.

Hyperferocity.brief: Fight phase, GENESTEALER CULTS unit not yet fought: until end of phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 against an enemy unit; full re-roll if friendly TYRANIDS units are within 6" of that enemy unit.

Hypermorphic Fury.brief: ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS and PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units: +1 to Charge rolls; when selected to fight after a Charge move this turn, +1 A on melee weapons until end of phase.

Hypermotility Protocols.brief: Friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS units' ranged attacks have [Assault]; their Advance move does not prevent them from being eligible to start an action. DYNASTY tag: not with another DYNASTY detachment.

Hyperphasic Fulcrum.brief: CRYPTEK only. While leading, unit wholly within your Power Matrix: re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

HYPERPHASIC RECALL.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit shot or fought, NECRONS INFANTRY unit that lost models to it and a friendly MONOLITH: remove the INFANTRY unit and set it up wholly within 6" of the MONOLITH, unengaged.

Hyperphasing.brief: End of opponent's turn: up to 1/2/3 unengaged NECRONS units (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught) removed from the battlefield and placed in Strategic Reserves.

Hypersensory Abilities.brief: Once per turn, enemy Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, shoot at it, then Normal move of up to D6" (no embarking).

Hypersensory Adaptations.brief: start of your Shooting, DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR/VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" has +6" detection range.

Hypersensory Array.brief: Once per battle round: Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention on this unit for 1 less CP, even if already used on another unit this turn.

HYPERSENSORY SCILLIA.brief: enemy Movement, enemy unit just ended a move, up to 2 VANGUARD INVADER units or 1 TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit within 8" of it (unengaged): each makes a Normal move of up to 6".

Hyperspace Hunters.brief: Once per turn, Reinforcements step of opponent's Movement phase: enemy unit set up from Reserves within 18" and visible: this unit shoots it as if your Shooting phase.

Hyperspatial Transfer Node.brief: NECRONS only. Bearer's unit Advances: no Advance roll, +6" M until end of phase instead.

Hyperstimm Trafficker.brief: SUCCUBUS only: bearer's unit has +1 T.

Hyperstimms.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets, targeted AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit: until end of phase, +1 T; if EVERSOR ASSASSIN, also Feel No Pain 4+.

Hyperstimulation.brief: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for this unit.

Hypertoxic Miasma (Aura).brief: end of your Movement phase, 1 D6 per enemy unit within 6": 2-3 = 1 MW; 4-5 = D3 MW; 6 = D6 MW.

Hypervirulent Strains.brief: Friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER units have +3" Contagion Range (max 12").

Hypnotic Gaze (Psychic).brief: start of Fight phase: 1 enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model, -1 to Hit rolls until end of phase.

Hysterical Frenzy.brief: Model in this model's unit destroyed before fighting this phase: stays in play, fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks, then removed.

Icon of Despair (Aura).brief: Enemy units within 6" of the bearer: Ld worsened by 1.

Icon of Discipline.brief: This model's unit can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Icon of Excess.brief: End of your Shooting phase or Fight phase, if bearer's unit destroyed an enemy unit this phase: Leadership test; passed = gain 1 CP.

Icon of Flame.brief: Ranged weapons of the bearer's unit (excluding CHARACTERS): [Ignores Cover].

Icon of Khorne#cf3b413781.brief: If the bearer's unit has an Icon of Khorne: each time it destroys an enemy unit, gain 1 Bloodshed point; each Blessings of Khorne roll: +1 D6 per Bloodshed point, then all points are lost.

Icon of Khorne#dfed617051.brief: Bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit: gain 1 Bloodshed point; each Blessings of Khorne roll: +1 D6 per Bloodshed point, then all points are lost.

Icon of Obstinacy.brief: Attacks targeting this unit: -1 to hit rolls.

Icon of Old Caliban (Aura).brief: Friendly DARK ANGELS units within 6": Stealth.

Icon of the Angel.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) in Engagement Range of bearer's unit Falls Back: Desperate Escape tests as if Battle-shocked, at -1 if also Battle-shocked.

Icon of War#22f9c496f8.brief: Friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6": has Blessings of Khorne; if Might of Khorne is active, re-roll its Battle-shock tests.

Icon of War#960de90988.brief: 1 friendly SKITARII or THULIA GHULD unit within 6", until your next Command phase: Fanatical Devotion = shoot and charge after Advancing; Adaptive Tactics = after Falling Back; Fires of Mars = both Imperatives active.

Iconoclast Idol.brief: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Heroic Intervention stratagem on a friendly DAMNED unit within 6": -1 CP.

Icy Calm.brief: Your Movement phase, GREY HUNTERS unit selected to Advance/Fall Back: that move does not prevent it from starting an action.

Idol of Belligerence.brief: Your Movement phase, when an embarked unit is selected to disembark: that unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Idol of Blessed Blood.brief: Start of the battle round, if on the battlefield: Blessings of Khorne roll +1 D6.

Idols of Khorne.brief: start of your Command: 1 Idol (each once per battle) for WORLD EATERS MONSTER and TITANIC units until your next Command; auras 6" (9" if TITANIC) on JAKHALS/GOREMONGERS: Infinite Rage +1 to hit and wound; Burning Wrath +1" M, +1 Advance/Charge; Blessed Blood: other effect.

Ignis Judicium.brief: Bearer's ranged weapons gain [Devastating Wounds], [Melta 1] and [Precision].

ILLUMINATED PRIORITY.brief: Your Shooting phase, after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN VEHICLE unit shot, that unit: 1 enemy unit it hit, until end of phase LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY attacks against it re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

ILLUMINATING FIRE.brief: your Shooting phase, RAVENWING unit that selected its targets: pick 1 targeted enemy unit within 12"; friendly DEATHWING attacks targeting it have +1 to Wound rolls until end of phase.

Illuminor.brief: While within 3" of another friendly NECRONS unit: Lone Operative.

Image of Death.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, DESTROYER CULT unit targeted: until end of phase, attacks against it -1 to Hit rolls.

Immaterial Flare (Aura).brief: Friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model within 6" Channels the Warp: +1 to the Psychic test result (not cumulative with other modifiers).

Immolation Protocols.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its Torrent weapons have [Devastating Wounds].

Immolator.brief: [Torrent] weapons of models in the bearer's unit: +1 A.

IMMORTAL FURY.brief: Fight, WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit just targeted: models destroyed before fighting still fight after the attacker, then are removed.

Immovable Conquerors Upgrade.brief: GRAVIS only. This unit has +1 OC.

Impeding Fire.brief: Start of opponent's Charge phase, RANGERS, SHROUD RUNNERS or STARFANG unit: pick 1 enemy unit (not TITANIC) visible within 36"; its Charge rolls are -2 until end of phase (not cumulative with other negative modifiers).

Impending Krunch.brief: Your Charge phase, friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move: each enemy unit engaged with it makes a battle-shock roll with -1.

IMPENETRABLE BASTION.brief: End of your Movement phase, 1 ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE): one objective it controls is secured.

Impenetrable Defence.brief: If this unit or the target is within range of an objective: attacks have [Sustained Hits 1] vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE.

IMPERATIVE DOMINANCE.brief: your Command, TYRANIDS unit in Synapse Range: 1 Synaptic Imperative (even already used) active for this unit instead of the army's until your next Command.

Imperial Law.brief: Start of battle: select one enemy unit; attacks targeting it have [Lethal Hits] and [Precision].

Imperialis of the Eternal Crusade.brief: Each time an enemy unit declares a charge against the bearer's unit: -2 to the Charge roll (not cumulative with other negative modifiers).

IMPERIOUS ADVANCE.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, up to 2 WAR DOG units or 1 TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit: until end of phase, their Normal/Advance/Fall Back/Charge moves pass through models and terrain (can't end in Engagement Range unless charging); Desperate Escape tests auto-passed.

Imperium’s Sword.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Weapon: Imperium's Sword, melee, A 6, WS 2+, S 7, AP -3, D 3.

Impetuosity.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted an unengaged friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN unit has shot: your unit makes a surge move of up to D6".

Impetuous Fervour.brief: Attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if the target is within range of an objective, re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Impetuous Glory.brief: Each charge move: until end of turn, reaper chain-cleaver strike +1 A and sweep +2 A.

Implacable Eradication.brief: Attacks: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; vs an enemy unit within range of an objective marker: re-roll Wound rolls.

IMPLACABLE GUARDIANS.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, targeted RUBRIC MARINES PSYKER unit: until end of phase, attacks allocated to non-PSYKER models have -1 Damage.

Implacable Resilience.brief: Each attack allocated to this model: -1 D.

Imposing Arrival.brief: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, from round 2, ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit in Reserves: set it up wholly within 8" of the battlefield edge and more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units.

IMPOSSIBLE ECLIPSE.brief: Any phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH MONSTER on the battlefield: pick No Man's Land or the enemy deployment zone (both for 1 Flux token); until end of phase, that area is within your Shadow of Chaos.

Impossible Form (Psychic).brief: Each attack made against this PSYKER (excluding Psychic Attacks): -1 D.

Improbable Shield (Aura).brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH only. Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH units within 6": [Feel No Pain 4+] against Psychic Attacks and MW.

Impulsive Recon Upgrade.brief: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. Your first Movement phase: this unit can make an ingress move.

IN AURAMITE CLAD.brief: Enemy Shooting or Fight phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit targeted (unless CUSTODIAN WARDENS): attacks against it have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

In Sacrifice, Victory.brief: any phase, DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit destroyed within range of an objective: select 1 objective with no enemy units (except AIRCRAFT) in range, or one your unit controlled at the end of the previous phase; it is secured.

In the Lion's Claws.brief: enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) falling back from Engagement Range of a RAVENWING unit: every model takes a Desperate Escape test, -1 if battle-shocked; DEATHWING unit charging a target engaged with a RAVENWING unit: +2 to the Charge roll.

IN THE SHADOW OF BRASS IDOLS.brief: enemy Shooting or Fight, JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit just targeted: Feel No Pain 6+ until end of phase; 5+ if within 6" of a WORLD EATERS MONSTER or 9" of a TITANIC.

In the Shadow of Giants.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit selected to Advance/Fall Back: that move does not stop it from starting an action.

In the Shadow of Great Wings.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit targeted: it has Stealth and -3" detection range.

IN THE SHADOW OF IRON.brief: Any phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of your Cult Ambush markers, ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit: move one of those markers anywhere more than 8" from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.

Incandaeum.brief: EXALTED SORCERER only; once per battle: bearer can attempt Doombolt even if another model already attempted it this phase.

INCANTATION OF THE IRON SOUL.brief: Any phase, just after a MW is allocated to a CULT MECHANICUS model, its unit: until end of phase, CULT MECHANICUS models have Feel No Pain 4+ against MW.

Incendiary Animus#eda6dd9c59.brief: Melee weapons of models in the bearer's unit: AP improved by 1.

Incendiary Goad.brief: Bearer's unit below Starting Strength: DAMNED melee weapons +1 S; Below Half-strength: +1 A as well.

Incendiary Inspiration.brief: MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD only: bearer's unit can charge in a turn it Advanced.

INCENSE EXHAUSTS.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets chosen, 1 targeted ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit and 1 ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKE unit within 6": both have Stealth and Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Incensor Cherub.brief: Once per battle: Command Re-roll Stratagem on this unit for 0CP, even if another unit was already targeted by it this phase.

INCESSANT VIOLENCE.brief: Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit about to Consolidate: Consolidation moves of up to 6" instead of 3", if it ends within Engagement Range of an enemy unit.

Incorporeal Entities.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit targets a LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit: ranged attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound.

INCORPOREAL TERRORS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets are selected, 1 targeted LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit: until end of phase, attacks targeting it have -1 to Hit.

Incubi Shrine Token.brief: Once per battle per Incubi Shrine token: change 1 Hit or Wound roll of a KLAIVEX or INCUBI model to an unmodified 6.

Indefatigable Dedication.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit that just Fell Back: until end of turn, eligible to shoot; if Righteous, eligible to shoot and declare a charge instead.

Indefatigable Fortitude.brief: GRAVIS only. Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound rolls.

Indentured Daemon Engines.brief: While within 3" of friendly DAEMON VEHICLE units: this model has Lone Operative.

Independent Operatives.brief: Each Order issued to this unit lasts until a new Order, until Battle-shocked, or until the battle ends.

Independent Power.brief: Army cannot include both COMMANDER FARSIGHT and any ETHEREAL units.

Indomitable Defence.brief: While a GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective: attacks targeting it with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound rolls.

INDOMITABLE GUARDIANS.brief: Enemy Fight phase, after an enemy unit has fought, 1 ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit in range of an objective and eligible to fight: Fights First and must be the next unit selected to fight.

Indomitable Spirit (Psychic).brief: This model can shoot and charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Indomitable Steed.brief: VEHICLE OFFICER only. Bearer has Feel No Pain 6+.

Indomitable Strength of Will.brief: While leading, each time you spend a Battle Focus token for the unit to perform an Agile Manoeuvre: roll D6, on 3+ gain 1 Battle Focus token.

Indomitor Doctrines.brief: Ranged attacks of this unit targeting the closest eligible enemy unit: +1 S; if this unit charged this turn, melee attacks: +1 S.

Industrialised Destruction.brief: Attacks: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; if the target is within range of an objective marker, re-roll the Wound roll.

Inescapable Accuracy.brief: Ranged attacks: ignore any or all modifiers to BS and to the Hit roll.

Inescapable Death.brief: Once per turn, 1 unit with this ability: Fire Overwatch for 0 CP even if already used this phase; Fire Overwatch on this unit hits on unmodified 2+.

Inescapable Eye.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH only. Your Command phase, bearer on battlefield and opponent has ≥1 Flux token: gain 1 extra Flux token.

Inescapable Interrogation.brief: CHAPLAIN only. This unit's ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Inescapable Judgement.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back: roll D6: 2-5 = D3 MW; 6 = D3+3 MW (Psychic Attacks).

Inescapable Justice.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Precision].

Inescapable Manifestations.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit engaged with a LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit selected to fall back: that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode; -1 to those hazard rolls if it is battle-shocked.

INESCAPABLE WRATH.brief: end of opponent's Charge phase, DEATHWING INFANTRY or DEATHWING WALKER unit within 6" of enemy units it could charge: it declares and resolves a charge against those units now; no Charge bonus this turn.

INEVITABLE ANNIHILATION.brief: Shooting phase, GRAV-ASSAULT unit selected to shoot: it can ignore modifiers to its BS and hit rolls.

Inevitable Death.brief: Once per opponent's turn, when another friendly AELDARI unit is destroyed: remove this model and set it up as close as possible to the destroyed model, not in Engagement Range; still eligible to move.

INEXORABLE.brief: Movement phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit selected to move: until end of turn it can ignore modifiers to its M, advance rolls and charge rolls.

INEXORABLE ADVANCE.brief: Your Movement phase, RUBRICAE unit: until end of turn, ignores modifiers to its Move and Advance rolls, and its ranged weapons have [Assault].

INEXORABLE EFFICIENCY.brief: Your Shooting phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit: until end of phase it can shoot in a turn it Fell Back.

Inexorable Valour.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit engaged with a SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a fall-back move leaving it unengaged: that unit makes a normal move of up to D3+3".

Infamy (Aura).brief: ANHRATHE only: enemy units within 3" of this unit have -1 OC (min 1).

Infected Outbreak.brief: End of your Command phase, objective you control with this unit in range: stays yours with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

Infectious Murder‑madness (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS unit (unless MONSTER/TITANIC) within 6": attacks by DESTROYER CULT models, or against the closest eligible target, have [Sustained Hits 1].

Infernal Aegis (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG models within 6": Benefit of Cover.

Infernal Fulgurite.brief: Once per battle: Rapid Ingress on bearer's unit for 0CP, even if already used on another unit this phase.

INFERNAL FUSILLADE.brief: Your Shooting phase, THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit not yet shot: until end of phase, its inferno bolt pistols, boltguns, combi-bolters and combi-weapons have [Psychic].

Infernal Infusion.brief: Once per battle, start of Fight phase: bearer's unit has Fights First until end of phase.

Infernal Pacts.brief: SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units: Daemonic Illusions (Aura), friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit within 6" and visible has 4+ Inv vs ranged attacks; THOUSAND SONS units: Mortal Sorcery (Aura), friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS PSYKER unit within 6" and visible has Cabal of Sorcerers.

Infernal Puppeteer.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH MONSTER only. Your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: enemy units visible to a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit have +9" detection range until it has shot.

INFERNAL SACRIFICE.brief: Fight phase, DAMNED unit not yet fought: can make a Desperate Pact; if so, suffers D3 MW (plus any for a failed test), melee weapons +1 A; if the Leadership test was passed, +1 S too.

Infernal Vigour.brief: Your Command phase, friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (not KHORNE): heals D3+1 wounds.

Infested War Zone.brief: Any phase, after an enemy unit has attacked, friendly GRETCHIN unit just destroyed: add an identical new unit to strategic reserves, at starting strength and full wounds.

Infiltrator Comms Array.brief: Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem: roll D6; on 5+ gain 1 CP.

Inflamed Infections.brief: Start of Fight phase, one enemy unit within Engagement Range: until end of phase, this model's attacks on it score Critical Hits on unmodified 5+ (4+ if below Half-strength).

Inflamed Reprisal.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 6" targeted by an attack: after the attacker finishes, that unit can shoot back at that enemy unit only (if eligible), with -1 BS.

Informant Network.brief: ARCHON; start of Declare Battle Formations: up to three KABALITE WARRIORS and/or HAND OF THE ARCHON units gain [Infiltrators].

INFOSLAVE SKULL.brief: Your Command phase, 1 TECH-PRIEST model and 1 other objective within 24": that objective also counts as an Acquisition objective until your next Command phase.

Infused with the Blessings of Nurgle.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this unit shoots: 1 enemy unit hit is Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

Ingrained Superiority.brief: NECRONS only. Attacks by the bearer's unit: on a Critical Wound, AP improved by 1.

Inheritors of Sigismund Upgrade.brief: SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD only. This unit has Fights First.

Inhuman Integration.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS only: bearer's unit weapons gain [Sustained Hits 1] against enemy units within 6" of a friendly TYRANIDS unit.

Inhuman Reactions.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of an unengaged PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit: that unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

Inloaded Lethality#5c58102ef6.brief: TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS or TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS only. Bearer's melee weapons: +3 A, +1 D.

Inloaded Lethality#abf15d54fe.brief: TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS or TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS only. Bearer's melee weapons: +3 A, +1 D.

Inner Circle.brief: Attacks targeting this unit: -1 D; this unit cannot be targeted with the Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude stratagem.

Inquisitorial Henchmen.brief: If Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM: per INQUISITOR unit, one INQUISITORIAL AGENTS unit does not count towards the RETINUE limit.

INSANITY’S IRE.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DESTROYER CULT/FLAYED ONES unit has shot, that unit: surge move of up to D6".

Insectile Murmuration Upgrade.brief: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. Attacks targeting a unit within Contagion Range of a friendly unit: re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

Insensate Bloodthirst.brief: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit, that unit: Feel No Pain 5+.

INSENSATE RAMPAGE.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, DEATH COMPANY unit just targeted: Feel No Pain 5+ until end of phase.

INSENSIBLE TO PAIN.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit just targeted: until end of phase, attacks allocated to its models have -1 D.

Insidious Evasion.brief: Once per battle, end of enemy Fight phase, if not in Engagement Range: remove this unit and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Inspirational Battle Canticles.brief: Start of Command phase, one friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY FLY or EXORCIST unit: one friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTA SORORITAS unit within 6" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Inspirational Exemplar#2922ed318a.brief: While leading: melee attacks of the unit score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

Inspirational Exemplar#7da4eece2b.brief: Melee attacks of this unit: +1 to Hit rolls.

Inspirational Exemplar#a72b74fda3.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only; once per battle round per army, start of any phase: 1 friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 9" is no longer battle-shocked.

INSPIRED COMMAND.brief: Enemy Command phase, ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit: it can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.

Inspired to Greatness.brief: MAGUS/PRIMUS only. Bearer's unit's attacks: re-roll Damage rolls.

Inspiring Exemplar.brief: Each time this model destroys a CHARACTER model in the Fight phase: gain 1 CP and +1 A on its Nemesis force weapon until end of battle.

Inspiring Hero (Aura).brief: Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit within 6": re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

INSPIRING PRESENCE.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Instant of Grace.brief: Your Command phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit: it has CHARACTER until the start of your next Command phase.

Instinctive Defence.brief: TYRANIDS only. Bearer within 6" of a friendly HARVESTER unit: Heroic Intervention on this unit -1 CP; bearer's unit has [Fights First].

Instinctive Hunters.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge: place it in strategic reserves.

Instinctive Interception.brief: DEATH COMPANY only. Heroic Intervention Stratagem on this unit costs -1 CP.

INSTINCTIVE SPITE.brief: Start of your Shooting phase or Fight phase, up to 2 DRUKHARI BATTLELINE units or 1 other DRUKHARI unit: until end of phase, +1 to Hit vs units Below Half-strength; may spend 1 Pain token for +1 to Wound too.

Instrument of Chaos#168b35dcdf.brief: +1 to Charge rolls for the bearer's unit.

Instruments of the Emperor's Wrath.brief: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units can re-roll Charge rolls.

INSUBSTANTIAL ENTITIES.brief: Your Movement phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit not yet moved: on its next move this phase, models can pass through Walls and closed Hatchways, but no model moves more than 6". Once per battle.

Insurmountable Odds.brief: enemy Shooting, an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit loses a model to a unit's shooting: surge move of up to D6".

Integrated Command Structure.brief: KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS units: in your Shooting phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 12", it is prey-marked (+3" detection range). GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/STEALTH BATTLESUITS (Aura): shooting by KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS within 6" does not stop them being hidden. Auxiliaries tag.

Integrated Tactics.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM unit selected to shoot: may pick one visible enemy unit within 18"; until end of phase it only targets that unit, which is caught in overlapping fire: GENESTEALER CULTS models get +1 to Hit rolls with ranged attacks against it.

Interceptor.brief: Ranged attacks by this model against a unit that can FLY: +1 to Hit.

Internal Grenade Racks.brief: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT only. Bearer has GRENADES keyword; end of a Normal move: 1 enemy unit moved over, roll 6 D6, each 4+ = 1 MW.

Internal Rivalries.brief: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER units ignore modifiers to M, Advance and Charge rolls. WARLORD's unit = Favoured Champions; first time each turn an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit destroys an enemy unit, it becomes Favoured Champions. Favoured Champions re-roll Wound rolls.

Intimidating Motivation#08c8d58f74.brief: Once per battle round, your Movement phase, start or end of this unit's move: 1 friendly ORKS unit within 6" is no longer battle-shocked and is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Intimidating Motivation#c76faee673.brief: Once per battle round, your Movement phase, start or end of this unit's move: 1 friendly ORKS unit within 6" is no longer battle-shocked and is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Intimidating Motivation#ceabe930f0.brief: Once per battle round, your Movement phase, start or end of this model's move: 1 friendly ORKS unit within 6" is no longer battle-shocked and is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Intimidating Reminder.brief: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit has shot, that unit: 1 enemy unit hit is suppressed until your next Command phase: its attacks -1 to hit.

Into Darkness.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, up to 2 PHOBOS and/or SCOUT SQUAD units, or 1 other ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit, none in Engagement Range: remove them and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Into the Breach.brief: Your Shooting phase, ANHRATHE unit that just destroyed an enemy unit: after resolving its shooting, Normal move of up to D6+1".

Into the Fray.brief: If this unit charged this turn: melee attacks have [Cleave 1].

Intoxicated by Triumph.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with a FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a Fall Back move, that unit if unengaged: Normal move of up to D3+3".

Intoxicating Elixir.brief: Bearer has [Feel No Pain 5+]; bearer shoots or fights after its unit passed a Dark Pact this phase: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test.

Intoxicating Musk.brief: Melee attacks vs the bearer's unit with S greater than the unit's T: -1 to Wound.

INTRACTABLE.brief: your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that just Fell Back: it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.

Intractable Will.brief: Fight phase, when a model is destroyed before this unit fought: roll D6, 4+ = model stays until the unit has fought or end of phase.

Introneural Biotech.brief: EVERSOR ASSASSIN only: once per round, Heroic Intervention or Counter-offensive on this model for 1 less CP, even if already used on another unit this phase.

Invasion Beams.brief: End of Fight phase, if empty: 1 friendly NECRONS INFANTRY unit wholly within 6" not in Engagement Range embarks; allowed in a turn it disembarked.

INVIOLATE JURISDICTION.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets, targeted ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit within range of an objective: until end of phase, Feel No Pain 5+.

INVISIBLE HUNTER.brief: end of enemy Fight, up to 2 VANGUARD INVADER units or 1 TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit more than 3" from enemies: removed into Strategic Reserves.

Invocation of Machine Vengeance.brief: Start of your Command phase: select 1 enemy unit as Machine Vengeance target until your next Command phase; friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS attacks against it can re-roll the Hit roll.

Invocations of Ancient Fury.brief: friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES weapon profiles with 'Plasma' in their name are plasma weapon profiles; plasma weapon profiles have +1 S. Army: DARK ANGELS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES from another Chapter.

Ion Aegis (Aura).brief: Friendly ARMIGER model within 6": has the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

Iron Ambassador.brief: Autoch-pattern combi-bolter only. Once per battle, when selected to shoot: spend up to 3YP, +that many D on the bearer's ranged weapons until end of phase.

Iron Father.brief: Within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit: this model has Lone Operative.

Iron Fortitude.brief: Each ranged attack targeting a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (except DAMNED) with S greater than the unit's T: -1 to the Wound roll.

Iron Priest.brief: Within 3" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES VEHICLE unit: this model has Lone Operative.

Iron Surplice of Saint Istalela.brief: CANONESS or PALATINE only. Bearer: Sv 2+ and [Feel No Pain 5+].

Iron Tread.brief: When a SQUADRON unit Advances, no Advance roll: until end of phase +6" Move, and it can move through Engagement Range of enemy models during that Advance but cannot end within it.

Ironbound Enmity.brief: Bearer's attacks while within range of an objective marker: +1 to Wound.

Ironstorm Auto-targeters.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units (except WALKER): ranged attacks re-roll 1 Hit roll and 1 Wound roll.

IRRESISTIBLE WILL.brief: your Shooting or Fight, SYNAPSE unit not yet shot/fought and 1 enemy unit within 24" visible: TYRANIDS within 6" of the SYNAPSE unit re-roll hits and wounds of 1 against that enemy until end of phase.

ISHA’S FURY.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, ASURYANI PSYKER model within 9" of it: roll 6 D6, each 3+ = 1 MW to that enemy unit.

ISOLATE AND DESTROY.brief: Your Shooting phase, 1 SICARIAN, PTERAXII, SYDONIAN, IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII or SKITARII MOUNTED unit not yet shot: attacks on a target with no other enemy unit within 6" of it have +1 to wound.

It Itches!.brief: Start of the Fight phase: 1 enemy unit within Engagement Range must take a Battle-shock test.

Jammer Array.brief: Enemy units arriving from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

Jetbike.brief: ARCHTORMENTOR only: M 16", T 4, W 5; gains FLY and MOUNTED; can only be attached to REAVERS.

JOIN THE HUNT.brief: Any phase (once per battle), KROOT INFANTRY or KROOT HOUNDS unit just destroyed: add an identical new unit to your army in Strategic Reserves at Starting Strength (not for CHARACTERS of Attached units).

Jolly Gutpipes#0f214d1d81.brief: While leading a unit: +1" M for that unit and re-roll its Advance rolls.

Jolly Gutpipes#7dc6e25c1e.brief: While leading: +1" M to models in the unit; re-roll Advance rolls for the unit.

Judged for Execution.brief: End of your Movement phase: 1 enemy unit within 18" and visible; until your next Command phase, attacks by friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS models against it have [Lethal Hits].

Judgement of the Golden Host.brief: Your Charge phase, SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a charge move: 1 enemy unit engaged with it, D6 per model engaged with it, each 3+ = 1 MW.

Judgement of the Omnissiah.brief: This model's attacks targeting an enemy unit engaged with a friendly SPACE WOLVES VEHICLE: re-roll Wound rolls.

Judgement of the Weak.brief: Enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) in engagement range of this unit Falls Back: every model takes a Desperate Escape test, at -1 if Battle-shocked.

Jump Pack.brief: INFANTRY only. M 12"; gains FLY, JUMP PACK and Deep Strike; can only be attached to ASSAULT INTERCESSORS WITH JUMP PACKS, VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS.

Jungle Fighters.brief: Melee attack, if this unit made a Charge move or was charged this turn: +1 to the Wound roll.

Kabal Overlord.brief: ARCHTORMENTOR only: M 7", Ld 6+; loses WYCH CULT, gains KABAL; can only be attached to HAND OF THE ARCHON, INCUBI, KABALITE WARRIORS.

Kabalite icon.brief: While the bearer's unit is not Battle-shocked: bearer +1 OC.

Kabalite Icon.brief: Bearer's unit not Battle-shocked: bearer +1 OC.

Kalamandra.brief: KINBAND CHAMPION only. M 12", T 5, Sv 5+, W 6; +1 kalamandra's bite; loses INFANTRY, gains MOUNTED and Lone Operative.

Kaleidoscopic Tempest.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, targeted THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit: until end of phase, Stealth; if wholly within your Flow of Magic, -3 detection range.

Kaptin's Hat.brief: BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY only. After both armies deploy: redeploy up to 3 friendly ORKS INFANTRY units, possibly into strategic reserves regardless of the limit.

Karnivore.brief: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for this model.

Keep Counting!#53c62750a0.brief: While leading: melee weapons of the unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

Keep Huntin'.brief: Once per battle round per army, your Movement phase, start or end of this unit's move: 1 friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" is no longer battle-shocked and is riled up until your next turn.

Keep It Runnin'.brief: End of Fight phase, unengaged friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit eligible to fight this phase, wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark within: it embarks within that TRANSPORT.

Keywords#0316c86a45.brief: ARMIGER models gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

Keywords#2d22c8d3d1.brief: MAWLOC and TRYGON units gain BURROWER; when mustering, up to 2 TRYGON models gain CHARACTER (Enhancements allowed, one can be WARLORD).

Keywords#640ca0eb22.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM SQUADRON units have the ARMOURED SKIRMISHER keyword (not ARTILLERY units nor units with a model of 13+ Wounds).

Keywords#aa0a516c8c.brief: In the Muster Armies step, one or more ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC units can gain the CHARACTER keyword (they can take Enhancements and one can be your Warlord).

Keywords#ca600f1d86.brief: While a CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit is not Battle-shocked: +1 OC for its CELESTIAN SACRESANTS models.

KHAINE’S VENGEANCE.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) is selected to Fall Back, ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit in Engagement Range of it: all its models take a Desperate Escape test, -1 if Battle-shocked.

Khorne.brief: +2 S to this model's hellforged weapons.

Kill Kommanda.brief: BIG MEK/WARBOSS INFANTRY only. While part of an attached unit: this model has Infiltrators and Stealth.

Kill Team#569b458adc.brief: Attacks against this unit use the majority Toughness (highest if tied); Gravis Veteran models take up 2 spaces in a TRANSPORT but can embark wherever the unit can.

Kill Team#d87ab8a8d2.brief: Attack targets this unit with mixed T: use the majority T (highest if tied) for the Wound roll; Gravis Veterans take 2 spaces in a TRANSPORT but may embark in any TRANSPORT the unit can.

Kill Teams.brief: attack targeting a KILL TEAM unit with mixed T: use the majority T of the unit to wound (highest T if tied) until the attacker has finished; KILL TEAM models follow the normal TRANSPORT embarking restrictions.

Killer Reputation.brief: Friendly KELERMORPH, LOCUS, REDUCTUS SABOTEUR and SANCTUS models have the KILLER keyword; KILLER models' attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Killers from the Dark Spires.brief: Your Shooting phase, KABALITE WARRIORS unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Killing Blow.brief: Battle rounds 1-3: ranged weapons of T'AU EMPIRE models have [Assault]; while a unit is Guided (For the Greater Good), its ranged weapons also have [Lethal Hits].

Killing Clarity.brief: Bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit: roll D6, on 4+ gain 1CP.

Kindred Hero#3406f25a61.brief: While this model leads a unit: weapons of models in that unit have [Lethal Hits].

Kindred Hero#3c962c1a4b.brief: While leading a unit: weapons of that unit have [Lethal Hits].

Kindred Sorcery.brief: Your Command phase: 1 ability until your next Command phase, each once per battle; Imbued Manifestation: +6" range on THOUSAND SONS ranged Psychic weapons; Psychic Maelstrom: +1 to Wound with Psychic weapons; Wrath of the Immaterium: Psychic weapons have [Devastating Wounds].

Knight Champion of Macragge (Once per ph.brief: Once per phase per army, enemy Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" and this unit unengaged: Normal move up to 6".

Knight Diabolus.brief: Bearer's melee weapons WS improved by 1; while using Diabolic Power: melee weapons have [Lance].

Knight of the Opus Machina (Aura).brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit within 6": its melee attacks +1 WS and AP.

Knightly Teachings.brief: Each time a model uses its Bondsman ability, if no other model used that Bondsman ability this turn: select up to 3 friendly ARMIGER models (instead of 1) within 12", or 15" while your army is Honoured; affected until the start of your next Command phase.

Knights of Caliban.brief: If this unit charged this turn: melee attacks have [Anti-Monster/Vehicle 4+].

Knights of Iron.brief: your Movement/Charge phase, RAVENWING unit selected to move or declaring a charge: it has MOBILE.

KNIGHTS OF IRON.brief: your Movement or Charge phase, RAVENWING unit: its models can move horizontally through terrain features during Normal, Advance or Charge moves until end of phase.

Knights of Legend.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models have [Feel No Pain 6+]; at the start of your Command phase, each IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model regains 1 lost wound.

KRAKEN ROUNDS.brief: Your Shooting phase, DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot (not already targeted by Dragonfire/Hellfire Rounds): until end of phase, its ranged weapons get AP improved by 1 and +6" Range.

Kraken Rounds#14395383cf.brief: your Shooting phase, KILL TEAM unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have +6" range and +1 S.

Kraken Rounds#1f9a3f79c4.brief: Your Shooting phase, KILL TEAM unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have +6" range and +1 S.

Kroot Ambush.brief: After both armies deployed: redeploy this model's unit and 1 other friendly KROOT unit; any of them can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

Kroot Linebreakers.brief: End of Charge move: pick 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll 1 D6 per model of this unit in Engagement Range of it; each 4+ = D3 MW; if a model is destroyed, that unit takes a Battle-shock test.

Kroot Packmates.brief: Once per turn, opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly KROOT INFANTRY unit within 6" is targeted: after the enemy unit finishes its attacks, this unit can shoot, targeting only that enemy unit.

Kroothawk Flock.brief: KROOT only. Bearer's unit's ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover]; enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer.

Krootox.brief: KINBAND CHAMPION only. T 6, Sv 5+, W 7; +1 Rampager fists; loses INFANTRY, gains MOUNTED; can only lead KROOTOX RAMPAGERS, KROOTOX RIDERS.

Krumpin' Time.brief: Fight phase, if riled up: +1 to Hit rolls.

Krushin' Impetus.brief: When this unit ends a charge move: 1 enemy unit engaged with it, roll D6 per model of this unit engaged with it: each 3+ = 1 MW.

Kunnin' But Brutal.brief: ORKS only. After a fall-back move, this unit is still eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

Kunnin' Infiltrator.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, if each model is hidden and unengaged: can place this unit in strategic reserves.

Kustom Dakka#75f66de07e.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have +1 to Wound rolls against non-MONSTER/VEHICLE units.

Kustom Dakka#decdd27c28.brief: Ranged attacks of this unit: [Ignores Cover].

Labyrinthine Cunning.brief: ARCHON; start of your Command phase, bearer on the battlefield: spend 1 Pain token to gain 1CP; or roll one D6: on a 4+, gain 1CP.

LANCEBREAKER.brief: Fight phase, targeted IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit on your defensive line: attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound.

Lancer’s Duty (Bondsman).brief: Affected model: can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Lancet of the Worldsore Upgrade.brief: Friendly HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER unit only. This unit has MOBILE.

LASH OF GUILT.brief: Your Movement phase, PENITENT unit about to Advance: until end of turn, eligible to charge after Advancing; if PENITENT ENGINES, no Advance roll, instead +6" M until end of phase.

Laud Hailer#6cea3f698a.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER only. Bearer issues Orders to units within 12" instead of 6".

Laud Hailer#87024e2122.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTA SORORITAS unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Laud Hailer#c5e5ae94d6.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: select 1 friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTA SORORITAS unit within 12" of this model; it is no longer Battle-shocked.

Laurels of Triumph.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. This model's melee attacks: +1 S and AP; if the Assault Doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP instead.

Laurels of Vigilance.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Once per battle round, per army: Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention on a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit within 12" of this model is -1 CP.

Lay Low the Tyrants.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Precision].

Layered Ceramite.brief: Any phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a MW: it has Feel No Pain 5+ against MW.

Layered Wards.brief: Any phase, AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffering a mortal wound: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds until end of phase.

Leader of Astartes.brief: While within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit: [Lone Operative].

Leader-beast.brief: 4+ Inv, gains PSYKER and SYNAPSE keywords and Shadow in the Warp; if INFANTRY: can also be attached to NEUROGAUNTS.

Leader-beasts.brief: TYRANID WARRIORS units (ranged or melee bio-weapons) gain BATTLELINE; TYRANID WARRIORS, TYRANID PRIME and WINGED TYRANID PRIME models have a 5+ invuln.

Leading the Charge.brief: Each time this model's unit makes a Charge move: until end of turn, the unit's melee weapons have [Devastating Wounds].

Leash of the Masters.brief: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly WAR DOG unit has shot, that unit: those attacks don't prevent it from starting an action.

Leechbite Plate.brief: ARCHON: bearer Sv 3+; start of either player's Command phase, may spend 1 Pain token: bearer regains all lost wounds.

LEECHSPORE ERUPTION.brief: Your Command phase, wounded DEATH GUARD model: 1 enemy unit within 3", roll 1 D6 per wound lost: each 5+ = 1 MW to it (max 6) and your model regains 1 wound (max 6).

Legacy of Jerulas.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots, pick 1 enemy unit it hit: until end of turn, models that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1 against it.

Legacy of the Angel#bdd5f03a9a.brief: Start of round 1: pick 2 for all your ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTERS, all battle: shoot and charge after Falling Back; re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1; re-roll Advance and Charge rolls.

Legacy of the Angel#d40aaead63.brief: friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY CHARACTER units (not COMMANDER DANTE): +1 to Advance and Charge rolls. GRACE tag: cannot be taken with another GRACE detachment. Army: BLOOD ANGELS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES from another Chapter.

Legacy Sidearm.brief: INFANTRY OFFICER only. +2 A to the bearer's Pistols.

Legendary Freeblade.brief: Once per turn, 1 unit with this ability targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

Legendary Killer.brief: While leading a unit, melee attacks of that unit: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Legendary Slayers.brief: Attacks by friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY and WULFEN units have [Lethal Hits: CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Legendary Tenacity.brief: Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to wound rolls.

Legions of Excess.brief: LEGIONS OF EXCESS units allowed without the EMPEROR'S CHILDREN keyword: Incursion up to 500 pts; Strike Force up to 1000 pts; Onslaught up to 1500 pts. No LEGIONS OF EXCESS model can be WARLORD.

Leonine Ferocity.brief: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only; once per phase per army: Rapid Ingress stratagem on this unit for -1 CP, even if already used this phase; does not block other uses.

Lesser Prey.brief: Fight, NORN ASSIMILATOR/NORN EMISSARY unit selected to fight: its melee attacks +2 S.

LET DUTY BE YOUR SHIELD.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit picks targets, ARMIGER unit targeted: until the attacker finishes its attacks, attacks targeting your unit have AP worsened by 1.

Let Loose the Wolves.brief: Start of the Declare Battle Formations step: you can split this unit in two, WOLF GUARD HEADTAKER models plus leader/support models on one side, HUNTING WOLVES models on the other.

LET THE GALAXY BURN.brief: Your Shooting phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not TZEENTCH) not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover] and Torrent weapons have A 6.

LETHAL DOSAGE.brief: Your Shooting phase, 1 ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit not yet shot: its ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits] until end of phase.

Lethal Ichor.brief: Melee attack allocated to a model in this unit, after the attacker finishes: roll D6 (max 6 per attacking unit); each 4+ = 1 MW to the attacking unit.

Lethal Obsession.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit; until end of turn, when charging: re-roll charge roll ; must end engaged with that unit.

Lethal Ruse.brief: Your Movement phase, AELDARI unit that just Fell Back: it can still charge this turn; if ANHRATHE, pick 1 enemy unit it was engaged with at the start of the phase, roll 6 D6: each 4+ = 1 MW.

Liber Heresius.brief: After both armies deploy: redeploy up to 3 AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

Librarian (psyker level 1).brief: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.

Librarius.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units have a psyker level; each battle round a unit can use psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed its psyker level.

Lifewards.brief: While the unit contains ≥1 Geminae Superia: Celestine has [Feel No Pain 4+].

Light of Clarity.brief: SPIRITSEER; your Command phase: one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 12": until your next Command phase, +1 OC for INFANTRY models, +3 OC for MONSTER models.

LIGHT OF THE EMPEROR.brief: Command phase, one ADEPTA SORORITAS unit: until end of turn, blessed = can ignore modifiers to its models' profile characteristics, its weapons' WS/BS and any roll or test (except saving throws); if JUMP PACK, friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 3" are also blessed.

Lightning Descent.brief: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only; your first Movement phase: this unit can make an ingress move.

LIGHTNING WRATH.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit selected to Pile in: that Pile-in move can be up to D3+3".

Lightning-fast Manoeuvres.brief: Ranged attacks targeting this unit: -1 to Wound rolls.

LIGHTNING-FAST REACTIONS.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after targets chosen, targeted ASURYANI unit (not WRAITH CONSTRUCT): attacks against it get -1 to Hit until end of phase.

Lightning-fast Strike.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +2" M.

Like Fighting a Shadow.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if not within Engagement Range: can make a Normal move; if so, cannot declare a charge this turn.

LIMB FROM LIMB.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that made a Charge move this turn: melee weapons +1 S or +1 AP until end of phase ; or give in to the Red Thirst: Battle-shocked but +1 S and +1 AP.

Limitless Zeal.brief: CHAPLAIN only. This unit has +1 to Charge rolls.

LINE OF FIRE.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons (not [Blast]) can target enemy units within 12" that are in Engagement Range of friendly units.

Line-breaker.brief: Demolisher battle cannon can target enemy units within Engagement Range (if no other friendly unit is engaged with them); no Hit roll penalty for shooting while within Engagement Range.

Line-breakers.brief: End of a Charge move: pick 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll a D6 per model in range of it (+2 if the charge started within 6" of friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE); each 4+ = 1 MW.

Linebreaker Onslaught.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY only. If this unit disembarked this turn: re-roll Charge rolls; enemy units cannot target it with snap shooting attacks.

Lion's Will.brief: Command phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within range of an objective: +1 OC until end of turn.

Litanies of Faith.brief: CANONESS or PALATINE only. Start of your Command phase, bearer on the battlefield: Leadership test for the bearer; passed = gain 1 Miracle dice.

LITANIES OF PURGATION.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its attacks get +1 AP if it or the target is within range of an objective.

Litanies of Sanctity.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked GREY KNIGHTS unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Litanies of the Devout.brief: Melee attacks of this unit: re-roll Hit rolls.

Litany of Deeds.brief: Miracle dice gained from a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS unit or model destroyed within 12": re-roll that dice before adding it to the pool.

Litany of Hate#3c7f40fa39.brief: While leading a unit: melee attacks of that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

Litany of Hate#9c3a821056.brief: Melee attacks of this unit: +1 to Wound roll.

LITANY OF THE ELECTROMANCER.brief: Your Shooting phase, CULT MECHANICUS unit: D6 per enemy unit within 6" of a CULT MECHANICUS model of the unit (+1 if that model is an ELECTRO-PRIEST); on 5+, D3 MW to that enemy unit.

Lithe Agility (Pain).brief: Your Movement phase when Advancing, or Charge phase before the Charge roll: spend 1 Pain token to Empower this model's unit; while Empowered, re-roll Advance and Charge rolls.

Lithe Embarkation.brief: End of Fight phase, if this TRANSPORT is empty: one friendly YNNARI INFANTRY unit it can carry (≤6 models) wholly within 6" and not in Engagement Range can embark, even if it disembarked this turn.

Living Carapace.brief: CHAOS LORD only. Bearer: +1 W and [Feel No Pain 5+].

Living Lightning.brief: Your Shooting phase, 1 visible enemy unit within 18" (Lone Operative only if attached or within 12"): roll 4D6, 1 MW per 4+.

Living Up to Legend.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, KILLER unit that has just destroyed an enemy unit or enemy CHARACTER model: each visible friendly Battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Loathsome Dexterity.brief: Normal, Advance or Fall Back move by the bearer's unit: can move through enemy models (not end in Engagement Range); Desperate Escape tests auto-passed.

Loci of Power.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER models (unless MONSTER) have +1 Ld and +1 OC.

Logis.brief: While leading: unit's attacks vs a unit within range of your Acquisition objective: +1 to Hit.

Long-Range Scout Upgrade.brief: SCOUT SENTINEL only. This unit has Infiltrators.

Long, Uncontrolled Bursts.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks targeting a FLY unit can re-roll Hit rolls.

Loping Charge.brief: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to Charge rolls. Restriction: SPACE WOLVES units only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter.

Loping Pounce.brief: Start of your Command phase, if within 6" of friendly KROOT INFANTRY: until end of turn, can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Loping Speed.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, this unit makes a Normal move of up to D6".

Lord Castellan.brief: While leading a unit: that unit can be affected by up to 2 different Orders at the same time.

Lord of Badab (Aura).brief: Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit within 6" (not Battle-shocked, not DAMNED): +1 OC.

Lord of Chaos#a7136c3245.brief: While within 3" of friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY: this model has Lone Operative.

Lord of Chaos#e9da8486bf.brief: Once per battle round, one unit with this ability targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

Lord of Chaos#eac39adf9d.brief: Once per battle round: 1 unit with this ability can be targeted by a Stratagem for 0 CP, even if another unit was targeted by it this phase.

Lord of Decapitations.brief: While leading: the unit's melee weapons have [Devastating Wounds].

Lord of Deceit (Aura).brief: Opponent targets their unit within 12" with a Stratagem: +1 CP cost for that use.

Lord of Excess.brief: While within 3" of friendly SLAANESH INFANTRY: Lone Operative.

Lord of Forbidden Lore.brief: Bearer manifests a Ritual: +6" to its range.

Lord of Machines.brief: Once per turn, start of opponent's Shooting phase: 1 enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" and visible takes a Leadership test; passed = -1 to Hit this phase; failed = cannot shoot this phase.

Lord of Murder.brief: Within 3" of a friendly WORLD EATERS INFANTRY unit: this model has [Lone Operative].

Lord of Slaughter.brief: Once per round, 1 unit with this ability: targeted by a Stratagem for 0CP, even if another unit already used it this phase.

Lord of the Death Guard.brief: Once per turn: this model can use one Lord of the Death Guard ability.

Lord of the Eightbound.brief: If attached to a WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit at Declare Battle Formations: Deep Strike and Scouts 6".

Lord of the Host.brief: If attached to an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit at Declare Battle Formations: Infiltrators and Scouts 6".

Lord of the Hunt.brief: Bearer's unit can shoot and charge in a turn it Fell Back; re-roll Desperate Escape tests for that unit.

Lord of the Machine Cult.brief: While leading a unit: its models have Feel No Pain 5+; ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit: Feel No Pain 4+ instead.

Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers (Psy.brief: Up to 2 Ritual attempts per turn (instead of 1); each attempt: +2 to the Psychic test result.

Lord of the Pyroclasts.brief: Enemy unit engaged with this unit: -1 OC.

Lord of the Ravenwing.brief: This unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

Lord of the Rubricae.brief: While leading: RUBRICAE models' attacks in the unit +1 to Hit.

Lord of the Storm.brief: Once per battle, end of your Command phase, each enemy unit within 12": on 2-5, D3 MW; on 6, D3+3 MW.
