Lord of the Walking Pox.brief: Bearer leading a POXWALKERS unit in Strategic Reserves: for setting that unit up, treat the current battle round as the third.

LOST TO RAGE.brief: Fight phase, DEATH COMPANY unit below Starting Strength not yet selected to fight: melee weapons +1 A, +1 S, +1 AP until end of phase ; [Hazardous] unless within 12" of a friendly CHAPLAIN.

Low Profile.brief: Your Shooting phase, after a RATLINGS unit has shot, that unit: those ranged attacks do not prevent it from being hidden.

Loyal Henchmen.brief: While an INQUISITOR is leading this unit: attacks targeting it get -1 to Wound.

Loyal Protector#45d65c00be.brief: Declare Battle Formations: must join one COMMAND SQUAD (max 1 LOYAL PROTECTOR per squad, else counts as destroyed); counts as part of it, may embark with it (3 spaces); no Warlord, no Enhancements.

Loyal Protector#eabad54223.brief: Declare Battle Formations: must join one COMMAND SQUAD (max 1 LOYAL PROTECTOR per squad, else counts as destroyed); counts as part of it, may embark with it (3 spaces); cannot be Warlord.

Loyal to the End.brief: Fight phase, KILLER unit targeted by an enemy unit: when a KILLER model is destroyed before the unit has fought, roll D6: 1 = that enemy unit suffers 1 MW; 2+ = model stays until the unit has fought or end of phase, then is removed.

Lucid Eye.brief: ASURYANI PSYKER; your Command phase: add 1 to or subtract 1 from one Fate dice in your pool.

Luck Has, Need Keeps, Toil Earns.brief: End of your Command phase, within range of an objective you control: it stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

LUMINESCENT BLESSING.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets chosen, 1 targeted CULT MECHANICUS unit: its CULT MECHANICUS models have a 4+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Lurk and Strike.brief: Your Movement phase, PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit selected to Fall Back: that move does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

LYING IN WAIT.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE unit in Cult Ambush: until end of phase, when set up from a Cult Ambush marker, place it anywhere wholly within 6" of that marker, outside Engagement Range.

MACABRE RESILIENCE.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after targets chosen, targeted YNNARI INFANTRY or YNNARI MOUNTED unit (not WRAITH CONSTRUCT): attacks against it get -1 to Wound until end of phase.

MACHINE SPIRIT RESURGENT.brief: Your Command phase, LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit below Starting Strength: until your next Command phase, re-roll Hit rolls; if Below Half-strength, re-roll Wound rolls too.

MACHINE SUPERIORITY.brief: Your Command phase, LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit: until end of turn, eligible to shoot after Falling Back and ignores any modifiers to its characteristics, rolls or tests (except saving throws).

Macro-extinction Protocols#88a255e949.brief: Attacks vs MONSTER or VEHICLE units: +1 to Hit; if the target is TITANIC or TOWERING, +1 to Wound as well.

Macro-extinction Protocols#9c6415b539.brief: Attacks vs a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit: +1 to Hit; vs TITANIC or TOWERING: +1 to Wound as well.

Madcap Artillery.brief: After shooting, if all Mek Guns have the same weapon: 1 enemy unit hit, until your next turn: Bubblechukka = its targets get cover; Kustom Mega-kannon = -1 Ld; Smasha Gun = -2" M; Traktor Kannon = no take to the skies.

Maddened Ferocity.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES melee attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1 ; unit selected to fight that made a Charge move this turn: melee weapons +1 A until end of phase, +2 A instead if Battle-shocked.

Magaera’s Duty (Bondsman).brief: Affected model, ranged attacks vs the closest eligible target: S and AP improved by 1.

Maggot Maws.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE only. Your Shooting phase, 1 enemy unit within 6": Battle-shock test, then D6: 3+ = D3 MW; no MW from Daemonic Terror that use.

Magna Imperator.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit selected to attack: its attacks can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll.

Magos.brief: End of your Command phase, bearer within range of your Acquisition objective: roll D6; 4+ = gain 1 CP.

Magos Questoris.brief: TECH-PRIEST only. Sacristan Pledge: the selected IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model heals 2 additional wounds.

Mailed Fist.brief: GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit Advances: no Advance roll, +6" Move until end of phase; its ranged weapons have [Assault] until end of turn.

Makari, Hoist Dat Banner!.brief: Once per battle, your Movement phase: up to as many friendly ORKS units as the current battle round number are riled up until the start of your next turn.

MAKING A POINT.brief: Your Shooting phase, KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have BS and AP improved by 1.

Malefic Deceit.brief: Attacks against this unit: -1 to Hit roll.

Malefic Destruction.brief: Once per battle, start of the Fight phase: +3 A on this model's hellforged weapons until end of phase.

Malefic Maelstrom (Psychic).brief: While leading a unit: that unit's weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Malefic Surge.brief: Your Command phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS units may Surge: Leadership test, fail = D3 MW; Empowered until next Command phase, 1 use: Unholy Hunger +3" M for a move; Diabolic Power, weapons get [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1] for the phase; Unnatural Fortitude, 5+ Inv or Feel No Pain 6+ when targeted.

Malefic Wardings (Psychic).brief: While leading a unit: that unit has a 6+ invulnerable save, 4+ against Psychic Attacks and attacks by DAEMON models.

Malefic Will.brief: Weapons of models in this unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

MALEVOLENT ANIMUS.brief: Your Command phase, THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit within 6" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit: until your next Command phase, ignores modifiers to its profile characteristics, its weapons' WS/BS and any roll or test (except saves).

Malevolent Arcing.brief: Your Shooting phase, target of twin tesla destructor: D6 for target and each other enemy unit within 3" of it; each 5+ = that unit suffers D3 MW after the attacks resolve.

Malevolent Heraldry.brief: Each time you roll to select active Dread abilities, if the bearer is on the battlefield: re-roll one or both results.

Malevolent Locus (Aura).brief: Friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 9" of this Fortification: Ld improved by 1.

Malevolent Souls.brief: Model destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: D6, on 3+ it fights after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed.

Malice Made Manifest.brief: Start of Fight phase, 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range of bearer's unit, D6: 2-5 = D3 MW; 6 = 3 MW.

Malicious Calculations.brief: While leading a unit: attacks of that unit can ignore any modifiers to BS, WS and Hit rolls.

Malicious Frenzy.brief: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: pick [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1]; its weapons have it until end of phase.

Malicious Surge.brief: Your Charge phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit: can declare a charge this turn after Advancing.

Malicious Vigour.brief: Bearer's unit Brazen Fury move: distance counts as a 6.

Malign Cover.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a model not fully visible to every attacking model because of this Fortification: Benefit of Cover.

Malign Presence (Aura).brief: once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP more.

Malign Sacrifice.brief: Start of Fight phase, with a Dark Disciple: 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, D6: 2-5 = 1 MW; 6 = D3 MW; that Dark Disciple is destroyed.

Malign Trickery.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Malign Wardings (Psychic).brief: While leading a unit: models in that unit have [Feel No Pain 4+] against Psychic Attacks.

MALIGNANCE MAGNIFIED.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, DEATH GUARD Attached unit not yet shot or fought: its attacks against a unit below its Starting Strength can re-roll Hit and Wound rolls until end of phase.

Mandiblasters.brief: Melee attacks after a Charge move this turn: unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is a Critical Hit.

Mandulian Reliquary.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; while the bearer's unit is not Battle-shocked: bearer +3 OC.

Manifestation of Destruction.brief: Cannot be your WARLORD; cannot be given Enhancements.

Manifold Maladies.brief: Start of battle round: you can choose 1 Plague from Nurgle's Gift; it replaces any previously chosen Plague until end of battle.

MANOEUVRE AND FIRE.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit selected to Fall Back: that move does not prevent it from shooting or declaring a charge.

Mantle of Elders.brief: Bearer's unit selected to shoot and YP spent via Optimal Application: D6, on 2+ gain 1YP.

Mantle of Gloom (Aura).brief: Enemy units within Engagement Range of bearer's unit: -1 OC.

Mantle of Ophelia.brief: CANONESS or PALATINE only. Each attack allocated to the bearer: D changed to 1.

Mantle of the Gnosticarch.brief: Each attack allocated to the bearer: D changed to 1.

MANTLE OF THE MENTOR.brief: Start of your Shooting phase, ARMIGER or IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model plus friendly ARMIGER models affected by its Bondsman ability: until end of phase, your ARMIGER models can shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.

Mantle of Wisdom.brief: AUTARCH or AUTARCH WAYLEAPER only: while leading an ASPECT WARRIORS unit, each time it is selected to shoot or fight, until end of phase its models gain both Path of the Warrior abilities.

Mantra of Discipline.brief: This model has BATTLELINE; Binharic Courage (Aura): friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit within 6": +1 OC and +1 to Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

Manual of Saint Griselda.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. Start of your Command phase: discard up to 2 Miracle dice, then add 1 Miracle dice showing the sum of the two discarded (max 6).

Mark of Legend.brief: Once per turn: re-roll 1 Hit roll, 1 Wound roll or 1 saving throw for the bearer.

Mark of the Nekrosor.brief: Attacks by the bearer's unit: +1 to Hit rolls.

Mark of the Soul Forges.brief: Bearer's attacks: unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Mark of the Star Children Upgrade.brief: PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS only. Bearer's unit: +1 T; 4+ Sv; melee attacks +1 S.

Marked by Fate (Psychic)#936bd248e1.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: select 1 enemy unit visible to this PSYKER; until end of phase, this unit's attacks against it +1 to Hit.

Marker Beacon.brief: End of your Movement phase, PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit: one objective it controls becomes secured.

Marker Drone.brief: Bearer's unit has the MARKERLIGHT keyword and can be an Observer unit even if it Advanced this turn.

Marks of Chaos.brief: At muster, each HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not EPIC HERO, none already) picks KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE, SLAANESH or CHAOS UNDIVIDED; a Dark Pact whose Leadership test is passed grants the mark's ability for the phase. No KHORNE for PSYKERS; attach/embark only with units sharing the mark.

Martial Leverage.brief: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed: you gain 1YP.

MASKS OF DEATH.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit targeted: until end of phase, attacks against it -1 to Hit rolls.

Mass Driver Accelerators.brief: End of a Charge move: one enemy unit within Engagement Range, roll D6; 2-5 D3 MW; 6 D3+3 MW.

Mass of Doom.brief: If this unit made a charge move this turn: melee attacks have [Devastating Wounds] unless MONSTER/VEHICLE.

Master of Ka'tahs (Once per battle round.brief: Once per round, if this unit is not readied: it becomes readied.

Masters of the Shadowed Sky.brief: End of your Command phase, within range of an objective you control with KABALITE WARRIORS embarked: it stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Matter Absorption.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: 1 enemy VEHICLE within 12", D6: on 2+ it suffers D3 MW and this model regains that many wounds.

Measured Strategist.brief: Your Command phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit: 1 combat doctrine is active for it until the start of your next Command phase.

Mechanical Augmentation (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS BATTLELINE units within 3": their attacks AP improved by 1; attacks targeting them AP worsened by 1.

Mechanicus Allies.brief: Army can include TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS/TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS/MARSHAL/RANGERS/VANGUARD units (Codex Adeptus Mechanicus), combined value up to 500 pts.

Mechanicus Bodyguard.brief: While within 3" of other friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units: this model has Lone Operative.

Medi-pack#be360a30de.brief: Start of your Command phase, if the bearer's unit is below Starting Strength: return up to D3 destroyed Tempestus Scions models.

Medicus Ministorum.brief: While leading a unit: models in that unit have [Feel No Pain 5+].

Meet Your Quota!#849f2cddc5.brief: While leading: +1 OC to models in the unit.

Mekwaaagh! Mastermind.brief: BIG MEK only. This unit is riled up.

Memento Moritoi (One per army).brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only: melee attacks +1 A, +1 S and +1 D.

Mentor's Pride.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. While 2+ ARMIGER models are under the bearer's Bondsman ability: their attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Mercenary Prospector.brief: Enemy unit destroyed by bearer's unit: gain 2YP.

Merciless Denunciation.brief: Melee attacks of models in the bearer's unit: re-roll Hit rolls.

Merciless Judgement.brief: Ranged attacks targeting a unit Below Half-strength: +1 to Wound.

Merciless Veterans.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits] and [Sustained Hits 1].

Mercy is Weakness.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, DREADNOUGHT unit selected to attack: its attacks have [Lethal Hits] ; or [Sustained Hits 1].

Mesmerising Form.brief: Attacks targeting this model: -1 to Hit roll.

Metalodermal Tesla Weave.brief: CRYPTEK only. Once per phase, enemy unit targeting the bearer's unit with a charge: on 2-5, D3 MW; on 6, 3 MW.

Metalophagic Infection.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: 1 enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE hit, roll D6 (+1 if Afflicted); 5+ = D3 MW.

Metaphysical Brokerage.brief: End of your turn, bearer on battlefield, fewer than 3YP gained this turn: gain the difference.

Meteoric Descent.brief: If this unit made an ingress move this turn: ranged attacks have +1 to hit.

Methodical Annihilation.brief: LEAGUES OF VOTANN attacks targeting the closest eligible target or a unit within Engagement Range: re-roll Wound rolls of 1 ; KÂHL, EINHYR HEARTHGUARD and ÛTHAR THE DESTINED units also +1 AP.

Methodical Brutality.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to attack: its attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]; if a VEHICLE unit, +1 to Wound as well.

Methodical Destruction.brief: Start of battle round 1: pick 1 enemy unit as victim; attacks vs victim: re-roll Wound roll; victim destroyed: pick a new one.

Methodical Murder.brief: Shooting phase or Fight phase, NECRONS unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) not yet selected to shoot or fight: until end of phase, its weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Miasma of Pestilence (Aura).brief: Friendly DEATH GUARD units within 6": Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

Microdrone Support.brief: Your Shooting phase, PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit starting an action: that action does not prevent it from shooting.

Micromelta Rounds.brief: VINDICARE ASSASSIN only: exitus rifle gains [Anti-MONSTER 4+] and [Anti-VEHICLE 4+].

Might Is Right.brief: If this unit made a charge move this turn: this model's melee attacks have +3 A and +2 S.

Might of Angels.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Lance].

Might of Heroes (psychic level 1).brief: Fight phase, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6; on 1 battle-shocked; this unit's melee attacks have +2 S.

Might of the Machine Spirit.brief: Your Command phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (except DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER): until your next Command phase, ignores modifiers to its M, BS, Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

Might of Titan (Psychic).brief: Once per battle, start of the Fight phase: until end of phase, this model's melee weapons +3 A and +3 S.

Mindhunger.brief: DEATHLEAPER, LICTOR and NEUROLICTOR units have Deep Strike; LICTOR and NEUROLICTOR attacks against a CHARACTER unit re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Mindless Killing Machines (Pain).brief: Start of Fight phase, spend 1 Pain token to Empower: each model destroyed by a melee attack that has not fought, on 2+ it fights after the attacking unit, then is removed.

Mindshock Pod (Aura, Psychic).brief: Enemy units within 9": -1 to Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

Minefield Detail Upgrade.brief: GRETCHIN unit only. While not embarked: this unit has Scouts 6".

Miniaturised Nebuloscope.brief: Ranged weapons of the bearer's unit: [Ignores Cover].

Ministorum Sermon#56588d5a0e.brief: While this unit contains a MINISTORUM PRIEST: melee attacks get +1 to Wound.

Ministorum Sermon#9ced75b668.brief: While the unit contains a MINISTORUM PRIEST: melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Miraculous Saviour.brief: Once per battle, end of opponent's Charge phase (not round 1): pick up to 1 enemy unit that charged this phase; this unit makes an ingress move set up engaged with it, still eligible to move.

Mirage Field.brief: ASURYANI MOUNTED: attacks targeting the bearer's unit: -1 to Hit roll.

Mischief Makers (Aura).brief: Enemy unit (unless TITANIC) within Engagement Range selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee attacks get -1 to Hit.

Misfortune (Psychic).brief: End of your Movement phase: 1 enemy unit within 18" and visible; until your next Command phase, its attacks get -1 to Wound; each unit once per turn.

DEATHWATCH allies allowed up to 500 pts, never WARLORD; KILL TEAM enhancements from this detachment only.

Mist-wreathed Shadow Realms.brief: Your Command phase, if this unit is unengaged: place it in Strategic Reserves; it can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (even in your first turn).

Mistweave#5b7968c911.brief: SHADOWSEER only: while leading, models in the unit have Infiltrators.

Mistweave#bdcf140892.brief: SHADOWSEER only: bearer's unit has Infiltrators.

Mk X Gravis Armour.brief: INFANTRY only. M 5", T 6, W 5; loses TACTICUS, gains GRAVIS; can only be attached to GRAVIS units (excluding FLY).

Mk X Phobos Armour.brief: INFANTRY only. Gains Infiltrators and Stealth; loses TACTICUS, gains PHOBOS; attaches only to ELIMINATOR, INCURSOR, INFILTRATOR, REIVER or SCOUT SQUAD.

Mob Mentality.brief: Start of Battle-shock step of your Command phase, friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models: one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" passes its battle-shock rolls automatically.

Mob-Handed Brutality.brief: Friendly BOYZ units' melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]; a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit that charged this turn has [Lethal Hits: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE] on its melee attacks.

Mobile Arsenal.brief: Your Shooting phase: ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Mobile Command Vehicle.brief: Your Command phase: one OFFICER embarked within this TRANSPORT can issue Orders from inside; measure distances to and from the TRANSPORT.

Mobile Exploitation.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, 1 unengaged HERNKYN unit (or up to 2 for 2 YP): remove from the battlefield and place into Strategic Reserves.

Mobile Firebase.brief: Your Movement phase, after an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit Advances or Falls Back, that unit: until end of turn, it is eligible to shoot despite Advancing or Falling Back.

Mobile Fortress.brief: Ranged attacks targeting this unit: -1 D.

Mobile Hunter.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, optional: Normal move of up to D6"; then not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

Mobile Hunter-killers.brief: Attack targeting a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit: re-roll the Wound roll.

Mobile Lethality.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit: until end of turn it can shoot in a turn it Advanced or Fell Back.

Mobile Sensor Relays.brief: LEAGUES OF VOTANN TRANSPORT units have Firebase Control (Aura): friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY units wholly within 6" of the TRANSPORT have [Sustained Hits 1] on their ranged weapons.

MOBILE VECTOR.brief: Your Movement phase, before Reinforcements, DEATH GUARD CHARACTER not leading a unit: it attaches as Leader to a friendly DEATH GUARD unit it can lead within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically (not Battle-shocked, not already fully led); adjust Starting Strength.

MOCKING FLIGHT.brief: Your Movement phase, HARLEQUINS unit that just Fell Back: it can still shoot and charge this turn.

Molecular Erosion.brief: Command phase, NECRONS MONSTER unit: select 1 unravelling enemy unit visible to it; it takes a Battle-shock test at -1; if failed, D3+1 MW; once per battle round.

Molecular Targeting.brief: Shooting phase or Fight phase, NECRONS unit not yet selected to shoot or fight: until end of phase, ignore any modifiers to BS/WS and Hit rolls; if CRYPTEK, also ignore Wound roll modifiers.

Molten Form.brief: Each time an attack is allocated to this model: halve its D.

MOMENT OF GLORY.brief: Fight phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit about to Consolidate: its models move an additional 3" if the unit can end within Engagement Range of an enemy.

Moment Shackle.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase, until end of phase: Watcher's Axe +3 A; or 3+ Inv.

Momentum Feedback.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted an unengaged ELECTRO-PRIESTS unit has shot, that unit: surge move of up to D6".

Monarch of the Hunt#b2332dce99.brief: Start of battle round 1: 1 enemy unit = quarry; melee attacks on quarry: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls; quarry destroyed: pick a new one.

Monarch of the Hunt#d64a2968de.brief: Start of battle round 1: 1 enemy unit = quarry; melee attacks vs quarry: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls; quarry destroyed: pick a new one.

Monocular Targeting Helms.brief: Neutron fusil attacks vs MONSTER or VEHICLE: [Ignores Cover].

Monofilament Snare.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: one enemy unit hit by the Shadow Weaver is snared until your next turn; each Normal, Advance or Fall Back move it makes: 1 D6 per model, each 1 = 1 MW.

Monofilament Web.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if doomweaver hit an enemy unit: until your next turn it is pinned (-2 M, -2 to Charge rolls).

Monstrous Nemesis.brief: TYRANIDS MONSTER only. Bearer's melee attacks vs MONSTER or VEHICLE: +1 to Wound rolls.

Monstrous Visages.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit: attacks targeting it get -1 to Hit rolls.

Morbid Might.brief: SUCCUBUS only: bearer's melee attacks re-roll the Wound roll.

Mordian Minute.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit under the First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! Order: until end of phase, +1 Strength on its attacks.

More Dakka.brief: Ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover]; if riled up, also [Sustained Hits 1].

Morghenna's Curse.brief: SUCCUBUS: bearer's melee weapons AP and D improved by 1.

Morgog's Finkin' Cap.brief: WARBOSS only. Once per battle per army, end of your opponent's Movement phase, if unengaged: normal move up to D6" (re-roll the D6 if riled up).

Moritoi Ancients.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit: at starting strength +2 OC; below starting strength re-roll hit rolls of 1; below half-strength re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1.

Mortal Sorcery (Aura).brief: While a friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS PSYKER unit is within 6" and visible: that unit has the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

MORTAL THRALLS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted HERETIC ASTARTES unit + friendly DAMNED unit within 3" visible to both: while the DAMNED unit is visible and an eligible target, no Wound roll is made; the DAMNED unit suffers MW equal to the attack's D instead.

Mortality Shroud Upgrade.brief: OBELISK only. Opponent's Battle-shock step: enemy units within 8" Below Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test.

MORTARION'S TEACHINGS.brief: Your Shooting phase, TERMINATOR unit not yet shot: its ranged weapons have [Assault] and [Heavy] until end of phase.

Mortis Protocols.brief: Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit destroys its first enemy unit this turn, friendly NECRONS unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 9" of it: its Reanimation Protocols activate.

Mortis Snares.brief: End of your Movement phase, unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit controlling an objective: that objective is snared ; when an enemy unit ends a move within range of it, D6: 2+ = D6 MW to that unit ; the objective is then no longer snared.

MOTIVE IMPERATIVE.brief: Your Command phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit: until your next Command phase, +3" M and +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

Mount Up!.brief: End of opponent's Movement phase, if this TRANSPORT is empty: one friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit (not ARTILLERY) wholly within 6" and not engaged can embark.

Mounted Strategist.brief: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for the bearer's unit.

MOVE OUT.brief: End of enemy turn, ASTRA MILITARUM unit: if not engaged and every model within 3" of an ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Mow 'Em Down.brief: Fight phase, friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (not WALKER) that charged this turn selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Cleave 1], or +1 to their [Cleave] value if they already have it.

Mow Down the Enemy.brief: Punisher gatling cannon attack targeting an enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE): [Devastating Wounds].

Multi-spectral visor.brief: Ranged attacks of this unit: re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

Multi-threat Eliminator.brief: Once per turn, opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots a friendly NECRONS unit within 3" of this model: 1 model with this ability within 3" of the target shoots back at that enemy unit.

MultiCOG Targeting.brief: Ranged attacks of this model: ignore any or all modifiers to BS and to the Hit roll.

Multitudinous Limbs.brief: Your Movement phase, INFANTRY or MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit making an Advance or Fall Back move: that move does not stop it starting an action.

Multiwave System Jammer.brief: Once per battle, your Movement phase, bearer on battlefield: 1 friendly CTHONIAN unit in Reserves; until end of phase, treat battle round as 1 higher to set it up.

MURDER-CALL.brief: end of enemy Fight, unengaged BLOOD LEGIONS unit: removed from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

Murder-Forged Entity Upgrade.brief: WORLD EATERS VEHICLE only: unit gains DAEMON keyword.

Murder-maker (Aura).brief: Fight phase, friendly WULFEN model within 6" destroyed before its unit has fought: on a 4+, it stays until its unit has fought or the end of the phase.

Murder's Jest.brief: DEATH JESTER only: bearer's attacks vs a unit below Half-strength: each successful Hit is a Critical Hit.

Murdercall.brief: Enemy unit (unless AIRCRAFT) ends a Normal or Advance move within 6" of LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE units: 1 of them not in Engagement Range can make a Surge move: roll 1 D6, move up to that many inches, ending as close as possible to that enemy, may enter Engagement Range.

Murderer's Circus.brief: Fight phase, DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit just targeted: until end of phase, attacks targeting it are -1 to Hit.

Murderer's Cowl.brief: Can shoot and charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Murdermind.brief: CRYPTEK only. Bearer gains DESTROYER CULT keyword and +3" M.

Murderous Agenda.brief: Round 1: pick a Contract and a matching enemy Contract unit; when it dies, start of your Command phase: +3 Pain tokens. KABAL/BLADES FOR HIRE attacks: Trophy Hunters (CHARACTER): [Precision] vs it; Sow Fear (INFANTRY/MOUNTED): [Sustained Hits 1]; Show of Strength (MONSTER/VEHICLE): [Lethal Hits].

Murderous Crossfire.brief: After this unit shot: pick one enemy unit hit; until end of phase, friendly DRUKHARI ranged attacks vs it have AP improved by 1; same enemy unit affected once per turn.

Murderous Hurricane (psychic level 1).brief: Your Movement phase, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll of 1 D6; on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; 1 visible enemy unit within 12" cannot make Snap shooting attacks.

Murderous Imperative.brief: SKITARII unit attacks: Protector Imperative active = re-roll Hit rolls of 1; Conqueror Imperative active = re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

Murderous Insight.brief: Unit's attack destroys an enemy unit: roll D6, on 4+ gain 1CP.

Murderous Onslaught.brief: Bearer's unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: enemy cannot Fire Overwatch at it until end of turn.

MURDEROUS REANIMATION.brief: Fight phase, DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit that just destroyed an enemy unit or just brought one Below Half-strength: its Reanimation Protocols activate.

MURKSHADOWS.brief: Your Movement phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE INFANTRY unit: until end of phase, +5" M on Normal moves.

Mutagenic Magicks.brief: Start of Fight phase, engaged THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit: pick 1 engaged enemy unit, roll 6 D6, each 4+ = 1 MW.

Mutagenic Regeneration.brief: ABOMINANT, BIOPHAGUS or PATRIARCH only. Each Command phase: 1 model in the bearer's unit regains 1 wound.

MUTATE LANDSCAPE.brief: Your Command phase, THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit in range of an objective you control: objective mutated, stays yours until enemy Level of Control exceeds yours at end of a phase; while mutated and yours, enemy unit ending a move in range: D6, on 4+ D3 MW.

Mutated Bodyguard.brief: With a Traitor Ogryn in the unit: CHARACTER models in it have [Feel No Pain 4+].

Mutating Vortex (Aura).brief: End of your Movement phase, each enemy unit within 6": D6, 2-3 = 1 MW; 4-5 = D3 MW; 6 = D6 MW; then each takes a Battle-shock test.

MV15 Gun Drone.brief: Bearer is equipped with 1 twin pulse blaster.

My Will Be Done#e9da8486bf.brief: Once per battle round, 1 unit with this ability targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1CP less.

Mysterious Guardian.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Once per battle, end of opponent's turn, if unengaged: goes into Strategic Reserves; has Deep Strike until your next Shooting phase; must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase.

Mysterious Saviours.brief: Can be targeted by Heroic Intervention even if already used this phase: that use is -1 CP and does not block other uses this phase.

NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, NECRONS VEHICLE unit targeted: until end of phase, attacks allocated to its models -1 D.

Nanosaturation.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after enemy unit has shot at a friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit, that unit: shoots using snap shooting, targeting only that enemy unit.

Nanoscarab Projector.brief: Once per battle round, friendly NECRONS unit within 3" of the bearer activates its Reanimation Protocols: reanimates 1 additional wound.

Nanoscarab Reanimation Beam (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS units within 3": each time Reanimation Protocols activate, heal D3 additional wounds.

Narthecis Gauntlet.brief: APOTHECARY BIOLOGIS only. Your Command phase: this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

Narthecium#01b3c58aea.brief: While this unit contains a RAVENWING APOTHECARY: your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

Narthecium#40fc21333b.brief: Your Command phase: this unit heals D3+1 W.

Narthecium#6b142398a1.brief: Once per turn, your Command phase: this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

Narthecium#e9824b1b06.brief: Your Command phase: return 1 destroyed model (not CHARACTERS) to bearer's unit.

Nazdreg's Know-wotz.brief: This unit has Deep Strike; its ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

NECESSARY END.brief: Fight phase, targeted GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit: each model destroyed before fighting rolls a D6; if higher than the battle round number, it fights after the attacker, then is removed.

Necrodermis.brief: Each time an attack is allocated to this model: -1 D.

Necromechanic.brief: Once per battle round, failed save for a friendly LEGIO CYBERNETICA or ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE model within 12": D of that attack changed to 0.

Needle of Nurgle.brief: Each use of Tainted Narthecium: return up to D3 destroyed models (instead of 1).

Negation Emitters Upgrade.brief: STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only: this unit has -3" detection range.

Nemesis Rounds.brief: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR only: Fire Overwatch on the bearer's unit hits on unmodified 5+.

Neocapacitor Shields.brief: Start of opponent's Charge phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) takes a Battle-shock test and has -1 to Charge rolls until end of turn.

Nether-realm Casket.brief: NECRONS only. While leading: models in the unit have Stealth.

Nethershriek Mind-eater.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: 1 enemy unit within 12" and visible takes a Battle-shock test; failed = 3 MW.

Network Override.brief: While unit contains ≥1 TECH-PRIEST: eligible to perform an Action in a turn it Advanced; eligible to shoot in a turn it started an Action.

Neural Disruption.brief: Your Command phase: 1 enemy unit within 12" must take a Battle-shock test.

Neural Lash.brief: Command phase, friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit: pick 1 friendly battle-shocked ARMIGER unit within 12"; it is no longer battle-shocked.

Neural Overload.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit: if HALO OVERRIDE, it suffers D3 MW; choose 1 Override ability, active for it until your next Command phase (stacks with other Overrides only if HALO OVERRIDE).

Neurocytes.brief: while within Synapse Range of a friendly TYRANIDS unit (not NEUROGAUNT): this unit has the SYNAPSE keyword.

Never Enough Dakka.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Never Outgunned.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit just selected to shoot/fight: its weapons gain [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1] (your choice).

Never Too Busy to Fight.brief: Being engaged does not prevent this unit from starting an action.

Neverblade.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH MONSTER only. Bearer's melee weapons: +2 S, +1 A, AP improved by 1; melee attacks +1 to Hit roll.

Nexus of Devotion.brief: While leading: unit has [Feel No Pain 5+]; HYBRID METAMORPHS unit: [Feel No Pain 4+] instead.

NIGHT SHIELD.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, DRUKHARI VEHICLE unit just targeted: 4+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Nightforged Battery Upgrade.brief: LAND SPEEDER VENGEANCE only: re-roll rolls to determine a weapon's A and Hazard rolls.

Nightmare Shroud.brief: DRUKHARI; bearer's unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT: until end of turn, enemy units cannot Fire Overwatch at it.

Nightmare Shroud (Aura).brief: Battle-shock step of opponent's Command phase: enemy units below Starting Strength within 6" must take a Battle-shock test at -1.

Nightmare's Master.brief: Start of Fight phase: each enemy unit in Engagement Range of bearer takes a Battle-shock test.

No Barrier to Retribution.brief: your Movement or Charge phase, DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit selected to make a Normal/Advance/Charge move: it has MOBILE.

NO ESCAPE.brief: Enemy Movement phase, enemy ends a fall-back move, 1 unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6": declare a charge, targets only units that fell back this phase and are in range.

No Hiding from the Watchers.brief: Friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 6": [Feel No Pain 5+] against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

No Mercy.brief: While leading a unit: attacks targeting a unit Below Half-strength get +1 to Hit.

No Prey Too Big.brief: Your Shooting phase, ANHRATHE, RANGERS or SHROUD RUNNERS unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, +1 to Wound rolls when the attack's S is lower than the target's highest T.

No Retreat!.brief: Your Command phase, ASTRA MILITARUM unit under the Duty and Honour! Order: if within range of an objective you control, it stays yours even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase.

No Sacrifice Too Great.brief: your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to shoot: its [Hazardous] plasma ranged attacks have +1 S.

No Shot Wasted.brief: Shooting phase, friendly HERNKYN unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Noble Sacrifice.brief: Any phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit just destroyed: its Deadly Demise inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+ instead of only a 6 (+1 to the roll if an ARMIGER unit).

Noble Steed.brief: FRONT-LINE COMMANDER only. M 12", T 4, Sv 4+; loses INFANTRY, gains MOUNTED; can also be attached to ATTILAN ROUGH RIDERS or DEATH RIDERS.

Noctilith Mantle.brief: Bearer's unit on the battlefield counts as wholly within your Flow of Magic; its models cannot use Rituals.

Node Lash (Psychic).brief: while leading a unit: +1 to Hit rolls for that unit; +1 to Wound rolls too if target is Battle-shocked.

Nomad Strategist.brief: Once per battle, end of opponent's Fight phase: one HERNKYN unit (+1 per 2YP spent), not in Engagement Range (except of assailed units), placed into Strategic Reserves.

Nomadic Hunter.brief: KROOT TRAIL SHAPER only. While leading a unit: +3" M for its models and its ranged weapons have [Assault].

Nomads of the Hidden Way.brief: Your Shooting phase, RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit that has shot: Normal move of up to D6"; no charge nor embarking in a TRANSPORT until end of turn.

Noospheric Recon.brief: PTERAXII/INFILTRATORS/RANGERS/SERBERYS RAIDERS/SERBERYS SULPHURHOUNDS units have RECON AUGURY; RECON AUGURY units, your Shooting phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" is analysed: +3" detection range while analysed.

Noospheric Transference.brief: Your Command phase: 1/2/3 ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught) gain HALO OVERRIDE until your next Command phase, with 1 Override: Electromotive +2" M; Microactuator +1 T; Predation can charge after Advancing; Muted Servomotors Stealth.

Not a Shell Wasted.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only: this unit's ranged attacks +1 A.

Nova Charge.brief: Once per battle, when selected to shoot in your Shooting phase: 1 ranged weapon of this model has [Devastating Wounds] until end of phase.

Nowhere to Hide (Pain).brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot, spend 1 Pain token to Empower: after shooting, one enemy unit hit loses the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Nowhere to Hide#292c8884af.brief: Attacks targeting a hidden unit: +1 to Hit rolls.

Nowhere to Run (Pain).brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; after shooting, 1 enemy unit hit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) is pinned until your next turn (-2 M, -2 to Charge rolls).

Null Nodules.brief: TYRANIDS MONSTER only. Once per battle, when a Psychic Attack is allocated to the bearer: [Feel No Pain 5+] vs Psychic Attacks until end of phase.

Null Rod.brief: Bearer's unit: [Feel No Pain 4+] against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

Nullstone Field Generator (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS unit within 6" of the bearer: models have [Feel No Pain 5+] against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

Numberless Horde.brief: Your Command phase, a new 10-model POXWALKERS unit joins your army in Strategic Reserves: Incursion rounds 2-3; Strike Force rounds 2-4; Onslaught rounds 2-5. POXWALKERS units gain BATTLELINE.

Nuncio-acquila.brief: Once per battle, start of any Command phase: one objective marker within 6" of bearer; all enemy units (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within range take a Battle-shock test; max once per marker per turn.

Nuncio-aquila.brief: Once per battle, start of any Command phase: one objective marker within 6" of bearer; all enemy units (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within range take a Battle-shock test; max once per marker per turn.

Nurgle's Gift (Aura).brief: DEATH GUARD army: enemy within Contagion Range (3"/6"/9" rounds 1/2/3+, max 12") of a DEATH GUARD unit is Afflicted: -1 T and chosen Plague (cover vs its shooting and -1 melee Hit; or -1 Sv; or -1 M, Ld, OC).

Nurgle’s Rot (Psychic)#91c72344a1.brief: End of your Movement phase, one enemy unit within 12": -1 T until the start of your next Movement phase.

Nurgle’s Rot (Psychic)#aea1cae2c6.brief: End of your Movement phase: 1 enemy unit within 12" has -1 T until start of your next Movement phase.

Oath of Macragge.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: +1 A, +1 S; while under the Assault Doctrine: +2 A, +2 S instead.

Oathbound.brief: Melee attacks: +1 to hit rolls; or, against this unit's slayer's oath: +1 to hit rolls and wound rolls.

Oathbound Exemplar#578248f21e.brief: Bearer's unit: +1 to Advance rolls; if the mission pack features Actions, it can start an Action in a turn it Advanced.

Oathbound Exemplar#d21e75b78d.brief: Advance or Fall Back move of this unit does not prevent it from starting an action.

Oathbound Speculator.brief: Attacks of the bearer's unit: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; when selected to shoot or fight, spend 3YP: +1 to Wound rolls until end of phase.

Obelisk Node Control.brief: While within range of an objective you control: enemy units set up from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

Objective Ravaged.brief: End of your Command phase, if within range of an objective you control: it stays yours until your opponent's Level of Control is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Objective Scouted.brief: End of your Command phase, if in range of an objective you control: it stays yours even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

Oblivion Knight.brief: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only: this unit's attacks +1 to Hit rolls; or, against a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +1 to Hit and Wound rolls.

Obsessive Annunciation.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Obsessive Denunciation.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Obsessive Ruthlessness.brief: Ranged attacks vs MONSTER/VEHICLE units: can ignore modifiers to BS, Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

Occulus Infernum.brief: SORCERER/EXALTED SORCERER only; your Movement phase, start or end of move: 1 friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 6" gets +1 BS on ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.

Octagram of Conjuration (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG model within 9" has shot: pick 1 enemy unit hit by those attacks, it takes a Battle-shock test.

Ocular Adaptation.brief: WINGED TYRANID PRIME/TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP only. Unit's melee attacks: +1 to Hit rolls.

Offerings for the Dark Gods (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG models within 6": ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Plunging Talons.brief: Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that charged this turn selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Lance].

POINT-BLANK AMBUSH.brief: Your Shooting phase (not rounds 1-2), T'AU EMPIRE unit not yet shot: ranged attacks against enemy units within 9" get AP improved by 1 this phase.

Point-blank Barrage.brief: Ranged attack targeting the closest eligible target: AP improved by 1.

Point-Blank Barrage.brief: Your Shooting phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, Blast weapons can target enemies in its Engagement Range (if no other friendly unit engages them), no Hit penalty for being engaged; each unmodified Hit roll of 1 vs such a unit: 1 MW to your unit afterwards.

Point-blank Brutality.brief: Your Shooting phase, engaged TACTICUS unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks (except [Blast]) have [Close-Quarters] and [Ignores Cover].

POINT-BLANK DESTRUCTION.brief: Your Shooting phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit in Engagement Range not yet shot: its ranged weapons (except Blast) have [Pistol].

Point-blank Devastation.brief: Heavy Wraithcannon or Suncannon targeting a unit within half range: re-roll the number of attacks dice.

POINT-BLANK PURGATION.brief: your Shooting phase, GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot: its storm bolters have [Pistol] and [Twin-linked] until end of phase.

POISONER’S ART.brief: Fight phase, HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit that just fought: 1 enemy unit (not VEHICLE) it hit is poisoned for the battle; start of each Command phase, D6 per poisoned unit: on 4+ it suffers D3 MW.

Political Overwatch.brief: While another OFFICER is in this unit: re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

Polychromatic Camoflage.brief: Can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18".

Portal of Spite.brief: Your Charge phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit set up by Deep Strike this turn, no charge declared yet: +2 to charge rolls.

Possessed Blade.brief: Start of battle: 1 bearer melee weapon gets +1 A; each time the bearer fights, it can give that weapon +1 D, [Devastating Wounds] and [Hazardous] for those attacks.

Possessed Lord.brief: Once per battle, start of Fight phase: until end of phase, this model's melee weapons +3 A and [Devastating Wounds].

Possessive Mania.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective: attacks targeting it have -1 AP until the attacker has attacked.

POSTMORTALITY.brief: Any phase, HAEMONCULUS model just destroyed (once per model per battle): spend 1-3 Pain tokens; end of phase, set it back up unengaged as close as possible, unattached, with that many wounds.

Potentiality Syphon.brief: Opponent's Command phase, NECRONS unit within range of an objective marker: its Reanimation Protocols activate; if CRYPTEK, it reanimates 1 additional wound.

POUNCE ON THE PREY.brief: Your Movement phase, DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit that just disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this phase: it can declare a charge this turn.

Pouncing Leap.brief: Heroic Intervention on this unit regardless of other uses this phase: -1 CP, and does not prevent uses on other units.

Power from Pain.brief: DRUKHARI army: 1 Pain token at start of your Command phase, per enemy unit destroyed, per failed enemy Battle-shock test; spend as each Pain ability states to Empower that unit (whole Attached unit) until end of phase.

Power Matrix.brief: Power Matrix = your deployment zone, plus No Man's Land / enemy zone while you hold half their objectives; CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; unit wholly within the Matrix: re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Power of the Hive Mind.brief: TYRANIDS PSYKER only. Bearer's psychic weapons: +1 S and +1 AP.

Power of the Machine Spirit#241ad6232d.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted an unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit has shot: your unit shoots back at that enemy unit only, snap shooting, or normal shooting if at or below half-strength.

Power of the Machine Spirit#602c41b24c.brief: This unit's ranged attacks: re-roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll.

Power of the Rosette.brief: Each time this model's unit is targeted by a Stratagem: D6, on 3+ gain 1 CP.

Powers of Da Waaagh!.brief: ORKS PSYKER [Psychic] attacks: +1 S, +1 S more per 5 models in unit. Psychic abilities (D6, 1 = battle-shocked): Roar of Mork, Movement phase: enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 12" battle-shock roll, -1 per 10 models in unit; Visions of Violence, start of Fight phase: Fights First.

Powers of the C’tan.brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: pick up to 2 different C'tan Powers weapons; equipped with them until end of phase, no other C'tan Powers usable.

Poxbringer.brief: While leading: attacks of the unit score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

Practical Tactics.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit within 8" of it: Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if under the Tactical Doctrine.

Praesidium Shield#3277234efc.brief: Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound rolls.

Praesidium Shield#40c4b82470.brief: Attacks allocated to this model: -1 D.

Pragmatic Hunters.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, Normal move of up to D6".

PRAISE THE FALLEN.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit that lost 1+ models to it: can shoot as if your Shooting phase, targeting only that enemy unit (if eligible).

PRE-CALIBRATED PURGE SOLUTION.brief: Your Shooting phase, 1 ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit not yet shot (+1 non-BATTLELINE SKITARII unit within 6" if it is BATTLELINE): ranged attacks against targets in the enemy deployment zone re-roll hit rolls.

Precise Targeting.brief: Attacks by the unit targeting a Spotted unit: re-roll the Hit roll.

Precision Drop.brief: Your Movement phase, set up by Deep Strike: can be set up anywhere more than 6" from all enemy units; not eligible to charge this turn.

Precision of the Patient Hunter.brief: T'AU EMPIRE only. Bearer's ranged attacks: +1 to Hit roll; from battle round 3 onwards, +1 to Wound roll as well.

Precision Onslaught.brief: Your Charge phase, just after a SICARIAN unit declares a charge, that unit: when it ends its Charge move, pick 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, D6 per model in Engagement Range of it: each 4+ = 1 MW.

Precognicient Volleys Upgrade.brief: PURGATION SQUAD only: snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified 5+.

Precognisant.brief: After both armies deployed: redeploy up to three DRUKHARI units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of the units already there.

PRECOGNITIVE STRATEGIES.brief: opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, unengaged GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit within 8" of it: it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Precursive Judgement.brief: Bearer's unit wholly within 6" of friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN TRANSPORT: Fire Overwatch on it costs 0CP and hits on unmodified 5+.

PREDATORY IMPERATIVE.brief: your Command, up to 2 TYRANIDS units in Synapse Range (or 1 other): 1 extra Hyper-adaptation active for them until your next Command, not the one chosen at round 1.

Predatory Instinct.brief: Once per battle round, opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if unengaged, this unit makes a normal move of up to D6".

Predatory Instincts.brief: ABOMINANT, BIOPHAGUS or PATRIARCH only. Bearer's unit has [Infiltrators]; Heroic Intervention on it regardless of other uses this phase: -1 CP, does not prevent uses on other units.

PREDATORY PURSUIT.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or Vashtorr unit within 8" of it and not in Engagement Range: Normal move up to 6", ending as close as possible to that enemy unit.

Predestined Coordinates Upgrade.brief: INTERCEPTOR SQUAD only: in your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

Predictive Guidance.brief: Once per battle round, Fire Overwatch or Heroic Intervention targeting this unit: -1 CP.

Prelocational Optimiser.brief: NECRONS only. Unit set up via a Monolith's Eternity Gate this turn, when selected to shoot: ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1].

Presaged Rehearsal.brief: Fight phase, TROUPE unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Lance].

Prescience (psychic level 2).brief: Your Movement phase, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll (D6); on 1 the unit is battle-shocked; +1 Sv until the start of your next turn.

Prescience (Psychic)#a54200d563.brief: Leading a unit: attacks targeting it -1 to Hit.

Prescience (Psychic)#c1c6f2ad5a.brief: Attacks targeting this unit: -1 to Hit roll.

Prescient Redeployment.brief: From round 2, start of your Movement phase, if you did not use Gate of Infinity on the maximum number of GREY KNIGHTS units at the end of opponent's turn: 1 eligible GREY KNIGHTS unit on the battlefield goes into Strategic Reserves.

PRESENTIMENT OF DREAD.brief: Command phase, ASURYANI PSYKER model: an enemy unit within 18" and visible takes a Battle-shock test with -1.

PRESERVATION IMPERATIVE.brief: enemy Shooting, ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit just targeted: counts as fewer than 5 models for [Blast] until end of phase.

Press the Attack.brief: Melee attacks: [Sustained Hits 1] vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE; if the assault doctrine is active, [Sustained Hits 1] vs all.

PRETERNATURAL AGILITY.brief: Start of your Movement or Charge phase, WYCH CULT unit: until end of phase, ignore modifiers to its M, Advance and Charge rolls; until end of turn, its models can move horizontally through models (not ending a Normal/Advance move in Engagement Range of them).

PRETERNATURAL PRECISION.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASPECT WARRIORS unit not yet selected to shoot: may remove 1 Aspect Shrine token; pick 1 of [Ignores Cover], [Lethal Hits], [Sustained Hits 1] (2 if a token was removed) for its ranged weapons until end of phase.

PRETERNATURAL RAPIDITY.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit ends an Advance move: that Advance does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

PREVENTATIVE PURGE.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move, BRÔKHYR THUNDERKYN or IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit: shoots as if in your Shooting phase, at that enemy unit only, with -1 to Hit.

Prey of the Blood God.brief: Start of battle round 1: one enemy unit is this model's prey; the unit's melee attacks against it re-roll Wound rolls; when the prey is destroyed, select a new one.

Prey on the Weak#094a969ba4.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit not yet shot/fought: attacks against Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength units re-roll Hit rolls.

Prey on the Weak#6716193b46.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY units' attacks on a battle-shocked or at/below half-strength unit re-roll hit rolls of 1; enemy attacks on them have -1 to hit if the attacker is battle-shocked or at/below half-strength. NIGHTMARE tag: 1 such detachment max.

Preymark crest.brief: Attacks of the bearer's unit against an enemy unit in range of an objective: on a Critical Wound, [Precision].

Preysight (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG model within 6": its ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover].

Preyslayer.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY only. This unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

Prideful Superiority.brief: Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, attacks against CHARACTER units re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

Primarch of the First Legion.brief: Start of your Command phase: select up to 2 abilities from the Primarch of the First Legion section, this model has them until the start of your next Command phase.

Primarch of the XIII (Aura).brief: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6": attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Prime Target.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, attacks on a CHARACTER unit re-roll Wound rolls of 1; OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM attacks on the enemy WARLORD re-roll the Wound roll instead.

PRIME TARGET.brief: Shooting phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks can re-roll one hit roll, one wound roll and one damage roll.

Prime Test Subject.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (not DAMNED) only. Bearer's melee weapons +1 D; bearer's melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls.

PRIMED AND READIED.brief: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, GENESTEALER CULTS unit not yet shot/fought: until end of phase, its attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

Primed and Ready.brief: Your Shooting phase: one model with this ability can be the target of the Grenade Stratagem for 0CP (if not already targeted this phase).

Prince of Corsairs.brief: After both armies deployed, if this model (or its TRANSPORT) is on the battlefield: redeploy up to three AELDARI units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of the units already there.

Prince of Darkness (Aura).brief: Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6": Stealth.

Prince of Slaanesh.brief: While leading: melee attacks of the unit score Critical Wounds on unmodified Wound rolls of 5+.

Prioritised Efficiency.brief: LEAGUES OF VOTANN army: under 7 Yield points at end of your Command phase = Hostile Acquisition (+1 to Hit vs enemies near objectives; re-roll Advance and Charge); 7+ = Fortify Takeover (+1 to Hit if on your objective; -1 to Wound vs it if S > T).

Prioritised Victim.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit targeting a CHARACTER: its attacks against CHARACTER units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Priority Drop Beacon.brief: MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER only. Your first Movement phase: this unit can make an ingress move.

PRIORITY RECLAMATION.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit about to consolidate, not within 3" of enemies: consolidation moves of up to 6" instead of 3" if it ends within range of your Acquisition objective.

Priority Strike.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit selected to attack: +1 to Wound against MONSTER/VEHICLE units.

Priority Target.brief: Your Shooting phase, after its unit shoots: pick 1 enemy unit hit by a cult sniper rifle; until end of phase, friendly GENESTEALER CULTS attacks on it re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Priority Target Acquisition.brief: Ranged attacks of this unit targeting a unit within 12": +1 S.

Priority Target Identified (Once per bat.brief: Your Command phase: 1 visible terrain feature is identified until end of turn; enemy units within it have +3" detection range.

Prismatic Displacement.brief: Your Movement phase, INFANTRY or MOUNTED MUTANT unit making an Advance or Fall Back move: its ranged attacks have [Assault] until end of turn; that move does not stop it shooting or charging.

Privateer Arsenal.brief: Shooting phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1; if you spend 3 YP, re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls of 1 instead.

PROFANE SYMBIOSIS.brief: End of any phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit not Empowered: makes a Malefic Surge; same unit max once per battle round.

PROFANE ZEAL.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED unit not yet selected: until end of phase, re-roll Wound rolls.

PROGRAMMED WITHDRAWAL.brief: End of enemy Fight phase, up to 2 SICARIAN units or 1 SKITARII INFANTRY/SKITARII MOUNTED unit, each more than 3" from enemies: placed into Strategic Reserves.

Proper Killy.brief: WARBOSS only. This model re-rolls Hit rolls of 1.

Prophesied Doom.brief: Each Charge move: select 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll 1 D6 per model of this unit in Engagement Range of it; each 4+ = 1 MW.

Prophet of da Great Waaagh! (Aura).brief: Aura: friendly ORKS units within 6": melee attacks have +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound rolls.

Prophet of Destruction.brief: This model destroys an enemy unit: 1 other friendly DESTROYER CULT unit within 9" re-rolls Wound rolls of 1 until end of phase.

Prophetic Sentinels.brief: Once per turn, Fire Overwatch or Heroic Intervention on this unit: -1 CP.

Protect (Psychic).brief: While a FARSEER is leading this unit, attacks against it: -1 to Wound.

PROTECTION OF THE DARK PRINCE.brief: Any phase, just after a MW or attack is allocated to an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit: until end of phase, Feel No Pain 6+, and 4+ against MW.

Protection Protocols.brief: Heroic Intervention Stratagem on this unit costs 1 CP less, even if already used on another unit this phase.

Protective Disciples.brief: Within 3" of another friendly DESTROYER CULT unit: has Lone Operative.

Protector of the Paths.brief: ASURYANI; leading DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS: once per battle round, Fire Overwatch on the bearer's unit for 0CP; hits on unmodified 5+, 4+ if within range of an objective you control.

PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT.brief: Shooting phase, NECRONS unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, attacks against a unit within half range re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, re-roll the Hit roll instead.

PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT.brief: Any phase, NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model just destroyed: at end of phase, set it up unengaged as close as possible to where it died, as its own unit (Starting Strength 1) with half its starting wounds; once per model per battle.

PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID.brief: Fight phase, NECRONS unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, melee weapons +1 S; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, AP improved by 1 too (not cumulative with other AP improvements).

PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM.brief: Movement phase, NECRONS unit: until end of turn, its ranged weapons have [Assault]; if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER, re-roll its Advance rolls this phase.

PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit resolves its attacks, NECRONS unit that lost models to them: its Reanimation Protocols activate and reanimate D3 wounds (D3+1 if led by a NECRONS CHARACTER).

PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit, NECRONS CHARACTER unit that was within 6" of it: after the attacks resolve, it shoots as if in your Shooting phase, targeting only that enemy unit (if eligible).

Prototype Weapon System.brief: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT only. Each time bearer is selected to shoot: choose [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1]; bearer's ranged weapons have it until those attacks are resolved.

Proud and Vainglorious.brief: Bearer's unit: re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests; while your army's Favoured Champions: +1 OC.

Prowling Agitant.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS only: opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of bearer's unit not in Engagement Range: bearer's unit may make a Normal move of up to D6".

Psalm of Righteous Judgement.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time a PENITENT unit of yours destroys an enemy unit: discard 1 Miracle dice to gain 1 Miracle dice showing 6.

Pseudovian Form.brief: M 14", gains FLY, JUMP PACK and [Deep Strike]; can only be attached to SCOURGES WITH HEAVY WEAPONS or SCOURGES WITH SHARDCARBINES.

Psi Surge.brief: Start of any phase, TYRANIDS unit: until the start of your next Command phase, the range of its Catalyst ability is increased by 3"; not usable again until the end of your next Command phase.

Psionic Parasitism.brief: End of your Movement phase, per SYNAPSE unit: 1 GENESTEALER CULTS unit (not PURESTRAIN/PATRIARCH) and 1 TYRANIDS unit within 9": cult unit suffers D3+1 MW, a TYRANIDS model regains that many W, its unit +1 to Hit until your next Movement phase. TYRANIDS aura 6": GENESTEALER CULTS +1 to Hit.

Psionic Shield (Psychic).brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: until end of phase, 4+ Inv.

PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY.brief: Shooting phase, PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit that has shot: 1 enemy unit hit is prosecuted until end of turn; attacks against it have +1 AP.

PSYBOLT AMMUNITION.brief: Your Shooting phase, GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits] and [Psychic].

Psychedelic Soulflame.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit selected to attack: its attacks have +2 S.

Psychic Barrier (Psychic).brief: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase, you can roll D6: on 1, this PSYKER's unit suffers D3 MW; on 2+, until end of phase, its models have a 4+ Inv.

Psychic Celerity.brief: TERMINATOR model only: +1 to Charge rolls for this unit.

Psychic Communion (Psychic)#282674f9d4.brief: Each time selected to shoot: Destructor +1 A and +1 S per other friendly AELDARI PSYKER model within 6" (max +2) until end of phase.

Psychic Communion (Psychic)#d7d58f8365.brief: Each time selected to shoot, each WARLOCK: Destructor +1 A and +1 S per other friendly AELDARI PSYKER model within 6" (max +2) until end of phase.

Psychic Destroyer.brief: ASURYANI PSYKER: +1 D on the bearer's ranged Psychic weapons.

PSYCHIC DOMINION.brief: Any phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted THOUSAND SONS unit: until end of phase, attacker's Psychic weapons have [Hazardous] and your models have Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks.

Psychic Familiar#3c991e04de.brief: Once per battle, start of Fight phase: until end of phase, +6" to the range of Cosmic Horror.

Psychic Familiar#b6cb2124a4.brief: Once per battle, start of an enemy Shooting phase: until end of phase, +6" to the range of Mind Control.

Psychic Guidance#0067493f23.brief: Within 12" of a friendly AELDARI PSYKER model: Ld 6+ and +1 to Hit.

Psychic Guidance#19820bed50.brief: Within 12" of a friendly AELDARI PSYKER model: BS and WS improved by 1, Ld 6+.

Psychic Hood.brief: [Feel No Pain 4+] against psychic attacks and MW.

Psychic Hood (Psychic).brief: This unit has [Feel No Pain 4+] against psychic attacks.

PSYCHIC SHIELD.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets chosen, targeted ASURYANI INFANTRY unit (not WRAITH CONSTRUCT) within 9" of an ASURYANI PSYKER: can only be targeted by ranged attacks from models within 18" until end of phase.

Psychic Spoor#67ae9a39e8.brief: Start of round 1: pick 1 enemy unit as prey; attacks against it re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

Psychic Spoor#82d24196ae.brief: Start of round 1: pick 1 enemy unit as prey; attacks against it re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

Psychic Terror (Psychic)#f0f67018df.brief: if ≥1 Neurotyrant is on the battlefield when you unleash Shadow in the Warp: -1 to the Battle-shock test of each enemy unit.

Psychic Terror (Psychic)#fa6719eed6.brief: PSYKER only: if a model with this ability is on the battlefield when you unleash Shadow in the Warp: -1 to each enemy unit's resulting Battle-shock test.

Psychic Veil (Psychic).brief: Your Command phase: roll D6; 1 = unit suffers D3 MW; 2+ = until your next Command phase, unit can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18".

Psychological Saboteur (Aura).brief: Battle-shocked enemy unit within 12": -1 to its Hit rolls; friendly TYRANIDS attacks against it +1 to Wound rolls.

Psychostatic Disruption.brief: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE only. Enemy Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer; once per battle, round 1-2, enemy unit declared from Strategic Reserves: D6, on 4+ it cannot arrive this turn.

Psyoculum.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's ranged weapons have [Anti-Psyker 4+].

Pterrorshade Rookery.brief: KNIGHT TYRANT only. Selected to shoot: pick 1 enemy unit within 24"; it has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

PTERRORSHADES.brief: Any phase, after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit within 12" of it: roll 6D6, each 4+ = 1 MW to that enemy and 1 model in your unit regains 1 wound; once per battle round.

Pulsa Rokkit.brief: Once per battle, your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: attacks targeting 1 enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit within 24" have +1 AP and [Lethal Hits].

Pulse Accelerator Drone.brief: Pulse carbines of the bearer's unit: +6" Range.

Pulse Bombs.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase: 1 visible enemy unit (not Lone Operative) within 24", roll 6D6: each 4+ = 1 MW.

Pulse Jet.brief: Your Movement phase, when selected to move, if unengaged: can make a pulse jet move.

Pulse Jet Move.brief: Move type: D6+18", ignores vertical distance, through all models and terrain; must end unengaged; no charge or action this turn; until your next turn, attacks targeting the unit get -1 to hit.

PULSE ONSLAUGHT.brief: Your Shooting phase, T'AU EMPIRE INFANTRY unit (not KROOT) that just shot, and one enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) it hit: that enemy unit is shaken until end of your opponent's next turn (-2 Move, -2 to Advance and Charge rolls).

Punish the Craven.brief: enemy Movement, enemy unit falling back from your WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit: it must use desperate escape; -1 to those rolls if battle-shocked.

Punishing Salvoes.brief: Your Movement phase, Remains Stationary: until end of turn, ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Punishing Suppression.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit hit is suppressed until the start of your next turn: -1 to its Hit rolls.

Puretide Engram Neurochip.brief: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT only. Each time you target bearer's unit with a Stratagem: roll 1 D6, on 4+ gain 1CP.

Puretide's Teachings.brief: Once per battle round, when the unit is targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1CP less.

PURGATION PATTERN.brief: Your Shooting phase, GREY KNIGHTS unit set up by Deep Strike this turn, not yet shot: its weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Purgation Push.brief: Your Shooting phase, GRAVIS unit has shot: if unengaged, normal move of up to 5" ending within range of an objective ; cannot declare a charge or embark in a TRANSPORT until end of turn.

Purgation Run.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot: normal move of up to D6"; not eligible to charge until end of turn.

PURGATION SWEEP.brief: Shooting phase, WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit selected to shoot: its [Torrent] attacks have +1 A, or +2 A against a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit.

Purgation's Hand.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Melee attacks while the bearer is on your defensive line: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Purgatus Quarry.brief: Start of first battle round: up to one enemy unit is this unit's hunted; attacks targeting it re-roll Wound rolls of 1; when it is destroyed, select up to one new hunted.

Purge and Cleanse#6c130478d2.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit cannot have the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Purge and Cleanse#fd12c9417b.brief: Each time this model has shot: one enemy unit hit cannot have the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Purge and Sanctify#6c7779f581.brief: CRUSADER SQUAD surge move: can pick the closest objective instead of a surge target, models end as close as possible to it. Army: BLACK TEMPLARS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter.

Purge and Sanctify#8b452bc696.brief: Attack targets an ANCIENT unit within range of an objective with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound roll ; CRUSADER SQUAD surge move: can pick the closest objective instead of a surge target, models end as close as possible to it.

Purge Response.brief: Fire Overwatch on this unit: hits on unmodified 5+; 4+ with Fortify Takeover.

Purging Fire.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM unit under an Order, not yet selected to shoot: if within range of an objective marker, until end of phase its ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Purity of Execution.brief: Your Shooting phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 18" is detected: +3" detection range.

Purity of Purpose.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; bearer's unit set up by Deep Strike: re-roll Charge rolls for it until end of turn.

PURITY OF SUFFERING.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, PENITENT unit just targeted by an enemy unit: until end of phase, its PENITENT models have Feel No Pain 4+.

Push Dat Bit Back In.brief: Once per battle per unit, your Command phase: 1 friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" heals 3 W.

Putrefying Stink.brief: Enemy models cannot start or end an Advance move within 9" of this model.

Putrescent Fog (Aura).brief: Enemy units arriving as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

Putrid Carapace.brief: Bearer has Sv 2+; once per battle, start of either Command phase: bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.

PUTRID DETONATION.brief: Any phase, DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or MONSTER with Deadly Demise just destroyed: Deadly Demise MW inflicted automatically (no D6); enemy units suffering them are Afflicted until your next turn.

Pyrebrand.brief: BLACK TEMPLARS only. Models in bearer's unit have Stealth.

Pyresoul.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; start of your Shooting phase: 1 enemy unit within 24" and visible suffers D3 MW.

PYROGENESIS.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit not yet shot/fought: until end of phase, its weapons have +2 S; or spend 1 Flux token: +3 S and AP improved by 1 instead.

Quake Multigenerator.brief: Your Shooting phase, after the bearer shot: one enemy unit hit (unless TITANIC) is suppressed until your next turn (-1 to its Hit rolls).

Quake Supervisor.brief: While within 3" of friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN ARTILLERY: bearer has Lone Operative; those ARTILLERY units' ranged attacks vs enemy visible to bearer: +1 to Hit.

Quantum Abacus.brief: Bearer's unit targeted by a Stratagem: roll D6 (+1 if within range of an objective); on 4+, gain 1CP.

QUANTUM DEFLECTION.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, NECRONS VEHICLE unit targeted: until end of phase, 4+ invulnerable save.

Quantum Goad.brief: C'TAN SHARD OF THE NIGHTBRINGER only: can charge in a turn it Advanced.

Quantum Invader.brief: Can be set up in Reinforcements step of your 1st, 2nd or 3rd Movement phase, regardless of mission rules.

Questing Tendrils.brief: TYRANIDS units with this ability can charge after Falling Back; VANGUARD INVADER units can charge after Advancing.

Quickening (psychic level 1).brief: Your Command phase, if not Battle-shocked: psychic roll D6; 1 = Battle-shocked; assault doctrine also active for this unit until your next Command phase.

Quickening Foci.brief: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY only; your Movement phase, bearer's unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT: re-roll Charge rolls for it until end of turn.

Quicksilver Execution.brief: If this unit charged this turn: melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Quicksilver Grace.brief: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units: re-roll Advance rolls.

RABID INFUSION.brief: Start of Fight phase, DEATH GUARD unit with 2 CHARACTER models: it has Fights First until end of phase.

Rad-bombardment.brief: Start of round 1, each enemy unit in its deployment zone chooses: stand firm, D6 3+ = D3 MW; take cover, battle-shocked and D6 5+ = D3 MW. Start of your Command phase rounds 2-5: each enemy unit in its deployment zone, D6 3+ = 1 MW and Battle-shock test.

Radial Suffusion.brief: From battle round 2, Rad-bombardment Fallout: if bearer on the battlefield, also roll 1 D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of the opponent's deployment zone.

Radiant Champion.brief: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY only: bearer's melee weapons [Precision]; while wholly within your Hallowed Ground, each melee wound scored by the bearer = 1 extra MW on the target.

Radiant Mantle.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only: attacks targeting this unit -1 to Hit rolls.

Rage Embodied (Aura)#c23ccc3ecc.brief: Friendly KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6": +1 A on melee weapons.

Rage Embodied (Aura)#f331379b77.brief: Friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6": melee weapons +1 A.

Rage Eternal.brief: While leading, your Command phase: return 1 destroyed Bodyguard model to the unit.

Rage-fuelled Response.brief: opponent's Shooting phase, unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit targeted after the enemy unit has shot: it can make a surge move of up to D6".

Rage-Fuelled Warrior.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Once per battle, start of Fight phase: until end of phase, bearer's melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 3].

RAID AND FADE.brief: End of your Shooting phase, up to 2 KABALITE WARRIORS units or 1 other DRUKHARI unit (not SCOURGES, AIRCRAFT or engaged): each makes a Normal move of up to 6"; no charge until end of turn.

Raid and Run.brief: End of Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight: Normal move of up to D3+3" if not in Engagement Range; otherwise Fall Back move of up to D3+3".

Raid Leader.brief: Bearer's unit disembarking from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn: still eligible to charge.

Raider-pattern Bike.brief: INFANTRY only. M 12", T 5, W 5; loses INFANTRY and TACTICUS, gains MOUNTED; +1 twin bolt rifle; can only be attached to OUTRIDER SQUAD.

Raider's Due.brief: Charge declared against a unit within range of an objective marker: re-roll the Charge roll.

Raiders and Reavers.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES ranged weapons have [Assault]; HERETIC ASTARTES attacks against a unit within range of an objective have AP improved by 1.

Raiders' Spoils.brief: Command phase, ANHRATHE unit within Engagement Range of an enemy: +1 OC to its models until the start of the next Command phase.

Rain of Cruelty.brief: Each time a DRUKHARI unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until end of turn: its ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover] and its melee weapons have [Lance].

Rain of Devastation.brief: Friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS units' attacks targeting a unit in a terrain area: +1 to Hit.

Rain of Ruin.brief: Friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS units' ranged attacks have [Heavy].

Raise the Banner.brief: End of your Movement phase, controlling an objective: it is secured.

Raking Pass.brief: Your Movement phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit selected to Fall Back: that move does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

Ram Jets.brief: Selected for a Normal or Advance move: until end of phase, +D3" M.

RAMPAGING MONSTROSITIES.brief: Fight, TYRANIDS MONSTER unit not yet fought: re-roll hit rolls until end of phase.

Rampaging Terrors.brief: DAEMON VEHICLE units: start of Fight, 1 engaged enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test at -1 (each enemy unit once per phase). Onslaught tag: not with another Onslaught detachment.

Rampart (Once per battle, per army).brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: this model has a 2+ Inv until the end of the phase.

Rampart crest.brief: While leading a unit: models in it have a 5+ Inv.

Rampart Crest.brief: While the bearer leads a unit: models in that unit have a 5+ Inv.

Ramshackle Cover.brief: Attack on a unit not fully visible to the attacker because of this unit: target has the benefit of cover.

RANGER TACTICS.brief: Your Shooting phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, re-roll Hit rolls against assailed units and/or if the unit is HERNKYN.

RAPACIOUS HUNGER.brief: your Fight, TYRANIDS unit that just destroyed an enemy unit: it Regenerates at once; a HARVESTER choosing to heal regains up to 3 wounds instead of D3.

Rapid Assault.brief: Melee attacks in a turn this unit made a Charge move: +1 S.

Rapid Deployment (Pain).brief: Your Movement phase, when this model Advances, spend 1 Pain token to Empower: units can disembark after the Advance (count as Normal move, cannot charge this turn).

Rapid Deployment#56231789c9.brief: Units can disembark after this TRANSPORT Advanced: they count as having made a Normal move and cannot declare a charge this turn.

Rapid Deployment#eb51225aa1.brief: Units can disembark after this TRANSPORT Advanced: they count as having made a Normal move and cannot charge this turn.

Rapid Deployment#f6ebb1f498.brief: Units can disembark after this TRANSPORT Advanced: they count as having made a Normal move and cannot charge this turn.

Rapid Disembarkation#307942c4ea.brief: Your Movement phase, when this unit ends an advance move: embarked units can make a shock disembark move.

Rapid Disembarkation#fecf68c340.brief: Your Movement phase, when this unit ends an advance move: embarked units can make a shock disembark move.

RAPID DISPERSAL.brief: Your Movement phase, ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this phase: it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Rapid Embarkation.brief: End of Fight phase, if empty: 1 friendly HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit of 6 or fewer models wholly within 6" and not in Engagement Range can embark, even if it disembarked this turn.
