RAPID FEINT.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, ACHILLES RIDGERUNNERS or ATALAN JACKALS unit within 8" of it: makes a Normal move of up to 6".

RAPID MANIFESTATION.brief: your Movement, EXALTED EIGHTBOUND unit arriving by Deep Strike: set up more than 6" from enemies instead of 9"; cannot charge this turn.

RAPID REACTIONS.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a Fall Back move, ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit engaged with it at start of phase: shoots normally, targeting only that enemy unit.

RAPID REAPPRAISAL.brief: end of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged RAVENWING unit: remove it from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

RAPID REGENERATION.brief: enemy Shooting or Fight, TYRANIDS unit just targeted: Feel No Pain 6+ until end of phase; 5+ if within Synapse Range.

Rapid Strike Vehicle.brief: While units are embarked, unless Battle-shocked: +1 OC per 3 embarked models (rounding down).

RAPID TACTICAL RELOCATION.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, INQUISITOR or DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit not in Engagement Range: removed from the battlefield; set up in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, more than 8" from enemy models.

Rapid Takeover.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED/VEHICLE models not Battle-shocked: +1 OC. End of your Command phase: an objective you control with an ATALAN JACKALS unit in range stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Raptorial Vigilance.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit within 9" of it and not engaged: Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if a PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit.

RAPTUROUS AGONY.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, enemy unit targets a LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE): attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound.

Rapturous Blows.brief: Unit selected to fight, discard 1 Miracle dice: until end of phase, each melee wound scored by this model inflicts 1 MW in addition to normal damage.

Ratling Battlemutt.brief: Once per battle, when selected to shoot: until end of phase, the unit's ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Raucous Occupants.brief: While within range of your home objective: add the OC of embarked models to this model's OC.

Ravenwing Bike.brief: INFANTRY only. M 12", T 5, W 5, Inv 5+; loses INFANTRY and TACTICUS, gains MOUNTED; +1 plasma talon or Astartes grenade launcher; attaches only to OUTRIDER SQUAD, RAVENWING BLACK KNIGHTS.

Ravenwing Hunter.brief: While leading: the unit can shoot and declare a charge in a turn it Advanced.

Reactive Command.brief: OFFICER only. Each time an enemy unit is set up within 8" of the bearer's unit: the bearer can issue 1 Order, not counted towards its Orders per battle round.

REACTIVE DISEMBARKATION.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TRANSPORT: 1 embarked EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit disembarks, set up wholly within 6" of the TRANSPORT, not within Engagement Range of enemies.

Reactive Reposition.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, NECRONS unit (not MONSTER/TITANIC) it targeted: Normal move of up to D6".

REACTIVE REPRISAL.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shot, while your army has Fortify Takeover, targeted LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit: shoots as if in your Shooting phase, at that enemy unit only.

REACTIVE SAFEGUARD.brief: Enemy Charge phase, after a charge is declared, 1 targeted ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY unit within range of your Acquisition objective and 1 ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TRANSPORT: the unit embarks (all models within 3", capacity sufficient).

REACTIVE SUBROUTINES.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, CANOPTEK unit within 8" of it: Normal move of up to 6".

Readied Brawlers.brief: Your Movement phase, friendly WAGON unit ends a Normal move: units embarked within it can make an assault disembark move.

REANIMATION CRYPTS.brief: Command phase, your NECRONS WARLORD: each NECRONS unit in Reserves activates its Reanimation Protocols.

Reanimation Nodes (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS INFANTRY units within 6" of this FORTIFICATION: [Feel No Pain 6+].

Reanimation Protocols.brief: Army Faction NECRONS, end of your Command phase: each friendly unit with this ability on the battlefield heals D3 wounds.

Reap a Terrible Tally.brief: Attacks vs an INFANTRY unit: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Reaping Tally.brief: Ranged attacks of this unit targeting a unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE): +1 AP.

Rearm, Reload, Fire.brief: While affected by an Order and Remained Stationary this turn: Heavy weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Reavers of the Void.brief: Each attack: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if the target is within range of an objective marker, re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Reavers' Flurry.brief: Your Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit that made a Charge move this turn: melee weapons +1 A.

REAVERS’ HASTE.brief: Your Charge phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit: can charge after Advancing; +1 to Charge roll if a target is within range of an objective marker.

Reavers' Reaction.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by those attacks: Normal move up to D6".

Rebind Rubricae (Psychic).brief: Your Command phase, if leading a unit, optional D6: 1 = that unit suffers D3 MW; 2-5 = return 1 destroyed Bodyguard model; 6 = return up to 2.

Reborn in Blood.brief: Start of battle round, Blessings of Khorne roll, if this model is destroyed: spend a triple 6 (no Blessings activated) = no longer destroyed, Deep Strikes in your next Reinforcements step with 8 wounds.

Reborn Mastermind.brief: Once per battle round, one model with this ability, when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

RECITATION OF THE REVERED.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit has selected targets, ANCIENT unit among them: until end of phase, attacks targeting it get -1 to Hit roll.

RECKLESS HASTE.brief: Your Charge phase, DAMNED unit: can declare a charge this turn after Advancing.

RECLAIM BIOMASS.brief: any phase, a TYRANIDS unit is destroyed: 1 HARVESTER unit within 6" of it Regenerates 1 friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" (see Feed the Swarm).

RECLAIM OUR HONOUR!.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, enemy unit destroys an ANCIENT model (not targeted by Refusal to Yield this phase), ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit visible to it: rest of battle, ADEPTUS ASTARTES attacks on that enemy unit get +1 to Hit roll.

Recon Drone.brief: Bearer is equipped with 1 drone burst cannon and its unit has Infiltrators.

Recon Hunter.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have [Scouts 9"].

Recon Star Upgrade.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY PLATOON only. Your first Movement phase: this unit can make an ingress move.

Recount the Deeds of the Saints.brief: While leading a unit with Agathae Dolan: each time that unit destroys an enemy unit, gain 1 Miracle dice; when Agathae Dolan is destroyed, gain D3 Miracle dice.

Recursive Reanimation Upgrade.brief: TOMB BLADES only: +1 to Reanimation Protocols rolls.

RED RAMPAGE.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to fight: its melee weapons have [Lance] or [Lethal Hits] until end of phase ; or give in to the Red Thirst: Battle-shocked but both abilities.

RED WRATH.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that just Advanced: can shoot or charge this turn ; or give in to the Red Thirst: Battle-shocked but can shoot and charge.

Redeemer of the Lost.brief: Fight phase, model destroyed before this unit has fought: roll D6, +1 if engaged with an enemy of T ≥ this unit's T; 4+ = model stays until this unit has fought or end of phase.

REDIRECTED STRIKE.brief: End of your Command phase, unengaged GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit: if it has Deep Strike, place it into Strategic Reserves.

REDOUBLED ASSAULT.brief: Your Movement phase, GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit that just Fell Back: it can still shoot and charge this turn.

Redoubtable Machine Spirit Upgrade.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE only (not DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER). This unit has 5+ Inv; end of your Command phase: heals 1 W.

Refrain of Enduring Faith.brief: PENITENT only. While the bearer is leading a unit: models in that unit have a 5+ Inv.

REFUSAL TO BE OUTDONE.brief: Your Charge phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declaring a charge: re-roll charge rolls; must end engaged with one of those enemy units.

REFUSAL TO YIELD.brief: Any phase, just after an ANCIENT model is destroyed, that model: at end of phase, set it back up as close as possible to where it died, unengaged, full wounds; once per battle per model.

Refuse to Yield.brief: Attacks allocated to this model: -1 D.

Regenerating Gene-mass.brief: First time destroyed: at end of phase, on 2+ set it back up as close as possible to where it died, outside Engagement Range, with full W.

Regenerating Monstrosities.brief: Start of each player's Command phase: one model in this unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.

Regenerating Monstrosity.brief: TYRANIDS only (not MONSTERS). Bearer's unit can be Regenerated up to twice per phase instead of once.

Regimental Banner.brief: VEHICLE OFFICER only. +3 OC to the bearer.

REGIMENTAL REINFORCEMENTS.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY REGIMENT unit just destroyed (not ARTILLERY/CHARACTER): D6, on 3+ an identical new unit at Starting Strength returns in Cult Ambush, marker over 8" from enemies; once per battle.

Regimental Standard.brief: +1 OC to models in the bearer's unit.

Reign of Confusion.brief: Once per turn, when your opponent targets one of their units within 12" with a Stratagem: that use costs +1CP.

Reinforced Cover#3dc5956e33.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a model not fully visible to every attacker because of this FORTIFICATION: that model has the Benefit of Cover.

REINFORCED HIVE NODE.brief: enemy Shooting or Fight, SYNAPSE unit just targeted: attacks against it have AP worsened by 1 until the attacker has finished.

REINFORCEMENTS!.brief: Any phase, INFANTRY REGIMENT unit just destroyed: add an identical new unit to your army in Strategic Reserves, at Starting Strength and full wounds; cannot return CHARACTERS to Attached units; once per battle.

Rejuvenating Swarm.brief: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY only (not TERMINATOR). Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound rolls.

Relentless Assault.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, TACTICUS unit selected to attack: its attacks have [Sustained Hits 1] vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE; or [Lethal Hits] vs MONSTER/VEHICLE.

RELENTLESS ASSAULT.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that just Fell Back: can shoot or charge this turn ; or give in to the Red Thirst: Battle-shocked but can shoot and charge.

Relentless Avalanche.brief: Heroic Intervention on this model's unit costs 1 CP less, even if another unit was already targeted by it this phase.

Relentless Carnage.brief: End of Fight phase: pick 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, roll 8D6: each 4+ = 1 MW.

Relentless Combatants.brief: Re-roll Charge rolls for this unit; can declare a charge in a turn it Fell Back.

RELENTLESS GRIND.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit not yet moved or charged: its Normal, Advance and Charge moves can go horizontally through terrain features until end of phase.

Relentless March (Aura).brief: Friendly NECRONS unit within 6" of this unit's Szarekh model: +2" M.

Relentless Onslaught.brief: NECRONS attacks against a unit within range of an objective marker +1 to Hit; ranged weapons of NECRONS VEHICLE and NECRONS MOUNTED models (not TITANIC) have [Assault].

RELENTLESS PURSUIT.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit within 8" and not in Engagement Range: Normal move of up to 6".

Relentless Rage.brief: friendly WORLD EATERS units: melee attacks +1 A.

Relentless Raiders.brief: Enemy unit ending a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move in range of an objective you control: D6, on 2+ D3 MW. ANHRATHE units: at end of a phase, an objective you control within their range stays yours until the enemy Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Relentless Rebirth.brief: Any phase, friendly INFANTRY or MOUNTED THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit suffering a mortal wound: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Relentless Terror.brief: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit Falls Back, that unit: can shoot and declare a charge this turn despite Falling Back.

RELENTLESS TERROR.brief: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit Falls Back, that unit: can declare a charge this turn despite Falling Back.

Reletavistic Tether.brief: TRANSCENDENT C'TAN only. Your turn, ingress or Advance move via Transdimensional Displacement: can end more than 6" from enemies (not 8"); if within 8" of an enemy, cannot charge this turn.

Relic of the Matriarch - Censer of the S.brief: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6": re-roll Battle-shock tests.

Relic of the Matriarch - Icon of the Val.brief: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6": [Feel No Pain 6+].

Relic of the Matriarch - Petals of the B.brief: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6": melee weapons get AP improved by 1.

Relic of the Matriarch - Simulacrum of t.brief: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6": ranged attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1.
Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6": up to 2 Acts of Faith per phase instead of 1.

Relic of the Matriarch - The Fiery Heart.brief: Friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 6": +2" M and +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

Relic Teleportarium.brief: your Movement phase, DEATHWING unit with Deep Strike making an ingress move: set up more than 6" from enemy units (instead of 8"); it cannot declare a charge this turn.

Relics of the Dark Age.brief: your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have +2 S.

Relics of the Matriarchs.brief: Start of battle round: pick up to 2 Relic of the Matriarch abilities; this model has them until the start of the next battle round.

Remorseless Barrage.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if an Indirect Fire attack hit an enemy unit: that unit takes a Battle-shock test (-1 for INFANTRY hit by a multiple rocket launcher).

Remorseless Persecution#5f8109c2bd.brief: Your Movement phase, when this unit advances: the advance move does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

Remorseless Persecution#8671515ff6.brief: While leading: the unit can declare a charge in a turn it Advanced.

Remote mine.brief: Once per battle, start of your Shooting phase: select an enemy unit within 9" and visible, roll D6; on 3+, D3 MW (2D3 MW if VEHICLE or FORTIFICATIONS).

Rend and Tear.brief: Melee attacks vs a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit: +1 D.

Renegade Claim.brief: Your Movement phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit within range of an objective marker you control: it stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Reorder Reality.brief: Enemy unit within 18" targets this model: -1 to Hit; until end of phase its ranged weapons have [Hazardous].

Repair Auto-simulacra.brief: End of your Command phase: regains up to D3 lost wounds.

Repair Barge.brief: Once per turn, after an enemy unit finishes attacking: 1 friendly NECRON WARRIORS unit within 3" that lost wounds activates Reanimation Protocols; same unit max once per turn.

REPELLING SPHERE.brief: start of opponent's Charge phase, GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit: enemy charges targeting it have -1 to the Charge roll, or -2 if your unit is wholly within your Hallowed Ground.

Replenishing Swarms.brief: your Movement, TYRANIDS unit wholly within 9" of a Tunnel Marker: 1 model regains up to D3+1 wounds, or up to D3+1 destroyed 1-wound models return.

Repolarised Augurs.brief: Start of opponent's Movement phase, unengaged RECON AUGURY unit: -3" detection range until end of turn.

Repulsed by Weakness.brief: Enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) Falls Back from Engagement Range of bearer's unit: Desperate Escape tests, -1 if bearer's unit is your Favoured Champions.

Repulsor Grid.brief: Targeted by enemy ranged attacks, until that unit has shot: each unmodified 6 to save = that enemy unit suffers 1 MW after it has shot.

Repulsor Suspensor Technology (Once per.brief: Once per phase, opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, if this unit lost a wound and is unengaged: Normal move of up to D6".

Resilient Organism.brief: once per battle, when an attack is allocated to this model: its D becomes 0.

Resistance Tunnels.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, one unengaged GENESTEALER CULTS or TYRANIDS unit: remove it from the battlefield and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Resource Transmutation.brief: Once per turn, your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: spend 1YP, ranged weapons gain [Sustained Hits 1]; if those attacks destroy an enemy unit, gain up to 2YP.

Responsive Displacement.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy engaged with an INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit ends a Fall Back move, that unit now unengaged: Normal move of up to D3+3".

Responsive Tactics.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of an unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit, that unit: Normal move of up to D6".

Restless Prey-seeker.brief: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for this unit.

Resurrection orb#7bc799b95b.brief: Once per battle per unit, end of any phase: 1 friendly NECRONS INFANTRY/NECRONS MOUNTED unit within 6" resurrects (Reanimation Protocols activate, heals D6 wounds instead of D3); max 1 per turn.

Resurrection orb#fe46e3fb47.brief: Once per battle per unit, end of any phase: this unit resurrects (Reanimation Protocols activate, heals D6 wounds instead of D3); max 1 unit resurrected per turn.

Retreat Below.brief: end of enemy Fight, 1 TYRANIDS unit or up to 2 BURROWER units, unengaged: removed into Strategic Reserves.

Retro-thrusters.brief: End of Fight phase, if eligible to fight this phase: Normal move of up to 6" or Fall Back move.

RETURN TO THE SHADOWS.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY unit: remove it and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Revel in Desecration.brief: Attacks targeting an enemy unit not Below Half-strength: +1 to Hit roll.

Revelation of Guilt.brief: your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to shoot: its plasma ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

Revenant Jet Pack.brief: Advancing: no Advance roll; +8" to Move until end of phase instead.

REVENGE OF THE RUBRICAE.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model dies, RUBRICAE unit within 6" of it: after the attacker shoots, your unit shoots as in your Shooting phase, only at the unit that killed the PSYKER.

Reverberant Rancidity.brief: PLAGUE LEGIONS unit within 7" of a DEATH GUARD unit: has Nurgle's Gift; DEATH GUARD unit within 7" of a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit: +3" Contagion Range.

Ride the Thermals.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if not in Engagement Range: Normal move up to 6"; or up to 12" if it ends wholly within 6" of friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE; then cannot charge this turn.

Ride the Wind.brief: ASURYANI MOUNTED and VYPER units can start in Reserves and arrive as from Strategic Reserves, counting the battle round as 1 higher; end of opponent's turn: unengaged such units can return to Strategic Reserves (Incursion 1, Strike Force 2, Onslaught 3); WINDRIDERS gain BATTLELINE.

Rider of the Immaterial Winds#25a73407a3.brief: Once per battle, end of opponent's turn, if this model's unit is not engaged: place it in Strategic Reserves.

Rider of the Immaterial Winds#515a501603.brief: Once per battle, end of opponent's turn, unit not in Engagement Range: remove it and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Righteous Awareness.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, Normal move up to D6".

RIGHTEOUS BLOWS.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Lethal Hits]; if they destroy 1+ enemy models this phase, one destroyed model's unit takes a Battle-shock test.

Righteous Denunciation.brief: Start of the Fight phase: each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Righteous Fervour.brief: Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army.

Righteous Fervour Upgrade.brief: CRUSADER SQUAD only. This unit can re-roll Advance rolls.

Righteous Fury (Once per battle, per arm.brief: Once per battle per army, Fight phase: melee attacks +1 S; after fighting this model heals D3 W, or 2D3 W if it destroyed an enemy model this phase.

Righteous Paragons.brief: Attacks targeting a MONSTER or VEHICLE: +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

Righteous Persecution.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this unit shot: 1 non-MONSTER, non-VEHICLE enemy unit it hit is pinned until your next turn: -2 M and -2 to Charge rolls.

Righteous Purpose.brief: Your Command phase: up to 3 ADEPTA SORORITAS units (embarked too) are Righteous until your next Command phase: +1" Move, +1 Ld, and +1 WS/BS for BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD, CELESTIAN INSIDIANTS, CELESTIAN SACRESANTS and PARAGON WARSUITS models. CELESTIAN SACRESANTS not Battle-shocked: +1 OC.

Righteous Rage.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. Each time the bearer is selected to fight: discard up to 3 Miracle dice; per dice discarded, until end of phase, bearer's melee weapons +1 A and +1 S.

Righteous Repugnance.brief: Unit selected to shoot or fight, discard 1 Miracle dice: until end of phase, +3 A to Fidelis and Lance of Illumination; each enemy unit destroyed by this model = 1 Miracle dice.

Righteous Smiting.brief: While leading a unit: melee attacks by that unit get +1 to Wound.

RIGHTEOUS VENGEANCE.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls; if Below Half-strength, re-roll Wound rolls as well.

Righteous Zeal.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots and destroys ≥1 model of this unit: surge move of up to D6+1".

Rise to the Challenge.brief: Once per battle, end of Fight phase, bearer in Engagement Range of 3+ enemy models: fights 1 additional time, choosing 1 Exquisite Swordsmanship ability for those attacks.

Risen Rubricae.brief: Start of Declare Battle Formations: 2 RUBRICAE BATTLELINE units or 1 other RUBRICAE unit gain Infiltrators.

Rite of Perfervid Wrath.brief: Fight phase, CHAPLAIN unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have +1 S.

Rites of Battle.brief: Once per battle round, when a unit with this ability is targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1CP less.

Rites of Castigation.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: pick 1 enemy unit hit; until end of turn, ranged attacks by friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS against it get AP improved by 1 (each enemy unit once per turn).

Rites of Coalescence.brief: While this unit contains 1+ PSYKER models, each attack targeting it: -1 to the Wound roll.

RITES OF EXORCISM.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit: 1 visible enemy DAEMON unit within 12" takes a Battle-shock test; if failed, until end of phase AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM attacks on it have [Devastating Wounds].

Rites of Feasting.brief: While leading: unit's models have Feel No Pain 6+; if the unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, Feel No Pain 5+ instead for the rest of the battle.

RITES OF FIRE.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, ranged attacks on enemy units within 6" and in range of an objective get +1 to Wound; if a model is destroyed, its unit takes a Battle-shock test.

Rites of Reanimation.brief: While leading: models in the unit have [Feel No Pain 5+].

Rites of Teleportation.brief: If one or more INQUISITOR units are attached in the Declare Battle Formations step: those units have Deep Strike.

Rites of Tempering.brief: Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to wound rolls.

Rites of Thermal Appeasement.brief: +1 to hazard rolls for this unit's Plasma Incinerators and Plasma Pistols.

Ritual Butchery#4a90a07321.brief: KINBAND CHAMPION only. While leading a unit: melee weapons of that unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

Ritual Butchery#53c62750a0.brief: While leading: melee weapons of the unit's models have [Sustained Hits 1].

RITUAL OF WARDING.brief: Start of any Command phase, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit in range of an objective you control: it stays yours even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn; while Warded, enemy DAEMON units cannot be set up within 6" of it.

Rituale Nullificatus.brief: Models in this unit: [Feel No Pain 4+] against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

Robotic Bodyguard.brief: While a CYBERNETICA DATASMITH is leading this unit: that model has Feel No Pain 4+.

Rod of Office.brief: Attacks by the bearer's unit: re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Rod of the War Forge.brief: Your Command phase: pick one Icon of War ability; this model has it until the start of your next Command phase.

Rokkit Barrage.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Rokkit Charge.brief: Selected to fight after a charge move this turn: optionally, melee attacks have +1 A and S and [Hazardous].

Rollbar searchlight.brief: Ranged attacks of the bearer's unit: ignore any or all Hit roll modifiers.

Rolling Fortress.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM model not fully visible to every attacker because of this BANEBLADE: that model has the Benefit of Cover.

Root of Honour.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked KROOT unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Root Out Heresy.brief: ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS and ORDO HERETICUS models: ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover]; attacks targeting a CHAOS unit of 5+ models have [Sustained Hits 1].

Root-carved Weapons.brief: KROOT WAR SHAPER only. All bearer's weapons have [Precision] and [Devastating Wounds].

ROT AND RENEWAL.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE unit: until end of phase, its models can move through terrain features.

ROTATE ION SHIELDS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, targeted IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit: its models have a 4+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Rugged Resilience.brief: Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to wound rolls.

Ruination's Bounty.brief: Your Shooting phase, HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit selected to shoot: when it uses Dark Pacts, its ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits] and [Sustained Hits 1].

RUINOUS RAID.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, not yet selected: until end of phase, re-roll Hit and Wound rolls against units within range of an objective.

RUN THEM THROUGH!.brief: Fight phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit not yet fought: its melee weapons have [Lance].

Rune of Mists.brief: SPIRITSEER; your Command phase: one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 12": until your next Command phase, Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks unless the attacker is within 18".

Rune-cursed Stronghold.brief: Any phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit suffers a MW, that unit: Feel No Pain 5+ against MW.

Runes of Battle (Psychic).brief: Weapons of this unit have [Ignores Cover].

RUNES OF DISDAIN.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit targeted: until end of phase, attacks allocated to it -1 D.

Runes of Fortune (Psychic).brief: Enemy charge targeting a unit with this ability: -2 to the Charge roll.

Runes of Warding.brief: ASURYANI PSYKER: bearer's unit has [Feel No Pain 4+] against MW, Psychic Attacks and Critical Wounds from [Devastating Wounds] attacks.

Runnin' wiv da Herd.brief: While attached to a MOUNTED unit: this model loses INFANTRY, gains MOBILE and MOUNTED, +4" M.

Rush to the Fray.brief: WORLD EATERS unit disembarking from a TRANSPORT: +1 to Charge rolls and melee [Lance] until end of turn.

Ruthless Discipline.brief: Each ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER can issue 1 more Order than its datasheet states; while an ASTRA MILITARUM unit is affected by an Order, its attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Ruthless Killers.brief: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, its attacks have +1 D.

Ruthless Reinvestment.brief: LEAGUES OF VOTANN units start the battle with Hostile Acquisition and only get Fortify Takeover through this rule ; end of your Command phase: spend 3YP to swap Hostile Acquisition for Fortify Takeover, or vice versa.

Sacred Banner.brief: Bearer's unit: re-roll Advance and Charge rolls.

Sacred Command.brief: Once per battle round, when this unit is targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

Sacred Healing.brief: While leading a unit, your Command phase: return up to 1 destroyed model (not CHARACTER); discard 1 Miracle dice first = up to D3+1 instead.

Sacred Rites.brief: Each ADEPTA SORORITAS unit can perform up to two Acts of Faith per phase instead of one.

Sacred Unguents.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER only. Start of your Shooting phase: 1 TRANSPORT within 3" (not AIRCRAFT/TITANIC) re-rolls Hit rolls until end of phase.

Sacrificial Blessing.brief: While leading, each time the unit is selected to shoot or fight: destroy 1 Bodyguard model; until end of phase, this model's Psychic weapons +D3 A and +D3 S.

Sacrificial Dagger.brief: Once per phase, selected to shoot or fight: this unit suffers 1 MW; until end of phase, Psychic Attacks of this model +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

Sadistic Display.brief: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit destroys an enemy unit, that unit: each enemy unit within 6" and visible (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) must take a Battle-shock test.

Sadistic Epicurean.brief: This model's unit destroys an enemy unit: gain 1 Pain token.

Sadistic Fulcrum.brief: DRUKHARI; each 1 Pain token spent to Empower the bearer's unit in the Shooting phase: one friendly DRUKHARI TRANSPORT within 6" re-rolls Hit rolls until end of phase.

Sadistic Raiders.brief: End of your Command phase, objective you control within range of this unit (or its Transport): stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Sadistic Raiders (Pain).brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when selected: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; while Empowered, re-roll Wound rolls of 1; target within range of an objective: re-roll Wound rolls.

Saintly Example.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. Bearer destroyed: gain D3 additional Miracle dice.

SAINTLY PAROXYSM.brief: Fight phase, enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER model, that destroyed model: roll one D6: on 2+ that enemy unit suffers D3 MW (2D3 MW if the CHARACTER was an ABOMINANT or PATRIARCH).

Sally Forth.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES SHIELD-CAPTAIN model only; start of your Charge phase: 1 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" that Advanced this turn is still eligible to declare a charge.

Salting the Wound.brief: Fight phase, CRONOS/TALOS unit selected to fight: its attacks against Battle-shocked units have [Devastating Wounds].

Salvationist Medikit.brief: Your Command phase, bearer on the battlefield: return up to D3 destroyed models (not CHARACTER) to the unit.

Sanctic Hood#5e311e2f25.brief: Models in this unit have Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks.

Sanctic Hood#d87c79de29.brief: While leading a unit: models in that unit have Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks.

Sanctic Reaper.brief: GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR only: bearer's melee weapons +3 A.

Sanctified Amulet.brief: ADEPTA SORORITAS only. Enemy units set up from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer.

Sanctified Blows.brief: Fight phase, CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have +1 A and +1 S.

Sanctified Flames.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock roll, -1 to it if PSYKER.

SANCTIFIED IMMOLATION.brief: Any phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS VEHICLE with Deadly Demise just destroyed: do not roll the D6, Deadly Demise mortal wounds are inflicted automatically.

SANCTIFIED KILL ZONE.brief: your Shooting or Fight phase, GREY KNIGHTS unit not yet selected to shoot/fight, wholly within your Hallowed Ground: its attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1, or re-roll the Wound roll if PURIFIER SQUAD.

Sanctified Ordnance.brief: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only. +6" Range to ranged weapons of the bearer's unit; re-roll Hazardous tests for that unit.

Sanctifying Ritual (Psychic).brief: End of your Command phase, if within range of an objective marker you control: it stays yours until your opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Sanctity of Purpose.brief: Attacks by this unit: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; if the target is within range of an objective marker, re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Sanctuary.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Bearer has a 5+ Inv.

Sanctuary (Psychic).brief: This unit has Stealth; melee attacks targeting this unit -1 to Hit.

Sanguinary Tear (Aura).brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Friendly DEATH COMPANY unit within 6" of the bearer: +1 S to its weapons.

Sanguinius' Fury.brief: friendly DEATH COMPANY units: at the start of each phase the Assault doctrine is active for them; the Devastator/Tactical doctrine can never be active for them. Army: BLOOD ANGELS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES from another Chapter.

Sanguinius' Grace.brief: Once per battle, end of Fight phase, bearer within Engagement Range of 3+ enemy models: the bearer can fight one additional time.

Santified Ordnance.brief: ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only. +6" Range to ranged weapons of the bearer's unit; re-roll Hazardous tests for that unit.

Saturation Fire.brief: Ranged attacks vs a unit within range of an objective marker: [Ignores Cover].

Saturation Rounds Upgrade.brief: SAGITAUR only: ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

SAVAGE ECHOES.brief: Opponent's Charge phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit just charged: its melee weapons have +1 S or +1 A until end of turn ; or give in to the Red Thirst: Battle-shocked but +1 S and +1 A.

Savage Exaltation.brief: Melee attack vs enemy unit below Starting Strength: +1 to Hit; if also Below Half-Strength: +1 to Wound.

Savage Frenzy.brief: Enemy unit engaged with this unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) falling back: must use the desperate escape mode; if it is battle-shocked, -1 to those hazard rolls.

SAVAGE ROAR.brief: Fight, TYRANIDS MONSTER unit just targeted: the attacker takes a Battle-shock test and has -1 to hit against it until end of phase; -1 to wound as well if the test failed.

Scanner Gheist.brief: end of enemy Fight, unengaged DEATHLEAPER/LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR unit: placed into Strategic Reserves.

Scanner Uplinks.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: one enemy unit hit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) is suppressed until your next turn (-1 to its Hit rolls).

Scare Gas Grenades.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY only. Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 enemy unit within 8" of bearer's unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) takes a Battle-shock test.

Scarper!.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of unengaged friendly GRETCHIN unit: Normal move of up to D6"; up to 6" instead if it is an attached unit.

Scattershield.brief: Bearer: 4+ Inv; attacks allocated to bearer: -1 D.

Scenting Fear.brief: Once per battle round, your Shooting phase: pick 1 visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly WAR DOG unit; it has +6" detection range. War Dogs tag: can't be taken with another War Dogs detachment.

Science Guild Support.brief: Within 3" of another friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit (without Lone Operative): Lone Operative.

Scintillating Legions.brief: SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units allowed without the THOUSAND SONS keyword: up to 500 pts (Incursion), 1000 pts (Strike Force), 1500 pts (Onslaught); none can be your WARLORD.

Scintillating Tempo.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit just selected to move, set up or declaring a charge: until end of turn, enemies cannot use Fire Overwatch against it.

Scorn the Witch.brief: any phase, WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (not EPIC HERO) suffering a mortal wound: Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

Scornful Analysis.brief: Start of Shooting phase, friendly HERNKYN unit: select 1 visible enemy unit within 12" of it; friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN attacks against that unit have [Ignores Cover].

SCOUR AND SEIZE.brief: Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, attacks against a unit within range of an objective have [Precision].

Scouring Warpflame.brief: Your Shooting phase, THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit not yet shot, wholly within your Flow of Magic: its ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover]; after shooting, 1 enemy unit hit cannot have the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

SCOUTING OUTRIDERS.brief: End of enemy turn, ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED or WALKER unit wholly within 10" of a battlefield edge and not engaged: remove it from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

SCRAMBLE FIELD.brief: Start of enemy Reinforcements step, ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit: until end of phase, enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of it.

SCRAMBLED COORDINATES.brief: Start of opponent's Reinforcements step, HERETIC ASTARTES unit: until end of phase, enemy Reserves can't be set up within 12" horizontally of it.

Scrambler Array.brief: Enemy Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

SCREAMING DESCENT.brief: Reinforcements step, from round 2, HERETIC ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit in Reserves: set up anywhere more than 6" from enemies, cannot charge this turn; then one enemy INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit within 9" and visible makes a battle-shock roll.

Screening Line.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Scriptural Prognosis.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a TECH-PRIEST unit within range of an objective, that unit: attacks targeting it have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Scryer of Fates (Psychic).brief: After both armies are deployed: redeploy up to 3 THOUSAND SONS units, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of the units already there.

Sculpting the Stage.brief: Your Movement phase, WYCH CULT unit selected to Advance or Fall Back: that move does not prevent it from starting an action.

Scuttling Horrors.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, Normal move up to 6".

Scuttling Walker#1d5340ab17.brief: Normal, Advance or Fall Back move: can move through models (unless TITANIC) and terrain; may pass within Engagement Range but not end there; Desperate Escape tests auto-passed.

Scuttling Walker#2c2eb6ed63.brief: Normal or Advance move: can move over friendly MONSTER and VEHICLE models and terrain 4" or less in height as if not there.

Scuttling Walker#8f6f1c76d6.brief: Normal, Advance or Fall Back move: can move through friendly MONSTER and VEHICLE models and terrain features 4" or less in height.

Seal of Shrouding.brief: PHOBOS only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Searing Bursts.brief: your Shooting phase, HELLBLASTER SQUAD unit that has shot: 1 enemy unit hit by its plasma ranged attacks is seared until the start of your next turn: -2" M.

Searing Conflagaration.brief: Phosphor torch attacks vs a unit in range of an objective: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; within 6" of friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS BATTLELINE: re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Searing Flames.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit by the Acheron flame cannon cannot have the Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

Searing Soulflame.brief: When a PURGATION SQUAD unit pins an enemy unit with Righteous Persecution: that enemy unit makes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

Seasoned Noble.brief: Ranged attacks vs the closest eligible target: AP improved by 1.

SECURE BIOMASS.brief: Fight, TYRANIDS unit not yet fought: melee weapons [Lethal Hits] until end of phase; a HARVESTER also scores Critical Hits on unmodified 5+ in melee.

SECURE POSITIONS.brief: End of any of your phases, LEAGUES OF VOTANN TRANSPORT unit: 1 embarked LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit disembarks anywhere wholly within 6" of it ; cannot charge this turn, otherwise acts normally.

Secutor of Olympus.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: 1 enemy VEHICLE within 12", roll a D6: on 2+ it suffers D3+1 MW.

Seductive Gambit.brief: End of a Charge move, optional: until end of turn, loses [Fights First]; instead re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls of 1.

Seed Mucolids.brief: once per turn, your Shooting phase, instead of shooting: add 1 MUCOLID SPORES unit (1 model) wholly within 18" of this model, more than 8" from enemies.

Seed Spore Mines.brief: once per turn, your Shooting phase, instead of shooting: add 1 SPORE MINES unit (1 model per model in this unit) wholly within 48" of this unit, more than 8" from enemies.

Seed the Garden of Nurgle.brief: End of your Movement phase, if this model is within one AREA TERRAIN feature: that feature counts as within your Shadow of Chaos until end of battle.

SEEDED BROODS.brief: your Movement, 1 TYRANIDS unit or up to 2 VANGUARD INVADER units in Reserves: for their arrival, the battle round counts as one higher.

Seeker of the Unfound.brief: First time set up on the battlefield, select 1 objective: while within range of it, this model has 10 OC, 5+ Ld and Feel No Pain 4+.

Seeker's Instincts.brief: +2" M; re-roll Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

Seekers of Divine Arcana.brief: While leading: +1 OC for models in the unit.

SEEPING VIRULENCE.brief: Fight phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE unit not yet fought: until end of phase, its attacks score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

SEER’S EYE.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, AELDARI PSYKER model and a friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 12" not yet selected to shoot/fight: pick an enemy unit visible to the PSYKER; the WRAITH CONSTRUCT's attacks on it ignore modifiers to AP and/or Damage.

Seersight Strike.brief: ASURYANI MOUNTED PSYKER: bearer's Psychic weapons have [Anti-Monster 2+] and [Anti-Vehicle 2+].

Seething Hatred.brief: Each time selected to shoot or fight: re-roll one Hit roll or one Wound roll.

Seize the Prize.brief: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) is selected to Advance, that unit: no Advance roll, +6" to Move instead until end of phase.

Seized Opportunity.brief: Once per phase, one model with this ability whose unit destroys an enemy unit: gain 1YP.

Self Repair.brief: Start of your Command phase: regains 1 lost wound.

Self-destruction.brief: Start of Fight phase, if in Engagement Range: destroy 1 model of this unit; 1 enemy unit in its Engagement Range, D6 (+1 if VEHICLE): 2-5 = D3 MW; 6+ = 3 MW.

Self-repair.brief: Start of your Command phase: regains 1 lost wound.

Self-repair Mechanisms.brief: Start of your Command phase: this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

SELFLESS BODYGUARD.brief: Opponent's Shooting or the Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets, targeted AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM Attached unit: until end of phase, each [Precision] attack allocated to a CHARACTER model, if Bodyguards remain: D6, on 2+ allocated to a Bodyguard of your choice instead.

SELFLESS DEMISE.brief: Fight phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted DAMNED unit: until the attacker finishes, each time a model is destroyed, roll a D6: on 6, 1 MW to the attacker after its attacks are resolved.

Selfless Protector.brief: Ranged attack allocated to a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model not fully visible to the attackers because of this model: it has the Benefit of Cover and a 4+ Inv.

SELFLESS SERVICE.brief: End of enemy Charge phase, 1 unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 6" of an enemy (VEHICLE only if CHARACTER/WALKER): declare a charge; charge roll above 6 becomes 6; targets = any enemy within 6" and in range.

Senior Officer.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Sensational Performance.brief: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit selected to fight after a Charge move this turn, optional, until end of phase: cannot target a unit it was engaged with at start of turn nor a unit already targeted by another unit this phase; melee weapons +1 S and AP improved by 1.

SENSORY EXCRUCIATION.brief: Your Command phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER on the battlefield: every unit (friend or foe) within your Shadow of Chaos takes a Battle-shock test, at -1 if Below Half-strength.

Sentinel Construct.brief: Fire Overwatch on this unit: hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

Sentinel Directive.brief: Fire Overwatch targeting this unit: hits on unmodified 5+.

Sentinel Protocols (Once per phase, per.brief: Once per phase. Can be targeted by Fire Overwatch regardless of other uses this phase: snap shots hit on unmodified 4+ and that use does not block uses on other units.

SENTINELS OF ETERNITY.brief: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit targeted: until end of phase, each model destroyed that has not fought: D6, on 4+ it stays, fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

Serpentine.brief: Normal, Advance or Fall Back move: can move over terrain features 4" or less in height.

Serpentine Tactics.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED only: bearer's unit can shoot in a turn it Fell Back.

Servant of the Whispering God#05ef479bad.brief: Army with The Visarch: no other EPIC HERO units except YNNARI; and vice versa.

Servant of the Whispering God#c1d7398840.brief: Army with Yvraine: no other EPIC HERO units except YNNARI; and vice versa.

Servants of the Whispering God.brief: YNNARI units allowed in the army despite lacking the ASURYANI keyword; ASURYANI units (not EPIC HEROES) gain YNNARI; must include Yvraine and/or The Yncarne, one of them as WARLORD.

Servile Pawns.brief: While within 3" of 1+ friendly THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY units: Lone Operative.

Servo-Designators.brief: Your Shooting phase, MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit that has shot: pick 1 enemy unit hit; friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS ranged attacks against it have [Ignores Cover].

Servo-Driven Charge.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Lance].

Servo-scribes.brief: Once per battle, when issuing an Order: the Lord Commissar can issue one additional Order.

Servo-sentry.brief: When set up by Deep Strike: the Tempestor Aquilon can shoot with its sentry weapon.

Servo-skull Uplink.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked SKITARII unit within 6" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Seven-fold Chant.brief: Your Command phase, if on the battlefield: roll 2D6; on 7+ gain 1 CP.

SHADE PATH.brief: Start of opponent's Charge phase, 1 SHADOW LEGION unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" has -1 to charge rolls when it declares a charge; if your unit has NURGLE, it must also make a battle-shock roll.

Shade Weavers.brief: Can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within 18".

Shadow Assignment.brief: Cannot be WARLORD; AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM army, Declare Battle Formations: may swap for another OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM model of equal or lower points; max 1 of each assassin.

Shadow Form.brief: Start of each battle round: select one Shadow Form ability; this model has it until end of the round.

Shadow in the Warp.brief: Army Faction TYRANIDS, once per battle, either player's Command phase, if a unit with this ability is on the battlefield: every enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, -1 if within 6" of a SYNAPSE unit.

Shadow Killer.brief: If not in an Attached unit and with no ranged weapons (except pistols): enemy units cannot use Fire Overwatch against this model.

Shadow Lord (Aura, Psychic).brief: Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA or SHADOW LEGION unit within 6": re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Shadow Masters.brief: When a PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot, 1 choice: those attacks do not prevent it from being hidden ; or normal move of up to D6", then cannot declare a charge until end of turn.

Shadow of Abomination.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK only. Once per battle, when selected to fight: this model's melee attacks have +1 D.

SHADOW OF ANARCH.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, unengaged GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit within 8": Normal move of up to 6", or, if it has Deep Strike, go into Strategic Reserves.

Shadow of Khorne (Aura).brief: Within 6" of this FORTIFICATION counts as within your Shadow of Chaos; friendly KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6" re-roll Battle-shock tests.

Shadow's Caress.brief: Enemy units cannot Fire Overwatch at this unit.

Shadowcowl Talisman.brief: CHAOS LORD WITH JUMP PACK only: 5+ Inv.

Shadowfall Masks Upgrade.brief: TROUPE only: the unit has Fights First.

Shadowfield.brief: While this model has an invulnerable save, the unit cannot re-roll save rolls; when it loses a wound (not from MW), no invulnerable save until end of battle.

Shadows' Reach.brief: Your Shooting phase, BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit that has shot: those attacks do not prevent it from being hidden.

SHAMBLING WALL.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets chosen, targeted DEATH GUARD unit + POXWALKERS unit within 3" visible to both: attacks allocated to the DEATH GUARD unit get no save; instead POXWALKERS equal to the attack's D are destroyed.

Sharp Eyes Upgrade.brief: RATLINGS only. When selected to shoot: enemy units have +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

Shattered Defences.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: pick 1 enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit hit; friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES ranged attacks targeting it have +1 AP.

Shattering Salvo.brief: Your Shooting phase, after an ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC unit has shot, that unit: pick 1 enemy unit it hit; until end of phase, that enemy cannot have Benefit of Cover.

SHEATHED IN BRASS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets are selected, 1 targeted LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE unit: until end of phase, its models have Sv 3+.

Shedskin Raiment.brief: SHADOWSEER; after both players deploy: redeploy up to three HARLEQUINS units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

Shepherd of the Blessed.brief: Can only be attached to ABERRANTS.

Shepherds of the Dead.brief: Enemy unit destroying an ASURYANI PSYKER model gets a Vengeful Dead token: WRAITH CONSTRUCT attacks on it get +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound; ASURYANI PSYKER aura 12": WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD, WRAITHLORD get Battle Focus; WRAITHBLADES and WRAITHGUARD gain BATTLELINE.

SHIELD NODES.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after targets chosen, targeted DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit within range of an objective marker: attacks against it get -1 to Wound until end of phase.

SHIELD OF AVERSION.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit just targeted by an enemy unit: until that unit finishes attacking, attacks targeting your unit have AP worsened by 1.

Shield of Denial.brief: Any phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit just allocated a MW: until end of phase, Feel No Pain 6+ vs MW; Feel No Pain 5+ instead if the unit is Righteous.

SHIELD OF FAITH.brief: Any phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit that just suffered a MW, or a friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS JUMP PACK unit within 3" of it: until end of phase, Feel No Pain 5+ vs MW; if JUMP PACK targeted, friendly ADEPTA SORORITAS units within 3" of it also get Feel No Pain 5+ vs MW.

SHIELD OF HONOUR.brief: Start of Fight phase, 1 ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit: an engaged enemy model that does not aim all its attacks at your unit has -1 to hit and -1 to wound.

Shield of Prophecy.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; once per battle, start of the battle round: models in the bearer's unit +2 T until end of round.

Shield of the Righteous.brief: Models in this unit have a 4+ Inv.

Shieldbreaker.brief: Once per battle, when selecting targets for the exitus rifle: until end of phase, its attacks get +1 to Wound and any successful Wound roll is a Critical Wound.

Shimmerstone.brief: AUTARCH or AUTARCH WAYLEAPER only: while leading an ASPECT WARRIORS unit, ranged attacks vs that unit have -1 to the Wound roll.

SHINING RESOLVE.brief: opponent's Shooting phase, GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit selected as a target: attacks targeting it with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound rolls until end of phase.

SHINING VEIL.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, targeted GREY KNIGHTS unit: it has Stealth until end of phase.

Shock and Awe.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: on declaring a charge, one target takes a Battle-shock test ; its melee attacks get +1 to Hit roll.

SHOCK AND HORROR.brief: Your Charge phase, DEATH GUARD unit ends a Charge move: each enemy unit within Engagement Range takes a Battle-shock test with -1.

Shock Charge.brief: Tank Shock Stratagem on this model for 0 CP, even if already used on another unit this phase.

Shock Disembark Move.brief: Special move type when a rule allows it: unit embarked in a TRANSPORT on the battlefield (not embarked this phase) is set up wholly within 3" of it; not eligible to charge until end of turn.

Shock Troops.brief: End of your Command phase, if within range of an objective you control: it stays yours even with no models in range, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a turn.

Shokk Attack Engine.brief: Your Command phase, if unengaged: can place this unit in Strategic Reserves.

Shokk-boosta.brief: Your Movement phase, when selected to advance: can change the advance roll to 6; can move through all models; at the end of the move, hazard roll for each model.

Shoot Sharp and Scarper.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if not in Engagement Range: Normal move as if your Movement phase; not eligible to charge this turn.

Shorten the Odds.brief: Your Movement phase, DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit that just Advanced: it can shoot and declare a charge this turn.

Shriekworm Familiar.brief: Once per battle round: Fire Overwatch on the bearer's unit for 0CP.

Shroud of Disease#67794ad4c4.brief: While leading a unit: that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacker is within 18".

Shroud of Disease#6957e51ef9.brief: While leading a unit: that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacker is within 18".

Shroud of Flies (Aura).brief: Friendly NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA units within 6" of this Fortification: Stealth.

Shroud of Heroes.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Once per battle, when this model is destroyed, end of phase: 2+ = set it back up unengaged, as close as possible, alone (starting strength 1), with 3 W (full W if it was Battle-shocked).

Shroud of Obfuscation.brief: Bearer has Stealth and Lone Operative.

Shroud of the Hidden Blade.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only: Stealth; Lone Operative.

SHROUD PROTOCOLS.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets chosen, 1 targeted SKITARII INFANTRY unit: until end of phase, only attackers within 18" can target it with ranged attacks.

Shrouding (psychic level 1).brief: When an enemy unit targets this unit, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6; on 1 battle-shocked; attacks targeting this unit -1 to hit until end of phase.

Shroudpsalm (Aura).brief: Friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit within 6": has Stealth.

Shroudwërke Talismans Upgrade.brief: YAEGIRS only: this unit has -3" detection range.

Shudderblink.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit selected to Advance: its ranged attacks have [Assault] until end of turn; that move does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

SICKENING IMPACT.brief: Your Charge phase, TERMINATOR unit ends a Charge move: 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range, 1 D6 per model of your unit in Engagement Range of it: each 2+ = 1 MW (max 6).

Sickening Stimulation.brief: While leading a unit, your Command phase: return 1 destroyed model (not CHARACTER) to that unit.

Sickening Vitality.brief: While leading a unit: +1" M and re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for that unit.

Siege Captain.brief: This model's attacks targeting a FORTIFICATION/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit: +2 S, AP and D.

Siege Crawler.brief: You can ignore any modifiers to this model's Move and to its Advance and Charge rolls.

Siege Shield.brief: Demolisher cannon can target enemy units within Engagement Range of this model (if no other friendly unit is engaged with them); no Hit penalty for shooting while within Engagement Range.

Siegebreaker Strike.brief: Your Shooting phase, up to 2 HERETIC ASTARTES units set up by Deep Strike this turn, not yet shot: their ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover] until end of phase.

SIEGECRAFT.brief: Start of opponent's Charge phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit: enemy charges targeting it get -2 to the Charge roll (not cumulative with other negative modifiers).

Sigil of Exigence.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; once per battle, opponent's Shooting phase, when the bearer's unit is targeted: remove it and set it up more than 8" from enemies; opponent may pick new targets.

Sigil of the Hunt.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; your Shooting phase: attacks by the bearer's unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

SIGNAL POX.brief: Your Command phase, LORD OF VIRULENCE model: 1 objective within 30" and visible; until your next turn, enemy units within range of it are Afflicted.

Signature Restoration.brief: Each friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN model repaired by bearer's Forgewrought Expertise: +1 wound regained.

Signum Array.brief: Your Shooting phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 18" cannot have the benefit of cover.

Silent Bodyguard.brief: While a CHARACTER is leading this unit: that CHARACTER has Feel No Pain 4+.

Silent Executioner.brief: Attacks against a unit below Starting Strength: re-roll Hit rolls; if Below Half-Strength, also re-roll Wound rolls.

Silent Sisterhood.brief: An ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER can be Warlord; PROSECUTOR SQUAD units are BATTLELINE; ANATHEMA PSYKANA units: Creeping Dread (Aura), in enemy Battle-shock step each enemy PSYKER or below-starting-strength unit within 12" makes a battle-shock roll at -1.

Simulacrum Imperialis#3a3e89761d.brief: +1 Ld for models in bearer's unit.

Simulacrum Imperialis#4c0a366745.brief: End of your Command phase, per objective you control with ≥1 unit with this ability in range: roll D6; on 4+, gain 1 Miracle dice showing that result.

Simulacrum Imperialis#7ddac25784.brief: +1 Ld for models in bearer's unit.

Simultaneous Contamination.brief: Your Shooting phase, DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starting an action: that action does not prevent it from being eligible to shoot.

Single-minded Strike.brief: Your Charge phase, FLAWLESS BLADES unit starting a charge move: can move through models (not MONSTER/VEHICLE).

Singular Expertise.brief: While not leading a unit: melee attacks re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

Singular Purpose.brief: start of battle round 1, 1 choice for the battle: 1 enemy unit, this model's attacks against it re-roll Hit and Wound rolls; or 1 objective marker, while within range of it [Feel No Pain 5+] and OC 15.

Singular Will.brief: Consolidation move of this unit: up to D3+3".

Singularity Matrix.brief: C'TAN SHARD OF THE DECEIVER only. Lord of Deceit (Aura): opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem: +1CP cost.

Sinuous Breach.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN DAEMON unit not yet moved or charged: until end of phase, Normal, Advance and Charge moves can pass horizontally through terrain features.

Site-To-Site Teleportation.brief: end of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit: place it in Strategic Reserves; if KILL TEAM, it has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.

Sixty-sixth Seal.brief: GREY KNIGHTS only; your Shooting phase: attacks by the bearer's unit AP improved by 1.

Skilled Crews.brief: Ranged attacks of AELDARI VEHICLE units have [Assault].

SKINSHIFT.brief: Your Command phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit: 1 model regains up to 3 wounds; if a TZEENTCH unit below Starting Strength, 1 destroyed model (not CHARACTER) returns with full wounds.

Skirling Magicks.brief: Your Shooting phase, LEGIONES DAEMONICA CHARACTER TZEENTCH unit (unless MONSTER) selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Skirmish Fighters.brief: KROOT models have a 6+ invulnerable save against melee attacks and 5+ against ranged attacks.

Skitarii Hunter Cohort.brief: SKITARII INFANTRY, SKITARII MOUNTED and IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII units have Stealth.

Skjald.brief: Each time a SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit from your army achieves a Boast, if the bearer is on the battlefield: gain 1 CP.

Skjald's Foretelling.brief: WOLF GUARD BATTLE LEADER only. This unit's melee attacks have [Lance].

Skulking Horrors.brief: opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Skullmaster’s Fury.brief: While leading, each time the unit ends a Charge move, until end of turn: its Juggernaut's bladed horns have [Devastating Wounds].

SKULLS BEGET BLOOD.brief: Your Shooting phase, 1 unengaged LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit that did not Fall Back this turn: 1 unengaged enemy unit visible within 8": roll 6 D6, each 4+ = 1 MW.

Skulls for Khorne.brief: Attacks against a CHARACTER unit: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls; each enemy CHARACTER unit this model destroys: gain 1 CP.

SKULLS FOR THE SKULL THRONE!.brief: Fight, WORLD EATERS unit just destroyed a CHARACTER or MONSTER: Blessings of Khorne roll, 1 extra Blessing active until end of battle round.

Skulls of the Fallen.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model has shot: one enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test.

Skyboard.brief: ARCHTORMENTOR only: M 14", T 4, W 5; gains FLY, MOUNTED and [Deep Strike]; can only be attached to HELLIONS.

Skyboard Evasion.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8": if not in Engagement Range, Normal move up to D6".

SKYBORNE ANNIHILATION.brief: Your Shooting phase, DRUKHARI unit that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1], or [Sustained Hits 2] for KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON.

Skyborne Loons.brief: Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units do not count towards the combined points of your strategic reserves; while a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is riled up, its ranged attacks have +1 to Hit rolls.

SKYBORNE SANCTUARY.brief: End of Fight phase, unengaged ASURYANI unit eligible to fight this phase and a friendly TRANSPORT it can embark within: if wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, the unit embarks.

Skyborne Surveillance.brief: your Shooting phase, RAVENWING FLY unit that has shot: visible enemy units within 6" of it have +3" detection range.

Skyhunter.brief: Ranged attacks against a unit that can Fly: +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound rolls.

Skyrunner's Heavy Aspect armour.brief: MOUNTED only: Sv 3+; can also be attached to Shining Spears.

Skyward Lunge.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, HARLEQUINS VEHICLE or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit not in Engagement Range: remove it and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Slashing Dive#81b9d7c788.brief: Your Movement phase, after a Normal move: 1 enemy unit moved over, D6 per model in this unit: each 4+ = 1 MW.

Slashing Dive#89c06937ef.brief: Your Movement phase, after a Normal move: select 1 enemy unit moved over, roll 1 D6 per model; each 4+ = 1 MW.

Slaughterthirst (Aura).brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE only. Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE units (not MONSTERS) within 6": weapons have [Lance].

Slaves to None.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES models lose Dark Pacts; their ranged weapons have [Assault]. Cults of the Dark Gods cannot be used when mustering.

Slayer of Champions.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: [Precision]; melee attacks targeting a CHARACTER unit: S and AP improved by 1.

Slayer of Tyrants.brief: Melee attacks vs a unit with higher T than this unit: +1 to Wound rolls.

Slayer’s Oath.brief: Start of the first battle round: pick up to 1 enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit as slayer's oath; this unit's attacks against it ignore modifiers to BS, WS and Hit rolls.

Slayers of Abominations.brief: Fight phase, SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit selected to fight: its melee attacks vs MONSTER/VEHICLE have +2 S.

SLAYERS OF NIGHTMARES.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit selected to fight: its melee attacks against a target with higher T than its own have +1 to wound.

Slunk from the Underbelly.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit wholly within a terrain area targeted by an enemy unit: ranged attacks targeting it have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

SMASH THROUGH.brief: your Movement, WORLD EATERS VEHICLE not yet moved: it can move horizontally through terrain features this phase.

SMEARED WITH FILTH.brief: Fight phase, POXWALKERS unit just destroyed: 1 enemy unit that attacked it this phase is Afflicted until end of battle.

Smoke Grenades.brief: INFANTRY OFFICER only. Bearer's unit wholly within 3" of friendly TRANSPORT models: Benefit of Cover and Stealth.

Smoky Gubbinz Upgrade.brief: SPEED FREEKS unit only (unless AIRCRAFT). Target not fully visible to the attacker because of a model in this unit: benefit of cover against that attack.

Snap To It.brief: Start of any phase, ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER unit: its OFFICER model can issue 1 Order as if it were your Command phase.

Snare of Fire.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move within 8" of an unengaged HAVOCS unit: that HAVOCS unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Snarling Protector.brief: Heroic Intervention on this unit: always allowed, -1 CP, does not block other uses; charge with a friendly engaged PSYKER within 12": re-roll Charge roll, must end engaged with an enemy engaging that PSYKER.

Snarling Rivalry Upgrade.brief: EXECUTIONER only: ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Sneaky Little Gitz.brief: Friendly GRETCHIN units have BATTLELINE; their Advance/Fall Back move does not prevent them from being eligible to start an action.

SOLAR PULSE.brief: Start of Shooting phase, CRYPTEK model: select 1 objective marker within 18" of it; until end of phase, friendly NECRONS weapons have [Ignores Cover] against units within range of that objective.

Solemn Procession.brief: Miracle dice gained at the start of your turn, if this model is on the battlefield: no roll, it is a 6.

Solid-image Projection Unit.brief: T'AU EMPIRE only. After both armies deployed: redeploy up to 3 T'AU EMPIRE units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

Sonic Destruction.brief: Your Shooting phase, Vibro Cannon attacks: +1 S, AP and D for each other friendly Vibro Cannon Platform that attacked the same enemy unit with its Vibro Cannon this phase.

Soporific Musk#363b5eb439.brief: Enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) Falls Back from Engagement Range of units with this ability: Desperate Escape tests, -1 if Battle-shocked.

Soporific Musk#dd314734d9.brief: Enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within Engagement Range of units with this ability Falls Back: Desperate Escape tests, -1 if Battle-shocked.

Sorcerous Invigoration.brief: Once per turn per unit, friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit (not MONSTER) successfully manifests a Ritual: heals D3 wounds.

Sorcerous Support.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shoots: 1 enemy unit hit, until end of phase Psychic attacks against it by models that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn: +1 to Hit and Wound rolls.

Sorrowscent Vulture.brief: CHAOS LORD JUMP PACK only. Bearer's unit has Scouts 6".

Sorrowsyphon.brief: While leading a POXWALKERS unit: +1 D on bearer's Plague Wind; each time the bearer attacks with it, after the unit's attacks, D3 Bodyguard models are destroyed.

SOUL BRIDGE.brief: Your Command phase, WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit and an ASURYANI PSYKER model: until your next Command phase, the unit counts as within 12" of that PSYKER for Psychic Guidance and Spirit Guides.

Soul Eater.brief: End of Fight phase, if this model's attacks destroyed an enemy unit this phase: +1 A on its weapons for the rest of the battle.

Soul Forge Boons.brief: HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE units gain DAEMON; HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE, LORD DISCORDANT and VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE units gain SOUL FORGE; SOUL FORGE units have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Soul Glutton.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER only. End of Fight phase, if bearer's attacks destroyed ≥1 enemy model this phase: regains up to D3 W.

Soul Harvester.brief: While bearer is on the battlefield, each enemy unit destroyed within 12" of it: roll 1 D6, on 5+ gain 1CP.

Soul Link.brief: Start of your Command phase: pick 1 other HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER (not EPIC HERO); until next Command phase bearer gains PSYKER and its datasheet abilities are replaced by that CHARACTER's.

Soul Sight (psychic level 1).brief: Your Shooting phase, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6; on 1 battle-shocked; pick 1 visible enemy unit: ranged attacks targeting it have [Ignores Cover].

Soul Trap.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: +1 A and +1 S; first time a melee attack destroys an enemy model, after resolving: +1 A and +1 S more for the rest of the battle.

Soul-darkened Fury.brief: opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit falling back from an engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit: it must use Desperate Escape, with -1 to those Hazard rolls if battle-shocked.

Soul-Hungry Slaughterers Upgrade.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit only: Heroic Intervention or Fire Overwatch targeting this unit costs -1 CP.

Soul-locked.brief: Your Movement phase, PURGATION SQUAD unit selected to Fall Back: that move does not stop it from shooting.

Soul-Shattering Charge Upgrade.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED only. Selected to fight after charging this turn: models within 3" of enemy units engaged with this unit can fight them.

Soul-Tally Offering.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, SOUL FORGE unit not yet shot or fought: its attacks against CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE units can re-roll the Wound roll until end of phase.

Soulguilt scanner.brief: Ranged weapons of bearer's unit have [Ignores Cover].

Soulless Horror.brief: Once per battle, start of any Command phase: each enemy unit within 9" takes a Battle-shock test at -1 (-2 if PSYKER).

Soulless Reaper.brief: DESTROYER CULT only. Enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer's unit selected to Fall Back: on 3+, it cannot Fall Back and must Remain Stationary.

Soulrot Flux.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit engaged with a CONTAGION ENGINE unit selected to Fall Back: roll 1 D6: 1 = 1 MW; 2-5 = D3 MW; 6 = 3 MW to that enemy unit.

Soulseeing#b8a5c2ec1d.brief: Start of your Shooting phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA BATTLELINE unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" has +6" detection range.

Soulsight.brief: Your Shooting phase, AELDARI VEHICLE unit selected to shoot: re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.

SOULSIGHT.brief: Your Shooting phase, YNNARI unit not yet selected to shoot: its ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits] and [Ignores Cover] until end of phase.

Soulstain Made Manifest.brief: Start of Fight phase: 1 enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Soulstealer.brief: SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONICA only. Bearer destroys an enemy model in melee: D6 (+1 within your Shadow of Chaos), on 4+ regains 1 W.

Spawn Termagants.brief: your Command phase: 1 friendly TERMAGANTS unit within 6" returns up to D3+3 destroyed models; max once per phase per unit.

Spear of Chogoris.brief: Ranged attacks have [Assault]; advancing does not prevent declaring a charge; if the assault doctrine is active: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls.

Spear Thrust and Sabre Swing.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase its melee weapons have [Lance] or [Lethal Hits] ; if MOUNTED, both.

Spearhead Striker.brief: Bearer disembarks from a TRANSPORT: until end of turn, re-roll Charge rolls for bearer's unit; enemy cannot Fire Overwatch at it.

Spearpoint Paragon.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: S and AP improved by 1; each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until end of turn: improved by 2 instead.

Spearpoint War Leader.brief: TACTICUS only. This unit has Scouts 6".

Spec Ops Veteran.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY OFFICER only. Extra Order available, Move to the Shadows: unit has Stealth against ranged attacks.

Special-issue Optics and Ammunition.brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover]; or 1 enemy unit within 24" has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

Specimens for the Spider.brief: Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit not yet fought: melee attacks against CHARACTER units re-roll Wound rolls; if an enemy CHARACTER model is destroyed, one enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test (every enemy unit within 6" if the enemy WARLORD died).

Spectrus Doctrines.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged: can be placed in Strategic Reserves.

Speed of the Kill.brief: WYCHES disembarking (not Emergency Disembarkation): set up wholly within 6" of this model.

Speed of the Primarch.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Once per battle, start of Fight phase: until end of phase, models in bearer's unit have Fights First.

Speediest Freeks.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit targets friendly SPEED FREEKS unit: ranged attacks targeting it fail on an unmodified Hit roll of 1-3.

Speednob Support.brief: While each model is within 3" of a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit (unless WARTRAKK): this unit has Lone Operative.

SPIRALLING EVASION.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets chosen, targeted ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit: 4+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Spirit Leech (Aura, Psychic).brief: enemy units within 6", if this unit contains a Neurothrope: each failed Battle-shock test = D3 MW and 1 model in this unit regains up to D3 W.

Spirit Mark (Psychic).brief: Once per turn, your Movement phase, start or end of a move: 1 friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT within 6" (not TITANIC) and 1 visible enemy unit; [Sustained Hits 1] against it until your next Movement phase.

SPIRIT OF THE MARTYR.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTA SORORITAS unit just targeted by an enemy unit: until end of phase, destroyed models that have not fought stay in play, fight after the attacker finishes, then are removed.

Spirit Snare.brief: Friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER with Cabal of Sorcerers destroyed within 9" of models with this ability: select 1 of them; rest of battle, +1 to its Psychic test results for Rituals (max +2).

Spirit Stone of Raelyth.brief: AELDARI PSYKER only: within 3" of a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE, bearer has Lone Operative; your Movement phase, start or end of its move: one friendly AELDARI VEHICLE within 3" heals D3 W.

Spirit Thief.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: 1 visible enemy VEHICLE; until end of phase, friendly HERETIC ASTARTES attacks on it re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

SPIRIT TOKEN.brief: Start of your Movement phase, WRAITHBLADES or WRAITHGUARD unit: an objective you control in its range stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Spirits of Iron.brief: Any phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffering a mortal wound: [Feel No Pain 5+] against mortal wounds.

Spiritsear.brief: Your Shooting phase, PURGATION SQUAD unit has shot: 1 Battle-shocked enemy unit hit by those attacks suffers D3+1 MW.

Spiritseer.brief: Within 3" of a friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit: Lone Operative.

Spiritsliver.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: +1 S and +1 A.

Spiritual Leader (Once per battle round,.brief: Once per round. Start of any phase: 1 friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6" of this model is no longer battle-shocked.

Spiritual Leader#bc5de74756.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Spiritual Leader#d16676012f.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Spiritual Leader#d66e55728f.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Spiritus Machina.brief: GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY only; your Shooting phase, if the bearer's unit disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn: can re-roll Wound rolls until end of phase.

SPITEFUL DEMISE#4ed7801679.brief: Any phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit is destroyed, that unit: its Deadly Demise inflicts MW on a 4+ instead of a 6.

SPITEFUL DEMISE#c75b05a06c.brief: Any phase, SHADOW LEGION unit just destroyed, before removing the last model and before Deadly Demise: roll 1 D6 per enemy unit in Engagement Range of it (+2 if SLAANESH): 4-5 = D3 MW, 6+ = 3 MW.

Spiteful Power Trip.brief: Attacks targeting a unit with no model of T7 or more: +1 to Hit rolls.

Spiteful Raider.brief: DRUKHARI; bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase that was within range of an objective when the bearer's unit was selected to fight: +1 Pain token.

Splinter Racks (Pain).brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; while Empowered with units embarked, ranged attacks with [Anti-] re-roll Hit rolls.

Split#b9b6001576.brief: BLUE HORROR destroyed, unit not destroyed: after the attacks, roll 1 D6; 4+ = add 1 BRIMSTONE HORROR.

Split#c5300ada0c.brief: PINK or BLUE HORROR destroyed, unit not destroyed: after the attacks, roll 1 D6; 4+ = PINK adds 2 BLUE HORRORS, BLUE adds 1 BRIMSTONE HORROR.

Split#e4ca6db071.brief: PINK HORROR or BLUE HORROR destroyed, after the attacker finishes, if unit survives: roll D6, on 4+ a PINK HORROR adds two BLUE HORRORS; a BLUE HORROR adds one BRIMSTONE HORROR.

Spoor of the Unholy.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to attack: ignores modifiers to its BS and WS; and to its Hit rolls.

SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover] and its attacks ignore modifiers to BS/WS and Hit rolls.

Spore Mine Cysts.brief: end of opponent's Fight phase, 1 choice: 1 visible enemy unit (not LONE OPERATIVE) within 24", 6 D6, each 3+ = 1 MW; or add 1 SPORE MINES unit (D3 models) within 6", more than 8" from enemies (1 model/turn).

Spore-laced Shock Waves.brief: Your Shooting phase, target of its Plagueburst mortar: roll D6 for it and each enemy unit within 3" of it (+1 if Afflicted); on 6+, that unit suffers D3 MW after the attacks.

Spreading Madness.brief: Charge phase, NECRONS unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) that has not declared a charge: until end of phase, when it charges, if a target is within Engagement Range of a friendly unit, +2 to the Charge roll.

Spy Network.brief: Each time your opponent gains a CP from an ability: on a 2+, you also gain 1CP.

Spy-skull Data Link.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit's ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover].
