Squadron Command.brief: OFFICER units can also issue Orders to SQUADRON units. New Order On My Signal (ARMOURED SKIRMISHER only): each time an enemy unit ends a Normal or Advance move within 9" of this unit, it can make a Normal move of up to D6"; once per unit per turn.

Squig Barrage.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by Squig Launchas is covered in Squigs until the start of your next turn: its attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

SQUIRES OFTHE HUNT.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, ARMIGER or IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model plus friendly ARMIGER models affected by its Bondsman ability: each of your ARMIGER models within 9" of a battlefield edge and not in Engagement Range goes into Strategic Reserves.

Stabilisation Talons.brief: Ranged attacks: ignore any modifiers to the Hit roll and to BS.

STAGED DEATH.brief: Any phase, HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model just destroyed: at end of phase, set it back up as close as possible to where it died, out of Engagement Range, with half its starting wounds; once per battle per model.

Stalker#238c5bc937.brief: Attacks vs an enemy unit with no other enemy unit within 6" of it: +1 to Wound.

Stalker#7c0ec4762a.brief: VANGUARD INVADER only. Start of battle: pick 1 enemy unit; bearer's attacks against it +1 to Hit and Wound rolls.

Stalking Focus.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit within range of an objective, that unit: ranged attacks against it -1 AP until that enemy has attacked.

Stalking Forward.brief: Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves: can move over models (not TITANIC) and terrain 4" or less in height as if not there.

Stalwart Champion.brief: While the bearer's unit is not Battle-shocked: models in it have +1 OC.

STALWART PROTECTOR.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after targets are chosen, ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit: until end of phase, your INFANTRY models not fully visible to every attacker because of that VEHICLE have Benefit of Cover.

Stalwart's Honours.brief: OFFICER only. While leading a unit, each Order issued to that unit: also affected by the Take Cover! Order.

Stanchion of Holy Martyrs.brief: While leading a unit: models in that unit have Sv 2+ and 4+ Inv.

Stand to the End.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, targeted ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE): attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound; or, if entrenched, all attacks against it have -1 to Wound.

Stand Unyielding.brief: End of your Movement phase, GRAVIS unit: 1 objective it controls is secured.

Stand Vigil.brief: If this unit or the target is within range of an objective: attacks have [Lethal Hits] vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE.

Standard of the Emperor Ascendant.brief: ANCIENT only. +1 OC and Ld; Feel No Pain 5+; Ancient Exhortation (once per battle, per army): when selected to fight, melee attacks have +1 A until end of phase.

Star Engines#a2f9a333ac.brief: Trigger: eligible VEHICLE unit selected to Advance: until end of turn, its ranged weapons have [Assault].

Starfall Shells.brief: GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED only: your Shooting phase, after bearer shot, 1 enemy unit hit by its cult sniper rifle: -1 to its Hit rolls until start of your next Shooting phase.

Starflare Ignition System.brief: T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT only. End of opponent's turn, if bearer's unit is not in Engagement Range of enemy units: remove it from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

Starscythe.brief: Ranged attacks (except against MONSTERS and VEHICLES): AP improved by 1.

Stasis Bomb.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 24" (not AIRCRAFT/Lone Operative) is slowed; when it moves (not stationary): D6, 1-4 = D3 MW and -2" M; 5-6 = 2D3 MW and -3" M.

Stave Abominus.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: [Sustained Hits D3] and [Devastating Wounds].

Stave of Kurnous.brief: SPIRITSEER; your Command phase: one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 12" (not TITANIC): until your next Command phase, its attacks have [Precision] on a Critical Wound.

STEADFAST DETERMINATION.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted HERETIC ASTARTES unit (except DAMNED): [Feel No Pain 5+] until end of phase.

STEADFAST SUPERIORITY.brief: Fight phase, engaged IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit on your defensive line, not yet fought: re-roll Hit rolls.

Stealth Drones.brief: Twice per battle, after an attack is allocated to this model: change its Damage to 0.

Stealth-Screened Cybercanids Upgrade.brief: SERBERYS RAIDERS only. Unit has [Lone Operative 15"].

STEEL HEART.brief: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD Falls Back, that unit: until end of turn, eligible to shoot and charge after Falling Back.

Steeped in Suffering.brief: Attacks by the bearer's unit vs an enemy unit below Starting Strength: +1 to Hit; if target also Below Half-Strength: +1 to Wound as well.

STIMM INJECTORS.brief: Enemy Shooting phase or Fight phase, after targets chosen, T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT unit targeted: Feel No Pain 6+ this phase.

Stimm-needler.brief: Once per turn, first failed saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit: that attack's Damage becomes 0.

STIMULATED BIO-SURGE.brief: Your Charge phase, ABERRANTS, BIOPHAGUS or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit not yet charged: +2 to Charge rolls.

Stimulated by Pain.brief: Attack allocated to this model: -1 D.

STINKING MIRE.brief: Start of opponent's Charge phase, unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" has -1 to charge rolls when it declares a charge.

Stirred to Action.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, after an enemy that targeted an unengaged BULLGRYN SQUAD or OGRYN SQUAD has shot, that unit: it can make a surge move of up to D6".

Stirring Rhetoric.brief: While leading a unit: each Act of Faith by that unit, 1 of the Miracle dice used is first changed to a 6.

Stitchflesh Abominations.brief: Each attack targeting a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit with S greater than the unit's T: -1 to the Wound roll.

Stomping Juggernaut.brief: Your Movement/Charge phase, friendly ORKS WALKER unit selected to move or declaring a charge: it has MOBILE.

Stone of Eldritch Fury.brief: ASURYANI PSYKER: +12" Range on the bearer's ranged Psychic weapons.

Storm and Secure.brief: End of your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit with an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked: 1 objective it controls is secured.

Storm Caller (psychic level 1).brief: When an enemy unit targets this unit, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll of 1 D6; on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; this unit has -3" detection range until the end of the phase.

Storm of Blades#53c62750a0.brief: While leading: melee weapons of the unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

Storm of Blades#d9207bf146.brief: While leading a unit: its melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Storm of Blades#f04d9cd321.brief: Leading a unit: melee weapons in that unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

Storm of Bolts#500bef503f.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 unit hit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) is suppressed until your next turn while this model is on the battlefield (-1 to its Hit rolls).

Storm of Bolts#ab8fe18acb.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shot: 1 unit hit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) is suppressed until start of your next turn while this model is on the battlefield (-1 to Hit).

STORM OF DARKNESS.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit targeted: Stealth; melee attacks against it -1 to hit.

Storm of Devastation.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Storm of Fire.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover]; or, if the devastator doctrine is active for it, [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.

Storm of Mutating Sorcery (Psychic).brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model has shot: one enemy INFANTRY unit hit takes a Battle-shock test.

Storm of Retribution.brief: Ranged attacks: re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1; against an enemy unit that destroyed ≥1 ADEPTA SORORITAS unit this battle, also +1 to Hit and +1 to Wound.

Storm of Silence.brief: Attacks against a CHARACTER unit: re-roll Wound rolls.

Storm of Vengeance (Once per turn, per u.brief: Once per turn, opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit destroys a friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 6": this unit shoots, targeting only that enemy unit.

Storm of Whispers.brief: WARLOCK only: your Shooting phase, after the bearer shot, one enemy unit hit must take a Battle-shock test.

Storm Shield#8eb3b6f1db.brief: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

Storm Troopers.brief: Each attack: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; if the target is within range of an objective, re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Storm-Swift Onslaught.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units can declare a charge in a turn they Advanced or Fell Back. Wrath of the First Khan: end of the Fight phase, an unengaged SUBODEN KHAN unit that destroyed an enemy unit this phase makes a Normal move of up to 6".

Stormblades.brief: End of your Command phase, within range of an objective you control: it stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Stormseers' Wisdom.brief: While leading a unit: re-roll Advance rolls for that unit.

Strafing Run#7e2c6142b7.brief: Ranged attacks vs units that cannot FLY: +1 to Hit.

Strafing Run#8453a1a369.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit hit that cannot FLY must take a Battle-shock test.

Strafing Run#8ff83e0a89.brief: Ranged attacks by this model against a unit that cannot FLY: +1 to Hit.

Strafing Run#e4a8fd5057.brief: Your Shooting phase, ranged attacks targeting a non-FLY unit: +1 to Hit rolls.

Strands of Fate.brief: Start of round 1: roll Fate dice (Incursion 3, Strike Force 6, Onslaught 9), kept as a pool; using a detachment Stratagem, discard a Fate die showing its value (Presentiment of Dread 1, Forewarned 2, Unshrouded Truth 3, Fate Inescapable 4, Isha's Fury 5, Psychic Shield 6): -1 CP on that use.

Strands of Time.brief: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit Falls Back: until end of turn, it can shoot or charge; if wholly within the Flow of Magic, it can shoot and charge.

Strategic Acumen.brief: Your Command phase: pick 1 combat doctrine active for this unit until your next Command phase.

Strategic Conqueror.brief: T'AU EMPIRE only. Start of battle round 1, before first turn: pick 1 objective marker; while bearer is on the battlefield, friendly T'AU EMPIRE models in range of it have +1 OC.

Strategic Knowledge#32ff965210.brief: While leading a unit: that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Strategic Knowledge#912e79c72e.brief: Ranged attacks have [Assault]; this unit can still declare a charge after advancing; can still shoot and declare a charge after falling back.

Strategic Mastery.brief: Once per battle round, one unit with this ability, when targeted with a stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

Strategic Savant.brief: AUTARCH or AUTARCH WAYLEAPER only: while leading an ASPECT WARRIORS unit, its models have +1 OC.

Strategic Slaughter.brief: After both deploy: redeploy up to 3 JAKHALS and/or GOREMONGERS units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of the Reserves limit.

Strategium Command.brief: After both armies deployed: redeploy up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of the limit.

Strength From Death.brief: Intent: end of opponent's Shooting phase, if a YNNARI unit died, a YNNARI INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit within 6" of it: Normal move of D6+1"; Surge: once per turn, Fade Back can be a surge move of D6+1"; Reprisal: start of Fight phase, a YNNARI unit (not TITANIC) below Starting Strength: Fights First.

Strength from Exile.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: until end of phase, if no other friendly units within 9" of it, re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

STRENGTH IN UNITY.brief: Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected as a target: if the enemy unit is engaged with a RAVENWING unit, its attacks have -1 to Hit; if engaged with a DEATHWING unit, -1 to Wound when S > T. Not with Armour of Contempt in the same phase.

Striding Colossus#182597b02c.brief: Stratagems targeting this model cost four times their stated CP.

Striding Colossus#c4e0e41d12.brief: Stratagems targeting this model cost three times their stated CP.

Striding Colossus#f7bf48868d.brief: Stratagems targeting this model cost twice their stated CP.

Strike from the Shadows.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, hidden PHOBOS unit selected to attack: its attacks have +1 S and [Lethal Hits].

Strike from the Skies.brief: Your Shooting phase, if this unit made an ingress move this turn: ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls.

Strike Now for Glory.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to attack: its ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Strike Swiftly.brief: Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step: up to 2 friendly T'AU EMPIRE units within 6" without Scouts gain Scouts 6" for the battle.

Strikes of Retribution.brief: Fight phase, when this model is destroyed before its unit fought: roll D6, 2+ = model stays until its unit has fought or end of phase.

Striking Stride.brief: Your Charge phase, HARLEQUINS unit: it can declare a charge this turn even though it Advanced.

Structural Analyser.brief: While leading: ranged attacks by the unit get +1 to the Wound roll.

Structural Collapse.brief: D-Cannon attacks: re-roll Damage rolls of 1; against TITANIC, re-roll the Damage roll.

Stubborn Tenacity.brief: While leading a unit below its Starting Strength: +1 to Hit rolls of that unit; also +1 to Wound rolls if it is Battle-shocked too.

Student of Kauyon.brief: KROOT SHAPER only. Declare Battle Formations: up to 3 KROOT CARNIVORES/KROOT FARSTALKERS units gain Deep Strike.

Student of the Codex.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. Start of your Command phase, bearer on the battlefield: until your next Command phase, Tactical Doctrine active for this unit (instead of any other, even if none is active for the army).

STUN GRENADES.brief: Start of any phase (not Command), unengaged ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES unit: 1 visible enemy unit within 8" (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) takes a Battle-shock test and, until end of phase, its attacks get -1 to Hit.

Stunning Fusillade.brief: Your Shooting phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged attacks vs enemy units more than 12" away have BS and AP improved by 1; if any enemy model is destroyed, one such model's unit takes a Battle-shock test.

Styrix’s Duty (Bondsman).brief: Affected model, after resolving its shooting or fight attacks: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

Sublime Prescience.brief: Once per turn, your Movement phase: 1 friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TRANSPORT in Strategic Reserves; until end of phase, treat battle round as 1 higher to set it up.

SUBOPTIMAL FACADE.brief: Opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge, CANOPTEK unit targeted by it and wholly within your Power Matrix: its Reanimation Protocols activate.

Subsurface Quantumweave.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, enemy unit targets friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY unit: attacks targeting it have -1 AP until that enemy unit has finished its attacks.

Subterranean Explosives.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: one enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by a mole grenade launcher cannot be targeted by Fire Overwatch until your next Shooting phase.

Subterranean Hunter.brief: End of the Fight phase, if not within Engagement Range: remove from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

Subterranean Tunnels.brief: Your Movement phase, set up via Deep Strike: can be set up anywhere more than 6" from enemy units; then cannot declare a charge this turn.

Sudden Onslaught.brief: Your Movement phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit selected to advance: its Advance rolls can be changed to 6.

Sudden Strike.brief: Trigger: eligible unit ends a Charge move: until end of turn, its Pile-in and Consolidation moves are up to 6" instead of 3".

SUFFER NO RIVAL.brief: Fight phase, LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Precision].

Suffer Not the Unfaithful.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, Righteous ADEPTA SORORITAS unit not yet selected to shoot or fight: choose [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1]; until end of phase its weapons have it.

SUFFERING AND SACRIFICE.brief: Start of Fight phase, one ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY or WALKER unit: until end of phase, each enemy model within Engagement Range of it must target it with its attacks.

Sullen Malevolence (Aura)#55ee103e7d.brief: While this unit contains 1+ BLUE HORRORS, enemy units within 6": Ld worsened by 1.

Sullen Malevolence (Aura)#849cd768f3.brief: While this unit contains a BLUE HORROR, enemy units within 6": -1 Ld.

SULPHUROUS VEIL.brief: Enemy Shooting or Fight phase, targeted THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit: until end of phase, attacks targeting it have -1 to Hit.

Summary Execution.brief: Once per round, start of any phase: select a Battle-shocked friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY unit within 12"; destroy 1 model in it, it is no longer Battle-shocked.

Summon the Cult.brief: Once per battle, when a Cult Ambush marker must be removed because the enemy moved too close: instead place it within 12" of a model with this ability and more than 8" from all enemy units.

SUMMONED BY SLAUGHTER.brief: any phase, a unit's last model destroyed: a BLOODLETTERS unit in Reserves deploys wholly within 9" of it and more than 6" from enemies; once per battle round.

Sump-Smog Screen.brief: Start of opponent's Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE unit: attacks targeting it, or a unit not fully visible because of its models, give the target the Benefit of Cover.

Sunderer of Fortresses#42275b8913.brief: Attacks vs a VEHICLE: S and D improved by 1; vs a FORTIFICATION: improved by 2 instead.

Sunderer of Fortresses#5577daf633.brief: Attacks vs a VEHICLE: +1 S and +1 D; vs a FORTIFICATION: +2 S and +2 D instead.

Sunforge.brief: Ranged attacks targeting a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit: re-roll the Wound roll and the Damage roll.

Supa-Glowy Fing.brief: ORKS INFANTRY only (not WEIRDBOY). Ranged attacks: [Anti-Infantry 4+], [Devastating Wounds], [Supa-Hazardous] = 2 hazard rolls per such weapon after shooting.

Supa-Snazz Dakka Upgrade.brief: FLASH GITZ unit only. Snazzgun weapons have [Rapid Fire 1].

Super Runts.brief: This unit is riled up; its Scavenged Shivs have +1 A, WS and S.

Super-Heavy Walker.brief: Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves: can move through models (not TITANIC) and terrain 4" or less in height as if not there.

Supercharged Engines Upgrade.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED only. This unit can re-roll Advance rolls.

SUPERHUMAN FOCUS.brief: End of any phase, 1 unreadied ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit: it is readied; same unit max once per battle round.

Superior Craftsmanship#018598f42a.brief: Ranged attacks of BATTLESUIT CHARACTER units have +6" Range. Retaliation tag: cannot be taken with another Retaliation detachment.

Superior Craftsmanship#1e0ee787c7.brief: Fight phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase its attacks against MONSTER/VEHICLE units have +1 D.

Superior Creation.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only; once per battle per army, end of the phase this model is destroyed: D6, on 2+ set it back up as close as possible, unengaged, with 3 wounds.

Superlative Strategist#c000681ad8.brief: While leading: re-roll the unit's Advance rolls and any rolls made for it while performing an Agile Manoeuvre.

Superlative Strategist#ecf5bf7730.brief: Re-roll Advance rolls for this model's unit and any rolls made for it during an Agile Manoeuvre.

Supernova Launcher.brief: BATTLESUIT only. Declare Battle Formations: 1 of bearer's airbursting fragmentation projector weapons gets +3 S, +1 AP and +1 D.

Support Artillery.brief: Start of Declare Battle Formations: can join one Guardian Defenders unit (max one Support Weapon per unit), counting as part of it (Starting Strength raised); neither can embark in a Transport.

Support Shokka.brief: While within 3" of a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (unless BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN): this model has Lone Operative.

Support System.brief: Ranged attacks: can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

Support Weapon.brief: Attack targets this model's unit while it contains other models: this model has T 3 until the attack is resolved.

Supporting Ordnance.brief: Your Shooting phase, ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, re-roll Hit rolls against visible MONSTER or VEHICLE units.

SUPPRESS AND OVERWHELM.brief: Your Shooting phase, after an ASTRA MILITARUM unit shot, that unit: pick one enemy unit it hit; until end of turn it cannot be targeted by Fire Overwatch and GENESTEALER CULTS units charging it can re-roll the Charge roll.

Suppression Bombardment.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: select an enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by the Wyvern quad stormshard mortar; until your next Shooting phase it is suppressed (-1 to its Hit rolls).

Suppression Protocols.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by the Armiger autocannon is suppressed until your next turn (-1 to its Hit rolls).

Suppression Volley.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 enemy INFANTRY unit hit is suppressed until start of your next turn while this unit is on the battlefield; its attacks get -1 to Hit.

Umbral Evasion.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, PHOBOS unit targeted: ranged attacks targeting it have -1 to hit rolls.

Umbralefic Crystal.brief: THOUSAND SONS only; once per battle per army, your Command phase if unengaged: unit goes into Strategic Reserves, has [Deep Strike] until your next Shooting phase, must make an ingress move next Movement phase.

UNBOUND ARROGANCE.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit destroys an enemy unit: increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1. Once per battle round.

Unbowed Conviction.brief: Your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit below starting strength: until your next Command phase, ignores modifiers to its BS, WS, Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

UNBREAKABLE LINES.brief: opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy charge move, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within Engagement Range of it: attacks targeting your unit have -1 to Wound rolls until end of turn.

UNBRIDLED ARDOUR.brief: Any phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit just destroyed: until end of battle, friendly SANGUINARY GUARD attacks targeting the enemy unit that destroyed it re-roll Hit and Wound rolls.

Unbridled Carnage.brief: Fight phase, friendly BOYZ unit that charged this turn selected to fight: its melee attacks have +1 A.

Unbridled Ferocity.brief: Fight phase, friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN unit selected to fight: its melee attacks have [Lance].

UNCANNY REACTIONS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, targeted SLAANESH unit: until end of phase, attacks targeting it have -1 to Hit rolls.

UNCEASING ONSLAUGHT.brief: Movement phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit ending an advance move: ranged attacks have [Assault] until end of turn; the advance does not prevent declaring a charge.

Unclean Icon.brief: While leading a unit: +1 OC for models in that unit.

UNCOMPROMISING EGRESS.brief: Your Movement phase, LAND RAIDER model not yet moved: one embarked ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit disembarks anywhere wholly within 6" of it, even within Engagement Range of enemies.

Undying Hatred#ab63729468.brief: Fight phase, after enemy picks targets, targeted HERETIC ASTARTES unit: each model destroyed before fighting: roll a D6, on 4+ it stays, fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

Undying Hatred#c279552244.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, enemy unit targets a HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit: attacks with S greater than its T have -1 to wound rolls.

UNDYING SPITE.brief: Fight phase, after targets chosen, targeted TERMINATOR unit: each model destroyed that has not fought, on a 4+ stays in play, fights after the attacker, then is removed.

Unearthly Power.brief: Start of battle round: choose one Crimson King ability; this model has it until the start of the next battle round.

UNENDING FIDELITY.brief: opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit selected as a target: each model destroyed that has not shot/fought this phase rolls 1 D6; on 4+ it stays, shoots or fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

UNENDING WAVES.brief: any phase, ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit just destroyed: an identical new unit goes into Strategic Reserves at full strength; attached Characters not returned; once per battle.

UNFAILINGLY OBDURATE.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not DAMNED) targeted: until the attacker finishes, attacks against it have AP worsened by 1.

Unflinching Determination#849f2cddc5.brief: While leading a unit: +1 OC for models in that unit.

Unflinching Determination#afa47e29b4.brief: Your Movement phase, CELESTIAN SACRESANTS unit selected to Advance or Fall Back: ranged attacks have [Assault] until end of turn; that move does not prevent it from shooting or declaring a charge.

Unflinching Will.brief: OVERLORD only. Bearer's melee weapons: [Precision] and [Anti-Infantry 5+].

UNFORGIVEN FURY.brief: your Shooting or Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: its weapons have [Lethal Hits]; if a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is battle-shocked, unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ are Critical Hits.

Unhinged Vengeance.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shot and this model lost W: surge move of up to D6+2".

Unholy Avalanche.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit that Fell Back this turn: that move does not prevent it from being eligible to shoot or to declare a charge.

Unholy Bloodshed.brief: Once per battle, when this unit makes a Dark Pact: until end of phase, its weapons have [Devastating Wounds].

Unholy Fortitude.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets chosen, targeted SOUL FORGE unit: +1 T until end of phase.

Unholy Mechanisms (Aura).brief: Friendly DAEMON VEHICLE unit within 6": +2 S on its weapons.

Unholy Resilience.brief: First time destroyed each battle round: at end of phase, on 2+ set back up near where destroyed, outside Engagement Range, with 3 W; once per battle per model.

Unholy Vigour.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 3+ invulnerable save until end of phase.

Unit Composition#01da5b99f9.brief: Grimnyr destroyed: remaining CORV models also destroyed; CORV take up the space of 0 models in a TRANSPORT.

Unit Composition#5d111625a0.brief: Iron-master destroyed: remaining E-COG models also destroyed; E-COG take up the space of 0 models in a TRANSPORT.

Unit Composition#97de31e11e.brief: Up to 2 Leader units can be attached (max 1 COMMAND SQUAD); if this Bodyguard unit is destroyed, the Leaders become separate units with their original Starting Strengths.

United in Destruction.brief: While leading: melee weapons of the unit have [Lethal Hits].

United In Destruction.brief: While leading: melee weapons of the unit have [Lethal Hits].

UNLEASH BALEFIRE.brief: Your Shooting phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit not yet selected to shoot: after shooting, 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test; failed = aflame until end of opponent's next turn: -2" M and -2 to Charge rolls.

Unleash Hell.brief: Start of your Shooting phase: pick 1 VEHICLE within 6" (or bearer's TRANSPORT); after it shoots, 1 enemy unit hit is suppressed until your next turn: -1 to its Hit rolls.

UNLEASH THE LIONS.brief: Your Command phase, 1 ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit of 2+ models: split into single-model units, each with starting strength 1.

Unleash Wrath.brief: End of opponent's Movement phase: pick 1 enemy unit set up within 12"; this model shoots it (if eligible) or declares a charge against it (no Charge bonus).

UNLIMITED ENDURANCE.brief: Movement phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit ending an advance move: until end of turn its ranged attacks have [Assault] and the advance does not prevent declaring a charge.

Unmasking Suite Upgrade.brief: GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only. When selected to shoot: 1 enemy unit within 24" has +9" detection range until this unit has shot.

Unnatural Aggression.brief: End of opponent's Charge phase, NECRONS unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 6" of enemy units it could charge: declares and resolves a charge against them now; no Charge bonus this turn.

Unpredictable Genius.brief: Your Shooting phase, all ranged attacks of a BIG MEK/MEK GUNZ/MORKANAUT/WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit at one enemy unit: D6. 1: target 4+ Inv until shot; 2-3: other enemy unit within 3" of target D3 MW; 4: +1 to Hit; 5: target FLY, no cover until your next turn; 6: target -1 T until shot.

Unquenchable Resolve.brief: First time destroyed, end of phase: D6, on 2+ set back up as close as possible, not in Engagement Range, full W.

Unquestioning Fanaticism.brief: ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS and NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS units led by a CHARACTER: re-roll Advance and Charge rolls; if that CHARACTER is a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD, it has Feel No Pain 3+ while leading.

Unravelled Fates.brief: TZAANGOR SHAMAN only; your Movement phase, start or end of move: 1 friendly battle-shocked MUTANT unit within 6" is no longer battle-shocked.

UNREAL SPEED.brief: Your Charge phase, 1 INFANTRY LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit: until end of phase, eligible to charge even if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn.

UNRELENTING ADVANCE.brief: enemy Shooting, WORLD EATERS VEHICLE just hit: Normal move of up to 6"; not with Fury Unleashed in the same phase.

Unrelenting Aggression.brief: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit Falls Back, that unit: until end of turn, eligible to shoot after Falling Back; if SKITARII, eligible to shoot and charge instead.

Unrestrained Terror (Aura).brief: Friendly WAR DOG models within 6" are affected; start of Fight phase: each enemy unit within Engagement Range of affected WAR DOG units takes a Battle-shock test.

UNSEEN LURKERS.brief: enemy Shooting, VANGUARD INVADER unit just targeted: only targetable by ranged attacks from within 18" (6" if it has Lone Operative) until end of phase; the attacker may re-pick targets.

Unshackled Wrath.brief: Your Shooting phase, SKITARII unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1] or [Lethal Hits]; or both plus [Hazardous].

UNSHAKEABLE OPPONENTS.brief: Command phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit: until end of turn, its attacks ignore modifiers to BS/WS, Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

UNSHROUDED TRUTH.brief: Your Movement phase, ASURYANI INFANTRY unit (not WRAITH CONSTRUCT) not yet moved nor set up this phase, within 9" of an ASURYANI PSYKER: placed in Strategic Reserves, gains Deep Strike and must make an ingress move this phase (even turn 1); cannot otherwise move this phase.

Unsparing Execution.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit engaged with a SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit falls back, that unit: the enemy must use the desperate escape mode, -1 to its Hazard rolls if Battle-shocked.

Unstable Energies.brief: ORKS PSYKER units have a psyker level (1+); each psychic ability has a psychic level (in its name); per battle round, a PSYKER unit can use psychic abilities whose total levels do not exceed its psyker level.

Unstable Payload.brief: Deadly Demise roll: units within 6" suffer MW on a 4+ instead of 6.

Unstoppable Advance.brief: Your Movement/Charge phase, DREADNOUGHT unit selected to move or declaring a charge: it has MOBILE.

Unstoppable Champion.brief: Once per battle per army, end of a phase in which this model is destroyed: on a 2+, set it back up as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds.

Unstoppable Destroyer.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only; pile-in/consolidation move: this unit moves up to 4"; any consolidation mode allowed, ignoring its Before Moving restrictions.

UNSTOPPABLE FORCE.brief: Fight phase, LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase its Pile-in and Consolidation moves are up to 6" instead of 3".

Unstoppable Momentum.brief: Friendly WAGON units can re-roll Charge rolls; when a friendly WAGON unit Advances, it can change its Advance roll to a 6.

UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM.brief: Movement/Charge phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit selected to move or declaring a charge: it has MOBILE.

Unstoppable Monster.brief: start of each player's Command phase: this model regains up to D3 W.

UNSTOPPABLE RAMPAGE.brief: Your Movement or Charge phase, HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or Vashtorr unit not yet moved/charged: Normal, Advance and charge moves pass horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.

Unstoppable Valour.brief: Re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

UNSTOPPABLE WARRIOR.brief: Your Movement phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit that just Fell Back: it can still shoot and charge this turn.

Untapped Power.brief: Shooting phase, CRYPTEK unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, when selected to shoot, pick 1 additional ability from the Techno-sorcerous Augmentations detachment rule.

Unto Death.brief: Once per battle per army, your Command phase: until end of turn this unit re-rolls Advance and Charge rolls.

Unto the Anvil.brief: Melee attacks: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; or re-roll Wound rolls if the assault doctrine is active for this unit.

Unto the Burning Skies.brief: End of your opponent's Fight phase, THE SANGUINOR or unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit: placed in strategic reserves.

UNTRAMMELLED FEROCITY.brief: your Movement, TYRANIDS MONSTER unit not yet moved: Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves pass through models (not TITANIC) and terrain up to 4" high; higher terrain too, but D6 after, on 1 battle-shocked.

UNWAVERING ACCURACY.brief: Your Shooting phase, BRÔKHYR THUNDERKYN unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase its attacks can ignore any modifiers to BS, Hit roll, Wound roll and AP.

UNWAVERING PHALANX.brief: Enemy Charge phase, after an enemy charge move, RUBRIC MARINES unit in Engagement Range of it: until end of turn, attacks targeting the unit with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound.

Unyielding Aggression.brief: Your Movement phase, after a LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit Falls Back, that unit: until end of turn it can shoot and declare a charge despite Falling Back.

Unyielding Ancient.brief: Attacks targeting this unit with S greater than its T: -1 to Wound rolls.

Unyielding Forms.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects targets, NECRONS VEHICLE or NECRONS MOUNTED unit (not TITANIC) targeted: until end of phase, attacks with S greater than its T -1 to Wound.

Unyielding in the Face of the Foe.brief: While controlling an objective: this unit has +1 to save rolls.

Unyielding Might.brief: Command phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within range of an objective: +1 OC until end of turn.

Upon Wings of Fire.brief: End of opponent's turn: unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK units (up to 1 Incursion, 2 Strike Force, 3 Onslaught) are placed in Strategic Reserves ; they return by Deep Strike in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase.

Urban Warfare.brief: Ranged attack targeting this model while it has the Benefit of Cover against it: -1 D.

Urgent Metamorphosis.brief: Your Movement phase, HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit selected to Fall Back: that move does not prevent it from declaring a charge.

Using Commissar Graves.brief: Army can include only one COMMISSAR GRAVES or COMMISSAR GRAVES ON FOOT unit.

Using Sir Hekhtur.brief: Canis Rex destroyed: this model performs an Emergency Disembarkation as from a destroyed TRANSPORT; only Core Stratagems can target him; Canis Rex counts as destroyed only once Sir Hekhtur is too.

Valour's Reward.brief: This detachment's Enhancements can become expended and cannot be used while expended; each time you fulfil your Oath, every expended Enhancement is restored.

Vanguard Ambushers.brief: End of your Movement phase, if a PHOBOS unit is hidden: its attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1 until end of turn.

Vanguard Assault.brief: If this unit charged this turn: melee attacks have +1 A.

Vanguard Honours#5c755841ce.brief: INFANTRY OFFICER only. Bearer's unit can disembark from a TRANSPORT after it Advanced: counts as a Normal move, cannot charge this turn.

Vanguard Intellect.brief: TYRANIDS with Deep Strike only. Bearer's unit can Deep Strike in the Reinforcements step of Movement phase 1, 2 or 3, regardless of mission rules.

Vanguard of the Dark City.brief: Start of your Command phase: choose 1 Vanguard of the Dark City ability; this model has it until your next Command phase.

Vanguard Predator.brief: attacks of this unit: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; re-roll Wound rolls of 1 too if target is within range of an objective marker.

Vanguard Prime.brief: DEATHLEAPER loses Hunter Organism and can be your WARLORD.

Vanguard Protocols.brief: Attached to a CANOPTEK MACROCYTES unit at Declare Battle Formations: has [Scouts 8"].

Vanguard Tyrant.brief: WINGED HIVE TYRANT only: bearer's melee weapons +1 S and AP improved by 1.

Vanguard-beast.brief: NODE ORGANISM only: M becomes 8", gains VANGUARD INVADER keyword, Fights First, Infiltrators, Lone Operative and Stealth; can only be attached to HORMAGAUNTS or VON RYAN'S LEAPERS.

VAUL’S VENGEANCE.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after an enemy unit destroys a DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit, a WAR WALKERS unit: once that enemy has finished attacking, it shoots as in your Shooting phase, only at that enemy unit; once per battle round.

Vector of Disease#36e81c2bd3.brief: While leading a unit: melee weapons of that unit have [Sustained Hits 1] and [Lance].

Vector of Disease#c7e572a04f.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1] and [Lance].

Vectored Engines.brief: Your Movement phase, AELDARI VEHICLE unit Falling Back: that move does not prevent it from shooting.

Vehement Aggression#70d6e49e90.brief: Fight phase, when selected to fight: Leadership roll ; melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 ; if the roll succeeds, melee attacks also re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

Vehement Aggression#f38dc71c0b.brief: While leading, unit selected to fight: Leadership test; passed = re-roll Hit rolls until end of phase; failed = re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Veil of Darkness.brief: once per battle per army, end of opponent's turn, if unengaged: unit goes into Strategic Reserves, has Deep Strike until start of your next Shooting phase; must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase.

Veil of Medrengard.brief: Bearer: 4+ Inv vs ranged attacks, 5+ Inv vs melee attacks.

Veil of Time (psychic level 1).brief: When selected to advance, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6; on 1 battle-shocked; this unit can change the advance roll to 6.

Veiled Hunter.brief: SKITARII MARSHAL only. After both armies deployed: redeploy up to 3 SKITARII INFANTRY units; any of them can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of the limit.

Veiling Smoke (Once per phase, per unit).brief: Once per phase. Can be targeted by Smokescreen regardless of other uses this phase: that use is -1 CP and does not block uses on other units.

Velocity Tracker.brief: Ranged attacks targeting a unit that can FLY: re-roll the Hit roll.

Venator Omni-auspex.brief: PHOBOS only. This unit's attacks against a hidden unit: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; if the Assault Doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and 2.

Vendetta.brief: Start of your Command phase: pick 1 enemy unit as Vendetta target until your next Command phase; HERETIC ASTARTES models (except DAMNED) attacking it re-roll Hit rolls.

Venerable Champion (Aura) Upgrade.brief: DREADNOUGHT only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED units within 6": re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Venerable Death Companion.brief: DREADNOUGHT only. Feel No Pain 6+; unless within 12" of a friendly CHAPLAIN: cannot Fall Back and OC 0; gains DEATH COMPANY.

Venerable Librarian.brief: DREADNOUGHT only. Gains PSYKER; may take 1 additional ranged weapon, which must be Psychic.

VENGEANCE FLARE.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shot, LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit it hit (optionally spend 2YP): 1 friendly KAPRICUS or SAGITAUR within 6" (or a HEKATON LAND FORTRESS if YP spent) shoots as if in your Shooting phase, at that enemy unit only.

VENGEANCE FOR THE MARTYR!.brief: Enemy unit destroys a GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER, another GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER: rest of battle, ACOLYTE HYBRIDS, HYBRID METAMORPHS and NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS attacks vs that enemy unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1; full Hit re-roll if a MAGUS, PRIMUS or ACOLYTE ICONWARD was slain.

Vengeance for the Omnissiah#1747b58fe7.brief: If a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE is destroyed within 12" of this model: its Omnissian axe has A 6 for the rest of the battle.

Vengeance for the Omnissiah#71b333c12f.brief: If a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE is destroyed within 12" of this model: until end of battle, its Enginseer axe has A 6.

Vengeance of the Machine Cult.brief: Any phase, an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit is destroyed by an enemy unit, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit: that enemy is marked until end of battle; ADEPTUS MECHANICUS attacks against it re-roll Wound rolls.

Vengeful Animus.brief: Any phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit destroyed, before rolling Deadly Demise: its Deadly Demise rolls become unmodified 6s.

Vengeful Destruction.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (not DAMNED) or MOUNTED unit not yet shot/fought: attacks against your Vendetta target get +1 to Wound rolls.

Vengeful Exhortation#50adec2dbb.brief: While leading, model in the unit destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase: on 4+ it fights after the attacking unit, then is removed.

Vengeful Exhortation#ccbdbba60f.brief: Fight phase, model of this unit destroyed before the unit has fought: roll 1 D6 ; 4+ = model stays until the unit has fought or end of phase, then removed.

Vengeful Onslaught.brief: If the bearer is destroyed: until end of your next turn, friendly DEATH COMPANY models get +1 to Hit rolls.

Vengeful Sorrow.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shot, AELDARI INFANTRY unit that lost 1+ models, not Battle-shocked nor engaged: surge move of up to D6+1".

VENGEFUL SURGE.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, targeted EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit: surge move of up to D6"; if not Favoured Champions, re-roll the distance.

Vengeful Surge (Once per battle, per uni.brief: Once per battle, opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit lost a wound: surge move of up to D6+2".

Vengeful Tread.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Once per turn: Tank Shock Stratagem on the bearer for 0 CP.

Venomous Wrath.brief: Your Shooting phase, HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit not yet selected to shoot: after shooting, if not in Engagement Range, Normal move of up to 6"; it cannot charge this turn.

Verminous Haze.brief: Declare Battle Formations step: up to 2 friendly PLAGUE MARINES units have Infiltrators. FLYBLOWN tag: cannot be taken with another FLYBLOWN detachment.

Verse of Holy Piety.brief: PENITENT only. Once per battle, start of the battle round: select 1 Vow of Atonement (even one already selected); active for the bearer's unit until the next battle round, in addition to the army's.

VERSE OF VENGEANCE.brief: Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets, targeted CULT MECHANICUS unit: until end of phase, each CULT MECHANICUS model destroyed that has not fought: D6, on 4+ it stays, fights after the attacker finishes, then is removed.

Veteran Bodyguard.brief: While attached: other CHARACTER models in the unit have [Feel No Pain 4+].

Veteran Crew#1796ef44a7.brief: VEHICLE OFFICER only. Ranged attacks by the bearer's unit: re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Veteran Marksmen.brief: This unit's ranged attacks re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Veteran of Behemoth.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES only. While leading a unit: its ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1]; while under the Devastator Doctrine, re-roll Advance rolls for that unit.

Veteran Scout.brief: SHAS'NEL only. M 7", gains Scouts 7"; can only lead PATHFINDER TEAM.

Veteran Sharpshooters.brief: Your Shooting phase, ASTRA MILITARUM unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover].

Veterans of the Long War.brief: Melee attacks: re-roll Wound rolls of 1; if target is in range of an objective, re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Veterans of the Void.brief: Each ANHRATHE unit added to the army can take up to 1 Corsair Enhancement; each Corsair Enhancement is unique in the army and its points cost is added to the unit (MFM); the army cannot exceed the points limit.

Vexilla#4433c2a120.brief: Models in the bearer's unit: +1 OC.

Vexilla#9032766db1.brief: +1 OC; can ignore modifiers to Ld.

VICIOUS BLADES.brief: Fight phase, DRUKHARI TRANSPORT that just selected targets: after it fought, 1 enemy unit it targeted, D6 per embarked model (+1 if WRACKS): each 5+ = 1 MW (max 6).

Vicious Insight.brief: while leading a unit: weapons of that unit have [Devastating Wounds].

VICTORY BEFORE DEATH.brief: Any phase, GRAV-ASSAULT unit destroyed within range of an objective: an objective it controlled with no enemy (except AIRCRAFT) in range is secured.

VIGIL UNENDING.brief: Enemy Shooting or Fight phase, ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit targeted: attacks against it have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

Vigilance of Titan.brief: TERMINATOR model only; start of your Shooting phase: 1 visible enemy unit within 12" gets +6" detection range.

Vile Vigour.brief: While leading a unit: +1" M for that unit's models and re-roll Advance rolls for that unit.

Vindictive Artillerists.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly MEK GUNZ unit selected to shoot, its ranged attacks have: [Lethal Hits]; or [Sustained Hits 1]; or [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits] and [Sustained Hits 1].

Vingh’s Wafers of Dynamism.brief: CYBERNETICA DATASMITH only. Start of battle round 1, if attached unit: unit has MOBILE for the battle.

VIOLENT ACQUISITION.brief: Your Shooting or the Fight phase, AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit: until end of phase, its attacks on an enemy unit within range of an objective have [Sustained Hits 1], [Lance] and [Ignores Cover].

VIOLENT CRESCENDO.brief: Fight phase, SLAANESH BEASTS, INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit not yet selected to fight: Pile-in and Consolidation moves of up to 6" instead of 3", need not end closer to the closest enemy model if as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

Violent Demise.brief: Bearer's Deadly Demise triggers on 2+ instead of 6, and is D3+1 instead of D3.

VIOLENT EXCESS.brief: Fight phase, EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit not yet selected to fight: until end of phase, its melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

Violent Fury.brief: If this model has two melee weapons: this unit's melee attacks have [Twin-linked].

VIRTUE OF COURAGE.brief: Start of Fight phase, ARMIGER or IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model plus friendly ARMIGER models affected by its Bondsman ability: pick 1 enemy unit; until end of phase, your ARMIGER attacks vs that unit get +1 to Hit.

Virtue of Intolerance.brief: Start of battle: 1 enemy unit is the quarry; attacks targeting it have [Precision] and re-roll the Hit roll; works even while embarked in a TRANSPORT.

Virulent Aura.brief: While leading a unit: ranged attacks of that unit re-roll Wound rolls.

Virulent Blessing (Psychic)#4868628e56.brief: Start of Fight phase: 1 enemy unit within 24" and visible; until end of phase, attacks of NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA models allocated to it: +1 D.

Virulent Blessing (Psychic)#62991e56fe.brief: Start of Fight phase, one enemy unit within 24" and visible: until end of phase, PLAGUE LEGIONS attacks allocated to it get +1 D.

Visage of Death.brief: Battle-shock step of opponent's Command phase: each enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within Engagement Range of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test.

Visions of Butchery.brief: WRACKS embarked: +1 A to Bladevanes and chainsnares per WRACKS model embarked.

Visions of Suffering (Psychic).brief: Attacks vs an enemy unit below Starting Strength: +1 to Hit; if Below Half-strength: +1 to Wound as well.

Visions of Virulence.brief: Enemy units enfeebled by the bearer's Pestilent Fallout are also Afflicted.

Vitruous Onslaught.brief: Attacks of this unit targeting the closest eligible target: re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

Vivispectral Analysis Targeting.brief: This unit's attacks have [Lethal Hits] vs non-VEHICLE.

Voice eater.brief: Enemy units (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) in Engagement Range of the bearer's unit cannot be targeted by Stratagems.

Voice Of Command.brief: ASTRA MILITARUM army: OFFICER issues Orders to eligible units within 6" until your next Command phase (1 per unit): +3" M; +1 WS; +1 BS; +1 A Rapid Fire; +1 Sv (max 3+); +1 Ld and OC.

Voice of New Truths#48a0766dba.brief: Your Command phase, one model with this ability: 1 enemy unit within 18" must take a Battle-shock test.

Voice of New Truths#fc8b115804.brief: Your Command phase, one model with this ability: 1 enemy unit within 18" must take a Battle-shock test.

Voice of the Triarch.brief: Start of battle round: select 1 Triarch ability; this unit has it until the start of the next battle round.

Voice of the Tyrant.brief: Bearer's unit has both abilities of the Tyrannical Motivation Detachment rule.

Voices in the Code.brief: Start of the Fight phase: each enemy unit within Engagement Range of ≥1 unit with this ability takes a Battle-shock test.

VOID HARDENED.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, after targets are chosen, while your army has Fortify Takeover, targeted LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit: attacks against it have AP worsened by 1 until the attacker has finished attacking.

Void Mine.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase: pick one visible enemy model (not Lone Operative) within 24"; roll one D6 per enemy unit within D6" of it: each 4+ = D6 MW to that unit.

Voidstone.brief: ANHRATHE INFANTRY only: models in the unit have a 5+ Inv.

Volley Fire.brief: While leading: ranged weapons of the unit's models get +1 A.

Voltagheist Reliquary.brief: TECH-PRIEST only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

Vortex Terrors (Psychic).brief: Start of your Shooting phase: 1 enemy unit within 24" and visible takes a Battle-shock test.

VOW OF RETRIBUTION.brief: Your Shooting phase, IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit not yet shot: its ranged weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Vowed Target.brief: your Command phase: select 1 objective, your vowed objective until your next Command phase; friendly DEATHWING INFANTRY attacks targeting an enemy unit within range of it have +1 to Wound rolls. Army: DARK ANGELS only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES from another Chapter.

Vox-caster#40b6083789.brief: Each time you target the unit with a Stratagem: roll D6 (+1 if a friendly OFFICER within 6"); on 5+, gain 1 CP.

Vox-caster#58401fb410.brief: Each time you target the unit with a Stratagem: roll D6 (+1 if a friendly OFFICER within 6"); on 5+, gain 1 CP.

VOX-HOWL.brief: Start of Shooting or Fight phase, WAR DOG CHARACTER unit: each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test; each Battle-shocked friendly WAR DOG unit within 6" takes a Leadership test, if passed no longer Battle-shocked; once per turn.

Vox-net.brief: Each time this model issues an Order: can issue it to an eligible unit up to 12" away.

VOX-RELAY.brief: Your Command phase, INFANTRY OFFICER unit embarked in a TRANSPORT: until end of phase, it can issue Orders while embarked, and to ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT units (not TITANIC) regardless of distance to its TRANSPORT.

Vox-relay beacon.brief: Start of battle: 1 Beacon token outside the enemy deployment zone; OFFICERS can issue Orders to friendly ASTRA MILITARUM REGIMENT units within 6" of it as if within 6"; removed if an enemy is within 1" at end of phase.

Vulkan's Quest.brief: Ranged weapons of ADEPTUS ASTARTES models have [Assault]; their attacks vs units within 12" get +1 S. Seeker's Companions: with Vulkan He'stan in your army, during your turn each INFERNUS SQUAD unit can either start an Action after Advancing, or shoot in a turn in which it started an Action.

Waaagh!.brief: Friendly ORKS units with this ability: re-roll Advance rolls; riled up: 5+ Inv, ranged [Assault], charge after Advancing; War Cry (once per battle, per army), start of Command phase: riled up until end of next turn.

Waaagh! Energy (psyker level 1).brief: This model has the psychic abilities listed below.

Wages of Cowardice.brief: opponent's Movement phase, unengaged CHAPLAIN unit after an enemy unit falls back from it: it can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

Walking Fortress.brief: In a turn a GRAVIS unit made a normal move: its ranged attacks lose [Heavy] and have +1 to hit rolls.

Walking Rampart.brief: SORCERER/EXALTED SORCERER only; your Movement phase, start or end of move: 1 friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 3" heals D3+1 wounds; within 3" of friendly SEKHETAR ROBOTS: bearer has [Lone Operative].

WALL OF MIRRORS.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, STEALTH, GHOSTKEEL or COMMANDER SHADOWSUN unit not within Engagement Range of enemies: remove it and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Wall of Muscle.brief: Each time an attack is allocated to a model in this unit: -1 D.

WALL OF STEEL.brief: Your Charge phase, after an IRONKIN STEELJACKS unit ends a Charge move, that unit (optionally spend 2YP): 1 enemy unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within Engagement Range, roll 1D6 per model (+2D6 if YP spent): each 4+ = 1 MW (max 6).

War Construct.brief: Can shoot in a turn it Fell Back.

War Howl.brief: Attached to BLOOD CLAWS: unit's melee attacks +1 S and [Sustained Hits 1]; attached to WOLF GUARD HEADTAKERS: advancing does not prevent the unit from declaring a charge.

War Hymns.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1].

War Leader.brief: Once per battle round, 1 unit with this ability targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

War-Form Mantles.brief: TECH-PRIEST models: 4+ Inv and Feel No Pain 5+; when selected to shoot, if not Battle-shocked, D6: on 2+, 1 enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" makes a Battle-shock roll at -1 (1×/turn per unit); or on 2+ those ranged attacks do not stop it being hidden.

Warden of Fate.brief: PSYKER only: Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks targeting this unit.

Warden of Honour.brief: While leading a unit: +1 to each D6 rolled for the bearer's Vengeful Exhortation ability.

Warden of the Imperium Nihilus.brief: Assault and tactical doctrines active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

Warden's Duty (Bondsman)#08b3ed8b25.brief: Affected model, each attack allocated to it: -1 D.

Warden's Duty (Bondsman)#331c892551.brief: Affected model: its weapons have [Sustained Hits 1], its ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover].

Wardens of the Dark Cells.brief: ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless MONSTER/VEHICLE) within range of an objective: melee attacks against it with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

WARDING CHANT.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, targeted GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit: Feel No Pain 5+ against attacks with unmodified Damage 1.

Warding Hex.brief: Command phase, THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit in range of an objective you control wholly within the Flow of Magic: that objective stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

WARDING SALVOES.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: re-roll Wound rolls against enemies within range of an objective marker until end of phase.

Warmaster's Gift.brief: Bearer's attacks vs your focus of hatred: unmodified successful Wound roll of 5+ = Critical Wound.

Warp Field (Aura, Psychic).brief: friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of this unit: 6+ Inv.

Warp Fields.brief: Enemy Shooting phase, targeted SEKHETAR ROBOTS unit within 12" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit: ranged attacks against it with S greater than its T have -1 to Wound.

Warp Flicker.brief: Your Movement phase, HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit: can shoot and declare a charge this turn after Advancing.

Warp Plunge.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit: placed into Strategic Reserves.

Warp Portals.brief: End of opponent's turn: pick HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS and MUTILATORS units not in Engagement Range (Incursion up to 1, Strike Force up to 2, Onslaught up to 3) and place them into Strategic Reserves.

Warp Rift Firepower.brief: Once per battle, your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot: this unit's ranged attacks have [Indirect Fire].

Warp Rifts.brief: LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit arriving by Deep Strike wholly within your Shadow of Chaos and/or wholly within 6" of a friendly Greater Daemon of the same god: can be set up more than 6" from enemy models instead of 9".

WARP STALKERS.brief: your Movement or Charge, WORLD EATERS POSSESSED unit not yet moved: it can move through enemy models (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) this phase; Desperate Escape auto-passed.

Warp Storms (Psychic).brief: End of your Movement phase: D6 per enemy unit within 9" of models with this ability, on 3+ it suffers D3 MW.

Warp Strike.brief: End of Fight phase, if this unit destroyed an enemy unit this phase and is not in Engagement Range: remove it into Strategic Reserves.

WARP SURGE.brief: Your Charge phase, 1 LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit within your Shadow of Chaos: until end of phase, eligible to charge even if it Advanced this turn.

Warp Syphon.brief: Bearer within 6" of friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE, Channels the Warp, after the extra D6 before doubles/triples: 1 MW to one such VEHICLE and re-roll that D6.

Warp Tracer.brief: Your Shooting phase, after bearer shot: 1 enemy unit hit loses Benefit of Cover until end of phase.

WARP VISION.brief: Your Shooting phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Ignores Cover].

Warp Walker#48eda268a2.brief: Bearer's unit Advances: no roll, +6" M instead; Normal, Advance or Fall Back moves can pass through enemy models (not end in Engagement Range); Desperate Escape auto-passed.

Warp-borne Stalker.brief: Bearer has [Deep Strike]; once per battle, end of opponent's turn, if not in Engagement Range: remove bearer into Strategic Reserves.

Warp-cursed Runemaster.brief: Bearer within 6" of 1+ friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE units: Rituals it manifests +6" range.

Warp-fuelled Thrusters#32fa068643.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, if bearer's unit not in Engagement Range: remove it into Strategic Reserves.

Warp-fuelled Thrusters#613a285951.brief: End of opponent's turn, if bearer's unit not in Engagement Range: remove it into Strategic Reserves.

Warp-riders.brief: Your Movement phase, LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED unit selected to move: it has MOBILE.

Warp-sighted Butcher.brief: Leading a unit, melee attacks vs a unit below Starting Strength: re-roll Hit roll; vs Below Half-strength: re-roll Wound roll too.

Warp-tainted.brief: Your Movement phase, HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit within range of an objective marker you control: it stays yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

Warp-twisted Terrors.brief: Your Movement phase, WARP TALONS unit ends a move: 1 visible enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) within 9" takes a battle-shock roll with -1.

Warpath (psychic level 1)#32d79eb2a1.brief: Fight phase, selected to fight, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6; on a 1 this unit is battle-shocked; melee attacks have [Lethal Hits] and [Psychic].

Warpath (psychic level 1)#f1408db6d9.brief: Fight phase, when selected to fight, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6, 1 = battle-shocked; melee attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and have [Psychic].

WARPCHARGED ENGINES.brief: Your Movement phase, HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or MOUNTED unit not yet moved: if it Advances, no Advance roll, +6" to Move instead until end of phase.

Warped and Rusted Animus.brief: Friendly FOETID BLOAT-DRONE (incl. heavy blight launcher), HELBRUTE and MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER units have CONTAGION ENGINE; CONTAGION ENGINE units' ranged attacks have [Assault]. ENGINES tag: cannot be taken with another ENGINES detachment.

Warped Foresight.brief: DARK APOSTLE or DAMNED only. While leading a unit with Scouts 6": every model in bearer's unit has Scouts 6".

Warped Interference (Psychic).brief: While leading a unit: that unit has the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

WARPED VICISSITUDE.brief: Enemy Shooting or Fight phase, targeted TZAANGORS unit: until end of phase, 4+ Inv.

Warpfire Infusion.brief: THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit shooting or fighting: within 6" of a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER, re-roll 1 Hit, 1 Wound and 1 Damage roll; otherwise re-roll 1 of them; VEHICLE with Deadly Demise destroyed within 6" of a friendly PSYKER explodes on 5+ instead of 6.

WARPFLAME GARGOYLES.brief: Enemy Charge phase, after an enemy charge move, THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit in Engagement Range of it: roll 6 D6, each 5+ = 1 MW to that enemy unit, which then takes a Battle-shock test.

Warphead.brief: ORKS PSYKER only. This model has psyker level 2, Deadly Demise D6 and re-rolls psychic rolls.

Warpmeld Dagger.brief: Bearer attempts a Ritual, before the Psychic test result: bearer suffers D3 MW; if not destroyed, +1 to the test per MW suffered.

Warpmeld Sacrifice.brief: TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit targeted by an enemy shooting/fighting, or selected to shoot/fight: may sacrifice; if so, until end of phase -1 to Wound against it (when targeted) or +1 to Wound for its attacks (when attacking); at end of phase it suffers D3 MW.

Warprot Talisman.brief: Once per battle, end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range: remove it and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Warpsmith.brief: Within 3" of a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit: Lone Operative.

Warptime (Psychic).brief: Leading a unit: re-roll Advance and Charge rolls.

Warrant of Trade#03cd277930.brief: After both armies deploy: redeploy up to D3 IMPERIUM BATTLELINE units; they can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many units are already there.

Warrant of Trade#73d604ea42.brief: After both armies deploy: redeploy up to D3 IMPERIUM BATTLELINE units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

Warrant of Trade#83fd886ad4.brief: After both armies deploy: redeploy up to D3 IMPERIUM BATTLELINE units, possibly into Strategic Reserves regardless of how many are already there.

Warrior Bond.brief: Once per battle, start of any phase: 1 friendly Battle-shocked T'AU EMPIRE unit within 12" is no longer Battle-shocked.

Warrior Elite.brief: Once per round, start of any phase: select one Order to affect this unit until your next Command phase, in addition to Orders issued by an OFFICER.

WARRIOR FOCUS.brief: Your Shooting or Fight phase, ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit not yet selected to shoot/fight: its attacks ignore any modifiers to BS, WS, S, AP, D and/or to the Hit roll until end of phase.

Warrior Noble.brief: OVERLORD only. Melee attacks targeting the bearer's unit: -1 to Hit rolls.

Warrior Strategist#235f0d5a5f.brief: Once per battle round, 1 model with this ability, when its unit is targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

Warrior Strategist#e9da8486bf.brief: Once per battle round, 1 unit with this ability, when targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP less.

Watch Master.brief: Attacks targeting a CHARACTER unit: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Watcher in the Dark.brief: Once per battle, any phase, just after a MW is allocated to an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model: summon a Watcher in the Dark, [Feel No Pain 4+] against MW until end of phase.

Watcher in the Dark (Once per battle, pe.brief: Once per battle, any phase, when this unit suffers a MW: summon a Watcher in the Dark, this unit has [Feel No Pain 4+] against MW.

Water from the Stoup of Elucidation.brief: Melee attacks of this unit: +1 AP.

Wave Serpent Shield.brief: Ranged attacks with S greater than this model's T: -1 to Wound.

Way of the Blade.brief: Leading a unit: models in that unit have Fights First.

Way of the Short Blade.brief: While leading: attacks by the unit targeting an enemy unit within 9" get +1 to the Wound roll.

Wayleaper's Heavy Aspect Armour.brief: INFANTRY only: M 14", Sv 3+, [Deep Strike], gains FLY and JUMP PACK; can only be attached to Swooping Hawks or Warp Spiders.

We Are Vengeance.brief: opponent's Shooting phase, unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit targeted after the enemy unit has shot: it can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

Weapon Sentinels.brief: Ranged attack targeting a unit within 12": you can ignore any or all modifiers to BS, the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

Weapon Support System#42cb4fb6b8.brief: Bearer's ranged attacks: ignore any or all Hit roll modifiers.

Weapon Support System#6cc270c310.brief: Ranged attacks by the unit: can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

Weaponised Hatred.brief: Once per battle round, after your Vendetta target is destroyed, if bearer is on the battlefield: 1 enemy unit visible to bearer becomes your Vendetta target.

Weapons of the First Legion.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: +1 A, +1 S, +1 D; while the bearer is Battle-shocked: +2 A, +2 S, +2 D instead.

Weavefield crest#69afb138bd.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have a 5+ Inv.

Weaver of Sagas.brief: WOLF PRIEST only. Once per round, your Movement phase, start or end of this unit's move: 1 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6", or 1 friendly GREY HUNTERS unit within 18", is no longer Battle-shocked.

Weavers' Coils.brief: End of your Fight phase, HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit eligible to fight this phase: Normal move if not in Engagement Range, otherwise Fall Back move of up to 6".

Weavers' Wail.brief: TROUPE MASTER: bearer's melee weapons +3 S and +1 A.

WEAVEWËRKE BUTTRESS.brief: Opponent's Shooting phase, after targets are chosen, while your army has Hostile Acquisition, targeted LEAGUES OF VOTANN INFANTRY unit: until end of phase, attacks against it have -1 to Wound.

Weaving Stride.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit within 8" of it: Normal move of up to 6".

Webway Awl.brief: ARCHON: bearer's unit has [Deep Strike]; Rapid Ingress on it for 0CP.

Webway Pathstone.brief: ANHRATHE only: models have Deep Strike; once per battle, end of opponent's turn, if not in Engagement Range: remove the unit and place it in Strategic Reserves.

WEBWAY TUNNEL.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, ASURYANI INFANTRY unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and not in Engagement Range: remove it and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Webway walker.brief: HARLEQUINS or DRUKHARI: bearer's unit has [Deep Strike]; set up by Deep Strike while losing the wager: re-roll Charge rolls for it until end of turn.

Where D'ya Fink You're Going?.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit engaged with friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit Falls Back: it must use the desperate escape mode; if MONSTER/VEHICLE, 3 additional hazard rolls per BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, -1 to those rolls if it is battle-shocked.

While Their Backs Are Turned.brief: End of opponent's Movement phase, unengaged friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at start of the phase: Normal move of up to 6".

Whirligig Evasion.brief: Opponent's Movement phase, enemy unit ends a move, unengaged friendly DEFFKOPTAS unit within 9" of it: Normal move of up to D6"; up to 6" if riled up.

Whirling Death.brief: Leading a unit, when it Advances: no Advance roll, +6" M until end of phase; ignore vertical distance on Advance moves.

Whirling Onslaught.brief: Melee attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if this unit charged this turn: re-roll Hit rolls.

Whispering Web.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shot: pick one enemy unit hit; until end of turn, friendly AELDARI attacks vs it score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

Whispers of the Shadow Forest (psychic l.brief: When an enemy unit targets this unit, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6, 1 = this unit battle-shocked; attacks targeting this unit -1 to Hit until end of phase.

Will of Iron.brief: First time destroyed: remove it, then at end of phase roll D6; on 2+, set back up as close as possible, not in Engagement Range, with 3 W.

Will of the Conqueror.brief: End of your Movement phase, friendly IMMORTALS/NECRON WARRIORS unit: one objective it controls is secured.

Will of the Hive Mind.brief: Once per battle round, when a friendly TYRANIDS unit within 12" is targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1CP less.

Will-Sapping Salvo.brief: Your Shooting phase, AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit not yet selected to shoot: until end of phase, its ranged weapons have [Sustained Hits 1]; if CULEXUS ASSASSIN, their D becomes 3.

Willbreaker.brief: Fight phase, after bearer's attacks: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test.

Wimp-Kickaz Upgrade.brief: NOBZ unit only. Enemy unit engaged with this unit falling back: must use desperate escape; if this unit is riled up, -1 to those hazard rolls.

WIND OF BLADES.brief: Your Movement phase, ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit not yet moved: it can shoot and charge this turn even if it Advanced or Fell Back.

Wind Walker.brief: Ranged attacks have [Assault]; when selected to advance, this unit can change advance rolls to a 6.

Wind-swift Evasion.brief: End of the Fight phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight: if unengaged, normal move ; or if engaged, fall-back move.

Winged Biomorph.brief: NODE or PRIME ORGANISM only: M becomes 12", gains FLY and VANGUARD INVADER keywords and Deep Strike; if INFANTRY: can only be attached to GARGOYLES.

Winged Strike (Pain).brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; while Empowered, ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls.

Winged Swarm.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if not within Engagement Range: Normal move up to 6"; then cannot declare a charge this turn.

Wings of Shadow.brief: opponent's Shooting phase, RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit targeted: it has Stealth.

Wings of the Blizzard.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit: placed into Strategic Reserves.

Witch Hunter.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's attacks on a PSYKER unit re-roll Hit rolls.

Withdraw and Regroup.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or FLY VEHICLE unit: removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

Withdraw and Reinforce.brief: End of opponent's Fight phase, unengaged ANHRATHE unit: remove it into Strategic Reserves; if below Starting Strength, return all destroyed models (not CHARACTER).

Witherbone Pipes.brief: While leading a POXWALKERS unit: +1 OC for that unit's models, and +1 to its Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

Withering Firepower.brief: Your Shooting phase, after an ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE unit has shot, that unit: pick 1 enemy unit it hit; it must take a Battle-shock test with -1.

Withering Hail.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: select one enemy unit hit by the exterminator autocannon; until end of phase, friendly ASTRA MILITARUM attacks on it have AP improved by 1 (once per phase per unit).

Wolf Lord's Chosen.brief: INFANTRY only: M 7"; can also be attached to BLOOD CLAWS, GREY HUNTERS, WOLF GUARD HEADTAKERS.

Wolf Master.brief: Your Command phase: select 1 friendly SPACE WOLVES unit within 9"; until your next Command phase, its teeth and claws and Tyrnak and Fenrir weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Wolf Totems.brief: Any phase, ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit suffering a mortal wound: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Wolf-Touched.brief: This unit has the WULFEN keyword and +2" M.

Wolves' Wisdom.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY only. With The Great Wolf Watches Detachment rule, bearer's unit can charge units within 6" instead of 3".

Word of the Phoenix (Psychic).brief: Leading a unit, your Command phase: D6, on 2+ D3+1 destroyed BODYGUARD models (not SUPPORT WEAPON) return with full W.

Worldblight.brief: End of your Command phase, objective held by a DEATH GUARD unit becomes secured; until you lose control of it, enemy units within range of it are Afflicted.

Worthy Foes.brief: Your Command phase: select 1 enemy unit; until your next Command phase, NOBLE, LYCHGUARD and TRIARCH attacks against it: +1 to Wound.

Wracking Agonies (Psychic).brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 INFANTRY unit hit by Agonising Energies, until start of your next turn: -2" M and -2 to charge rolls.

Wraith Form.brief: Each time this unit ends a Normal move: 1 enemy unit moved over, D6 per model in this unit: each 4+ = 1 MW.

WRAITHBONE ARMOUR.brief: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, after targets chosen, targeted WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit (not TITANIC): attacks allocated to it get -1 Damage until end of phase.

WRAITHLIKE RETREAT.brief: End of Fight phase, DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit that fought: Normal or Fall Back move, but unless WYCHES it must end within 3" (5" vertically) of a DRUKHARI TRANSPORT and embark in it, even one it disembarked from this turn.

Wrath Beyond Reason.brief: enemy Shooting, TERMINATOR SQUAD unit targeted: ranged attacks against it have -1 D until the attacker has attacked.

Wrath of Angels.brief: Tactical doctrine active for SANGUINARY GUARD units in addition to any other combat doctrine. Restriction: BLOOD ANGELS units only, no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from another Chapter.

Wrath of Khorne.brief: WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit (not EPIC HERO) selected to fight: its CHARACTER models' melee attacks get [Cleave 1] or +1 AP.

Wrath of the Chapter.brief: Friendly TACTICUS units can re-roll Advance rolls.

Wrath of the Doomed.brief: Fight phase, targeted THOUSAND SONS unit: until end of phase, each model destroyed before fighting rolls a D6 (+1 if wholly within the Flow of Magic); on 4+ it fights after the attacker, then is removed.

Wrath of the Lion.brief: your Charge phase, DEATHWING unit that ended a charge move: pick 1 engaged enemy unit, roll 1 D6 per model engaged with it; each 3+ = 1 MW (max 6).

Wrath of the Machine Spirit.brief: Ranged attacks targeting a unit within 12": [Devastating Wounds] vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE.

Wrath of the Omnissiah.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model has shot: 1 enemy unit hit must take a Battle-shock test.

WRATH UNDENIABLE.brief: Fight phase, after targets are selected, 1 targeted LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE unit: until end of phase, each model destroyed by a melee attack before fighting: on a 4+ it fights after the attacker, then is removed.

Wrathful Inferno.brief: Your Movement phase, after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit Falls Back: until end of turn, it can shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Wrathful Presence.brief: Start of battle round: choose one Wrathful Presence ability; this model has it until the start of the next battle round.

WRATHFUL RAMPAGE.brief: Your Movement phase, DEATH COMPANY unit that just Advanced: can charge this turn ; if within 12" of a friendly CHAPLAIN or below Starting Strength, can shoot and charge.

Wreathed in Shadows (Aura, Psychic).brief: Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA or SHADOW LEGION unit within 6": can only be targeted by ranged attacks from models within 18".

Wreathed in Warpflame.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit selected to shoot: its ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

Wreckin' and Lootin'.brief: Your Shooting phase, friendly BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit selected to shoot: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 if the unit or the target is within range of an objective.

Wretched Thralls.brief: Army may include DAMNED units (Codex: Chaos Space Marines) up to 500 pts combined; friendly DAMNED units re-roll Leadership rolls.

Writ of Acquisition.brief: Your Shooting phase, after the bearer's unit shot: gain 1YP per assailed unit hit (max 3YP).

Wurrboy (psyker level 1).brief: This model has the psychic abilities listed below.

Wyredjinn.brief: Start of your Command phase, if on the battlefield: roll 1 D6, +1 if within range of an objective you control; on 4+ gain 1CP.

Wyrmslayer Divination.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Once, your Shooting phase, when the bearer is selected to shoot: until end of phase, attacks vs a unit that can FLY re-roll Hit rolls.

Xenos Hunter.brief: While leading a unit: attacks targeting an enemy unit without IMPERIUM or CHAOS get +1 to Hit.

Xirat’p’s Sorcerous Barrages (Psychic).brief: End of your Movement phase, each enemy unit within 6": roll D6, on 2-3 it suffers 1 MW; on 4-5 D3 MW; on 6 D6 MW.

YOUR TIME IS NIGH.brief: Any phase, just after the enemy WARLORD is destroyed, your NECRONS WARLORD: until end of battle, enemy Battle-shock and Leadership tests -1 to the result.

Yriel's Example.brief: Fight phase, AELDARI INFANTRY unit (not WRAITH CONSTRUCT) just targeted: Feel No Pain 5+ until end of phase.

Yriel's Own.brief: AELDARI units can charge in a turn in which they Advanced; ANHRATHE, RANGERS and SHROUD RUNNERS units re-roll Advance rolls.

Yvraine's Champion.brief: Leading a unit: other CHARACTER models attached to it have Feel No Pain 4+.

Zealot#e15ccb9771.brief: Once per battle, Fight phase: until end of phase, melee weapons of this model get +3 S and +3 A.

Zealot#e20c54f353.brief: Once per battle, Fight phase: until end of phase, +3 A and +3 S on this model's melee weapons.

Zealous Fortitude.brief: This unit has [Feel No Pain 4+] against mortal wounds.

Zealous Path.brief: While leading a unit: re-roll Charge rolls for that unit.

Zealous Vanguard#1358b0bb9e.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have [Scouts 6"].
